title: Scale-Recursive Rectified Flows for Few-Step Precipitation Ensembles
summary: Fine-resolution precipitation estimates support flood risk assessment and water management, but coarse satellite products cannot resolve rainfall within each grid cell. Generative models address this ambiguity by producing ensembles of plausible high-resolution rainfall fields. Among these models, rectified flows generate samples by iteratively transforming random noise into rainfall fields. Reducing the number of sampling steps accelerates generation but can make ensemble members too similar, understating uncertainty. We propose a scale-recursive rectified flow that generates broad patterns before local details and guides sampling-step allocation by comparing ensemble variability with prediction error across spatial scales. Validation scores and rainfall power spectra constrain the allocation to avoid excessive amplification. In satellite-to-radar downscaling over the contiguous United States, our analysis identified broad rainfall patterns as the main source of insufficient ensemble variability under reduced sampling budgets. Allocating more steps to the coarse flow improved probabilistic accuracy and rain detection across training seeds at fixed architecture and computational cost. The proposed model also achieved better probabilistic accuracy with shorter sampling time than a nonrecursive flow using more steps.

AI.tldr: 提出尺度递归整流流模型，通过将采样步数更多地分配给粗尺度生成过程，在固定计算成本下提升降水降尺度集合的概率精度与检测能力。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率降水估计对洪水风险评估和水资源管理至关重要，但粗分辨率卫星产品无法刻画网格内的降雨变异。生成模型可通过产生合理的集合样本缓解这种不确定性，而整流流模型通过迭代将噪声变换为降雨场来采样。减少采样步数可加速生成，但会导致集合成员过于相似，从而低估不确定性。
AI.method: 提出一种尺度递归整流流（scale-recursive rectified flow）：先生成广域大尺度降水格局，再生成局部细节；通过比较各空间尺度上的集合变异性与预测误差，指导采样步数分配；并利用验证分数和降水功率谱约束该分配，避免过度放大。
AI.result: 在美国本土的卫星到雷达降尺度任务中，分析发现大尺度降水格局是有限采样预算下集合变异性不足的主要来源。将更多采样步分配给粗尺度流，在固定架构与计算成本下，跨训练随机种子提升了概率精度与降雨检测能力。所提模型在更短采样时间下即达到比使用更多步的非递归流更好的概率精度。
AI.conclusion: 在采样预算受限时，合理分配采样步数、优先保障大尺度格局的生成，是提升降水降尺度集合质量与不确定性强度的有效途径。

title: Learning When to Commit from Partial Speech for End-to-End Simultaneous Speech Translation
summary: Simultaneous speech translation must emit useful target text before the source is complete while preserving every committed token. We adapt a full-utterance speech language model using prefix supervision derived from its own complete- and partial-waveform translations, requiring neither transcripts nor human translations. We compare single-turn forced-prefix and multi-turn append-only decoding, use a confidence threshold to control the inference-time quality--latency trade-off, and vary the density of training prefixes with a separate synthesis margin. On FLEURS and CoVoST2 in three language directions, prefix training improves quality--latency frontiers over the unadapted model, and confidence provides the broadest consistently competitive operating range. Multi-turn decoding is generally stronger at low latency; under multi-turn training, commit-calibration error falls by 63--68% overall and 68--80% at early prefixes, whereas single-turn training provides only modest overall calibration gains and no early-prefix improvement. A small synthesis margin sometimes extends the frontier to lower latency, particularly on shorter utterances, while a larger margin degrades translation quality and calibration. Prefix adaptation therefore improves simultaneous speech translation, especially under multi-turn append-only decoding, while synthesis density introduces a non-monotonic quality--latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用模型自身全语音与部分波形翻译生成前缀监督，对整句语音语言模型进行同步语音翻译适配，并系统比较单轮强制前缀与多轮追加解码、置信度阈值和前缀密度的影响。
AI.motivation: 同步语音翻译需要在源语音未结束前输出有用目标文本，同时保持已提交词元的一致性。现有整句语音语言模型不适合直接流式使用，而构建前缀监督通常依赖转写或人工翻译，成本高且受限。因此需要一种无需转写和人工翻译的适配方法，并厘清解码方式、延迟控制与训练前缀密度之间的质量—延迟权衡。
AI.method: 方法上，从模型自身的完整波形翻译和部分波形翻译中派生前缀监督，对整句语音语言模型进行前缀适配，无需转写或人工翻译；比较单轮强制前缀解码与多轮追加式解码；推理时用置信度阈值控制质量—延迟权衡；训练时通过单独的合成边距调节训练前缀密度，并考察不同边距大小的影响。
AI.result: 在FLEURS和CoVoST2的三个语言方向上，前缀训练相比未适配模型改善了质量—延迟前沿，置信度提供最宽且持续有竞争力的工作范围。多轮解码通常在低延迟下更强；在多轮训练下，提交校准误差整体下降63%–68%，早期前缀下降68%–80%；单轮训练仅带来有限的整体校准增益，且早期前缀无改善。较小的合成边距有时可将前沿扩展到更低延迟，尤其在较短话语上；较大边距则会降低翻译质量与校准。
AI.conclusion: 前缀适配能够改善同步语音翻译，在多轮追加式解码下效果尤为明显；合成密度引入非单调的质量—延迟权衡，较小边距可能有益，较大边距则损害翻译质量与校准。

title: VERSE: Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses
summary: Harness evolution improves an LLM agent's prompts, tools, and workflow, while the optimizer's own tools and procedures often remain fixed. We study whether an optimizer can improve another agent more effectively by also improving how it diagnoses failures, develops edits, and tests their effects. Two observations guide our design. In a controlled study, optimizer self-evolution fails to improve performance without execution-based verification, but achieves the best result of that study when verification is available. Across five executors, self-evolving optimizers build their own tools for failure analysis, verification, training audits, and workflow control. Motivated by these findings, we introduce VERSE, a Verified Self-Evolving optimizer for agent harnesses. VERSE lets the optimizer test draft edits, replay failures, and perturb suspected steps before submission, while tracking fixes and regressions across rounds. Using this feedback, the optimizer revises both the executor harness and its own prompts, skills, tools, hooks, and notes, while the weights of the optimizer and executor models stay fixed. Under a shared protocol with disjoint training, validation, and test tasks, VERSE improves all four evaluated harness optimizers on held-out SWE-rebench tasks and newer out-of-distribution tasks in five languages. Its best validation-selected harness reaches 42.3% and 37.7% accuracy, respectively, against 39.2% and 29.3% for the strongest baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/wzekai/VERSE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VERSE，一种带有执行验证的自进化优化器，通过同时改进失败诊断、编辑生成与效果测试流程，在不更新模型权重的情况下提升智能体外壳（harness）的优化效果。
AI.motivation: 已有工作中，外壳进化只改进被执行智能体的提示、工具与工作流，而优化器自身的工具与流程保持固定。作者希望探究：优化器能否通过改进自身诊断失败、生成编辑和测试效果的方式，更有效地优化另一个智能体。
AI.method: 基于两项观察设计：(1) 控制实验中，缺少基于执行验证时优化器自进化无法提升性能，而有验证时取得最佳结果；(2) 在五个执行器上，自进化优化器会自建失败分析、验证、训练审计与工作流控制工具。据此提出VERSE：允许优化器在提交前测试草稿编辑、回放失败、扰动可疑步骤，并跨轮次追踪修复与回归；据此同步修改执行器外壳与优化器自身的提示、技能、工具、钩子与笔记，且优化器与执行器模型权重均冻结。
AI.result: 在训练、验证、测试任务互不相交的共享协议下，VERSE在SWE-rebench留出任务及五种语言的新分布外任务上提升了全部四个被测外壳优化器。其经验证集挑选的最佳外壳准确率分别达42.3%与37.7%，而最强基线为39.2%与29.3%。
AI.conclusion: 执行验证是优化器自进化生效的关键；让优化器同时进化自身诊断与验证流程，可稳定超越固定优化器流程的基线，且无需更新模型权重。代码已开源。

title: Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出IG-VLA框架：通过潜在时空推理在视觉表征空间想象未来场景演变，并用场景要旨记忆将推理结果内化为紧凑的Scene Gist Token，在保持未来推理收益的同时大幅降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型虽引入中间推理改善机器人操作，但主要针对已观测状态推理，缺乏对未来场景演变的显式预期；而在每个推理步都进行显式未来rollout会带来巨大计算开销。
AI.method: 两大组件：(1) Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning，在视觉表征空间直接想象任务相关的未来场景演变，指导动作预测，无需昂贵的像素级视频生成；(2) Scene Gist Memory，将推理得到的场景-行为关联内化为紧凑的Scene Gist Token，使推理时可绕过显式未来想象。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和VLABench上验证有效性与效率。LIBERO-Plus Language套件上，推理策略与要旨策略均比最强基线成功率高出近6%；要旨策略相比基线最高加速6.38倍，单张NVIDIA A6000上每动作块推理延迟从1081ms降至169.5ms。
AI.conclusion: 未来时空推理可被有效内化，从而实现高效的VLA部署。

title: Capturing Dynamics: The 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset
summary: The estimation and analysis of facial expression intensity play a crucial role in affective communication and human-computer interaction. Previous research has primarily focused on detecting and estimating facial expression intensity from frame-level 2D representations. However, this limitation restricts a comprehensive understanding of real-world facial expressions, as they are inherently 3D and temporally continuous. This paper investigates the perception of facial expression intensity by introducing the 4D Facial Expression Intensity Dataset (4DFEID). We employ a parametric face model and compile a total of 2,869 mesh sequences with controlled geometric variations, generating 4D data instances with diverse peak intensities and identity attributes. Using a Likert scale, we collect more than 90,000 subjective intensity perception ratings via a crowdsourcing platform. We explore various architectures and aggregation methods to establish baselines for episode intensity estimation on the new dataset, revealing that spatial-temporal graph models consistently outperform traditional frame-aggregation methods. In contrast to existing datasets that rely on 2D static imagery, the proposed 4D-FEID dataset provides the community with a unique and vital resource for investigating the perception of facial expression intensity through the use of dynamic 3D stimuli. By offering high-fidelity, spatio-temporally coherent facial data, 4D-FEID establishes a new foundation for research into more nuanced and naturalistic expression analysis, thereby addressing a gap in the current landscape of affective computing and human-computer interaction studies. The dataset is available at link.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了4D面部表情强度数据集4DFEID，通过参数化面部模型生成2,869个网格序列，并收集超90,000条主观强度评分，建立了情节级强度估计基线。
AI.motivation: 以往面部表情强度研究多基于帧级2D表示，难以全面刻画真实表情的3D本质与时间连续性，缺乏动态3D刺激下的强度感知数据与基准。
AI.method: 采用参数化面部模型，构建2,869个具有受控几何变化（峰值强度与身份属性多样）的网格序列，生成4D数据实例；通过众包平台以Likert量表收集超90,000条主观强度感知评分；探索多种架构与聚合方法，建立情节强度估计基线。
AI.result: 时空图模型在强度估计任务上持续优于传统帧聚合方法。
AI.conclusion: 4DFEID以高保真、时空连贯的4D面部数据，为动态3D刺激下的表情强度感知研究提供新资源与基准，弥补了情感计算与人机交互领域的空白。

title: SpectralCache: Accelerating Diffusion-Based World Models via Spectral Feature Caching
summary: Diffusion-based world models enable high-quality interactive environment generation but suffer from substantial inference overhead due to repeated Transformer evaluations during denoising. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy at the feature or token level, leaving the underlying mathematical structure of diffusion features largely unexplored. In this work, we reveal that world-model features exhibit highly stable singular subspaces across nearby denoising steps, while their singular values follow predictable evolution patterns. Building on this observation, we propose SpectralCache, a training-free spectral caching framework that reuses stable singular subspaces and estimates only low-dimensional singular values through linear extrapolation. We further exploit the spectral consistency between neighboring full-computation features to skip selected expensive backbone evaluations via singular value scaling. Extensive experiments on representative world models demonstrate that SpectralCache consistently improves inference efficiency while preserving generation quality. On HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B, SpectralCache achieves 5.22x acceleration while maintaining a WorldScore of 65.90 for static scenes, substantially outperforming existing training-free caching methods in inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpectralCache，一种免训练的谱域缓存框架，通过复用稳定的奇异子空间并线性外推低维奇异值来加速扩散式世界模型推理。
AI.motivation: 扩散式世界模型虽能高质量生成交互式环境，但去噪过程中反复的 Transformer 评估带来巨大的推理开销。现有缓存方法主要在特征或 token 层面利用时间冗余，未充分挖掘扩散特征背后的数学结构。
AI.method: 发现世界模型特征在相邻去噪步间具有高度稳定的奇异子空间，且奇异值遵循可预测演化规律。基于此提出 SpectralCache：复用稳定奇异子空间，仅通过线性外推估计低维奇异值；并利用相邻全计算特征的谱一致性，通过奇异值缩放跳过部分昂贵的骨干网络评估。该方法无需训练。
AI.result: 在代表性世界模型上，SpectralCache 在保持生成质量的同时持续提升推理效率。在 HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B 上实现 5.22 倍加速，静态场景 WorldScore 达 65.90，推理效率显著优于现有免训练缓存方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过挖掘扩散特征的谱结构（奇异子空间稳定性与奇异值演化规律），SpectralCache 为世界模型推理加速提供了免训练、高效的缓存新范式。

title: Large Language Continuous Diffusion Models
summary: Despite the success of discrete diffusion language models (dLMs) for fast parallel decoding, their non-smooth, high-dimensional space hinders trajectory steering for reasoning and inference acceleration. To overcome this, we present Sigma, the first large-scale (3B/8B) continuous dLM built on steerable, low-dimensional ODE/SDE latent trajectories. Trained blockwise via likelihood optimization, Sigma jointly denoises Gaussian-corrupted token embeddings while learning an optimal embedding geometry. To accelerate training, Sigma leverages pre-trained weights from autoregressive (AR) models for warm-starting. During inference, we identify classifier-free guidance and score temperature as essential for high-fidelity reasoning and coding. Across comprehensive math reasoning and coding evaluations against state-of-the-art discrete counterparts (masked dLMs and AR baselines), Sigma achieves competitive performance with discrete models on standard benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, Minerva, HumanEval, MBPP) after pre-training and on challenging reasoning tasks (e.g., MATH-500, AIME) after supervised fine-tuning. Beyond performance parity, we uncover key structural properties unique to continuous dLMs: (i) embedding-space steering effectively governs the quality-diversity trade-off, yielding strong pass@k performance and (ii) continuous trajectories enable graceful degradation for low NFEs and efficient distillation. These establish continuous dLMs as a promising paradigm for efficient language generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sigma，首个 3B/8B 大规模连续型扩散语言模型，基于可操控的低维 ODE/SDE 潜轨迹，通过分块似然训练与预训练自回归权重热启动，在数学推理与代码任务上达到与离散 dLM 及 AR 基线相当的性能，并揭示连续轨迹在质量-多样性权衡、低 NFE 鲁棒性与蒸馏效率上的独特优势。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型（dLMs）虽支持快速并行解码，但其非平滑、高维的离散空间阻碍了对推理过程与推理加速的轨迹操控。作者希望借助连续的、低维的、可操控的 ODE/SDE 潜轨迹来克服这一瓶颈，并验证连续 dLM 能否在保持竞争力的同时实现更优的效率与可控性。
AI.method: 1）构建 Sigma，首个 3B/8B 规模连续 dLM，在可操控的低维 ODE/SDE 潜轨迹上建模；2）采用分块（blockwise）似然优化训练，同时去噪被高斯噪声破坏的 token 嵌入并学习最优嵌入几何；3）利用预训练 AR 模型权重进行热启动以加速训练；4）推理阶段引入无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）与 score temperature 作为高保真推理与代码生成的关键要素。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码的综合评测中，与最强离散对手（掩码 dLM 与 AR 基线）对比：预训练后在 GSM8K、Minerva、HumanEval、MBPP 等标准基准上取得竞争力表现；监督微调后在 MATH-500、AIME 等困难推理任务上同样具竞争力。此外发现连续 dLM 的独有结构性质：(i) 嵌入空间引导可有效调控质量-多样性权衡，带来强 pass@k 表现；(ii) 连续轨迹在低 NFE 下平滑退化，并支持高效蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 连续 dLM 在性能上可与离散模型持平，同时在可控性、低 NFE 鲁棒性与蒸馏效率方面具备独特优势，确立了其作为高效语言生成范式的前景。

title: CHASE-VLA: Post-Training Quantization Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models with Chunk-Aware Scale Estimation
comment: Accepted at ACCV 2026. 22 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions, but a diffusion-based action expert (AE) poses a key challenge for low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ). The AE is repeatedly invoked across denoising steps and policy queries, where fixed calibration scales can be mismatched with activation ranges that vary with denoising progress and intended motion. We propose CHASE-VLA, a chunk-aware PTQ method that exploits a VLA-specific signal readily available from the policy: the generated action chunk, including its unexecuted future suffix. Rather than relying only on static scale matching for AE layers, CHASE-VLA combines the previously generated chunk as causal action context with denoising step group information to adapt AE activation scales. This enables W4A4 quantization of both MLP and attention projections in the repeated AE without modifying the pretrained policy. On LIBERO, CHASE-VLA achieves 97.3% average success rate on $π_{0.5}$ when both MLP and attention projections in the AE are quantized to W4A4, restoring FP16-level performance. CHASE-VLA also reduces the weight storage of the quantized AE linear layers by 73.4% and their single-chunk memory traffic by 70.9% and 71.2% on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.6, respectively, with a predictor overhead of at most 1.26% of the saved storage.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CHASE-VLA，一种面向VLA模型中扩散动作专家（AE）的块感知（chunk-aware）后训练量化（PTQ）方法，利用策略产生的动作块（含未执行未来后缀）作为因果动作上下文，结合去噪步分组信息自适应调整AE激活缩放，实现AE中MLP与注意力投影的W4A4量化，几乎无损地恢复FP16性能。
AI.motivation: VLA模型将视觉观测与语言指令映射为连续机器人动作，但其基于扩散的动作专家（AE）在低比特PTQ中面临挑战：AE在去噪步骤与策略查询中被反复调用，固定的校准缩放无法匹配随去噪进度和预期运动而变化的激活范围，导致量化误差大。
AI.method: 提出CHASE-VLA块感知PTQ方法，利用VLA特有的可用信号——生成的完整动作块（包括尚未执行的未来后缀）。不再仅依赖AE层的静态缩放匹配，而是将先前生成的动作块作为因果动作上下文，与去噪步分组信息结合，自适应地调整AE激活缩放，从而在修改预训练策略的前提下实现对重复AE中MLP与注意力投影的W4A4量化。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上，对π_{0.5}的AE中MLP与注意力投影均量化至W4A4时，CHASE-VLA取得97.3%的平均成功率，恢复至FP16水平。量化后AE线性层权重存储减少73.4%；单块内存流量在π_{0.5}与GR00T N1.6上分别减少70.9%与71.2%；预测器开销至多为所节省存储的1.26%。
AI.conclusion: CHASE-VLA通过利用动作块因果上下文与去噪步分组自适应激活缩放，有效解决了扩散动作专家低比特PTQ的激活范围失配问题，在不修改预训练策略的情况下实现W4A4量化并保持FP16级性能，同时显著降低存储与内存流量，开销可忽略。

title: LEAP: Learning Efficient Action Proposals For LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents are known to be slow in rollouts. An agent completes a task one step at a time. At each step, it reasons and then chooses an action to execute. The next step and action cannot start until the previous one has finished. Speculative decoding accelerates the rollouts at the reason phase by drafting and verifying the inference tokens. Recent works have also started to apply similar ideas at the action phase. These works use off-the-shelf models, usually large, to draft action proposals for target model to verify. Large drafters match the target more often but take longer to propose, while small off-the-shelf models are fast but rarely make the same decision as the target. We ask a more general question: what determines the end-to-end speedup of action speculation? To answer it, we develop a latency framework for the speculative round. The framework compares what a round gains with what it costs. The gain depends on how well the drafter predicts the target and on how many steps the task can take before it ends. The cost comes from drafting, from waiting for target verification and from executing tools. Guided by the framework, we introduce LEAP (Learning Efficient Action Proposals) which keeps the drafter small and makes it accurate by training it on the target actions sequences. With a small 0.6B model, LEAP agrees with the target on most decisions and makes agents up to 60% faster in end-to-end wall clock time, with no systematic change in task success. Across various datasets, target models and draft models, the framework accounts for most of the measured speedups. We also show the draft model can be online trained with no prior trace collection and match the performance of offline training, making LEAP practical to deploy in the real world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出延迟框架分析动作投机（action speculation）的端到端加速来源，并据此设计 LEAP：用小规模 drafter（0.6B）在目标动作序列上训练以提高预测准确率，使 LLM agent 端到端墙上时钟时间最多加速 60%，且任务成功率无系统性变化。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 的 rollout 速度慢：每个 step 需依次完成推理与动作执行，串行依赖导致延迟高。推理阶段已有 speculative decoding 加速，动作阶段的投机研究也开始出现，但现有方法多用现成的大模型做 drafter（匹配率高但耗时长）或小模型（快但决策一致性差）。作者提出更根本的问题：决定动作投机端到端加速的因素是什么。
AI.method: 1) 建立投机轮次（speculative round）的延迟框架，将一轮的收益与成本进行对比：收益取决于 drafter 对目标预测的准确度以及任务在执行结束前还能进行多少步；成本来自 drafting、等待目标模型验证以及工具执行。2) 在该框架指导下提出 LEAP（Learning Efficient Action Proposals）：保持 drafter 规模小，通过在目标模型的动作序列上训练使其预测准确。3) 支持无预先轨迹收集的在线训练方式。
AI.result: 使用 0.6B 小模型时，LEAP 在大多数决策上与目标模型一致，使 agent 端到端墙上时钟时间最多加快 60%，且任务成功率无系统性变化。在多种数据集、目标模型与 draft 模型上，该框架能解释大部分实测加速幅度。在线训练在无预先轨迹收集的情况下可达到与离线训练相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 动作投机的端到端加速由 drafter 预测准确度、任务剩余步数及 drafting/验证/工具执行成本共同决定；将 drafter 保持小规模并通过在目标动作序列上训练提升其准确性，可在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下显著降低 agent 端到端延迟，且在线训练使 LEAP 具备实际部署可行性。

title: Asterism: Exploring and Synthesizing Scattered Observations into Literature-Grounded Hypotheses and Theories
summary: A theory draws many independent observations into one framework with novel hypotheses. A researcher building such a theory must synthesize observations scattered across many papers, each describing related concepts but often in different terms. Which concepts matter most also depends on their preferences and research questions. Recent approaches scale theory synthesis with LLMs, but automate away choices and intuitions from researchers. We present Asterism, which extracts observations from hundreds of papers as concept-relation triples, with concepts unified in a hierarchical ontology. Researchers curate an evidence graph using the ontology and aggregate observations at different levels of granularity to focus theory formation on specific phenomena of interest. In a field deployment (n=10), researchers worked from observations to theories, and kept concepts and hypotheses fitting their preferences. In two case studies, teams of immunology and agriculture researchers discovered mechanisms outside their standard analyses and constructed hypotheses worth follow-up experiments.

AI.tldr: Asterism 从数百篇论文中抽取"概念-关系"三元组并统一到层级本体，研究者可据此策展证据图并在不同粒度聚合观察以形成理论。
AI.motivation: 理论构建需将散落在大量论文中的观察综合为统一框架，但各论文概念表述不一；哪些概念重要也取决于研究者偏好与问题。已有 LLM 方法虽能扩展理论综合，却自动化地剥离了研究者的选择与直觉。
AI.method: Asterism 抽取数百篇论文的观察为概念-关系三元组（concept-relation triples），概念在层级本体（hierarchical ontology）中统一；研究者借助该本体策展证据图（evidence graph），并在不同粒度层级聚合观察，将理论构建聚焦于特定感兴趣现象。
AI.result: 在实地部署（n=10）中，研究者从观察推进到理论，并保留了符合自身偏好的概念与假设。在免疫学与农业两个案例研究中，团队发现了其常规分析之外的机制，并提出了值得后续实验验证的假设。
AI.conclusion: Asterism 通过"本体统一＋证据图策展＋多粒度聚合"的交互式流程，将 LLM 的可扩展性与研究者的偏好、直觉结合，支持可扩展且以人为本的理论综合。

title: One Photon, Many Worlds: Posteriors and Predictions with Single-Photon Cameras
summary: Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras operate fundamentally differently from conventional cameras due to their photon-counting nature. Each frame produces a binary image: pixels report zero if no photons arrived during exposure, and one if one or more photons arrived. Reconstructing a scene or inferring its properties from a single binary frame is difficult because many different images could produce the same measurement; thus, the inverse problem is fundamentally one-to-many. As we gather more binary measurements, the inherent uncertainty associated with the inverse problem and any associated inference diminishes. With sufficient photon counts, photon noise becomes negligible relative to the signal mean, enabling near-deterministic scene recovery and inference. This work characterizes the transition from stochastic to near-deterministic scene understanding as photon budget increases, analyzing how the stochasticity in photon arrival affects downstream inference tasks. Technically, we develop a conditional generative framework based on a Hypergeometric frame-thinning process for accumulated binary SPAD measurements. Generative models capture the one-to-many nature of photon-starved inverse problems, enabling empirical characterization of how this ambiguity diminishes with increasing measurements and its impact on downstream tasks like character recognition, QR code decoding, and facial analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究SPAD相机在光子预算增加过程中，从随机到近确定性场景理解的转变。
AI.motivation: SPAD相机具有光子计数特性，单帧为二值图像，反问题本质是一对多，重建与推断困难；随着测量增多不确定性降低，需要刻画这一过渡过程及其对下游任务的影响。
AI.method: 基于超几何帧抽稀（Hypergeometric frame-thinning）过程，为累积二值SPAD测量构建条件生成框架。
AI.result: 生成模型刻画了光子稀缺反问题的一对多性质，并经验性地表征了歧义随测量增加而降低的过程，以及对字符识别、QR码解码和人脸分析等下游任务的影响。
AI.conclusion: 随着光子预算提高，随机性影响减弱，场景理解接近确定性；该框架可用于分析光子到达随机性对下游推断的作用。

title: Large language models exhibit unreliable updating of clinical judgment as patient evidence evolves
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for clinical reasoning, but whether they appropriately revise judgments as patient evidence evolves remains unclear. We evaluated longitudinal belief updating using matched intensive-care trajectories from electronic health records. Across diverse LLMs, conditioning on a preceding judgment more often increased than reduced prediction error when estimates changed, replicated for a second endpoint. Controlled interventions revealed two failure modes. First, with preceding assessment fixed, models responded more strongly to worsening than matched improving respiratory evidence; this asymmetry persisted after headroom normalization at moderate and strong evidence levels. Second, with current evidence fixed, increasing prior risk from 10% to 90% shifted estimates by 26.2 percentage points, demonstrating causal influence of prior model beliefs. Prompting did not restore reliable updating. Evidence-Validated Longitudinal Update (EVLU) identified fewer, more reliable revisions, revealing a reliability-coverage trade-off. These findings establish longitudinal belief updating as a distinct dimension of LLM reliability.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估大语言模型在临床纵向证据演进下的信念更新能力，发现模型在前序判断条件下更新常增加而非降低预测误差，并揭示出对恶化证据过度敏感、前序信念因果性影响估计两类失效模式，提示纵向信念更新是LLM可靠性的独立维度。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用于临床推理，但能否随患者证据演变而恰当修正判断尚不清楚；纵向信念更新的可靠性缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 基于电子健康记录中配对的ICU轨迹评估纵向信念更新；跨多种LLM检验前序判断条件化的影响，并用第二个终点重复；采用受控干预：固定前序评估时比较恶化与改善的呼吸证据反应强度（含headroom归一化），固定当前证据时将前序风险从10%提升至90%检验其因果影响；再测试提示策略与EVLU方法。
AI.result: 条件化于前序判断时，估计发生变化的情况下预测误差更常升高而非降低，且在第二终点复现；模型对恶化证据的反应强于匹配的改善证据，该不对称在headroom归一化后于中等和强证据水平下仍存在；当前证据固定时，前序风险由10%升至90%使估计偏移26.2个百分点，证明前序信念的因果影响；提示未能恢复可靠更新；EVLU识别出更少但更可靠的修正，呈现可靠性—覆盖度权衡。
AI.conclusion: 纵向信念更新是LLM可靠性的一个独立维度；现有模型在临床证据演进下更新存在系统性偏差，需针对性方法（如EVLU）在可靠性与覆盖度间权衡。

title: GeoScaffold: Learning Compact Geometric Latents via Reconstruction for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Recent vision-and-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adopt streaming Video-LLM policies that map egocentric RGB observations and instructions directly to low-level actions. Yet these policies inherit weak 3D geometric priors from 2D pretraining. Existing geometry-aware extensions charge a persistent inference-time price: depth sensors, 3D encoders, or per-step perception tool calls. We propose GeoScaffold, a geometric supervision framework that pays this price once, at training time, by internalizing geometry into the policy itself. It first learns a compact depth tokenizer on depth maps from the training trajectories and freezes it. It then fine-tunes the policy with a handful of learnable geometry query tokens, training their hidden states to reconstruct navigation-critical geometry such as depth, connectivity, and traversability. This supervision turns the query states into compact geometric latents for action decoding, and through the shared weights also internalizes geometry into the backbone's own representations. Like a scaffold, the tokenizer, target generators, and reconstruction heads are discarded after training, leaving the backbone and action interface unchanged. Extensive experiments show that GeoScaffold consistently outperforms leading vision-only navigators on continuous VLN benchmarks, offering a practical paradigm for lightweight edge deployment of spatially aware embodied navigation models.

AI.tldr: 提出 GeoScaffold 几何监督框架，在训练阶段一次性将几何先验内化进流式 Video-LLM 导航策略，推理时无需深度传感器或 3D 编码器，保持原有骨干与动作接口不变，在连续 VLN 基准上优于纯视觉导航器。
AI.motivation: 现有流式 Video-LLM 导航策略直接由自我中心 RGB 观测与指令映射到低层动作，从 2D 预训练中继承的 3D 几何先验薄弱；而现有几何增强方案需在推理时持续付出代价，如依赖深度传感器、3D 编码器或逐步调用感知工具，难以轻量部署。
AI.method: 1) 在训练轨迹的深度图上学习一个紧凑的深度分词器（depth tokenizer）并将其冻结；2) 用少量可学习的几何查询 token 微调策略，训练其隐状态重建导航关键几何（深度、连通性、可通行性）；3) 该监督使查询状态成为用于动作解码的紧凑几何隐变量，并通过共享权重将几何内化到骨干表示中；4) 训练后丢弃分词器、目标生成器与重建头，形成"脚手架"式设计。
AI.result: 在连续 VLN 基准上，GeoScaffold 持续优于当前领先的纯视觉导航器，且推理时保持原始骨干与动作接口，无额外感知开销。
AI.conclusion: GeoScaffold 以"训练时付费、推理时免费"的范式，为空间感知的具身导航模型提供了一种轻量边缘部署的实用方案。

title: STRIDE: Spatial-Temporal Representation for Interval-conditioned Disease Evolution in Longitudinal Glioblastoma MRI
summary: Glioblastoma (GBM), an aggressive primary brain tumor, is routinely monitored with longitudinal MRI after treatment. Distinguishing stable disease (SD), pseudoprogression (PsP), and true progression (TP) remains challenging because these states can show overlapping MRI appearances despite different temporal trajectories. Existing longitudinal methods still face challenges in modeling scan-specific spatial variability, variable follow-up intervals, and complementary information from the observed follow-up state and its longitudinal change. We propose STRIDE, a framework for spatial-temporal representation of interval-conditioned disease evolution that takes paired post-treatment MRI scans and their inter-scan interval as input and predicts SD, PsP, or TP. The lesion-prior-guided spatial representation combines SoftGate and an Adaptive-window Hierarchical Transformer (AWHT) to emphasize lesion-related regions while preserving surrounding context. The time-conditioned latent transition uses pair-level context and the actual inter-scan interval to estimate interval-dependent representation changes between visits. The observed--transition fusion integrates the transition-estimated follow-up representation with the directly observed follow-up representation to jointly characterize the follow-up state and its longitudinal change. BraTS2024 is used to develop and evaluate the lesion-prior generator, while longitudinal pretraining on LUMIERE supports transfer before downstream adaptation to Burdenko. On the Burdenko three-class task, STRIDE achieves a macro ROC--AUC of 0.816 and a macro F1-score of 0.796. These results support its potential for more reliable longitudinal post-treatment GBM state assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出STRIDE框架，以治疗后的配对MRI及扫描间隔为输入，通过病灶先验引导的空间表征、时间条件潜在转移和观测-转移融合，区分胶质母细胞瘤的稳定、假性进展与真性进展，在Burdenko三分类任务上macro AUC 0.816、macro F1 0.796。
AI.motivation: 胶质母细胞瘤治疗后常规用纵向MRI随访，但稳定疾病（SD）、假性进展（PsP）与真性进展（TP）在单次MRI上表现重叠、仅时间轨迹不同，鉴别困难。现有纵向方法在扫描特异空间变异、随访间隔不固定、随访状态与其纵向变化互补信息建模方面仍有不足。
AI.method: STRIDE由三部分构成：1）病灶先验引导的空间表征，结合SoftGate与自适应窗口层次Transformer（AWHT），突出病灶相关区域并保留周边上下文；2）时间条件潜在转移，利用配对级上下文与实际扫描间隔估计间隔依赖的表征变化；3）观测-转移融合，将转移估计的随访表征与直接观测的随访表征结合，共同刻画随访状态及其纵向变化。病灶先验生成器在BraTS2024上开发评估，并在LUMIERE上纵向预训练以支持向Burdenko的下游迁移。
AI.result: 在Burdenko三分类任务上达到macro ROC-AUC 0.816、macro F1-score 0.796。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明STRIDE有望用于更可靠的胶质母细胞瘤治疗后纵向状态评估。

title: Learning from Evolving Errors: Adaptive Iterative Repair for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supplies dense token-level feedback on trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, a richer training signal than the outcome-level rewards of reinforcement learning. This feedback comes from a teacher conditioned on a full reference solution unavailable to the student. The reference solution specifies the target but not how to move from the student's current error toward it, creating a solution-conditioned shortcut risk. We introduce AIR-OPD, an adaptive iterative repair framework for on-policy distillation that provides error-to-repair supervision. Given a failed response, a guidance generator synthesizes repair guidance for the current error. The student samples an on-policy retry with this guidance. If the retry remains incorrect, the generator produces new repair guidance for the newly observed error. At each round, a fixed teacher receives the guidance as privileged context and supervises the student on an error-aligned region of its latest failed response. Outcome-aware stage weighting favors early repair stages and credits stages whose immediate retry passes verification. We train AIR-OPD on the DAPO-Math-17K dataset and evaluate on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, alongside out-of-distribution tests on MMLU-Pro and GPQA. We examine two guidance sources, self-guidance from the current student policy and external guidance from a larger model. For both Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, AIR-OPD attains the best mathematical-reasoning averages, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 3.6 points, while preserving base-model performance on the out-of-distribution benchmarks.

AI.tldr: AIR-OPD是一种用于在线策略蒸馏的自适应迭代修复框架，通过错误到修复的监督解决参考解条件捷径风险，在数学推理基准上取得最佳平均成绩。
AI.motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）提供密集的token级反馈，优于强化学习的结果级奖励。但其反馈来自以完整参考解为条件的教师，而学生无法获得该参考解。参考解只指定目标而不指明如何从学生当前错误走向目标，从而产生"解条件捷径风险"——学生可能依赖参考解而非真正学会修复错误。
AI.method: 提出AIR-OPD（自适应迭代修复框架），提供错误到修复的监督：给定失败回答，引导生成器针对当前错误合成修复引导；学生据此进行在线策略重试；若仍错误，则为新观察到的错误生成新引导。每轮中，固定教师将引导作为特权上下文，在最新失败回答中与错误对齐的区域上监督学生。采用结果感知阶段加权，偏向早期修复阶段，并对即时重试通过验证的阶段给予奖励。检查两类引导源：来自当前学生策略的自引导与来自更大模型的外部引导。
AI.result: 在DAPO-Math-17K上训练，在AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25及分布外测试MMLU-Pro和GPQA上评估。对Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B，AIR-OPD均取得最佳数学推理平均成绩，相较最强基线提升最高达3.6分，同时在分布外基准上保持基础模型性能。
AI.conclusion: AIR-OPD通过迭代修复监督有效缓解了解条件捷径风险，在数学推理任务上超越强基线且不损害分布外泛化能力。

title: Silent Dissent: LLM Agents That Yield to the Majority Still Represent Their Original Premise
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary material in ancillary files
summary: Multi-agent debate is increasingly used to reach consensus among LLM agents, yet agents often yield to a unanimous majority. When an agent changes its answer, has it changed its mind or only its statement? We study this with two-hop factual questions whose intermediate entity (the bridge, e.g. the country in "the capital of the country where the Sagrada Familia is located") is never stated by anyone. Scripted peers, in the role of Asch's confederates, unanimously assert a wrong answer taken from another fact with a different bridge. At the moment the agent answers, we read the bridge from its residual stream with the Jacobian lens (J-lens) and, for comparison, the logit lens. In pre-registered tests on held-out facts with four open-weight models, agents of Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma-4-E4B-it that gave in still represented their original bridge in the pre-registered layers below the output (hit@100 above a control entity: 0.85, 0.22 and 0.24), where the logit lens rarely ranked it among the top 100 tokens (0.00-0.06). These agents also represented the bridge behind the peers' answer, beyond a mention baseline. A pre-registered addendum hid the agent's earlier answer or removed it: agents that gave in still represented their original bridge in all four models (0.43, 0.29, 0.37 and 0.25 with the answer hidden), including Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, which barely did so with its answer in view (0.03). The premise can thus be computed from the question alone while the agent states the majority's answer. Hiding the earlier answer also changed conformity: Qwen3.5-4B gave in on 89% of questions instead of 8%. In exploratory interventions, injecting the bridge's J-lens direction brought agents back to their original answer only in the two Qwen models. Stated consensus in multi-agent debate can thus overstate agreement. We also report the negative results of our pre-registered program.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过J-lens探针研究发现，多智能体辩论中"屈服"的LLM智能体在输出层之下仍保留着自己原本的推理桥接实体，说明其改变的是表述而非内心判断，一致共识可能高估真实一致性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论被广泛用于让LLM智能体达成共识，但智能体常屈服于一致多数。核心疑问是：当智能体改变答案时，它是真正改变了想法，还是仅改变了陈述？这一问题关系到辩论共识的有效性。
AI.method: 采用两跳事实性问题，其中间实体（bridge）从未被任何人说出。脚本化同伴扮演Asch实验中的从众者，一致断言一个取自另一事实、具有不同bridge的错误答案。在智能体作答时，用Jacobian lens（J-lens）从残差流中读取bridge，并与logit lens对比。在留出事实上对四个开放权重模型进行预注册测试，并加入预注册附录（隐藏或移除智能体先前答案）及探索性干预。
AI.result: 在预注册层，Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-27B和Gemma-4-E4B-it中屈服的智能体仍表征原始bridge（hit@100相对控制实体为0.85、0.22、0.24），而logit lens很少将其排入前100（0.00-0.06）。智能体还表征了同伴答案背后的bridge。隐藏先前答案后，四个模型仍表征原始bridge（0.43、0.29、0.37、0.25），包括Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（有答案时仅0.03）。隐藏答案还改变从众率：Qwen3.5-4B从8%升至89%。
AI.conclusion: 前提可从问题本身计算得出，而智能体却陈述了多数答案；多智能体辩论中的表面共识可能高估真实一致程度。注入bridge的J-lens方向仅在两个Qwen模型中使智能体回归原答案，论文同时报告了预注册程序的负结果。

title: WakeKV: Reactive, Reversible KV Residency for Heads That Change Their Minds
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on ML for Systems. 2 figures, 4 tables, appendix
summary: Most KV-cache compression methods classify attention heads once, either offline or during prefill, and keep this classification fixed throughout generation. Across three models (1.5B-8B) and three regimes (needle retrieval, long chain-of-thought, and multi-turn recall), we measure head behavior on four model-regime combinations and find that most heads change their reading behavior at least once during generation. We introduce WakeKV, a reactive residency policy that moves cooling heads to a recoverable CPU reservoir rather than freezing or permanently evicting their state. At matched memory or budget, WakeKV consistently improves miss rate over frozen classification and destructive eviction, evaluated across five model-regime combinations and over three cited baselines (SnapKV, uniform R-KV, and ReasonAlloc) across four eligible combinations. A FlexiCache/vLLM implementation on Mistral-7B confirms the benefit on real hardware, improving throughput while retaining LongBench quality.

AI.tldr: 本文将注意力头在生成过程中的行为分类视为动态过程，提出 WakeKV——一种响应式驻留策略，把"冷却"的头迁移到可恢复的 CPU 存储池，而非冻结或永久驱逐其状态，从而在同等内存或预算下降低 KV-cache 的 miss rate 并提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: 现有 KV-cache 压缩方法大多在离线阶段或 prefill 阶段对注意力头做一次性分类，并在整个生成过程中保持不变。作者通过测量发现，这一"静态分类"假设与真实行为不符：在 1.5B–8B 三个模型、三类任务范式（needle retrieval、长链式思维、多轮召回）共四种"模型—范式"组合上，大多数头在生成过程中至少改变过一次读取行为。因此固定分类会导致压缩决策与实际读写需求错配。
AI.method: 提出 WakeKV，一种响应式（reactive）驻留策略：对行为转为"冷却"的头，不采取冻结（frozen classification）或破坏性驱逐（destructive eviction），而是将其状态迁移至可恢复的 CPU reservoir，使其在后续需要时可被重新唤醒。并在 FlexiCache/vLLM 上以 Mistral-7B 实现，验证真实硬件可行性。
AI.result: 在匹配内存或预算条件下，WakeKV 在五个"模型—范式"组合上相较固定分类与破坏性驱逐持续降低 miss rate；在与三个被引基线（SnapKV、uniform R-KV、ReasonAlloc）的可比组合（共四个）中均有对比结果。Mistral-7B 的 FlexiCache/vLLM 实现证实该收益可落地于真实硬件，在保持 LongBench 质量的同时提升吞吐。
AI.conclusion: 注意力头的读取行为在生成过程中是动态变化的，静态一次分类不足；采用"冷却即可恢复迁移"的响应式驻留策略能够在同等资源约束下获得更优的压缩权衡，且已在真实推理框架上验证其吞吐与质量收益。

title: Revisiting Visual Representation Enhancement of VLMs via Kernel Canonical Correlation Analysis
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP exhibit strong semantic generalization, but remain limited in fine-grained visual perception. A recent work named KUEA presents a natural remedy by finetuning the image encoder under the supervision of the vision-centric DINOv2 to align their kernel matrices element-wisely, while regularizing the embeddings to remain close to the pretrained visual encoder for preserving image-text semantics in CLIP. However, we show that diminishing the role of the alignment loss to DINOv2 does not necessarily degrade its fine-grained visual performance, suggesting that the kernel-matrix discrepancy may be insufficient for further visual representation enhancement, motivating us to revisit the alignment formulation. In this work, we present a novel perspective to characterize representation alignment on feature subspaces through Kernel Canonical Correlation Analysis (KCCA), which maximizes the projection correlations. In optimization, we derive an efficient end-to-end training scheme upon KKT conditions, avoiding the eigenvalue problem in KCCA. Further, we extend our method into a 3-view formulation, i.e., 3vKCCA, in which the projections from the pretrained text encoder are also incorporated under a unified optimization framework for joint alignment. With CLIP ViT-L/14 on ImageNet-1K, our 3vKCCA improves the MMVP-VLM accuracy from 17.8 to 25.9, substantially outperforming the existing methods, and meanwhile maintains zero-shot image--text retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 本文指出KUEA中对DINOv2的核矩阵对齐损失并非细粒度视觉性能的关键，提出基于核典型相关分析（KCCA）的特征子空间对齐视角，并推导KKT条件下的高效端到端训练方案，进一步扩展为融合预训练文本编码器投影的三视图形式3vKCCA。在ImageNet-1K上使用CLIP ViT-L/14，MMVP-VLM准确率由17.8提升至25.9，同时保持零样本图文检索性能。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉-语言模型语义泛化强，但细粒度视觉感知不足。已有方法KUEA通过以DINOv2为监督逐元素对齐图像编码器核矩阵来增强细粒度能力，但作者发现削弱该对齐损失并不必然降低细粒度视觉表现，说明核矩阵差异不足以刻画并进一步提升视觉表征，因此需要重新审视对齐的建模方式。
AI.method: 从特征子空间对齐的新视角出发，采用核典型相关分析（KCCA）建模表征对齐，通过最大化投影相关性来刻画对齐。优化上，基于KKT条件推导高效端到端训练方案，避免求解KCCA中的特征值问题。进一步提出三视图形式3vKCCA，将预训练文本编码器的投影也纳入统一优化框架进行联合对齐。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上使用CLIP ViT-L/14，3vKCCA将MMVP-VLM准确率从17.8提升到25.9，显著优于现有方法，同时保持零样本图文检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 核矩阵逐元素对齐对细粒度视觉表征增强并不充分；通过KCCA在特征子空间上建模对齐、并扩展为融合文本视图的3vKCCA，可在不损失CLIP图文语义能力的前提下显著提升细粒度视觉感知，为视觉-语言模型的表征对齐提供了新的有效范式。

title: SymRegFlow: Symmetry-Regularized Flow Matching for Video World Models
summary: Flow-matching-based multi-view world models generate realistic videos, but are commonly restricted to fixed camera rigs. Extending them to continuously varying camera poses requires paired pose--video observations with dense pose coverage, which are costly to acquire. We introduce \emph{SymRegFlow}, a symmetry-regularized flow-matching framework for multi-view-consistent video generation across continuous viewpoints without ground-truth novel-view RGB supervision. For each target pose, SymRegFlow geometrically warps source views into noisy anchors and combines masked dual-anchor supervision with cross-anchor denoising-output consistency to mitigate anchor-specific errors. Under an affine Gaussian surrogate, we prove that suitable consistency regularization recovers the clean-reference optimum at fixed noise levels, strictly outperforming single- and merged-anchor baselines. Experiments on Cosmos-Drive-Dreams and nuScenes demonstrate high-quality, multi-view-consistent autonomous-driving video generation: on nuScenes, SymRegFlow achieves the lowest FVD and FVMD among the evaluated baselines, reducing FVD by over 31\% relative to the best baseline, and source-conditioned inference also attains the best FID and instance preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出SymRegFlow，一种对称正则化的流匹配框架，在无需novel-view RGB监督下实现连续视角的多视图一致视频生成。
AI.motivation: 基于流匹配的多视图世界模型可生成逼真视频，但通常局限于固定相机位姿；扩展到连续变化位姿需大量带密集位姿覆盖的配对位姿–视频观测，获取成本高昂。
AI.method: 对每个目标位姿，将源视图几何变换为含噪锚点，结合掩码双锚点监督与跨锚点去噪输出一致性以减少锚点特定误差；并在仿射高斯替代模型下进行理论分析，证明适当的一致性正则可恢复干净参考最优解。
AI.result: 在Cosmos-Drive-Dreams和nuScenes上实现高质量、多视图一致的自动驾驶视频生成；在nuScenes上取得最低FVD和FVMD，FVD较最佳基线降低超过31%，源条件推理也获得最佳FID和实例保持。
AI.conclusion: SymRegFlow无需novel-view RGB监督即可实现连续视角的多视图一致视频生成，理论上严格优于单锚点和合并锚点基线，实验验证其在自动驾驶视频生成任务上的领先性能。

title: TPBench: A Turning-Point Benchmark for Dialogue Compression
summary: A compressor can keep the facts of a dialogue and still drop the turn that changed them. A user corrects a price, reverses a choice, or adds a constraint. We call this failure turning-point eviction. One overall retention score hides it, because that score mixes what the user first wanted with what the user wants now. We introduce TPBench, which evaluates three complementary information targets at shared nominal retention budgets. P1 asks for the user's initial goal. P2 asks for the current value of a slot the user revised. P3 asks for both, in dialogues with a late annotated slot update. The current-value answers come from the human dialogue-state annotations of MultiWOZ and SGD. The initial-goal answer is the first sentence of the first user turn. Neither requires new crowdsourcing. The probe-specific evaluations rank compression methods differently. On the joint probe at a retained fraction of 0.30, every tested compressed method remains below full context with the main Llama reader. Deleting the turn that carries the update sharply lowers current-value accuracy, while deleting one matched irrelevant turn leaves it unchanged. A Mistral reader repeats the P2/P3 rankings and the joint-probe gap. Current-value recovery is tested on an additional corpus, LongMemEval-KU, and on Chinese RiSAWOZ: full context has the highest accuracy, and recency has the highest compressed-method mean in both evaluations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"转折点驱逐"这一对话压缩失效模式，并构建TPBench基准，通过三个互补探测任务（P1初始目标、P2当前值、P3联合）在相同名义保留预算下评测压缩方法，发现不同探测对方法排序不同，且所有压缩方法在联合探测上均落后于完整上下文。
AI.motivation: 现有对话压缩评测只用单一整体保留分数，该分数混合了用户最初想要的信息与当前所需信息，因而掩盖了一类关键失效：压缩器可能保留了对话事实，却丢弃了改变这些事实的那一轮对话（用户改价、反转选择或新增约束）。作者将此失效命名为"转折点驱逐"，需要一个能按信息目标拆分的评测基准来暴露它。
AI.method: 提出TPBench，在共享的名义保留预算下评测三个互补信息目标：P1要求用户初始目标（取首轮用户第一句），P2要求用户已修改槽位的当前值（来自MultiWOZ与SGD的人工对话状态标注），P3要求两者兼得且在对话后期存在标注的槽位更新。所有答案均复用既有标注，无需新众包。此外在LongMemEval-KU及中文RiSAWOZ上补充评测当前值恢复，并对比Llama与Mistral两种阅读器。
AI.result: 探测专属评测对压缩方法的排序不同。在保留比例0.30的联合探测上，所有被测压缩方法在Llama主阅读器下均低于完整上下文；删除承载更新的那一轮会显著降低当前值准确率，而删除一个匹配的不相关轮则无影响。Mistral阅读器复现了P2/P3排序及联合探测差距。在LongMemEval-KU与中文RiSAWOZ上，完整上下文准确率最高，两种评测中"近期优先"（recency）在压缩方法中均值最高。
AI.conclusion: 单一整体保留分数无法诊断转折点驱逐，需按P1/P2/P3分离评测。实验证明该失效真实存在且对承载更新的轮次高度敏感，现有压缩方法在联合探测上仍不及完整上下文，且最优压缩策略随阅读器与语料而异（recency在补充语料中表现最好），提示未来压缩方法需显式保护状态更新轮次。

title: Beyond Correctness: Resolving Underspecification in Agentic Text-to-SQL
summary: Agentic Text-to-SQL systems can interact with users to clarify underspecified queries before generating SQL. However, a correct execution result does not necessarily imply that the agent has adequately resolved the underlying underspecification: the agent may silently make unverified assumptions that happen to match the intended answer. We show that this behavior is driven in part by premature clarification termination. Although forcing an agent to ask more questions improves execution accuracy, ambiguities are concentrated in earlier interactions, making brute-force questioning inefficient. More importantly, even when explicitly prompted to plan its clarification process, the agent frequently abandons questions that it has already identified as relevant. To address this failure mode, we introduce PlanPool, which externalizes the clarification plan as a mutable question pool. Every planned question must be explicitly asked or dropped before submission, while newly discovered ambiguities can be added during interaction. Across three benchmarks derived from BIRD-Interact and Spider, PlanPool consistently improves ambiguity coverage and reduces silent failures over unconstrained and prompt-based alternatives, while maintaining competitive execution accuracy. Our results highlight an important distinction in agentic reasoning: identifying missing information is not sufficient, and the agent must also reliably maintain and resolve it before committing to an answer.

AI.tldr: 提出PlanPool方法，将澄清计划外化为可变问题池，强制每个计划问题被显式提出或丢弃，以提升Agentic Text-to-SQL的歧义覆盖并减少静默失败。
AI.motivation: Agentic Text-to-SQL系统虽能与用户交互澄清欠明确查询，但正确执行结果并不代表歧义被真正解决——智能体可能静默做出未经验证的假设并恰好命中答案。作者发现该行为部分源于“过早终止澄清”，且即使被显式提示规划澄清流程，智能体也常放弃已识别为相关的问题。
AI.method: 提出PlanPool，将澄清计划外化为可变问题池：每个计划问题在提交前必须被显式提出或丢弃，交互中新发现的歧义可动态加入池中。
AI.result: 在基于BIRD-Interact和Spider构建的三个基准上，PlanPool相比无约束和基于提示的替代方案，一致地提升歧义覆盖率并减少静默失败，同时保持有竞争力的执行准确率。
AI.conclusion: 识别缺失信息并不充分，智能体还须在给出答案前可靠地维护并解决这些信息，这是智能体推理中的一个重要区分。

title: EpiWorld: Grounding LLM Policy Agents in Epidemiological World Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 22 pages
summary: Epidemic intervention policies are textual artefacts that human decision-makers interpret, justify, and revise through natural language, making large language models a natural candidate for epidemic policy reasoning. A naive LLM, however, lacks the epidemic dynamics needed to project intervention consequences, the quantitative surveillance signals required to assess severity, and the institutional constraints that define admissible actions. We present EpiWorld, a closed-loop framework that grounds an LLM policy actor in a learned action-conditioned epidemiological world model and a tiered skill library of public-health protocols, surveillance tools, and adaptive lessons accumulated through after-action analysis. Given a candidate intervention, the world model predicts regional epidemic evolution and enables fast counterfactual rollouts that provide feedback for policy selection and refinement. Outcomes of simulated futures are distilled into reusable lessons while protocol constraints remain fixed, allowing the decision process to improve without sacrificing interpretability or controllability. We evaluate both the world model and the end-to-end framework on retrospective COVID-19 and Influenza datasets: the world model achieves the best out-of-distribution Peak-MAE among all forecasting baselines, and the closed-loop framework reduces cumulative hospitalisation by up to 59% across datasets and by an average of ~16% across six LLM backbones, outperforming reinforcement-learning and optimal-control policy baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出EpiWorld：将LLM政策actor锚定于动作条件流行病世界模型与分层技能库的闭环框架，用于流行病干预政策推理与优化。
AI.motivation: 流行病干预政策是通过自然语言解释、论证与修订的文本产物，适合LLM推理；但朴素LLM缺乏流行病动力学预测能力、量化监测信号与制度约束（可用行动范围）。
AI.method: 构建闭环框架：LLM政策actor + 学习的动作条件流行病世界模型 + 分层技能库（公共卫生协议、监测工具、事后分析积累的自适应经验）。给定候选干预，世界模型预测区域疫情演化并支持快速反事实推演，为政策选择与改进提供反馈；将模拟未来结果蒸馏为可复用经验，同时固定协议约束以保持可解释性与可控性。
AI.result: 在回顾性COVID-19与Influenza数据上评估：世界模型在所有预测基线中取得最优的分布外Peak-MAE；闭环框架跨数据集最多降低累计住院率达59%，在六种LLM骨干上平均降低约16%，优于强化学习与最优控制策略基线。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM政策推理与世界模型仿真、协议化技能库结合，可在保持可解释性与可控性的前提下显著提升流行病干预决策质量。

title: Correcting Guided Diffusion Trajectories with Spectral Alignment
summary: The practical success of conditional image generation hinges on fine-grained differences in condition alignment and visual fidelity. Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is central to this success, but its lack of an explicit criterion makes it difficult to assess whether the guided trajectory is progressing as intended. To address this gap, we show that spectral alignment provides a principled criterion for understanding guidance behavior and improving guided diffusion sampling through adaptive correction. Our analysis identifies the spectra of intermediate states as an indicator of consistency with the expected spectral evolution of the forward process. Based on this observation, we introduce Spectral Correction Guidance, a method that corrects deviations from an analytic reference spectrum during sampling. The proposed method is training-free and applicable across diffusion backbones and conditional generation tasks without modifying the underlying model. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains in preference-based metrics over baseline guidance methods in text-to-image generation and improved generation quality over CFG on ImageNet. These improvements persist across a range of guidance scales and with fewer denoising steps. Our analyses and ablations provide insight into guidance behavior and how the proposed method affects generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出谱校正引导（Spectral Correction Guidance），利用频谱对齐作为理解引导行为的准则，通过在校样过程中校正偏离解析参考谱的偏差来改进条件扩散采样，无需训练即可跨骨干网络和任务通用。
AI.motivation: 条件图像生成的成功依赖条件对齐与视觉保真度的细粒度差异，而分类器无引导（CFG）虽然关键，但缺乏显式准则，难以判断引导轨迹是否按预期进展。因此需要一个有原则的准则来理解引导行为并改进采样。
AI.method: 作者发现中间状态的频谱可作为与正向过程预期谱演化一致性的指标，据此提出谱校正引导（Spectral Correction Guidance）：在采样过程中将中间状态频谱校正至解析参考谱，从而纠正偏离。该方法无需训练，适用于不同扩散骨干网络与条件生成任务，且不修改底层模型。
AI.result: 在文本到图像生成中，相比基线引导方法在基于偏好的指标上获得一致提升；在 ImageNet 上相比 CFG 生成质量更好。这些改进在较宽的引导尺度范围和更少去噪步数下依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 频谱对齐为理解并改进引导扩散采样提供了有原则的准则，所提谱校正引导方法通用、无需训练且有效，分析与消融实验进一步揭示了引导行为及该方法对生成质量的影响机制。

title: FiberGeoText: A Vision-Language Model for Population- Level Organization of Superficial White Matter
summary: The superficial white matter (SWM), a critical brain region for cognition across the lifespan and brain disease, contains abundant short-range association fibers whose organization remains incompletely characterized, in part because the short trajectories and highly variable cortical folding make correspondence across individuals challenging. Anatomically corresponding connections may vary in spatial location across individuals and therefore may not be adequately defined by geometric proximity alone. We introduce FiberGeoText (FGT), a vision-language model (VLM) for organizing short-range superficial white matter (SWM) streamlines reconstructed from ultra-high-resolution diffusion MRI into population-level clusters. FGT jointly represents three complementary properties of each streamline: its three-dimensional trajectory, its cortical anatomical context, and its shape. Cortical endpoint information from multiple parcellation schemes is expressed as text and encoded using a pretrained large language model (LLM), enabling heterogeneous anatomical descriptions to contribute to a common continuous representation. We evaluated FGT on acquired submillimeter 0.76 mm diffusion MRI data. Compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, FGT produced substantially greater cortical parcel coherence, within-cluster shape consistency, cluster-size consistency, and cross-subject correspondence. The trained model also generalizes well to unseen subjects with an average of 96.7% of the 5,000 learned clusters recovered, and high consistency of cluster structure between training and testing data. Together, these findings demonstrate that integrating geometric, anatomical, and shape information by learning multimodal deep embeddings with a VLM model enables robust learning of population-consistent SWM organization despite interindividual anatomical variability.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉-语言模型 FiberGeoText (FGT)，联合流线三维轨迹、皮层解剖文本上下文与形状，将超高清弥散MRI重建的短程浅表白质流线组织为群体一致的聚类。
AI.motivation: 浅表白质富含有短程联络纤维，是认知与脑疾病的关键区域，但其组织方式尚未充分刻画；短轨迹与高度变异的皮层折叠使个体间对应困难，且解剖对应的连接在空间位置上因人而异，仅靠几何邻近无法充分定义。
AI.method: FGT 为视觉-语言模型，联合表示每条流线的三种互补属性：三维轨迹、皮层解剖上下文与形状。将多种脑图谱分区方案得到的皮层端点信息表达为文本，用预训练大语言模型（LLM）编码，使异构解剖描述贡献于统一的连续表征。在 0.76 mm 亚毫米弥散MRI数据上评估。
AI.result: 与SOTA方法相比，FGT 在皮层分区一致性、簇内形状一致性、簇大小一致性与跨被试对应性上显著更优；训练模型可良好泛化到未见被试，平均恢复5,000个学习簇中的96.7%，训练与测试数据间簇结构高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉-语言模型学习多模态深度嵌入，整合几何、解剖与形状信息，可在存在个体间解剖变异的情况下稳健学习群体一致的浅表白质组织。

title: When History Fails to Become Experience: Action Calibration in Language Agents
summary: Language agents should draw on prior attempts and environmental feedback to improve subsequent decisions within the same task. However, providing additional interaction history can sometimes reduce task success, suggesting that agents do not consistently use this information effectively. To investigate this limitation, we examine how agents use history. We find that history improves task completion overall, yet much of this benefit persists even when past actions are shuffled. Disrupting the correspondence between actions and observations causes only a modest decline in task success. We therefore hypothesize that agents do not reliably connect past actions with their outcomes when deciding how to proceed. To test this hypothesis, we explicitly label each returned observation as the outcome of the preceding action. This simple annotation improves task success and reduces next-action repetition without introducing new environmental information. Building on this insight, we introduce a learned calibrator that explicitly reassesses past actions and selectively records experience to guide subsequent decisions, improving task success beyond outcome labeling alone.

AI.tldr: 语言智能体虽能借助历史信息提升任务完成度，但该收益在动作被打乱时大部分仍保留，说明其未能可靠地将过去动作与其结果对应；通过显式标注观察为前一动作的结果可提升成功率并减少动作重复，进一步提出的学习型校准器选择性地记录经验，效果优于单纯标注。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体本应利用先前尝试与环境反馈来改进同一任务中的后续决策，但研究发现增加交互历史有时反而降低任务成功率，表明智能体并未始终有效利用这些信息。因此，作者希望探究该局限的根源，即智能体究竟如何使用历史。
AI.method: 首先通过扰动实验考察历史的使用方式：打乱过去动作的顺序，以及破坏动作与观察之间的对应关系，观察任务成功率的变化。随后在假设成立的基础上，对返回的观察显式标注其为前一动作的结果。进而在此基础上提出一个学习型校准器（learned calibrator），显式重新评估过去动作并选择性地记录经验以指导后续决策。
AI.result: 历史整体上能提升任务完成度，但该收益在动作被打乱后大部分仍存在；破坏动作与观察的对应关系仅造成任务成功率的适度下降。显式标注观察为前一动作的结果可提升任务成功率并减少下一步动作的重复，且未引入新的环境信息。学习型校准器在任务成功率上进一步超过单纯的标注方法。
AI.conclusion: 语言智能体的局限在于未能可靠地将过去动作与其结果相关联，而非历史信息本身无用。通过显式建立动作—结果对应关系（标注）并选择性记录经验（校准器），可有效改善智能体的历史利用效率与决策质量。

title: AptMQL-Bench: From Text-to-SQL to Text-to-MQL via Access-Pattern Schema Design and Data-Preserving Migration
summary: Document databases such as MongoDB are core infrastructure for modern applications, and natural-language interfaces to them---text-to-MQL---would let non-experts query complex, semi-structured data without mastering the query language. Progress on this task depends on high-quality benchmarks, which are most practically obtained by converting an existing text-to-SQL benchmark to the document setting. Unfortunately, existing efforts rely on heuristics for mechanical conversion: the document schema mirrors the relational foreign-key graph, and each query mirrors its source SQL. As a result in our experiments, these approaches fail to migrate 6 of 21 BIRD databases outright, silently drop up to 25.9\% of rows on others, and yield schemas whose ground-truth queries run over an order of magnitude slower as the data scales. We instead propose a conversion pipeline, driven by coding agents with human-in-the-loop verification, that designs each document schema from expected access patterns and rewrites queries to be MongoDB-native. Applying it to BIRD, we build an access-pattern-based text-to-MQL benchmark (AptMQL-Bench). It includes 21 document-oriented databases, 3,186 natural-language requests, and their associated MQL queries---whose databases are migrated from SQLite without data loss and scale efficiently. The strongest model, Claude Opus 4.5, achieves only 57.38\% accuracy without external knowledge evidence and 70.34\% with it. This indicates that realistic text-to-MQL generation remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种由编码智能体驱动、带人工验证的转换流水线，将BIRD文本到SQL基准转化为文档数据库基准，构建了基于访问模式的text-to-MQL基准AptMQL-Bench（21个数据库、3,186条自然语言请求及对应MQL查询）。最强模型Claude Opus 4.5在无外部知识证据时准确率仅57.38%，有证据时为70.34%，表明真实场景下的text-to-MQL生成仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 文档数据库（如MongoDB）是现代应用的核心基础设施，text-to-MQL自然语言接口可让非专家查询复杂半结构化数据。该任务进展依赖高质量基准，而最实用的获取方式是将现有text-to-SQL基准转换为文档场景。但现有工作依赖启发式机械转换：文档模式镜像关系型外键图，查询镜像源SQL。实验表明，这些方法在21个BIRD数据库中有6个直接迁移失败，在其余数据库上最多静默丢失25.9%的行，且生成模式上的真实查询随数据规模增长运行速度慢一个数量级以上。因此需要一种更合理的转换方式。
AI.method: 作者提出一条由编码智能体驱动、结合人工在环验证的转换流水线：不是机械映射，而是根据预期访问模式设计每个文档模式，并将查询重写为MongoDB原生形式。将该流水线应用于BIRD，构建了基于访问模式的text-to-MQL基准AptMQL-Bench，包含21个面向文档的数据库、3,186条自然语言请求及其对应MQL查询，数据库从SQLite迁移且无数据丢失、可高效扩展。
AI.result: AptMQL-Bench包含21个文档数据库、3,186条自然语言请求及对应MQL查询；数据库从SQLite迁移时无数据丢失，并可高效扩展。在评测中，最强模型Claude Opus 4.5在无外部知识证据时准确率为57.38%，提供外部知识证据时为70.34%。
AI.conclusion: 基于启发式的机械转换在保真度和可扩展性上存在严重缺陷，而面向访问模式的、智能体驱动且带人工验证的转换能构建更真实、可扩展的text-to-MQL基准。即便最强模型在AptMQL-Bench上准确率也仅57.38%（含外部知识证据为70.34%），说明真实场景下的text-to-MQL生成仍是具有挑战性的开放问题。

title: Improving Atomic-Fact Recall via Focused Views in Unstructured Knowledge Editing
comment: The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as general-purpose interfaces to factual knowledge, but their parameters do not automatically reflect information that changes after pretraining. Knowledge editing (KE) provides a targeted alternative to costly retraining by modifying selected knowledge and preserving unrelated knowledge and general capabilities. Conventional KE uses structured factual triples, whereas unstructured KE (UKE) uses free-form passages containing multiple facts. Nonetheless, existing UKE editors exhibit a failure mode known as context reliance: edited LLMs can often reproduce the editing passage but fail to reliably recall its individual facts without the original passage context. We identify context-induced difficulty underestimation under the standard passage-level editing objective: later facts receive increasingly rich ground-truth context and consequently incur lower initial losses, making them appear easier to learn. In response, we propose FOVEATED, a plug-and-play framework that constructs focused views of each sentence by randomly shifting the Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) positions assigned to the keys of its preceding context. The perturbation is applied during editing and removed afterward, leaving the model's native positional encoding unchanged at inference time. We instantiate FOVEATED for both direct-optimization and locate-then-edit editors. We theoretically analyze how FOVEATED counteracts context-induced difficulty underestimation and empirically demonstrate consistent improvements across five KE editors, two LLM backbones, and three benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非结构化知识编辑(UKE)中的"上下文依赖"失效模式，提出即插即用框架FOVEATED，通过对前文键的RoPE位置随机偏移构造聚焦视图，缓解上下文诱导的难度低估问题，并在多种编辑器与基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正成为事实知识通用接口，但参数无法自动反映预训练后变化的信息；知识编辑(KE)可在不重训练前提下修改特定知识并保留无关能力。非结构化KE以自由文本段落承载多条事实，然而现有编辑器存在"上下文依赖"失效模式：模型能复述整段编辑文本，却在脱离原文上下文时无法可靠召回其中单条事实。
AI.method: 作者识别出标准段落级编辑目标下的"上下文诱导难度低估"现象：靠后的事实获得更丰富的真实上下文，初始损失更低，显得更易学习。为此提出FOVEATED框架，为每个句子构造聚焦视图——对前文上下文键所分配的旋转位置编码(RoPE)位置进行随机偏移；该扰动仅在编辑阶段施加，编辑完成后移除，推理时模型原生位置编码保持不变。作者将其实例化到直接优化型与定位再编辑型编辑器中，并从理论上分析FOVEATED如何抵消上下文诱导的难度低估。
AI.result: 在五种知识编辑编辑器、两种LLM骨干网络与三个基准上，FOVEATED均展现出一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: FOVEATED是一种即插即用、推理时零开销的框架，通过编辑期的RoPE位置扰动构造聚焦视图，有效缓解非结构化知识编辑中的上下文依赖问题，具备良好的通用性与可迁移性。

title: Automatic Evaluation of Mental Health Stigma in Online Communication
summary: Mental health stigma has profoundly harmful impacts but its complexity makes it difficult to evaluate. Stigma may involve explicit derogation, but also subtler forms of blame, fear, paternalistic pity, social distancing, structural exclusion, and discrimination. We introduce a theory-grounded benchmark for automatic evaluation of mental health stigma in online communication, consisting of naturally occurring online news and social media text annotated with a fine-grained taxonomy of stigma across multiple mental health conditions. Our annotation framework comprises a binary stigma-detection task and a multi-level taxonomy covering (i) stigma mode, (ii) domain, and (iii) specific components of certain forms of stigma. We apply this framework to texts mentioning six mental health conditions and evaluate large language models alongside stigma-related classifiers for detecting sentiment, toxicity, and hate speech. Results show that mental health stigma is not well captured by models trained to detect these neighboring constructs, and that LLMs often overpredict stigma unless given explicit operational rules - mirroring the importance of decision rules in human annotation. We release the publicly available part of benchmark, annotations, prototypical exemplars of stigma and code at: https://github.com/jemimakang/mh_stigma.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于理论的心理健康污名自动评估基准，涵盖在线新闻与社交媒体文本，配有细粒度标注体系，并发现现有模型难以有效捕捉污名，大模型缺乏明确规则时易过度预测。
AI.motivation: 心理健康污名危害深远但结构复杂，既包含显性贬低，也包含责备、恐惧、家长式怜悯、社交疏离、结构性排斥与歧视等隐性形式，导致难以评估。既有针对情感、毒性、仇恨言论等邻近构念的模型未必能捕捉污名的独特特征，因此需要一个理论驱动的自动化评估基准。
AI.method: 构建一个理论驱动的基准，使用自然发生的在线新闻和社交媒体文本，覆盖多种心理健康状况，并按细粒度污名分类体系进行标注。标注框架包括二分类污名检测任务，以及多层级分类体系，涵盖（i）污名模式、（ii）领域、（iii）特定污名形式的具体组成要素。将框架应用于提及六种心理健康状况的文本，并评测大语言模型以及针对情感、毒性和仇恨言论的污名相关分类器。
AI.result: 结果表明，心理健康污名并不能被用于检测情感、毒性和仇恨言论等邻近构念的模型很好地捕捉；大语言模型在缺乏明确操作规则时往往会过度预测污名，这与人类标注中决策规则的重要性相一致。
AI.conclusion: 心理健康污名需要专门的理论驱动评估框架，邻近构念分类器不足以替代；显式操作规则对模型和人工标注都至关重要。作者公开了基准的公开部分、标注、污名典型样例及代码，链接为：https://github.com/jemimakang/mh_stigma。

title: TRAC: Trajectory-aware Reuse and Adaptive Correction for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: In this paper, we present trajectory-aware reuse and adaptive correction (TRAC), a training-free framework for efficient autoregressive (AR) video generation. Existing acceleration methods mainly target single-trajectory generation with bidirectional attention. AR video generation, by contrast, sequentially couples chunk-level denoising trajectories. Consequently, approximation errors accumulate and propagate through the generation process. TRAC addresses this challenge with three components, including robust cumulative scheduling (RCS), autoregressive trajectory-aware guidance scheduling (ATGS), and spectral structure correction (SSC). RCS selects cache reuse schedules by cumulative rollout error and cross-chunk/prompt variation. ATGS coordinates CFG refreshes along the global AR trajectory. SSC restores low-frequency structure of the first chunk to correct long-term structural loss. Experiments on SkyReels-V2 and FramePack-F1 show that, compared with existing methods, TRAC achieves both the highest inference efficiency and the best generation quality for AR video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架TRAC，通过轨迹感知复用与自适应校正加速自回归视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有加速方法主要针对双向注意力的单轨迹生成，而自回归（AR）视频生成按块级去噪轨迹顺序耦合，导致近似误差在生成过程中累积并传播，因此需要专门的加速方案。
AI.method: TRAC包含三个组件：鲁棒累积调度（RCS），依据累积展开误差及跨块/跨提示变化来选择缓存复用调度；自回归轨迹感知引导调度（ATGS），沿全局AR轨迹协调CFG刷新；频谱结构校正（SSC），恢复首块的低频结构以校正长时结构损失。
AI.result: 在SkyReels-V2和FramePack-F1上的实验表明，与现有方法相比，TRAC在AR视频生成中同时取得了最高推理效率和最佳生成质量。
AI.conclusion: TRAC是一种无需训练的AR视频生成加速框架，通过缓存复用调度、CFG引导调度与频谱校正协同应对轨迹耦合带来的误差累积，实现了效率与质量的双优。

title: OPD Before RL: Warm-Starting Rubric-Based RL with On-Policy Distillation
summary: Many useful language-model tasks cannot be evaluated by exact outcome verification. Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) addresses this issue by scoring open-ended responses against explicit criteria. However, because the reward is assigned after the complete response, the training signal does not directly identify which individual decisions contributed to the final score. We propose a two-stage training framework that uses rubrics first as privileged teacher context for dense token-level supervision, then as rewards for further RL. In the first stage, rubric-privileged on-policy distillation (RP-OPD), a student without access to the rubric matches a rubric-aware teacher's next-token distributions at student-generated prefixes. In the second stage, RL directly optimizes the rubric reward and improves beyond the observed distillation plateau. We evaluate the framework on health and science tasks using open-weight models. Across HealthBench, ResearchQA, and RubricHub Science, we compare post-training methods and vary the amount of SFT or RP-OPD training before RL, finding that our two-stage framework achieves the highest scores among the methods evaluated. RP-OPD + RL shows limited signs of reward hacking on RubricHub Science, whereas the SFT + RL baseline increasingly receives high rewards for claims of rubric compliance without providing the required content. These findings support using rubrics to guide on-policy distillation before applying rubric-based RL.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架：先用评分标准作为特权教师上下文进行稠密token级蒸馏（RP-OPD），再将其作为RL奖励优化，在健康与科学任务上取得最优表现并抑制奖励劫持。
AI.motivation: 开放式生成任务无法用精确结果验证来评价，基于评分标准（rubric）的强化学习虽可对开放式回答打分，但奖励在完整回答生成后才给出，无法直接指出哪些具体决策贡献了最终得分，导致训练信号稀疏、信用分配困难。
AI.method: 两阶段训练框架。第一阶段为"评分标准特权在线策略蒸馏"（RP-OPD）：教师模型可访问rubric，学生模型不可访问，学生在自己生成的prefix上匹配教师下一token分布，获得稠密的token级监督。第二阶段：直接以rubric奖励进行RL优化，突破蒸馏阶段的表现瓶颈。实验在HealthBench、ResearchQA、RubricHub Science上，使用开放权重模型，对比不同后训练方法，并改变RL前的SFT或RP-OPD训练量。
AI.result: 在三种基准上，该两阶段框架在所评估方法中得分最高。RP-OPD + RL在RubricHub Science上奖励劫持迹象有限；而SFT + RL基线则越来越多地通过声称"符合评分标准"却不提供所需内容来获取高奖励。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持先用评分标准引导在线策略蒸馏、再应用基于rubric的RL这一训练范式，能有效利用评分标准实现稠密监督并缓解奖励劫持。

title: Beyond Token Accuracy: Prioritizing What Matters for Visual Reconstruction
summary: Tokens have become a unified interface for multimodal foundation models, making visual-token communication a natural paradigm for efficient image delivery. However, existing methods typically rely on static policies that cannot jointly adapt to image content and channel conditions. Moreover, their token-level utility objectives do not necessarily translate into improved image reconstruction quality. In this paper, we propose AdapToC, an adaptive, reconstruction-oriented visual-token communication framework. At the transmitter, an adaptive selector jointly models image content, channel state, and communication budget to perform instance-wise resource allocation. Rather than using a fixed token rate and protection policy, it dynamically determines how many tokens should be transmitted and assigns different protection levels according to token importance and current channel conditions. At the receiver, an adaptive MaskGIT receiver incorporates channel reliability into contextual token modeling. It distinguishes tokens with different reliability levels, preserves high-confidence observations, corrects potentially corrupted tokens, and iteratively reconstructs missing content from the received evidence and global visual context. By co-designing token quantity, unequal protection, and reliability-aware recovery for image-level reconstruction quality, AdapToC achieves a peak mean PSNR gain of 4.20 dB over the strongest static baseline under matched communication costs and state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated visual-token communication methods.

AI.tldr: 提出AdapToC，一个面向重建质量的自适应视觉token通信框架，在发射端联合建模图像内容、信道状态与通信预算进行实例级资源分配（动态确定token数量与差异化保护），在接收端采用自适应MaskGIT接收机区分可靠token、纠正潜在损坏token并从全局视觉上下文迭代恢复缺失内容，在同等通信开销下较最强静态基线峰值平均PSNR提升4.20 dB。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token通信方法多依赖静态策略，无法同时适应图像内容与信道条件；且其token级效用目标并不必然转化为图像重建质量的提升。
AI.method: 发射端自适应选择器联合建模图像内容、信道状态与通信预算，实现实例级资源分配：动态决定传输token数量，并依据token重要性与当前信道条件分配不同保护等级（不等保护）。接收端自适应MaskGIT接收机将信道可靠性纳入上下文token建模，区分不同可靠性等级的token，保留高置信观测、纠正可能被破坏的token，并从已接收证据与全局视觉上下文迭代重建缺失内容。整体以token数量、不等保护与可靠性感知恢复的协同设计服务于图像级重建质量。
AI.result: 在匹配的通信开销下，相较最强静态基线取得峰值平均PSNR增益4.20 dB，并在所评估的视觉token通信方法中达到最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 面向图像级重建质量的自适应、联合优化设计（自适应token数量+不等保护+可靠性感知恢复）能显著优于静态策略与token级效用导向的方法，为多模态基础模型中的高效图像传输提供了有效范式。

title: FUSEye: Training-Light Fisheye Detection with Overlapping Views and Zero-Initialized Adapters
comment: Source code will be available at https://github.com/Su-wenya/FUSEye
summary: Fisheye cameras give mobile robots a single-sensor, low-cost view of their surroundings, yet the COCO-pretrained detectors that practitioners routinely reuse fail on them: strong radial distortion warps local image structure, while boundary compression shrinks objects to near-invisible sizes. Full fine-tuning closes much of the gap but requires abundant fisheye labels and compute. We present FUSEye, a training-light framework that turns a frozen-backbone COCO-pretrained extra-large YOLO26 detector (YOLO26-x) into a fisheye detector. FUSEye adds roughly 227k new parameters while updating the inserted modules and the pretrained detection head. It addresses the transfer gap at three causally linked levels. At the input level, overlapping grid view generation and box remapping (GridViews) enlarge compressed boundary regions. At the feature level, zero-initialized residual adapters (Z-Adapters) correct distortion-induced feature misalignment. At the decision level, learned cross-projection agreement fusion (AgreeFusion) promotes low-confidence detections only when they are supported by consistent evidence across multiple views. On the WoodScape surround-view fisheye benchmark, FUSEye raises YOLO26-x from 0.148 to 0.266 mAP50 and retains 84.3% fully fine-tuned accuracy. Moreover, randomly using only 25% of the labeled training images, FUSEye achieves 0.2597 mAP50, retaining 97.6% of its full-label performance. FUSEye also consistently improves YOLOv8-11 detectors, showing that the recipe is architecture-agnostic. Source code will be available at https://github.com/Su-wenya/FUSEye.

AI.tldr: FUSEye 是一种训练轻量框架，将冻结骨干的 COCO 预训练 YOLO26-x 转为鱼眼检测器，仅新增约 227k 参数，在 WoodScape 基准上将 mAP50 从 0.148 提升至 0.266。
AI.motivation: 鱼眼相机为移动机器人提供低成本单传感器全景感知，但常用的 COCO 预训练检测器在其上失效：强径向畸变扭曲局部结构，边界压缩使目标缩小至近乎不可见。全量微调虽能缩小差距，但需大量鱼眼标注与算力。
AI.method: 框架针对迁移鸿沟在三个因果关联层级进行适配。输入层：重叠网格视图生成与框重映射（GridViews）放大被压缩的边界区域；特征层：零初始化残差适配器（Z-Adapters）校正畸变引起的特征错位；决策层：学习式跨投影一致性融合（AgreeFusion），仅当多视图证据一致时才提升低置信度检测。方法冻结骨干，仅更新插入模块与预训练检测头。
AI.result: 在 WoodScape 环视鱼眼基准上，FUSEye 将 YOLO26-x 的 mAP50 从 0.148 提升至 0.266，保留全量微调精度的 84.3%；仅使用 25% 标注训练图像时达 0.2597 mAP50，保留全标签性能的 97.6%。该方法还持续提升 YOLOv8-11 检测器，表明其架构无关。
AI.conclusion: FUSEye 以训练轻量、架构无关的方式有效弥合 COCO 预训练检测器到鱼眼域的迁移鸿沟，在少标签场景下表现尤为突出，代码将开源。

title: ROUTEAUDIT: Interaction-Aware Identification for Budgeted Multi-Verifier Routing
summary: Adaptive multi-verifier systems are commonly compared through endpoint quality-cost gaps, even when the verifier catalog, availability, accounting, information filtration, or scorer changes with the policy. We formulate verifier routing as a contract-conditioned identification problem. The contract records request support, verifier catalog, realized availability, resource accounting, online filtration, and post-trace scoring; a matched route contrast changes only the policy coordinate. ROUTEAUDIT adds three measurable objects to this contract. A contract lattice averages coordinate increments over every admissible bridge order and reports the resulting attribution together with its path sensitivity. A policy-independent response tape identifies paired sequential contrasts when adaptive policies reveal different observations. For incomplete matching, request-level bounds use whichever potential outcome remains observed and give a sharp finite-population interval. The protocol commits paid observations and ledger events before the oracle join and returns an attribution certificate for each comparison. On two held-out raw-tail caches, matched static SF+SA equals the cascade, assigning the apparent gains of 0.1797 and 0.1250 over full static to the verifier-set edge. On 1,319 held-out task requests, the learned and RLVR studies report quality 0.9522 and 0.9553 versus 0.9484 for matched static; the RLVR-static paired difference is +0.0068 with a request-paired interval $[0.0015,0.0122]$ and a training-seed-by-request hierarchical interval $[0.0006,0.0131]$. Controlled attribution recovery yields route mean absolute error 0.0011 and endpoint reconstruction error 0.0004. Factorial, bridge-order, and stochastic-provider studies evaluate the certificate interface; RLVR supplies a learned-policy stress test under the same identification contract.

AI.tldr: 本文将验证器路由重新定义为"契约条件下的识别问题"，提出ROUTEAUDIT协议，通过契约格、策略无关响应带和请求级边界三件可测量对象，在统一识别契约下给出比较归因证书，并在静态/学习/RLVR策略上验证其精确性。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应多验证器系统常在验证器目录、可用性、资源记账、信息过滤或评分随策略变化时，仍直接比较端到端的质量-成本差距，导致归因不清、比较不可识别。需要一个能在契约层面控制混杂因素、给出可验证归因的框架。
AI.method: 将验证器路由形式化为契约条件下的识别问题，契约记录请求支持、验证器目录、实现可用性、资源记账、在线过滤与事后评分；匹配路由对照只改变策略坐标。ROUTEAUDIT引入三个可测量对象：(1)契约格，对所有可行桥接次序平均坐标增量并报告归因及其路径敏感性；(2)策略无关响应带，用于自适应策略暴露不同观测时的配对序贯对照；(3)不完全匹配下的请求级边界，利用仍可观测的潜在结果给出尖锐有限总体区间。协议在oracle join前先提交付费观测与账本事件，并为每次比较返回归因证书。
AI.result: 在两个留出原始尾部缓存上，匹配静态SF+SA等于级联，将相对全静态的0.1797与0.1250表观增益归因于验证器集合优势。在1,319个留出任务请求上，学习策略与RLVR研究报告质量0.9522与0.9553，而匹配静态为0.9484；RLVR与静态的配对差为+0.0068，请求配对区间[0.0015,0.0122]，训练种子×请求分层区间[0.0006,0.0131]。受控归因恢复的路由MAE为0.0011，端点重构误差0.0004。
AI.conclusion: 在统一的识别契约下，可以通过归因证书精确分离策略效应与验证器集合效应；因子、桥接次序与随机提供者研究验证了证书接口，RLVR提供了学习策略压力测试，表明该协议在自适应多验证器比较中具有可识别性与可复现性。

title: RMCW: A Deletion-Robust Watermark Based on Reed--Muller Codes for Language Models
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) watermarking provides a lightweight mechanism for identifying text generated by a specific model, but its robustness remains fragile under post-processing attacks. Deletion attacks are particularly challenging because they shift token positions and break the alignment between observed tokens and their original watermark positions. We propose Reed--Muller Code Watermarking (RMCW), an LLM watermarking method based on Reed--Muller codes. In contrast to global codeword recovery, RMCW searches for surviving local algebraic structure, leveraging the Reed--Solomon consistency induced by affine-line restrictions of Reed--Muller codewords. During generation, RMCW injects a Reed--Muller structure into the sequence via a secret-keyed vocabulary partition. During detection, it maps the given text to keyed vocabulary bins and tests local subsequences for low-degree Reed--Solomon consistency using Berlekamp--Welch tests. Experiments on C4 and ELI5 datasets with OPT-1.3B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that RMCW preserves strong clean-text detectability and outperforms or matches the baseline methods under several deletion and rewriting attacks. Our code is available at https://github.com/BaichengDanny/RMCW.

AI.tldr: 提出RMCW，基于Reed–Muller码的LLM水印方法，通过检测局部代数结构提升对删除攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM水印在删除攻击下鲁棒性脆弱，因为删除会改变token位置，破坏观测token与原始水印位置的对齐；该文旨在解决这一对齐失效问题。
AI.method: RMCW基于Reed–Muller码。生成时通过密钥控制的词表划分向序列注入Reed–Muller结构；检测时将文本映射到密钥词表分组，利用Reed–Muller码字仿射线限制诱导的Reed–Solomon一致性，用Berlekamp–Welch测试检验局部子序列的低次Reed–Solomon一致性，而非全局码字恢复。
AI.result: 在C4和ELI5数据集上，使用OPT-1.3B与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct实验：RMCW保持较强干净文本可检测性，在多种删除与改写攻击下超越或持平基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RMCW通过搜索存活的局部代数结构，有效缓解删除攻击导致的token错位问题，为LLM水印提供了一种更鲁棒的方案。

title: Text-Centric Post-Training for Omni-Modal Reasoning
summary: Improving joint audio-visual reasoning in Omni Large Language Models typically incurs substantial data construction and training costs. Our diagnostics reveal multi-hop reasoning difficulties despite correct answers to all corresponding single-hop questions and suggest partial decoupling in the local optimization of perception and reasoning objectives. This motivates post-training with different emphases on these capabilities. Text-only reasoning training yields gains across data sources, model scales, and families. With the best-performing text-only configuration, supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning (RL) raises Qwen2.5-Omni-7B's geometric mean of nine reasoning scores by 25.83% over the base model, outperforming the complete native audio-visual route with 56.6% fewer GPU-hours. Training on data synthesized entirely by a text-only LLM raises this geometric mean by 21.01% without audio-visual data in construction or training. However, text-only training degrades perception. We therefore propose a text-centric post-training paradigm: text-only training provides the main reasoning optimization, and reduced-data native audio-visual RL then refines perception. Refinement uses about 90% fewer input tokens than full-data audio-visual RL, restores perception above the base level, and retains 93.5% of the best-performing text-only pipeline's reasoning gain.

AI.tldr: 提出以文本为中心的后训练范式：主要用纯文本训练提升推理，再用少量原生音视频强化学习修复感知，兼顾性能与成本。
AI.motivation: 提升全模态大模型的联合音视频推理通常需要大量数据构建与训练开销。诊断发现：即使所有单跳问题都答对，模型仍存在多跳推理困难，且感知与推理目标的局部优化存在部分解耦，因此需要对这两类能力采取不同侧重的事后训练。
AI.method: 先进行纯文本推理训练（含由纯文本LLM合成数据的配置），并在最优文本配置上采用监督微调加强化学习（RL）；随后提出以文本为中心的后训练流程：文本训练承担主要推理优化，缩减数据的原生音视频RL用于感知精修。
AI.result: 最优纯文本配置使Qwen2.5-Omni-7B九项推理分数几何均值较基座提升25.83%，优于完整原生音视频路线且GPU时长减少56.6%；全新纯文本LLM合成数据方案提升21.01%且无需音视频数据。纯文本训练会损害感知，而精修阶段输入token比全量音视频RL少约90%，将感知恢复至基座之上，并保留最优文本流程93.5%的推理增益。
AI.conclusion: 解耦式以文本为中心的后训练可在显著降低数据与算力成本的同时大幅提升多模态推理，并通过轻量原生音视频RL修复感知，为全模态模型训练提供了高效范式。

title: TerrainForge: Physics-Grounded Road Geometry Editing for Counterfactual Autonomous Driving
summary: Road geometry (e.g., crests, sags, and speed humps) and surface conditions (e.g., wet or icy pavement) affect how vehicles move, what drivers and onboard cameras observe, and how much clearance remains between vehicles. Editing these properties in a driving scene therefore requires corresponding changes in vehicle motion. Capturing these differences in a driving video requires a road edit to propagate to vehicle motion, camera viewpoint, and the clearance between vehicles. We present TerrainForge, a framework for generating road geometry-focused counterfactuals from reconstructed multi-vehicle driving episodes. A unified road model connects scene deformation with four-wheel vehicle dynamics, allowing crests, sags, speed humps, and friction changes to propagate through vehicle motion, camera viewpoint, and inter-vehicle clearance. Vehicle dynamics are evaluated against CarSim, and prescribed road geometry is verified in reconstructed Waymo scenes. Across 18 episodes, leaving surrounding vehicles on their recorded trajectories instead of recomputing their responses produces median peak differences in predicted ego-lead distance of 1.52 m for crests and 1.41 m for sags. We further simulate the ego response to 15,758 road edits across 983 braking episodes, pairing each edit with its safety outcomes relative to an unedited replay. These pairs train a first-stage screening surrogate that takes the original driving context and candidate road-edit parameters as input and predicts the resulting change in the ego's terminal gap. On held-out scenes, this prediction achieves 22-40% lower mean absolute error than predicting no change, so candidates can be screened cheaply before the full multi-vehicle rollout.

AI.tldr: 提出 TerrainForge 框架，从重建的多车驾驶片段生成以道路几何为核心的反事实视频/仿真，统一道路模型将地形形变与四轮车辆动力学耦合，使坡度、减速带与摩擦变化传播到车辆运动、相机视角与车间距，并训练低成本筛选代理模型预测终端间距变化。
AI.motivation: 道路几何（坡顶、坡谷、减速带）与路面条件（湿滑、结冰）同时影响车辆运动、驾驶员与车载相机观测以及车间余量。在驾驶场景中编辑这些属性必须伴随车辆运动的相应变化，而这会进一步影响相机视角与车间距。现有驾驶视频生成方法难以让道路编辑同步传播到车辆动力学、视角与多车间距，因此需要一种面向道路几何的反事实生成与筛选框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建统一道路模型，把场景形变与四轮车辆动力学相连接，使坡顶、坡谷、减速带与摩擦系数变化沿车辆运动、相机视角与车间距链条传播；2) 从重建的多车驾驶片段出发生成道路几何反事实；3) 用 CarSim 校验车辆动力学，并在重建的 Waymo 场景中验证指定道路几何；4) 对 983 个制动片段施加 15,758 次道路编辑仿真，将每次编辑与相对未编辑回放的安全结果配对，训练第一阶段筛选代理模型：输入原始驾驶上下文与候选道路编辑参数，预测自车终端间距变化。
