AI.result: 车辆动力学与 CarSim 对齐，指定道路几何在重建 Waymo 场景中得到验证。在 18 个片段中，若让周围车辆保持记录轨迹而不重算其响应，坡顶与坡谷下预测的自车-前车间距中位峰值差异分别为 1.52 m 和 1.41 m，说明必须联动重算多车响应。在留出场景上，代理模型对自车终端间距变化的预测平均绝对误差比"预测无变化"基线低 22–40%（对应坡顶/坡谷场景）。
AI.conclusion: TerrainForge 实现了道路几何编辑向车辆运动、相机视角与车间距的因果传播，并以数据驱动的筛选代理模型在完整多车 rollout 之前低成本预筛候选道路编辑，为安全相关的驾驶场景反事实生成与评估提供可行路径。

title: FSPO: Policy-Consistent Risk and Pareto-Feasible Control for Budgeted LLM RL Post-Training
summary: Adaptive LLM reinforcement-learning post-training changes multiple training actuators online, including rollout temperature, group size, clipping, KL regularization, verifier allocation, and update budget. Three coupled issues remain unresolved. A future-risk model trained from behavior trajectories need not estimate the risk induced by the controller that will be deployed; a score calibrated on logged state-action pairs can become miscalibrated after selective action choice; and independent per-resource minimum costs do not in general certify a feasible multi-resource continuation. We introduce FSPO, a feedback-state controller for budgeted LLM RL post-training that addresses these issues jointly. FSPO learns a policy-consistent risk-to-go model whose Bellman target follows the same frozen controller used for future decisions, together with a long-horizon utility model. Decision-conditioned trajectory calibration (DCTC) calibrates risk on cross-fitted trajectories generated by actions selected by provisional controllers. A Pareto resource continuation certificate (PRCC) admits an action only when a non-dominated cumulative reservation remains feasible over the residual horizon. Under a matched GRPO resource envelope, FSPO reaches 66.11% held-out and 59.43% OOD accuracy, compared with 64.47% and 57.03% for PB2, the strongest evaluated adaptive baseline. Three paired training seeds give gains of +2.42 and +3.19 percentage points over the contextual bandit on held-out and OOD evaluation. Under high behavior-deployment mismatch, policy-consistent risk lowers selected-decision ECE from 0.108 to 0.053; DCTC lowers it from 0.039 to 0.022 at matched acceptance; PRCC removes false-feasible admissions on an 18-action catalog ($0.197\rightarrow0.000$); and enabling all three components reduces trajectory failure from 0.181 to 0.083 in a factorial ablation.

AI.tldr: FSPO 是一种面向预算受限 LLM 强化学习后训练的反馈状态控制器，通过策略一致的风险-to-go 模型、决策条件轨迹校准（DCTC）与 Pareto 资源延续证书（PRCC）联合解决风险估计、校准与多资源可行性问题。在匹配 GRPO 资源下取得 66.11% held-out 与 59.43% OOD 准确率。
AI.motivation: 自适应 LLM 强化学习后训练会在线调整多个训练执行器（rollout 温度、组大小、裁剪、KL 正则、验证器分配、更新预算），但存在三个耦合未解问题：1）由行为轨迹训练的未来风险模型未必能估计即将部署控制器所诱导的风险；2）在日志状态-动作对上校准的分数在选择性动作选择后可能失准；3）独立的单资源最小成本一般无法证明多资源续行可行。
AI.method: FSPO 学习一个策略一致的风险-to-go 模型，其 Bellman 目标遵循用于未来决策的同一冻结控制器，并配合长时域效用模型；决策条件轨迹校准（DCTC）在由临时控制器所选动作生成的交叉拟合轨迹上校准风险；Pareto 资源延续证书（PRCC）仅在非支配累积预留于剩余时域内可行时接纳动作。
AI.result: 在匹配 GRPO 资源包络下，FSPO 达到 66.11% held-out 与 59.43% OOD 准确率，优于最强自适应基线 PB2（64.47%/57.03%）。三个配对训练种子相对上下文赌博机在 held-out 与 OOD 上分别提升 +2.42 与 +3.19 个百分点。高行为-部署失配下，策略一致风险将所选决策 ECE 从 0.108 降至 0.053；DCTC 在匹配接纳率下将其从 0.039 降至 0.022；PRCC 在 18 动作目录上消除假可行接纳（$0.197→0.000$）；因子消融中三组件全启将轨迹失败从 0.181 降至 0.083。
AI.conclusion: FSPO 通过联合处理策略一致风险建模、决策条件校准与多资源可行性证书，在预算受限 LLM RL 后训练中显著提升准确率、校准质量与轨迹可行性，并消除假可行接纳。

title: Clinical Concept Centers in LLMs
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in clinical settings. However, research into the reliability and performance of these models has focused almost entirely on the language substrate, scoring what the model says. Mechanistic interpretability has found that the latent space carries a higher fidelity of representation than the text: internal representations not only encode substantially more than the output verbalizes, but the stated reasoning also systematically omits features that causally drive the answer. An evaluation of model behavior in terms of mechanistic interpretability has not been explored in clinical decision support. In this work, we extend behavioral evaluation into the latent space and ask whether clinical concepts exist as locatable, causally used representations inside open-weight LLMs. We find dedicated clinical concept centers in the latent space of all eleven open models we test. These concept centers are interpretable, firing only on their aligned clinical narratives, and meaningfully and causally drive model behavior in both constrained and open-ended settings. They are not just analytical representations, but circuits that can be utilized in clinical practice, and we explore their use from the perspective of both evaluation and performance. From the evaluation standpoint, models stay internally coherent and keep using the relevant concept centers even under adversarial role-based priming, while aligned priming improves downstream clinical performance. From a performance perspective, we simulate realistic deployment settings and find that steering models along these centers leads to meaningful downstream improvements. Finally, we conduct a blinded clinician validation and find the activation and usage of these concept centers predicts clinicians preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文将临床决策支持的大模型评估从文本层面拓展到潜空间，发现十一个开放权重模型中均存在可定位、可解释且具因果作用的临床概念中心，并验证其在评估与性能提升上的价值。
AI.motivation: 现有临床大模型可靠性研究几乎只关注语言表层，即评估模型"说了什么"；而机制可解释性研究表明潜空间表征比文本输出具有更高保真度，且陈述的推理会系统性遗漏驱动答案的因果特征。然而，基于机制可解释性对临床决策支持模型行为的评估尚属空白。
AI.method: 将行为评估扩展至潜空间，检验临床概念是否作为可定位、被因果使用的表征存在于开放权重LLM内部。测试十一个开放模型，识别并验证"临床概念中心"：考察其可解释性（是否仅对对齐的临床叙事激活）、因果驱动性（在受限与开放式设定下），并开展对抗性角色提示实验、转向（steering）模拟部署实验以及盲法临床医生验证。
AI.result: 在所有十一个被测开放模型的潜空间中均发现专门的临床概念中心；这些中心可解释，仅对对齐的临床叙事激活，并在受限与开放式设定下有意义且因果地驱动模型行为。在对抗性基于角色的提示下，模型内部保持连贯并持续使用相关概念中心；而对齐提示可提升下游临床表现。在模拟真实部署场景中，沿这些中心进行转向可带来有意义的下游改进。盲法临床医生验证显示，这些概念中心的激活与使用可预测临床医生的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 临床概念在开放权重LLM潜空间中以可定位、可解释且具因果作用的"电路"形式存在，不仅是分析性表征，还可在临床实践中加以利用；这为临床决策支持提供了潜空间评估与性能提升的双重视角。

title: FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have scaled rapidly to enhance manipulation performance and generalizability, but this scaling incurs high computational costs that render real-world deployment increasingly challenging. Existing approaches typically mitigate this issue by designing smaller architectures or reducing the iterative denoising steps in flow-based policies. In this work, we propose FastOPD, a foundation-to-lightweight VLA framework that enables the practical deployment of large-scale VLAs through efficient on-policy distillation. Specifically, FastOPD adapts a flow map for single-state teacher supervision and combines it with a self-consistency objective to construct a compact student that learns the teacher dynamics. Furthermore, we theoretically demonstrate that minimizing this objective allows the distilled student to recover a distribution on par with that induced by an ideal few-step teacher model. We evaluate FastOPD across diverse foundation policies in simulation and real-world experiments. On LIBERO, FastOPD retains 84% of the performance of $π_{0.5}$ with only two inference steps, reducing inference latency by 78.1% while outperforming existing few-step distillation baselines in average success rate. With LingBot-VLA as the teacher, FastOPD improves the single-step success rate over the base student by 15.9 percentage points on RoboTwin 2.0. We further demonstrate its applicability to a World Action Model (WAM) and deploy a compact student distilled from MolmoAct2 on a real robot.

AI.tldr: 提出FastOPD，一种"基础模型到轻量模型"的VLA蒸馏框架，通过on-policy蒸馏将大规模VLA的能力迁移到紧凑学生模型，实现少步甚至单步推理的低延迟部署。
AI.motivation: VLA基础模型规模快速扩张虽提升了操作性能与泛化性，但计算开销高，难以实际部署。现有缓解手段（缩小架构或减少流式策略的迭代去噪步数）各有局限，亟需兼顾性能与效率的部署方案。
AI.method: FastOPD采用高效的on-policy蒸馏：为目标教师适配flow map以实现单状态教师监督，并结合自一致性（self-consistency）目标，使紧凑学生模型学习教师动力学；理论上证明最小化该目标可使学生恢复与理想少步教师模型相当的分布。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上，仅用两步推理即保留π0.5性能的84%，推理延迟降低78.1%，平均成功率优于现有少步蒸馏基线；以LingBot-VLA为教师，在RoboTwin 2.0上单步成功率较基础学生提升15.9个百分点；还验证了在World Action Model上的适用性，并将由MolmoAct2蒸馏的紧凑学生模型部署到真实机器人。
AI.conclusion: FastOPD通过on-policy蒸馏有效弥合大规模VLA与轻量部署之间的鸿沟，在少步/单步推理下保持竞争性性能并显著降低延迟，且具备跨教师模型、跨任务与真机部署的通用性。

title: To Explore The Strange New World Beyond Data Distribution: System Behavior, Causality Tax, and Non-causal Base Model
summary: We show that the causality of language models (LMs) may not be necessary nor optimal. This is the case when system behavior (denoted as $S$) is incorporated as a first-principle Bayesian feature. Here, $S$ refers to extra dominant factors beyond the data space, and they involve coupled effects. Despite being the de facto foundation of modern architecture, recent studies indicate persistent mismatches and contradictions with causality. These issues largely stem from system behavior rather than the data distribution. We therefore propose the SBD framework, which incorporates $S$ as an irreducible component of the evidence lower bound (ELBO). SBD theoretically reveals a counter-intuitive Causality Tax phenomenon, where causality emerges as a suboptimal approximation with an additional structural error, due to the obliviousness to $S$. To address the challenge of latent variable analysis, we validate the SBD-predicted impact of $S$ via implicit measurements, theoretical-bound-guided controls, and Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evaluations. In particular, we construct Green Shell (GSH) to show the possibility of reducing Causality Tax. GSH is a non-causal variational family, and it replaces the sequential dependency chain of $S$ components with a divide-and-conquer partition. NTK spectra in the lazy-training regime confirm that GSH always achieves significantly tighter error bounds than causality, with $7dB+$ improvement in signal-to-noise ratio. In the relatively later stage of lazy-training, GSH further leads to superior generalization (up to $20\%$ richer multi-scale fitting capabilities). Taken together, SBD establishes system behavior as a complementary theoretical abstraction besides causality and distribution fitting, opening new research avenues such as designing and optimizing LM base models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SBD框架，将系统行为$S$作为第一性贝叶斯特征纳入ELBO，揭示"因果税"现象，并通过GSH构造（非因果变分族）验证可降低因果税，在NTK谱上取得更紧误差界与更优泛化。
AI.motivation: 语言模型虽以因果性为事实上的架构基础，但近期研究显示其与因果性存在持续的不匹配与矛盾。作者认为这些问题的根源不在数据分布，而在系统行为$S$——即数据空间之外的额外主导因素及其耦合效应。因此质疑因果性对语言模型的必要性与最优性。
AI.method: 提出SBD框架，将$S$作为证据下界（ELBO）中不可约的组成部分，从理论上推导出反直觉的"因果税"（Causality Tax）现象：由于对$S$的无知，因果性成为带有额外结构误差的次优近似。为应对潜变量分析难题，采用隐式测量、理论界引导的对照实验以及神经正切核（NTK）评估来验证SBD对$S$影响的预测。进一步构造Green Shell（GSH）——一种非因果变分族，用分治式划分替代$S$各分量的序列依赖链。
AI.result: 在惰性训练（lazy-training）区的NTK谱上，GSH始终获得比因果性显著更紧的误差界，信噪比提升7dB以上；在惰性训练较后阶段，GSH进一步带来更优泛化（多尺度拟合能力提升最高约20%）。
AI.conclusion: SBD将系统行为确立为独立于因果性与分布拟合的互补理论抽象，为语言模型基座模型的设计与优化开辟了新研究方向。

title: PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
summary: World action models jointly learn to forecast world dynamics and predict robot actions, such that the learned internal world dynamics guide accurate actions. Existing approaches typically represent the world as RGB frames or latent counterparts while predicting actions as end-effector poses or joint angles, but they often struggle to capture the 3D spatial structure and contact geometry central to dexterous manipulation. We introduce Point World Action Model (PointWAM), a 3D world action model that decomposes the world into a scene (i.e., environment) and hands (i.e., actor), and jointly forecasts both as 3D point trajectories within a shared space-time coordinate frame. This explicit, disentangled representation enables effective pre-training on large-scale human demonstration videos without requiring any task-specific object or keypoint selection. Given a colored point cloud and a language instruction, PointWAM predicts how the scene and hands co-evolve in 3D space over time, then retargets the forecast hand motion to robot actions. Pre-training on human videos improves average DexJoCo success by 56.9 percentage points, and scene-trajectory supervision adds 10.9 points over forecasting the hands alone. With both, PointWAM surpasses the prior state of the art on ten DexJoCo tasks by 11.7 points and outperforms strong VLAs on a real robot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PointWAM，一种将世界分解为场景与手部、并在统一时空坐标系下以 3D 点轨迹联合预测的 3D 世界动作模型，用于灵巧操作并实现大幅性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型通常以 RGB 帧或隐式特征表示世界、以末端位姿或关节角表示动作，难以刻画灵巧操作所依赖的 3D 空间结构与接触几何。
AI.method: 将世界显式解耦为场景（环境）与手（执行者），在共享时空坐标系下以 3D 点轨迹联合预测二者演化；基于彩色点云与语言指令，预测场景与手部在 3D 空间中的协同演化，并将预测的手部运动重定向为机器人动作；无需任务特定的物体或关键点选择，可直接在大规模人类演示视频上预训练。
AI.result: 人类视频预训练平均提升 DexJoCo 成功率 56.9 个百分点；场景轨迹监督在仅预测手部的基础上再提升 10.9 个百分点；二者结合后在十项 DexJoCo 任务上超越此前最优方法 11.7 个百分点，并在真实机器人上优于强 VLA 基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦且共享时空坐标的 3D 点轨迹表示，能有效利用人类视频预训练并提升灵巧操作性能，验证了 3D 场景–手部联合建模的优越性。

title: How Robust Is Multimodal Claim Verification to LLM Rewriting?
summary: LLMs are known to introduce stylistic changes into generated text, yet how these stylistic shifts affect model decisions on scientific tasks remains underexplored. In this paper, we focus on multimodal claim verification, where the goal is to determine whether a textual claim is grounded in a given piece of evidence. We apply two rewriting strategies: natural rewriting, which simulates how researchers routinely use LLMs to polish academic text, and controlled injection, which inserts a single LLM-associated word to isolate the effect of vocabulary choice. We evaluate 11 open-weight models spanning five VLM families and ranging from 2B to 38B parameters. We find that models are robust to these modifications: most show no significant drop in accuracy, and compared to prior work on review-score manipulation, verification appears far more stable. However, consistent probability shifts do occur. Hedging-oriented conditions produce significant shifts across nearly all models, while boosting conditions show a weaker effect and general polishing conditions (e.g., grammar correction, fluency improvement) have little effect.

AI.tldr: 研究考察LLM改写文本风格对多模态论断验证任务的影响，发现模型整体稳健，但概率分布出现系统性偏移。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的文本常带有风格变化，但这种风格偏移如何影响模型在科学任务上的决策尚缺乏系统研究，尤其在多模态论断验证场景中。
AI.method: 采用两种改写策略：模拟研究者润色学术文本的自然改写，以及仅插入一个LLM关联词以隔离词汇效应的受控注入。评估11个开放权重模型，涵盖5个VLM家族，参数量从2B到38B。
AI.result: 模型对这些修改具有稳健性，多数模型准确率无显著下降，相比此前的评审打分操纵研究，验证任务更加稳定。但概率分布出现一致偏移：以模糊限制语为导向的条件在几乎所有模型上产生显著偏移，提升类条件效果较弱，通用润色类条件（如语法纠错、流畅度提升）影响甚微。
AI.conclusion: 多模态论断验证模型对LLM风格改写整体鲁棒，但模糊限制语等特定词汇线索仍会系统性影响模型概率判断，提示需关注词汇层面的隐性偏差。

title: Adaptive Mutual Distillation for Balanced Multi-Task Post-Training of Large Language Models
summary: Multi-task post-training of large language models (LLMs) aims to improve performance across tasks with unequal amounts of training data. Existing methods focus primarily on balancing task contributions during single-model training. Different task-balancing strategies can produce models with complementary strengths, creating opportunities for mutual distillation. However, the usefulness of cross-model supervision can vary across tasks, transfer directions, and stages of training. We propose Adaptive Mutual Distillation (AMD), a collaborative post-training framework that jointly trains two models with different task-balancing strategies. AMD evaluates candidate adjustments to distillation weights through short training probes shared across tasks, then uses task-wise validation scores to select an adjustment for each task and transfer direction. Across six benchmarks and three LLM backbones, both AMD models achieve higher average benchmark scores than supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines trained with the same sampling strategies. They also outperform the task-balancing methods evaluated in our experiments. Merging the two trained models can further improve their average benchmark score while yielding a single model for inference. The merged models outperform multi-task SFT by an average of 2.91 points across the three backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应互蒸馏（AMD）框架，通过联合训练两个采用不同任务平衡策略的模型并在训练中动态选择各任务、各迁移方向的蒸馏权重，提升多任务性能，合并后模型平均优于多任务SFT 2.91分。
AI.motivation: 多任务后训练中不同任务数据量不均，现有方法主要在单模型训练中平衡任务贡献；而不同任务平衡策略训练出的模型具有互补优势，为跨模型互蒸馏提供机会，但跨模型监督的有效性会因任务、迁移方向和训练阶段而异。
AI.method: AMD 联合训练两个采用不同任务平衡策略的模型。它通过跨任务共享的短训练探针评估蒸馏权重的候选调整，再利用任务级验证分数为每个任务和迁移方向选择调整方案，实现自适应的互蒸馏权重分配。
AI.result: 在六个基准和三种LLM主干上，AMD的两个模型平均基准分数均高于采用相同采样策略的SFT基线，也优于实验评估的任务平衡方法；合并两个模型可进一步提升平均分数并获得单一推理模型，合并模型在三种主干上平均优于多任务SFT 2.91分。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型互蒸馏对多任务后训练有效，且监督价值需按任务、方向自适应调整；模型合并可兼顾性能提升与单模型推理的实用性。

title: ConvoDrift: A Multi-Turn Conversational Dataset for Modeling Stylistic Tone Evolution
comment: 13 pages, 14 figures, 7 tables, Accepted paper at the 13th Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing (ROCLING) 2026
summary: The evolution of linguistic style in conversations is an underexplored issue in NLP. Most style-control datasets focus on sentences or assume a static style throughout, missing the dynamic shifts that occur as user preferences change during interactions. We introduce ConvoDrift, a dataset designed to model progressive stylistic conversational tone drift under fixed semantic intent. It is built on 15,727 shared multi-turn conversational structures for adaptation and persona-conditioned alignment methods. It consists of six prompt-response pairs per conversation, each with the annotation of style drift and style direction labels. These pairs cover a range of communication genres. We further derive a complementary pairwise dataset by pairing semantically equivalent but stylistically distinct responses and annotating persona-conditioned preferences using five distinct style communication personas, enabling the controlled study of personalisation and pluralistic alignment in language tone. In addition to dataset construction, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation involving human validation, LLM-as-judge assessment, and automatic lexical and semantic evaluations. Across seven Likert criteria annotated by three human annotators, the average Krippendorff's alpha is 0.88, and our lexical and semantic analyses show that drift events induce lexical changes while preserving semantic similarity.

AI.tldr: 提出 ConvoDrift 数据集，用于在固定语义意图下建模多轮对话中渐进式的语言风格漂移，并支持角色条件化对齐研究。
AI.motivation: 现有风格控制数据集多聚焦单句或假设风格静态不变，忽略了交互过程中随用户偏好变化而产生的动态风格转变，语言风格演化问题在 NLP 中研究不足。
AI.method: 构建 ConvoDrift：基于 15,727 个共享多轮对话结构，每段对话含 6 组提示-回复对，并标注风格漂移与风格方向标签，覆盖多种交流体裁；另派生配对数据集，将语义等价但风格不同的回复配对，用五种风格沟通角色标注角色条件化偏好。评估采用人工验证、LLM-as-judge 以及词汇与语义自动评估。
AI.result: 三位标注者在七项 Likert 标准上的平均 Krippendorff's alpha 为 0.88；词汇与语义分析表明漂移事件引起词汇变化，同时保持语义相似性。
AI.conclusion: ConvoDrift 为渐进式对话风格漂移、个性化与多元对齐提供了可控研究平台，验证了风格漂移可在保持语义一致的前提下实现。

title: Query-aware routing for Cross-lingual performance gains in Encoders
summary: Multilingual encoders can exhibit reduced retrieval effectiveness when queries and relevant documents differ in language, despite strong same-language performance. We investigate whether Finnish and Swedish cross-lingual retrieval can improve while preserving an encoder's existing same-language performance and document index. We combine a query-only low-rank adapter, trained against frozen document embeddings, with deterministic routing based on query and index languages. Cross-language queries use the adapter, while same-language queries use the original encoder. SampoTron, our fine-tuned low-rank (LoRA) adapter alongwith the Nemotron-3-Embed-1B model, improves average retrieval quality across six English, Finnish, and Swedish directions from 0.241 to 0.291 in normalized discounted cumulative gain (nDCG) at rank ten, a 20.9% relative gain on a sampled financial benchmark. All six cross-lingual directions improve, and routing preserves the original same-language performance, including two full-corpus Finnish evaluations. The approach enables selective cross-language specialization with reusable document embedding vectors.

AI.tldr: 提出查询侧低秩适配器配合确定性路由，在冻结文档向量下提升芬兰语-瑞典语跨语言检索，同时保持同语言性能。
AI.motivation: 多语言编码器同语言检索表现强，但查询与相关文档语言不一致时检索效果明显下降。作者希望在提升芬瑞跨语言检索的同时，不损害原编码器的同语言性能，也不重建文档索引。
AI.method: 采用仅作用于查询的低秩（LoRA）适配器，针对冻结的文档嵌入进行训练；并基于查询语言与索引语言设计确定性路由：跨语言查询走适配器，同语言查询走原始编码器。最终方案为 SampoTron，即微调后的 LoRA 适配器与 Nemotron-3-Embed-1B 模型结合。
AI.result: 在英语、芬兰语、瑞典语构成的六个方向、采样金融基准上，前10位 nDCG 平均由 0.241 提升至 0.291，相对提升 20.9%；六个跨语言方向全部改善，路由机制保持原有同语言性能，包括两项全语料芬兰语评测。
AI.conclusion: 该方案实现了选择性的跨语言专精能力，并可复用已有文档嵌入向量，避免重索引开销。

title: Seeing, Saying, but Not Using: From Reportable Spatial Facts to Usable States in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: A multimodal large language model that correctly reports a spatial fact does not necessarily use that fact in subsequent reasoning. To study this distinction, we introduce \textsc{SpaceConflict}, a benchmark of 23{,}196 inputs for the construction and use of spatial state. Under a unified Supported/Contradictory/Unknown judgment interface, it covers local fact binding (L1), relational composition (L2), cross-observation consistency (L3), and state judgment under transformation (L4). Posing a direct-state query, a full-transformation query, and an explicit-initial-state query on the same world reveals an availability--utilization gap: models recover the initial state from visual evidence yet fail when that state must drive a transformation. For Qwen3.5-9B, 50 of 100 sequences with a correctly recovered initial state fail the full transformation, and supplying the state explicitly repairs all 50; the gap narrows with scale but does not close. We therefore propose Operational State Supervision (OSS), which supervises task-relevant spatial states and their transformation trajectories and aligns shared facts across contexts. OSS improves paired accuracy on matched judgments most on L3 and L4, the levels that depend on organizing and using state. Evaluating multimodal spatial reasoning thus requires asking not only whether a model can see and state a spatial fact, but whether that fact becomes a usable state in subsequent computation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SpaceConflict 基准（23,196 条输入）揭示多模态大模型的"可用性—利用性鸿沟"：模型能正确报告空间事实，却无法在后续变换推理中使用该事实；为此提出 Operational State Supervision (OSS) 训练方法。
AI.motivation: 现有评估只关注模型能否"看到并说出"空间事实，忽视了该事实能否成为后续推理中可用的状态。作者希望区分空间状态的"构建"与"使用"，系统刻画二者之间的脱节。
AI.method: 构建 SpaceConflict 基准，采用统一的 Supported/Contradictory/Unknown 判断接口，覆盖四个层级：L1 局部事实绑定、L2 关系组合、L3 跨观测一致性、L4 变换下的状态判断；对同一世界分别提出直接状态查询、全变换查询和显式初始状态查询，以暴露可用性—利用性鸿沟。提出 Operational State Supervision (OSS)，对任务相关空间状态及其变换轨迹进行监督，并跨上下文对齐共享事实。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，100 条正确恢复初始状态的序列中有 50 条在全变换任务上失败，而显式提供该状态可修复全部 50 条；鸿沟随模型规模增大而缩小但未消失。OSS 在配对准确率上提升最显著的是依赖状态组织与使用的 L3、L4 层级。
AI.conclusion: 多模态空间推理评估不应只问模型能否看见并陈述空间事实，而应进一步检验该事实是否成为后续计算中可用的状态。

title: Evaluating LLM-as-a-Judge Beyond Score Alignment: A Psychometric Analysis of Residual Judging Difficulty
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as automatic judges, with validity typically assessed via alignment with human scores. However, aggregate agreement fails to reveal whether humans and LLMs find the same evaluation cases difficult. In this paper, we study this problem in summarization evaluation from a psychometric perspective. We fit Many-Facet Rasch Models separately to human and LLM ratings to decompose scores into latent summary quality, rater severity, dimension severity, and rating-scale thresholds. Building on this decomposition, we define residual hardness as a model-adjusted measure of judging difficulty and compare whether human and LLM judges share the same hardness structure. Across 17 open-weight LLM judges on SummEval, we find that moderate alignment in latent summary quality does not imply alignment in residual hardness. Human and LLM judges differ in which summary--dimension units remain difficult, and this mismatch is strongly dimension-dependent. Consistency shows a pronounced LLM-hard shift, whereas coherence shows a human-hard shift. We further show that human-easy but LLM-hard cases are partially predictable from observable source--summary properties. These findings suggest that aggregate human alignment reflects only part of LLM-as-a-judge reliability, while psychometric residual diagnostics support more informative judge evaluation and more targeted human--LLM collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文从心理测量学视角出发，用多面Rasch模型分解人类与LLM评分，提出"残差难度"概念，发现潜在摘要质量上的中等一致性并不意味着评判难度结构一致，且难度错配具有明显的维度依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM作为自动评判者的有效性评估主要依赖与人类评分的总体一致性（聚合一致性），但聚合一致性无法揭示人类与LLM是否在相同的评判案例上感到困难，从而掩盖了二者在难点结构上的潜在差异。
AI.method: 在摘要评估任务中，分别对人类评分与LLM评分拟合多面Rasch模型（Many-Facet Rasch Model），将分数分解为潜在摘要质量、评分者严厉度、维度严厉度和评分量表阈值四个成分；在此基础上定义"残差难度"作为经模型校正的评判难度度量，并比较人类与LLM评判者是否共享相同的难度结构。实验在SummEval数据集上对17个开放权重LLM评判者进行。
AI.result: 潜在摘要质量上的中等一致性并不对应残差难度上的一致性；人类与LLM评判者在哪些"摘要—维度"单元上仍然困难存在差异，且这种错配强烈依赖具体维度：一致性（consistency）维度呈现明显的"LLM更难"偏移，而连贯性（coherence）维度呈现"人类更难"偏移。进一步发现，"人类容易但LLM困难"的案例可部分由可观测的原文—摘要特征预测。
AI.conclusion: 聚合的人类一致性只反映了LLM作为评判者可靠性的一个侧面；心理测量学的残差诊断能够支持更具信息量的评判者评估以及更有针对性的人机协作。

title: Evaluating VQA in Vision Language Models using Cooperative Principles
summary: We evaluate the performance of Vision Language Models in Visual Question Answering (VQA) when questions violate Grice's maxims. To do this, we use VLMs to generate question modifiers that add non-essential, ambiguous or false information and show that in the presence of such violations, the VLMs that we evaluate (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Llava) show diminished performance. Further, we empirically show the difference between how humans reason pragmatically compared to VLMs, and the difference in VLM reasoning when it resolves violations that are human-induced compared to those that are AI-generated. Finally, we show that human cognitive effort (measured through time-on-task in an experiment) is lower for resolving VLM-induced violations, but VLMs themselves perform less accurately in such cases.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在问题违反Grice会话准则时的VQA表现，发现违规会降低ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Llava的准确率，且人类与VLM的语用推理方式及对人工诱导与AI诱导违规的处理存在差异。
AI.motivation: 探究VLM在真实语用场景（问题违反Grice准则、含冗余/歧义/虚假信息）下的鲁棒性，并对比人类与VLM的语用推理差异。
AI.method: 利用VLM生成添加非必要、歧义或虚假信息的问题修饰语，在违规条件下评测ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Llava的VQA性能；通过实验比较人类与VLM的语用推理，并使用任务用时（time-on-task）测量人类认知负荷。
AI.result: 在违规问题存在时，所评测VLM性能下降；人类与VLM的语用推理方式不同；VLM处理人工诱导违规与AI生成违规时推理表现存在差异；人类解决VLM诱导违规的认知负荷更低，但VLM在此类情况下准确率更差。
AI.conclusion: VLM在应对违反Grice准则的问题时表现脆弱，其语用推理与人类存在系统性差距，表明当前VLM的语用理解能力仍有待提升。

title: Found but Not Read: When Extracted Text Closes the Retrieval-Reading Gap in Document Vision-Language Models
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Retrieval-augmented document question answering assumes that once the right page is found, a vision-language model (VLM) can read it. We show that this assumption often fails, leaving a retrieval-reading gap: evidence found but not used. A paired protocol isolates this gap by comparing answers from the retrieved page images alone with answers from the same images plus their extracted text. On FoveDoc-Bench, our benchmark with traceable evidence, retrieval finds nearly every evidence page, yet adding CPU-OCR text raises strict accuracy by 13 to 16 points. An exact text layer roughly doubles the gain, which appears across six VLMs from three families and, within one family, narrows with scale without closing. The reader can read this evidence but cannot find it: crops of it recover most of the text gain, boxes around it on the page none. The same protocol identifies two boundaries. Extracted text helps on textual evidence but is neutral or harmful on charts and figures. Its advantage shrinks as retrieval degrades, and unrelated text of the same form adds nothing detectable. Extracted text is an amplifier of retrieval that works, not a substitute for retrieval that does not. Our code is available at https://github.com/atoz03/fovedoc-sup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"检索—阅读鸿沟"（retrieval-reading gap）概念，指出检索到正确页面后VLM仍可能无法利用证据；通过配对协议与FoveDoc-Bench基准量化该鸿沟，并揭示抽取文本是检索的放大器而非替代品。
AI.motivation: 检索增强文档问答通常假设"找到正确页面=VLM能读懂"，但作者发现该假设经常失效：证据被找到却未被使用。研究动机是显式隔离并量化这一被忽视的检索与阅读之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出配对协议：对比"仅检索页面图像"与"同一图像+抽取文本"两种条件下的答案。构建带可溯源证据的基准FoveDoc-Bench；使用CPU-OCR文本与精确文本层对照；在来自三个家族的六个VLM上验证；通过证据裁剪（crop）与边界框（box）干预定位失败环节；并考察文本形式、检索质量等边界条件。
AI.result: 检索几乎能找齐所有证据页，但加入CPU-OCR文本使严格准确率提升13–16个百分点；精确文本层收益约翻倍。该现象在六个VLM中一致出现，同家族内随规模缩小但未消失。证据裁剪可恢复大部分文本增益，而页面上的边界框无增益。抽取文本对文字型证据有效，对图表图形无效或有害；其优势随检索退化而缩小；同形式的无关文本无可检测增益。
AI.conclusion: VLM能读却找不到证据，问题不在阅读能力而在定位与利用环节。抽取文本是"有效检索的放大器"，而非"无效检索的替代品"。代码已开源于https://github.com/atoz03/fovedoc-sup。

title: Misinformation Without Triggers: From Factual Answers to Downstream Decisions
summary: Language models learn from web documents, some of them false, and false content can reach a model's answer to a factual question and the summaries and decisions that use it. Most data-poisoning studies add a trigger to the training data and activate it in the prompt. False documents can also change factual responses without any trigger, but we do not know whether the direct answer predicts the decision. In this work, we follow false content past the answer and find an \emph{audit gap} between what a direct probe reports and what the model then does, comparing false training with matched truthful controls in a controlled decision task, \emph{Guess the Capital}, where a fixed decoder turns factual answers into a scored card choice, and on a misleading claim from Facebook posts about the 2019--20 Australian bushfires. Across eight models at dose 1,000, direct injected-choice rates reach 95.8--100\%, while injected game choices increase by 1.7--14.4 percentage points over matched truthful training. The gap runs the other way too. Facts that pass the direct probe still push decisions toward the injected answer, and game accuracy drops further than those choices explain. Truthful correction brings the fact back but not the decisions built on it. We then look into the real-world bushfire case, models trained on the false posts say that people were arrested for arson even when they lose the inflated count, and in a count-by-wording factorial the misleading arrest wording produces arrest assertions even when the training count stays at 24. In simpler terms, \textbf{a correct factual answer does not guarantee a correct decision, and losing the injected number does not remove the misleading story}.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示虚假语料引发的"审计缺口"：直接事实探针（直接答案）与模型下游决策不一致，且真实纠正能恢复事实但无法恢复基于该事实的决策，指出仅用直接问题审计模型风险不足。
AI.motivation: 语言模型从含虚假内容的网页学习；现有数据投毒研究多依赖触发词，且以直接问答表现作为评估指标，假定"答对即安全"。作者要检验这一假设：直接答案能否预测模型后续基于该事实的决策行为，从而暴露审计方法的盲区。
AI.method: 构建受控决策任务"Guess the Capital"：固定解码器将事实性答案转化为计分的卡片选择，比较虚假训练与匹配的真实对照（8个模型，剂量1000）。并引入2019–20澳大利亚丛林大火Facebook虚假帖子的真实案例，采用"计数×措辞"析因设计检验误导性措辞与注入计数的独立作用。
AI.result: 直接注入选择率达95.8–100%，而游戏选择仅相对真实训练提升1.7–14.4个百分点，存在显著缺口；缺口双向存在——通过直接探针的事实仍将决策推向注入答案，且游戏准确率下降幅度超过这些选择可解释的程度。真实纠正能恢复事实，却无法恢复由此构建的决策。丛林火案例中，模型即使不再输出被夸大的数字，仍声称有人因纵火被捕；在析因设计中，即使训练计数保持为24，误导性"逮捕"措辞仍单独诱发逮捕断言。
AI.conclusion: 正确的事实回答并不保证正确的决策，丢失被注入的数字也不消除误导性叙事。直接探针低估了虚假内容的真实影响，审计需从"答案层"扩展到"决策层"及叙事层。

title: Revealing Epistemic Uncertainty in MLLMs via Causal-Invariant Masking
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) suffer from hallucinations, creating a critical need for Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) to ensure reliable deployment. However, existing approaches struggle to detect uncertainty caused by superficial associations, especially when the query-relevant signal is weak. We mainly attribute this issue to their bias toward aleatoric uncertainty arising from data ambiguity, overlooking epistemic uncertainty stemming from model limitations. To further decompose uncertainty types for a comprehensive UQ, we propose Causal-Invariant Masking (CIM), which measures the semantic shift between the original predictions and those conditioned on a causally-focused view. Based on this framework, we introduce Semantic Divergence as our core metric for UQ and provide theoretical evidence that it converges to the variance of model's sensitivity to non-causal correlations, establishing its ability to capture MLLM's limitation. To accelerate UQ in MLLMs, we further propose Expected Embedding Drift (EED), a fast geometric proxy metric that estimates semantic shift directly within the hyperspherical embedding space. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on various benchmarks, while the proposed EED accelerates by nearly 50% with comparable performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的幻觉问题，提出因果不变掩码（CIM）框架与语义分歧（Semantic Divergence）指标用于不确定性量化（UQ），并引入期望嵌入漂移（EED）作为快速几何代理指标，实现SOTA性能且加速近50%。
AI.motivation: MLLMs存在幻觉，可靠部署亟需不确定性量化（UQ）；但现有方法难以检测由表层关联（superficial associations）引发的不确定性，尤其在查询相关信号较弱时。作者将其归因于现有方法偏向由数据模糊性带来的偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty），而忽视了源于模型局限性的认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）。
AI.method: 提出因果不变掩码（CIM）：通过度量原始预测与在"因果聚焦视图"条件下的预测之间的语义偏移来分解不确定性类型。基于该框架，提出核心UQ指标"语义分歧"（Semantic Divergence），并从理论上证明其收敛于模型对非因果关联敏感度的方差，从而刻画MLLM的局限性。为进一步加速，提出期望嵌入漂移（EED），一种在超球嵌入空间直接估计语义偏移的快速几何代理指标。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上取得当前最优（SOTA）性能；所提出的EED在性能相当的情况下实现近50%的加速。
AI.conclusion: CIM与Semantic Divergence为MLLMs提供了可分解偶然/认知不确定性、并能捕获模型局限性的UQ方案；EED在保持性能的同时显著提升效率，验证了方法的有效性与实用性。

title: ViTok: Improving Dense Semantics in AM-RADIO-Style Multi-Teacher Distillation with PHI-S and Masked Image Modelling
summary: We study how to consolidate the current VITOK progress into a single multi-teacher distillation recipe that jointly preserves global recognition and dense semantics. Our starting point is an AM-RADIO-style student distilled from SigLIP2 and DINOv3-L, where SigLIP2 supplies strong global semantics and DINOv3-L supplies stronger dense features. The central empirical issue is that the same recipe does not optimize all objectives equally well: changes that improve ImageNet-1K kNN accuracy can still degrade ADE20K segmentation. We summarize a progression of modifications that make this trade-off more explicit and more manageable: split adaptor heads for CLS and patch tokens, asymmetric cosine/MSE losses, initialization from a DINOv3-L checkpoint, teacher reweighting, masked image modeling (MIM), and PHI-S feature balancing. The resulting model reaches 83.2 patch kNN and 85.2 CLS kNN, slightly surpassing the DINOv3-L teacher on ImageNet-1K kNN classification, while PHI-S restores ADE20K performance from 46.5/58.1 to 48.5/61.0 mIoU/mAcc, matching the teacher on this dense benchmark. We also summarize negative results: scaling distillation from ImageNet-1K to ImageNet22K does not consistently help, and naively adding extra teachers such as SAM3 or HOG features introduces interference. Rather than claiming a final recipe, this paper distills the current project state into a compact empirical story and a concrete set of lessons for future iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文将 VITOK 项目的多教师蒸馏经验整合为一份紧凑的实证报告：以 SigLIP2 与 DINOv3-L 为教师，通过拆分适配头、非对称损失、教师重加权、MIM 与 PHI-S 特征平衡等修改，使模型在 ImageNet-1K kNN 上略超 DINOv3-L 教师，并借 PHI-S 将 ADE20K 性能恢复至与教师持平。
AI.motivation: 作者希望把当前 VITOK 的进展整合成单一的多教师蒸馏方案，同时兼顾全局识别语义与稠密语义。核心矛盾在于：同一套蒸馏配方无法对各目标同等优化——提升 ImageNet-1K kNN 精度的改动可能会损害 ADE20K 分割性能。因此动机是显式化并管理这一权衡，并为后续迭代总结可复用的经验与教训。
AI.method: 以 AM-RADIO 风格的学生模型为基础，从 SigLIP2（提供强全局语义）与 DINOv3-L（提供更强稠密特征）蒸馏。采用一系列渐进式改动：为 CLS 与 patch token 拆分适配头（split adaptor heads）、非对称 cosine/MSE 损失、从 DINOv3-L 检查点初始化、教师重加权、掩码图像建模（MIM）以及 PHI-S 特征平衡。同时给出负结果：将蒸馏从 ImageNet-1K 扩展到 ImageNet22K 并无稳定收益；朴素地加入 SAM3 或 HOG 等额外教师会引入干扰。
AI.result: 最终模型达到 83.2 patch kNN 与 85.2 CLS kNN，在 ImageNet-1K kNN 分类上略超 DINOv3-L 教师；PHI-S 将 ADE20K 从 46.5/58.1 恢复到 48.5/61.0 mIoU/mAcc，在该稠密基准上追平教师。负结果方面：从 ImageNet-1K 扩展到 ImageNet22K 的数据规模并未带来一致性提升；额外教师（SAM3、HOG）的朴素加入造成干扰。
AI.conclusion: 本文并非提出最终配方，而是将项目当前状态凝练为一个紧凑的实证故事，并给出面向未来迭代的具体经验：多教师蒸馏中的全局与稠密目标需通过显式的结构设计（如拆分头、非对称损失、特征平衡）来分别管理，教师数量与数据规模并非越多越好。

title: Probe the Harness: Setup Checks for Stale-Data RL Comparisons in Language Models
summary: Methods for training language models on stale samples are judged by comparisons against importance-corrected baselines. We show that details of the experimental harness can reverse the observed ranking of methods, and we introduce PTH (Probe The Harness), a set of checks that makes the harness visible. Our case is a comparison between SAN, a behaviour-free method, and truncated importance sampling (TIS) on verl and in a single-GPU trainer, in which SAN first finished ahead in both stacks. Four details of the harness changed this comparison: the PPO ratio was taken against the learner's own recomputed probabilities, the data seed did not reach the TIS arm, the replay queue reused its first batch for 33 updates, and two loss normalisers differed from their description. In each case the logged quantity looked consistent with a working setup, while the quantity that defines the comparison went unchecked. With the harness checked, TIS matches SAN on verl, and in the trainer TIS learns steadily while SAN keeps a margin. We contribute the signature of each detail and its effect on the comparison, reference results for TIS and uncorrected GRPO under sampler lag, and the PTH checklist.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，训练语言模型使用陈旧样本时，方法排序可能被实验“装置”（harness）的细节所逆转，并提出 PTH（Probe The Harness）检查清单以暴露这些隐患。以 SAN 与 TIS 的对比为例，修正四处装置细节后，TIS 在 verl 上追平 SAN，而单卡训练器中 TIS 稳定学习、SAN 保持优势。
AI.motivation: 现有对“陈旧样本训练方法”的评价，依赖于与重要性校正基线的对比。但论文发现，实验装置本身的一些隐蔽细节会逆转方法之间的观测排序，且这些细节在日志中往往看似正常，导致比较结论不可靠。因此作者希望让实验装置“可见”，以保证方法对比的有效性。
AI.method: 作者以行为无关方法 SAN 与截断重要性采样 TIS 的对比为案例，在 verl 框架和单卡训练器两种环境中复现。通过 PTH（Probe The Harness）系列检查，逐项排查并修正四处装置细节：(1) PPO ratio 是否基于 learner 自身重算的概率；(2) 数据 seed 是否传递到 TIS 分支；(3) replay queue 是否将首个 batch 重复用于 33 次更新；(4) 两个 loss normaliser 是否与其描述一致。每处细节均记录了特征签名及其对比较结果的影响。
AI.result: 在初始装置下，SAN 在两个环境中都先取得领先。修正上述四处细节后：在 verl 上 TIS 追平 SAN；在单卡训练器中 TIS 能够稳定学习，而 SAN 仍保持一定优势。文中还给出了在采样器滞后（sampler lag）条件下 TIS 与未校正 GRPO 的参考结果。
AI.conclusion: 实验装置的隐性细节足以逆转方法间的观测排序，因此仅凭与重要性校正基线的对比来评判陈旧样本训练方法是不充分的。作者贡献了各细节的特征签名及其影响、采样器滞后下 TIS 与未校正 GRPO 的参考结果，以及 PTH 检查清单，用于在实验中显式核查装置一致性。

title: Custom Forcing: Training-Free Subject Customization for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video models can generate minute-long videos in real time, but they produce generic subjects from text rather than specific subjects from user-provided images. Existing customization methods either require costly per-subject optimization or use pretrained conditioning networks that jointly process all video frames with bidirectional attention. Neither approach is designed for causal streaming. We present Custom Forcing, a training-free method that stores reference-based anchor frames in the persistent KV cache of a frozen autoregressive video model. However, fixed anchors face two limitations: simple conditioning allows identity to drift, and the text prompt continues to favor a generic subject. To address these problems, drift-adaptive value amplification (DVA) scales reference influence with the degree of identity drift, while anchor contrast guidance (ACG) steers generation away from the generic class prior. Over two-minute rollouts, fixed anchors fall from 0.58 to 0.42 in DINO-I, while Custom Forcing keeps it between 0.58 and 0.62 without reducing motion. Custom Forcing also achieves higher subject similarity than bidirectional customization methods and better preserves identity over 30s than causal image-to-video and reference-to-video models, while generating each frame 9.5-28.5 times faster than these long-video baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法 Custom Forcing，将参考锚帧存入冻结自回归视频模型的持久 KV cache，并用 DVA 与 ACG 缓解身份漂移与类别先验，实现实时长视频的特定主体定制。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频模型虽能实时生成分钟级视频，但只能依据文本生成泛化主体，无法从用户图像定制特定主体。现有定制方法要么需昂贵的逐主体优化，要么依赖双向注意力的预训练条件网络，均不适用于因果流式生成。
AI.method: Custom Forcing：在冻结自回归视频模型的持久 KV cache 中存储基于参考的锚帧（训练无关）。针对固定锚帧的身份漂移与文本提示偏向泛化主体两个问题，引入漂移自适应值放大（DVA，按身份漂移程度缩放参考影响）与锚对比引导（ACG，使生成偏离泛化类别先验）。
AI.result: 两分钟 rollout 中，固定锚帧的 DINO-I 从 0.58 降至 0.42，而 Custom Forcing 维持在 0.58–0.62，且不降低运动幅度；主体相似度高于双向定制方法，30 秒内身份保持优于因果 image-to-video 与 reference-to-video 模型，每帧生成速度比这些长视频基线快 9.5–28.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: Custom Forcing 以训练无关方式实现自回归视频的特定主体流式定制，在长时身份一致性与生成效率上均优于现有定制及因果基线。

title: Output Language Confusion under Multilingual Prompt Contamination
summary: Standard factual benchmarks assume clean monolingual prompts and exact-match scoring, two assumptions that break simultaneously in real-world multilingual deployment, from retrieval-augmented generation pipelines returning mixed-language passages to users pasting multilingual web content. We introduce Multilingual Distractor Interference (MDI), a lightweight and fully replicable evaluation protocol requiring no new data or annotation, in which factual questions are preceded by a semantically irrelevant foreign-language sentence, and evaluate five instruction-tuned LLMs across TruthfulQA and TriviaQA under eight distractor conditions (40,000 evaluations). Our central finding is a metric confound: for Llama-3.1-8B under a Hindi distractor, 58% of responses switch to Devanagari script, yielding a raw hallucination proxy of 0.710, but manual review reveals that 120 of 148 script-switched responses that were correct under clean conditions remain semantically correct despite being written in the wrong script, reducing the adjusted semantic hallucination rate to 0.470. All other models respond through abstention escalation with no hallucination increase. A paragraph-length English distractor triggers near-universal abstention (0.806-0.998) across all models, consistent with reading-comprehension confusion, a failure mode with direct consequences for multilingual RAG pipelines. TruthfulQA multiple-choice accuracy is unaffected under all single-sentence conditions. These results show that exact-match hallucination rates in mixed-language settings should be decomposed into script-switching and semantic error components before drawing conclusions about model reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"多语言干扰项干扰"(MDI)评测协议：在事实性问题前加入语义无关的外语句子，对五个指令微调LLM在TruthfulQA和TriviaQA上进行8种干扰条件下共40,000次评测。核心发现是"指标混淆"——Llama-3.1-8B在印地语干扰下58%回答切换为天城文书写，原始幻觉率0.710，但人工复核后语义幻觉率降至0.470；其他模型表现为弃答升级而无幻觉增加；段落级英文干扰引发近乎普遍的弃答(0.806-0.998)。
AI.motivation: 标准事实性基准假设提示为干净的单语文本且采用精确匹配打分，但真实多语言部署中这两个假设同时失效：RAG流水线会返回混合语言段落，用户也会粘贴多语言网页内容。因此需要一种无需新数据与标注、轻量且可完全复现的评测协议，来揭示混合语言场景下精确匹配指标对模型可靠性的误导。
AI.method: 提出MDI(Multilingual Distractor Interference)协议：在事实性问题前拼接一句语义无关的外语句子，不引入任何新数据或标注。在TruthfulQA与TriviaQA上，对五个指令微调LLM设置8种干扰条件，共进行40,000次评测，并结合人工复核区分"文字系统切换"与"语义错误"两类失败。
AI.result: Llama-3.1-8B在印地语干扰下58%的回答转为天城文，原始幻觉代理指标为0.710；人工复核显示148个切换书写系统的回答中有120个在干净条件下正确且语义仍正确，修正后语义幻觉率为0.470。其余模型表现为弃答升级，幻觉未增加。段落级英文干扰导致所有模型近乎普遍弃答(0.806-0.998)，符合阅读理解混淆的失败模式。TruthfulQA多选题准确率在所有单句干扰条件下均不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 混合语言场景下的精确匹配幻觉率会被书写系统切换严重污染，应在得出模型可靠性结论前将其分解为文字系统切换成分与语义错误成分。MDI可作为轻量、可复现的评测协议，为多语言RAG部署中的可靠性评估提供更准确的度量基础。

title: RAIN: Robotic Task Generalization with Region-Aware Interaction Networks
summary: Existing vision-language-action (VLA) models benefit from large-scale vision-language pretraining, but tend to memorize training trajectories, limiting their ability to adapt learned interactions to new task and scene configurations. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{Region-Aware Interaction Networks (RAIN)}, which formulates a task as a sequence of goal-conditioned subtasks, each specified by an action type and a target-region mask. This formulation allows learned skills to be reused across different objects and scene layouts and composed into task sequences not seen during training. Its Target-adaptive Cross-View Encoder (TCE) conditions multi-view features on target masks and exchanges information across views, while PlanDiT predicts target-directed trajectories and actions. A Transition Head estimates subtask completion to enable automatic transitions. We also introduce a \textbf{Reference-based Retargeting Strategy (RRS)}, which uses recorded trajectories to synthesize smooth approaches to reference interactions with alternative target regions, without collecting additional data. Experiments on \textbf{LIBERO-Analogy}, our new benchmark for robotic task generalization, and real-world tabletop tasks demonstrate that RAIN generalizes more robustly than existing VLA baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出区域感知交互网络RAIN，将任务建模为"动作类型+目标区域掩码"的子任务序列，实现技能复用与组合泛化，并在新基准LIBERO-Analogy和真实桌面任务上优于现有VLA基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽受益于大规模视觉-语言预训练，但倾向于记忆训练轨迹，难以将已学交互迁移到新的任务与场景配置，泛化能力受限。
AI.method: RAIN将任务表示为一系列目标条件子任务，每个子任务由动作类型与目标区域掩码定义；其目标自适应跨视角编码器（TCE）以目标掩码为条件融合多视角特征并跨视角交换信息；PlanDiT预测目标导向的轨迹与动作；Transition Head估计子任务完成度以触发自动切换；并提出基于参考的重定向策略（RRS），利用已有记录轨迹合成对新目标区域的平滑接近动作，无需额外采集数据。
AI.result: 在自建机器人任务泛化基准LIBERO-Analogy与真实世界桌面任务上，RAIN相比现有VLA基线展现出更稳健的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 以"动作类型+目标区域掩码"的子任务分解可有效缓解轨迹记忆问题，支持技能跨物体、跨布局复用及未见任务序列组合，是提升VLA泛化性的一条有效途径。

title: Kinematics-Induced Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation with Subject-Level Privacy
summary: Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation (3D HPE) combines complementary information from RGB, LiDAR, and mmWave radar, but models trained on correlated observations from the same individuals, raise privacy risks overlooked by record level analysis. We present a unified framework for multimodal 3D HPE that couples kinematics-induced sensor fusion with subject level privacy auditing and private training. First, our multimodal model aligns modality specific joint representation, injects skeletal structure and adaptively aggregates complementary sensor evidence for accurate pose prediction. Second, we formulate a black-box subject membership inference attack for 3D HPE, complemented by an empirical pointwise maximal leakage analysis, which characterizes how individual attack score outcomes change inference about the membership outcome. Third, we instantiate user-level differential privacy via Action Temporal Stratification, a population weighted within-subject sampling strategy that enforces action and temporal coverage. We evaluate our framework on the MM-Fi dataset across three diverse experimental protocols. Source-code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向多模态3D人体姿态估计（3D HPE）的统一框架，将运动学驱动的传感器融合、受试者级隐私审计与隐私训练相结合：设计模态对齐与骨骼结构注入的自适应融合模型；提出黑盒受试者成员推断攻击及逐点最大泄露分析；通过Action Temporal Stratification实现用户级差分隐私。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态3D HPE（融合RGB、LiDAR、mmWave雷达）虽能提升精度，但模型在来自同一受试者的相关观测上训练，会带来隐私风险，而这类风险在记录级（record-level）分析中被忽视，需从受试者级角度进行隐私审计与保护。
AI.method: 1) 多模态模型：对齐各模态特定的关节表示，注入骨骼结构，并自适应聚合互补的传感器证据以预测姿态；2) 隐私审计：形式化针对3D HPE的黑盒受试者成员推断攻击，并辅以逐点最大泄露（pointwise maximal leakage）的实证分析，刻画单个攻击得分如何改变对成员归属的推断；3) 隐私训练：通过Action Temporal Stratification（一种按人群加权、受试者内采样策略，强制动作与时间覆盖）实现用户级差分隐私。
AI.result: 在MM-Fi数据集上，采用三种不同的实验协议对所提框架进行了评估。源代码将在论文被接收后发布（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将多模态3D HPE的精度提升与受试者级隐私保护统一到一个框架中，提出可操作的黑盒成员推断审计与用户级差分隐私训练方案，为多模态人体姿态估计的隐私风险度量与缓解提供了系统方法。

title: Continual Graph Memory for Mathematical Research Agents
summary: Using frontier agent harnesses to tackle mathematical research problems has emerged as an effective means of advancing mathematics. However, solving frontier problems in mathematics may require a massive number of agents working in parallel for extended periods to construct proofs, thereby generating an enormous volume of intermediate proof results. Organizing these intermediate results throughout a long-horizon proof-search process and reusing knowledge gained from prior explorations remain major challenges. We present Ansatz, a mathematical research agent built around Continual Graph Memory, a graph-based, evolvable, cross-problem mathematical research memory system that explicitly organizes the entire proof search process and reuses information from exploration trajectories of previous problems. Specifically, we develop a unified graph memory that represents all intermediate exploration results, including facts, plans, and counterexamples, together with edges that explicitly represent the relationships among them; dependency-aware retrieval supplies precisely targeted local context; an evidence-sensitive curator updates the research frontier and distills lessons from prior attempts; and scoped recall surfaces earlier statements and negative findings for local re-proving rather than uncritical reuse. Experiments cover runs across all ten First Proof Second Batch problems, together with four component studies. Ansatz reports closure on all ten research tasks, demonstrating its ability to sustain and resume long-horizon mathematical search. Beyond these problems, Ansatz also produces solutions to the Jamison caterpillar conjecture and Erdős Problems 289, 348, and 488 without human intervention, and makes partial progress on several open problems, illustrating its strong ability to solve open mathematical research problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ansatz——一个基于"持续图记忆"(Continual Graph Memory)的数学研究智能体系统,通过图结构显式组织长程证明搜索的全过程并复用跨问题探索知识,在10个 First Proof Second Batch 任务上全部闭合,并在 Jamison 毛毛虫猜想和 Erdős 问题 289、348、488 上实现无人工干预求解。
AI.motivation: 前沿数学问题的求解需要大量智能体长时间并行工作以构造证明,会产生海量中间证明结果。在长程搜索过程中如何组织这些中间结果、以及如何复用先前探索所获得的知识,仍是两大核心挑战。
AI.method: 构建以 Continual Graph Memory(可演化、跨问题的图式数学研究记忆系统)为核心的数学研究智能体 Ansatz。其统一图记忆表示全部中间探索结果(事实、计划、反例)及其显式关系边:依赖感知检索提供精准的局部上下文;证据敏感的策展器(curator)更新研究前沿并从既往尝试中提炼经验;作用域召回(scoped recall)在局部重证时调出先前陈述与否定性发现,而非不加甄别地直接复用。
AI.result: 实验涵盖 First Proof Second Batch 全部10个问题的运行以及4项组件研究。Ansatz 在全部10个研究任务上报告闭合(closure),展现出维持与恢复长程数学搜索的能力;此外无人工干预地给出 Jamison 毛毛虫猜想及 Erdős 问题 289、348、488 的解答,并在若干开放问题上取得部分进展。
AI.conclusion: Ansatz 表明,基于可演化图记忆的组织与知识复用机制能够支撑长程数学证明搜索,具备较强的求解开放数学研究问题的能力。

title: When Predicting Nothing Beats SAM 3: Revisiting Evaluation in Video Object Segmentation
summary: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) in complex and long videos is increasingly important for real-world applications, where target objects often appear only intermittently within long temporal horizons. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on temporally salient objects that remain visible for most of the video. To address this gap, we introduce FaVOS (A Benchmark for Video Object Segmentation with Fractional Temporal Visibility), a benchmark designed to evaluate VOS methods under low temporal visibility. We show that, in this regime, the standard J&F metric can collapse VOS evaluation into absence classification, because empty predictions receive high rewards on target-absent frames. Consequently, even a trivial empty-mask predictor can outperform strong models such as SAM 3, revealing a fundamental mismatch between current metrics and practical VOS performance. To mitigate this issue, we propose Volumetric J&F, which evaluates mask sequences as spatio-temporal volumes and reduces the dominance of target-absence rewards while preserving sensitivity to segmentation quality and temporal structure. Project page: https://aidaslab.github.io/FaVOS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FaVOS基准，用于评估低时间可见度下的视频目标分割（VOS），并揭示标准J&F指标在此场景下退化为"缺失分类"的问题，进而提出Volumetric J&F指标以缓解该缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有VOS基准主要关注在视频大部分时间中持续可见的时间显著目标，而真实应用中目标往往只在长时序中间歇性出现。在此类低可见度场景下，现有评估指标与实际性能存在不匹配，缺乏针对性的评测基准。
AI.method: 1）构建FaVOS基准，专门评估低时间可见度条件下的VOS方法；2）分析标准J&F指标在目标缺失帧上的奖励机制，指出其可使评估退化为缺失分类；3）提出Volumetric J&F，将掩码序列视为时空体积进行整体评估，在保留对分割质量与时间结构敏感度的同时，降低目标缺失奖励的主导性。
AI.result: 在低时间可见度场景中，标准J&F指标下即使是平凡的空掩码预测器也能超过SAM 3等强模型，表明当前指标与实际VOS性能存在根本性错配。Volumetric J&F可有效削弱目标缺失带来的奖励优势，同时保持对分割质量和时序结构的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: FaVOS基准与Volumetric J&F指标共同揭示了现有VOS评测在低时间可见度下的局限，并为更贴近实际应用的VOS评估提供了新方向。

title: Enhancing Biomedical Named Entity Recognition via Multiple Programming Languages Instruction Tuning and Ensemble Method
summary: Instruction tuning has become a common paradigm for applying large language models (LLMs) to biomedical named entity recognition (BioNER). However, existing instruction-tuning approaches still face two key challenges. First, conventional natural-language instructions typically serialize BioNER annotations as flat textual outputs, providing limited structural constraints for typed entity extraction. Second, high-quality biomedical annotations are limited, and learning from a single serialized output form may restrict structural diversity and reduce model robustness. Although external biomedical knowledge can be introduced to alleviate data scarcity, it often requires costly resource construction. To address these challenges, we propose MITE, a Multiple Programming Languages Instruction Tuning and Ensemble method for BioNER. MITE reformulates BioNER as a structure-to-structure generation task by representing both instructions and entity outputs in code-formatted representations. Specifically, each training instance is transformed into multiple programming-language formats, including Python, C++, and Java, while preserving the same underlying entity semantics. These language-specific representations provide structurally diverse supervision without requiring external biomedical knowledge or additional annotations. During inference, MITE aggregates predictions from different code formats through an entity-level voting strategy, reducing language-specific prediction variance and improving robustness. Experiments on six widely used BioNER datasets demonstrate that MITE consistently outperforms representative BERT-based and LLM-based baselines and exhibits strong cross-dataset generalization. Ablation and parameter analyses further verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed components.

AI.tldr: MITE将BioNER重构为结构到结构生成任务，用Python、C++、Java三种代码格式表示指令与实体输出，推理时通过实体级投票集成，在六个数据集上超过BERT与LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 现有生物医学命名实体识别（BioNER）的指令微调方法存在两点不足：一是自然语言指令将标注序列化为扁平文本，对类型化实体抽取的结构约束有限；二是高质量生物医学标注稀缺，单一序列化输出形式限制结构多样性并削弱鲁棒性；引入外部知识又需高昂的资源构建成本。
AI.method: 提出MITE（Multiple Programming Languages Instruction Tuning and Ensemble）。将BioNER重构成结构到结构（structure-to-structure）生成任务，指令与实体输出均采用代码格式表示；每条训练实例转换为Python、C++、Java等多种编程语言格式，保持底层实体语义一致，从而在不依赖外部生物医学知识或额外标注的情况下提供结构多样的监督信号；推理阶段通过实体级投票策略聚合不同代码格式的预测，降低语言特有的预测方差。
AI.result: 在六个常用BioNER数据集上，MITE持续优于代表性的BERT类与LLM类基线，并表现出较强的跨数据集泛化能力；消融实验与参数分析进一步验证了各组成部分的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 以多编程语言代码格式进行指令微调并结合实体级投票集成，是一种无需外部知识即可提升BioNER结构监督多样性与鲁棒性的有效范式。

title: Understanding Trajectory Heterogeneity in Federated World Model Learning
summary: World models learn state evolution from trajectories, making access to temporal context a central training requirement. Federated learning can use distributed records, while ownership boundaries within a trajectory restrict the examples each client can construct. Our study benchmarks this cross-time setting through hourly action-conditioned clinical prediction on eight MIMIC-IV disease cohorts, comprising 40.87 million transition memberships. We specify severity-based client ownership, patient-separated construction, local history and future-window rules, and paired rollout evaluation from one to 32 hours. A matrix of ten federated algorithms covers 32 disease--partition configurations under five rounds of ten-percent participation. Three findings emerge from existing results and training logs. First, client ownership and participation jointly restrict long-window coverage: only 7.55\%--21.36\% of pooled-available 32-step windows have a locally complete anchor visited during training, averaged across diseases. Second, finer severity partitions accompany higher FedAvg error in 15 of 16 paired comparisons, while algorithm gains are small and horizon-dependent: FedProx reduces mean error by 0.56\%, with no consistent improvement at 32 steps. Third, algorithm labels conceal distinct update behavior, including inactive extrapolation and orders-of-magnitude differences in update scale. Cached-update performance also varies strongly across trajectory partitions under the same benchmark protocol. These results establish temporal access, participation coverage, optimization behavior, and horizon-resolved prediction as complementary dimensions for evaluating federated clinical world models.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了基于MIMIC-IV八类疾病队列的联邦临床世界模型基准（4087万转移样本），考察跨时间联邦学习的时序上下文可及性问题。
AI.motivation: 世界模型需从轨迹中学习状态演化，依赖时序上下文；联邦学习虽可整合分布式记录，但轨迹内的所有权边界限制了各客户端可构造的训练样本，形成"跨时间"训练困境。
AI.method: 在八个MIMIC-IV疾病队列上开展逐小时动作条件临床预测（4087万转移成员），设定基于严重度的客户端所有权、患者分离构造、本地历史与未来窗口规则，以及1至32小时的配对rollout评估；使用十种联邦算法矩阵，覆盖32种疾病-划分配置，每轮10%参与、共5轮。
AI.result: 1）客户端所有权与参与度共同限制长窗口覆盖，仅7.55%–21.36%的可汇集32步窗口拥有训练中访问到的本地完整锚点；2）更细的严重度划分在16组配对比较中有15组伴随更高FedAvg误差，算法增益小且依赖预测视界（FedProx平均误差降0.56%，32步无一致改善）；3）算法标签掩盖了不同的更新行为，包括不活跃外推与数量级差异的更新尺度，缓存更新性能在同一基准协议下随轨迹划分变化显著。
AI.conclusion: 时序可及性、参与覆盖、优化行为与视界分辨预测构成评估联邦临床世界模型的互补维度。

title: TerraVis: Towards Evaluation of World-Grounded Visual Consistency in Text-to-Image Generation via MLLM Workflows
summary: Recent text-to-image models have made substantial progress in photorealism, aesthetics, and text-image alignment. Yet visually appealing images can still violate real-world plausibility, exhibiting malformed object structures, impossible anatomy, physically implausible interactions, or inconsistent spatial relationships. Such failures are not well captured by existing fidelity, aesthetics, preference, or alignment metrics. To address this gap, we introduce TerraVis, a framework for evaluating world-grounded visual consistency in generated images. TerraVis defines a structured taxonomy of world-consistency violations spanning object-, interaction-, and scene-level failures, and employs a multi-stage evaluation framework to identify and quantify them. Given an image, TerraVis first uses an MLLM to assess its eligibility for evaluation, then detects violations across 18 taxonomy-defined types and classifies them as minor or major to derive an overall world-consistency score. Across diverse open-source and proprietary text-to-image models on two widely used benchmarks, TerraVis achieves the strongest correlation with human judgments of world consistency among existing metrics. Our benchmark results further show that models that achieve strong performance on conventional metrics can still exhibit substantial world-consistency failures. These findings highlight world consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension and demonstrate that TerraVis enables systematic quantification, diagnosis, and comparison of such failures. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShyFoo/TerraVis.

AI.tldr: 提出 TerraVis 框架，用于评估生成图像中"世界一致性"（物理、解剖、结构、空间合理性）的违反情况，建立包含对象级、交互级、场景级失败的结构化分类体系，并在多模型、多基准上验证其与人类判断的相关性最强。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型在真实感、美学和文本-图像对齐方面已取得显著进展，但生成的图像仍可能违反现实世界的合理性，如物体结构畸变、解剖错误、物理上不可能的交互或空间关系不一致。这类失败难以被现有的保真度、美学、偏好或对齐指标有效捕捉，因此需要一个新的评估维度。
AI.method: TerraVis 定义了一套结构化分类体系（taxonomy），涵盖对象级、交互级和场景级三个层次的世界一致性违反类型；采用多阶段评估框架：先用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）判断图像是否具备评估资格，再在 18 种分类类型上检测违规，并将违规划分为轻微与严重两类，最终得出整体世界一致性得分。
AI.result: 在两个广泛使用的基准上，对多种开源与闭源文本到图像模型进行评估，TerraVis 在衡量世界一致性方面与人类判断的相关性优于现有指标。基准结果显示，在传统指标上表现强劲的模型仍可能存在大量世界一致性失败。
AI.conclusion: 世界一致性应被视为一个补充性的评估维度；TerraVis 能够对这类失败进行系统化的量化、诊断与比较。代码已公开于 https://github.com/ShyFoo/TerraVis。

title: Post-Training Frontier Text-to-Image Models by Composing Preference and Rubric Rewards
summary: Recent text-to-image generation models have achieved remarkable visual quality, but improving them through post-training remains challenging because no single reward signal captures the full range of human preference. In this work, we develop a simple and effective post-training recipe for open-domain text-to-image generation based on the composition of complementary reward signals. Our reward system consists of two main components: a preference reward, trained on large-scale human preference data using a Bradley-Terry objective to capture overall human aesthetic and perceptual preferences, and rubric-based rewards, which explicitly evaluate prompt faithfulness and other desirable properties while providing safeguards against reward hacking. A key challenge is how to combine these heterogeneous reward signals. We show that a naive weighted average leads to suboptimal optimization behavior, and propose a simple reward composition strategy that more effectively balances preference optimization with rubric satisfaction. In the Arena text-to-image leaderboard (https://arena.ai/), our RL-trained Flux2dev achieves an Elo rating 69 points above the base model, and our post-trained Ideogram-4 surpasses every open-source model on the leaderboard, reaching an Elo of 1223.5. (Claims of state-of-the-art performance are based on the Arena leaderboard snapshot as of September 4, 2026.) Our results suggest that effective rewards for frontier generative-model training require broad coverage of user intent and robustness to exploitation under optimization. To support reproducible research, we release Arena-T2I-Training, a 1K subset of training data that recovers some gains of full-scale training, providing a resource that we hope will facilitate future work on post-training for text-to-image models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于互补奖励信号组合的开放域文生图后训练方法，通过偏好奖励与规则奖励的有机结合提升生成质量与提示词遵循度。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图模型视觉质量已很高，但事后训练（post-training）难以提升，因为单一奖励信号无法覆盖人类偏好的全部维度；同时多种异构奖励信号的组合方式本身存在优化困难。
AI.method: 构建双组件奖励系统：(1) 偏好奖励，基于大规模人类偏好数据、采用Bradley-Terry目标训练，捕捉整体美学与感知偏好；(2) 规则（rubric）奖励，显式评估提示词遵循度等期望属性，并防范奖励黑客（reward hacking）。针对异构奖励组合，指出朴素加权平均导致次优优化行为，提出一种简单的奖励组合策略以更有效平衡偏好优化与规则满足。
AI.result: 在Arena文生图排行榜上：经RL训练的Flux2dev较基座模型Elo提升69分；后训练的Ideogram-4超越所有开源模型，Elo达1223.5（SOTA声明基于2026年9月4日排行榜快照）。此外发布Arena-T2I-Training——1K训练数据子集，可复现全量训练的部分增益。
AI.conclusion: 前沿生成模型训练的有效奖励需具备对用户意图的广泛覆盖以及对优化过程中被利用（exploitation）的鲁棒性；释放训练数据子集以促进文生图后训练的可复现研究。

title: A Guideline-Augmented Multi-Agent Framework for Schema-as-Code Biomedical Named Entity Recognition
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promising potential for biomedical named entity recognition (BioNER) through instruction following and in-context learning. However, existing LLM-based BioNER methods still face two key limitations. First, retrieved demonstrations and external biomedical knowledge provide limited support for dataset-specific annotation semantics, leaving entity boundaries, type scopes, and annotation conventions ambiguous. Second, free-form generation lacks sufficient structural control, often leading to invalid formats, hallucinated mentions, duplicated entities, and boundary errors. To address these limitations, we propose GAMA, a guideline-augmented multi-agent framework for schema-as-code BioNER. GAMA first induces candidate annotation rules from labeled training instances and verifies them against annotated data to construct reliable dataset-specific guideline memory. Guided by these verified rules, a planning component generates ranked span-type hypotheses with rationales, and a coding component converts them into schema-constrained entity objects. A verification module then checks span grounding, type validity, and structural compliance, and performs dual-loop refinement to correct invalid or low-confidence predictions. Experiments on five widely used BioNER datasets with multiple LLM backbones show that GAMA consistently outperforms strong LLM-based baselines. Ablation and parameter analyses further verify the effectiveness of the proposed components.

AI.tldr: GAMA：面向schema-as-code BioNER的指南增强多智能体框架
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的BioNER存在两大局限：一是检索式示范与外部生物医学知识难以支撑数据集特有的标注语义，导致实体边界、类型范围与标注惯例含糊；二是自由形式生成缺乏结构控制，易产生格式无效、幻觉提及、重复实体与边界错误。
AI.method: 提出GAMA指南增强多智能体框架，实现schema-as-code的BioNER。首先从有标注训练实例归纳候选标注规则，并利用标注数据验证，构建可靠的数据集特有指南记忆；在验证规则指导下，规划组件生成带理由的、按序排列的span-type假设，编码组件将其转换为schema约束的实体对象；验证模块检查span接地、类型有效性与结构合规性，并通过双循环精修纠正无效或低置信预测。
AI.result: 在五个广泛使用的BioNER数据集上，使用多种LLM骨干进行实验，GAMA持续优于强LLM基线；消融与参数分析进一步验证了各提出组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将数据集特有标注规则显式化为可复用指南记忆，并以规划-编码-验证的多智能体流程施加schema约束，GAMA有效缓解了标注语义模糊与自由生成不可控问题，提升了LLM在BioNER上的性能与结构可靠性。

title: From Language Priors to Field Adaptation: Preference Learning for Traversability Estimation
summary: Image-based traversability estimation is inherently dependent on the robot platform, deployment domain, and mission preferences, which limits the applicability of purpose-trained models. To facilitate domain adaptation, this work aims to reduce the number of required annotations in the target domain using sample-efficient preference learning. Our method represents traversability through von Mises-Fisher mixture prototypes in a frozen vision-language feature space. Relative natural-language rules provide a commonsense prior, while sparse relative image annotations adapt the prototype directions and utilities to a target domain through computationally and sample-efficient fine-tuning. Experiments on WayFAST demonstrate accuracy competitive with end-to-end trained estimators while enabling sample-efficient image-based adaptation. Qualitative experiments further demonstrate the language prior's zero shot applicability and the fine-tuned estimator's improved dense prediction on semantic maps. Evaluation is complemented via semantic interpretation of learned prototypes by dissecting semantically close natural language prompts. Code and trained estimators available at https://resireg.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用样本高效的偏好学习，在冻结的视觉-语言特征空间中用 von Mises-Fisher 混合原型表示可通行性，通过相对自然语言规则提供常识先验、稀疏相对图像标注微调原型方向与效用，实现域自适应的可通行性估计。
AI.motivation: 基于图像的可通行性估计高度依赖机器人平台、部署域和任务偏好，导致专用训练的模型泛化能力受限；同时在新目标域进行标注成本高昂，因此需要减少目标域标注量并实现高效的域自适应。
AI.method: 方法在冻结的视觉-语言特征空间中使用 von Mises-Fisher 混合原型表示可通行性；以相对自然语言规则作为常识先验，并利用稀疏的相对图像标注，通过计算与样本均高效的微调来调整原型方向和效用，从而适配目标域。
AI.result: 在 WayFAST 数据集上的实验表明，该方法达到了与端到端训练估计器相当的精度，同时实现了样本高效的图像域自适应；定性实验显示语言先验具有零样本适用性，微调后的估计器在语义地图上的稠密预测性能提升；并通过拆解语义相近的自然语言提示对学习到的原型进行了语义解释。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过语言先验与稀疏相对标注的结合，实现了样本高效的可通行性域自适应，兼顾精度与泛化，并提供了原型的语义可解释性；代码与训练好的估计器已公开。

title: OLMo-Detect: A Multi-Stage, Confounder-Controlled Benchmark for Membership Inference on Large Language Models
summary: Membership inference on large language models (LLMs) aims to determine whether a given text sample was included in an LLM's training data, without access to its training corpus. Despite recent progress, existing benchmarks suffer from three limitations: limited coverage of training stages, insufficient distributional alignment between members and non-members, and lack of rigorous filtering of non-members against the training corpus. To address these limitations, we propose OLMo-Detect, a multi-stage, confounder-controlled benchmark built upon the fully open OLMo 2 pipeline. OLMo-Detect spans pre-training, mid-training, and post-training, explicitly aligns members and non-members on three key axes, and rigorously filters non-members via infini-gram. To assess robustness to distribution shifts, we further introduce OLMo-Detect (Shifted), a variant where members are misaligned with non-members. We evaluate 15 unsupervised and 3 supervised membership inference attacks (MIAs) across the OLMo 2 family, finding that: (i) overall performance is limited: the best unsupervised and supervised MIAs both reach an AUC of only 0.68, and supervised MIAs degrade under cross-domain evaluation; (ii) MIA performance peaks at mid-training and is lower at pre-training and post-training, a pattern driven by data type rather than a stage effect: curated math data is far more detectable than other types; (iii) overall scores improve from 1B to 13B but plateau at 32B; and (iv) no unsupervised MIA is robust to distribution shifts, with AUCs shifting by up to 0.42. Finally, we find that our findings on OLMo 2 generalize to OLMo 3 and non-OLMo models.

AI.tldr: 提出 OLMo-Detect 多阶段、混淆因素受控的成员推断攻击基准，覆盖预训练/中训练/后训练，发现最优 MIA 的 AUC 仅约 0.68，且对分布偏移缺乏鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 成员推断（MIA）基准存在三大局限：训练阶段覆盖有限、成员与非成员分布对齐不足、未对非成员做严格过滤。针对这些问题构建更严谨的评测基准。
AI.method: 基于完全开放的 OLMo 2 流程构建 OLMo-Detect：跨越预训练、中训练与后训练三个阶段；在三个关键维度上显式对齐成员与非成员；利用 infini-gram 严格过滤非成员。并引入 OLMo-Detect (Shifted) 变体使成员与非成员失配，以评估分布偏移鲁棒性。评测 15 种无监督与 3 种有监督 MIA。
AI.result: (i) 整体性能有限，最优无监督与有监督 MIA 的 AUC 均仅 0.68，有监督 MIA 跨域时性能下降；(ii) MIA 性能在中训练达到峰值，预训练与后训练较低，该模式由数据类型驱动而非阶段效应，精选数学数据可检测性远高于其他类型；(iii) 从 1B 到 13B 性能提升，到 32B 趋于平台期；(iv) 无监督 MIA 均无法抵抗分布偏移，AUC 变化幅度最高达 0.42。结论在 OLMo 3 与非 OLMo 模型上具有泛化性。
AI.conclusion: OLMo-Detect 提供了更严格的多阶段 MIA 评测基准，揭示了当前 MIA 方法在性能、阶段差异与分布偏移鲁棒性上的显著不足，且该结论可推广至其他模型家族。

title: Sentry: Learning to Recover from LLM Agent Failures at Test Time
summary: LLM agents often fail mid-task due to invalid tool calls, repeated actions, or poorly grounded reasoning, and learning from these failures is a path to reliability. We find that how failure knowledge reaches the agent matters as much as what it contains. Failure lessons are conditional: kept in the agent's context, they misfire when their failure is absent, and removing them from an evolving playbook improves performance. Runtime interventions, in contrast, act only when a failure occurs but do not learn from their repairs. We argue that failure knowledge is conditional knowledge and should be conditionally exposed, and instantiate this principle in Sentry, a failure-management layer that runs alongside the agent. When Sentry detects a failure, it retrieves matching lessons from an external playbook to guide recovery, verifies without access to task rewards whether the agent recovered, and stores a new lesson only if it did; the full playbook never enters the agent's context. Across multiple agentic benchmarks, Sentry outperforms the strongest runtime-intervention baseline on every benchmark, by 37\% on average, and the strongest context-evolution baseline by 39\% on the two benchmarks where both are evaluated; combining Sentry with context evolution yields further gains. Learned lessons transfer to held-out tasks, and controlled experiments show that exposing the full playbook to the agent lowers performance even when relevant lessons remain available on demand.

AI.tldr: 论文提出「失败知识是条件性知识」的原则，并实现 Sentry 失败管理层：仅在检测到失败时从外部 playbook 检索匹配教训以指导恢复，验证恢复后仅存成功教训，完整 playbook 从不进入 agent 上下文，在多个 agentic 基准上平均超越最强运行时干预基线 37%。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 常因无效工具调用、重复动作或推理缺乏依据而在任务中途失败。作者旨在通过从失败中学习提升可靠性，并指出失败知识「如何到达 agent」与「包含什么」同样重要：教训是条件性的，若常驻上下文会在失败不存在时误触发，反而降低性能；而运行时干预虽只在失败时生效，却不从修复中学习。
AI.method: 提出原则：失败知识是条件性知识，应条件性暴露，仅在相关失败发生时展示对应教训。据此实现 Sentry——一个与 agent 并行运行的失败管理层。当检测到失败时，Sentry 从外部 playbook 检索匹配教训指导恢复，并在不访问任务奖励的情况下验证 agent 是否恢复，仅当恢复成功才存储新教训；完整 playbook 始终不进入 agent 上下文。
AI.result: 在多个 agentic 基准上，Sentry 在每个基准上都优于最强的运行时干预基线，平均提升 37%；在两个均被评估的基准上，比最强的上下文演化基线高 39%；与上下文演化结合可获进一步增益。学到的教训可迁移到留出任务；控制实验表明，即便相关教训仍可按需获取，向 agent 暴露完整 playbook 也会降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 失败知识应按条件性、按需暴露，而非常驻上下文；将失败管理与上下文演化解耦的 Sentry 设计能有效提升 agent 可靠性，且与上下文演化方法互补。

title: OmniConfess: Eliciting Token Confessions to Mitigate Omni-Modal Hallucination
summary: Omni-modal large language models (OmniLLMs) unify text, images, audio, and video, yet hallucinate when generation relies on the wrong evidence. Existing inference-time methods can reduce hallucinations, but rarely reveal which evidence sustains a generated commitment. We introduce OmniConfess, a training-free method for mitigating omni-modal hallucinations. It fixes a candidate response and re-scores it at token resolution under controlled channel-wise evidence interventions, producing a structured token-by-channel confession that reveals the response's evidential dependence. OmniConfess uses this confession to preserve grounded content and correct commitments driven by irrelevant or contradictory evidence. To evaluate OmniConfess, we construct OmniHalluBench, a 3,540-example benchmark built from six datasets spanning text, image, audio, and video settings and both judgment and free-form generation. Experiments show that OmniConfess mitigates hallucinations across heterogeneous modality and task settings. Our code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/RongHuiQiang/OmniConfess.

AI.tldr: OmniConfess是一种免训练方法，通过通道级证据干预的token级重打分，生成"token-通道忏悔"结构来揭示多模态生成承诺的证据依赖，从而缓解全模态大模型幻觉。
AI.motivation: 全模态大模型统一文本、图像、音频和视频，但当生成依赖错误证据时会产生幻觉。现有推理时方法虽能减少幻觉，却很少揭示究竟是哪些证据支撑了生成的承诺（commitment）。
AI.method: 固定一个候选回复，在受控的逐通道证据干预下对其在token粒度重新打分，产出结构化的"token-通道忏悔"，据此揭示回复的证据依赖性；再利用该忏悔保留有依据的内容，并纠正由无关或矛盾证据驱动的承诺。方法免训练。
AI.result: 构建了OmniHalluBench基准，包含3,540个样例，来自六个数据集，覆盖文本、图像、音频、视频四种模态及判断式与自由生成两类任务；实验显示OmniConfess在异构模态和任务设置下均能缓解幻觉。
AI.conclusion: OmniConfess提供了一种免训练、可解释的全模态幻觉缓解方案，通过证据依赖的显式归因实现精准纠正；代码与基准已公开。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) understand and generate both text and images, which lets a model produce its own training data. Existing self-improvement in UMMs keeps supervision on the visual side, where image understanding judges image generation. We propose recursive cross-capability self-improvement (RSI), a training loop in which the text and visual abilities of a UMM supply training data for one another. In each round, the model generates images and reads them to find where it falls short. It then writes programs aimed at these shortcomings, and execution verifies every result against its specification. Verified renders train image generation, while labeled renders and the model's own correct programs train visual understanding and program writing. Program execution thus acts as a source of truth outside the model, so errors do not accumulate across rounds. We study RSI on charts and build BasicChartBench to evaluate open models early in training. On requests worded differently from training, four rounds of RSI raise the score from 45.7% to 60.2%, while continued training stays at 46.3%. Verified construction carries most of the gain, and targeting the model's failures adds 3.5%. Along the way, the share of verified programs rises from 48.9% to 95.2%, and the reader's accuracy on edited renders rises from 55.6% to 87.4%.

AI.tldr: 提出递归跨能力自我改进（RSI）训练循环，让统一多模态模型的文本与视觉能力互相提供训练数据，并以程序执行作为外部真值源防止误差累积；在图表任务上4轮RSI将泛化得分从45.7%提升到60.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（UMM）虽能理解并生成文本与图像、可自造训练数据，但自我改进的监督信号仅停留在视觉侧（用图像理解评判图像生成），能力间未形成闭环，性能提升受限且易累积误差。
AI.method: RSI训练循环：每轮模型先生成图像并阅读以定位自身短板，再针对短板编写程序，由程序执行按其规范逐一验证结果。经验证的渲染图用于训练图像生成；带标注的渲染图与模型自身正确程序用于训练视觉理解与程序编写。程序执行作为模型之外的真值来源。同时构建BasicChartBench以评估训练早期的开源模型。
AI.result: 在措辞不同于训练集的请求上，4轮RSI将得分从45.7%提升至60.2%，而持续训练仅停留在46.3%。验证性构造贡献主要增益，针对模型失败点额外带来3.5%提升。过程中验证程序占比从48.9%升至95.2%，阅读器对编辑后渲染图的准确率从55.6%升至87.4%。
AI.conclusion: 以程序执行为外部真值的递归跨能力自我改进可有效提升UMM的文本与视觉能力，且增益主要来自验证性构造与失败点定向，具备跨轮次抑制误差累积的泛化优势。

title: Rethinking Fixed Temporal Grids: Frequency-Disentangled Motion Generation
summary: Most human motion generation methods encode motion as tokens on a uniform temporal grid, where every token spans the same fixed time window. Human motion, however, is temporally heterogeneous: slowly evolving global trajectories coexist with rapid transient events such as foot contacts and joint impulses. Forcing such multi-scale dynamics onto tokens of identical temporal resolution entangles motion frequencies, leaving slow regions redundant while smoothing out the rapid details that distinguish realistic motion. We propose \textbf{FreqMo}, a scale-adaptive motion representation that decomposes motion into wavelet frequency bands, separating dynamics across temporal scales while preserving temporal localization and exact reconstruction. Unified Frequency Residual Quantization (UFRQ) then encodes all bands within a single shared codebook, compressing the token sequence threefold and enabling stable single-stage generation. Experiments show FreqMo attains SOTA fidelity with substantially improved high-frequency preservation, and the same decomposition transfers to continuous diffusion backbones.

AI.tldr: FreqMo 提出尺度自适应的小波频带运动表示与统一频率残差量化（UFRQ），将运动分解到不同时间尺度，在保持精确重构和时序定位的同时把 token 序列压缩三倍并实现单阶段稳定生成，取得高保真且高频细节保留更优的 SOTA 结果。
AI.motivation: 现有运动生成方法通常在均匀时间网格上将运动编码为 token，每个 token 覆盖相同固定时间窗。但人体运动具有时间异质性：缓慢演化的全局轨迹与快速瞬态事件（如足部接触、关节冲量）共存。将多尺度动力学强行塞入相同时间分辨率的 token 会混叠运动频率，导致慢速区域冗余、快速细节被平滑，损害真实感。
AI.method: 提出 FreqMo 尺度自适应运动表示，基于小波频带将运动分解，分离不同时间尺度的动力学，同时保持时序定位与精确重构；并设计统一频率残差量化（UFRQ），在单一共享码本内编码所有频带，实现 token 序列三倍压缩与稳定的单阶段生成。
AI.result: 实验表明 FreqMo 达到 SOTA 保真度，高频保留能力显著提升；该分解方式同样可迁移至连续扩散骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: FreqMo 通过频率分解与共享码本量化，缓解均匀网格 token 的频率混叠问题，在压缩序列的同时提升生成保真度与高频细节保留，并具备向连续扩散框架的通用性。

title: RYOPO: Bringing End-to-End Category-Level Object Pose Estimation into Real Time
summary: Category-level object pose estimation predicts the rotation, translation, and metric size of unseen instances within known categories. Many accurate RGB-D methods rely on external instance segmentation and crop-based pose estimation, introducing separate stages and object-dependent processing costs that hinder real-time inference. To bring accurate pose estimation into real time, we present \ours{}, an end-to-end trainable query-based RGB-D set predictor. It jointly detects and segments objects and estimates their \mbox{9-DoF} poses without explicit CAD-derived shape priors or a separately trained instance segmentor. Shared image and scene encoding avoids repeated per-object crop encoding. A query-conditioned geometry pathway associates observed 3D points and RGB features with object queries and incorporates shared scene context. Object-centric refinement uses the resulting point descriptors to update an explicit pose state through pose-conditioned cross-attention and recurrent residual corrections. On NOCS, \ours{} substantially improves on published RGB-D joint detection and pose estimation results. It achieves competitive performance compared with two-stage methods under all-object evaluation on REAL275 and HouseCat6D, while enabling real-time full-frame pose estimation at $31.8$ FPS on an RTX~A6000. Project page: https://yopo-series.github.io/RYOPO-project-page/.

AI.tldr: 提出RYOPO，一种端到端可训练的基于查询的RGB-D集合预测器，联合检测、分割并估计物体9-DoF位姿，无需显式CAD形状先验或独立实例分割器，在NOCS、REAL275和HouseCat6D上取得竞争性精度并实现实时推理。
AI.motivation: 现有许多精确的RGB-D位姿估计方法依赖外部实例分割和基于裁剪的位姿估计，引入分离阶段和随物体数量增长的额外计算开销，难以实时推理。作者希望将精确的类别级位姿估计带入实时水平。
AI.method: RYOPO是一个端到端可训练的基于查询的RGB-D集合预测器：联合检测并分割物体并估计其9-DoF位姿，无需显式CAD形状先验和单独训练的实例分割器；共享图像与场景编码避免逐物体重复裁剪编码；查询条件几何通路将观测到的3D点与RGB特征关联到物体查询并融合共享场景上下文；物体中心细化利用点描述子，通过位姿条件交叉注意力和递归残差修正更新显式位姿状态。
AI.result: 在NOCS上显著提升已发表的RGB-D联合检测与位姿估计结果；在REAL275和HouseCat6D的全物体评估下与两阶段方法性能相当；在RTX A6000上实现31.8 FPS的实时全帧位姿估计。
AI.conclusion: RYOPO通过统一端到端的查询式架构，在避免裁剪编码与独立分割阶段的同时保持高精度，实现了类别级位姿估计的实时推理，兼顾精度与效率。

title: OmniAct3D: Leveraging Foundation Geometry and Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for Panoramic 3D Detection
summary: Accurate 3D detection is essential for mobile embodied agents, while Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) offer transferable visual and geometric priors. Yet existing VFM-based 3D detectors rely on narrow-view monocular images or discrete perspective views, limiting coherent surround perception; equirectangular projection (ERP) instead encodes a continuous 360 scene in a single image. Direct transfer remains difficult because ERP organizes geometry and visual information differently, making object-relevant cues hard to model, localize, and preserve. We propose OmniAct3D, a framework that adapts perspective-trained VFM detectors to ERP while preserving transferable VFM priors. To resolve geometric mismatch, the ERP-Ray Geometry Adapter (ERGA-Ray) models spherical viewing rays and periodic spatial structure. To localize evidence in scene-wide context, the Visual-Action Reasoning Chain (VARC) grounds each hypothesis in relevant panoramic evidence and converts it into a structured geometric action. To recover local cues lost under fixed token budgets, the Appearance-Guided Heading Expert (AGHE) re-encodes object regions at higher resolution for heading estimation. Experiments show that OmniAct3D improves over the previous best 3D detector by 2.96 NDS points on Spheriverse and over the unadapted VFM baseline by 24.87 mAP points on PanoMMOcc. With target-specific geometry adaptation, VARC retains 95--98% of the same-configuration mAP, indicating reusable object-level 3D reasoning across sensing configurations. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/FeiT-FeiTeng/OmniAct3D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OmniAct3D框架，将透视视图训练的视觉基础模型（VFM）检测器适配至360°等距柱状投影（ERP），通过ERP-Ray几何适配器、视觉-动作推理链和外观引导朝向专家实现全景3D检测，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 移动具身智能体需要准确的3D检测，VFM提供了可迁移的视觉与几何先验。然而现有基于VFM的3D检测器依赖窄视角单目图像或离散透视图，限制了连贯的环绕感知；而ERP虽能在单张图像中编码连续360°场景，却因几何与视觉信息组织方式不同，导致物体相关线索难以建模、定位与保留，直接迁移困难。
AI.method: OmniAct3D在保留VFM可迁移先验的同时将透视训练的VFM检测器适配至ERP，包含三个模块：1）ERP-Ray Geometry Adapter（ERGA-Ray）建模球面视线与周期性空间结构，解决几何失配；2）Visual-Action Reasoning Chain（VARC）在全景上下文中定位证据，将每个假设锚定于相关全景证据并转化为结构化几何动作；3）Appearance-Guided Heading Expert（AGHE）在固定token预算下对物体区域进行高分辨率重编码，恢复局部线索用于朝向估计。
AI.result: 实验表明，OmniAct3D在Spheriverse上较此前最佳3D检测器提升2.96 NDS，在PanoMMOcc上较未适配的VFM基线提升24.87 mAP。通过目标特定的几何适配，VARC在同配置下保留了95–98%的mAP，表明对象级3D推理可跨传感配置复用。
AI.conclusion: OmniAct3D有效弥合了透视训练VFM与ERP全景感知之间的几何与信息组织鸿沟，实现了高性能且具备可复用对象级3D推理能力的全景3D检测，源代码将公开。

title: From Expression to Reaction: Role-aware Visual Transfer and Stimulus-guided Reasoning for Interlocutor Emotion Recognition
comment: Technical report of the second-place solution in Track 1 (MER-Cross) of the MER Grand Challenge at ACM MM 2026
