AI.tldr: 该论文提出行为包优化（BPO），通过在多视角反事实输入上联合评分奖励，替代单响应奖励，使视频多模态大模型摆脱外观与语言先验，实现基于时序证据的推理。
AI.motivation: 现有视频多模态大模型虽在视频问答基准上表现提升，但对帧打乱、关键片段遮挡或目标物体遮挡几乎不敏感，说明其准确率依赖外观和语言先验而非问题所需的时序证据。作者将根因追溯到后训练单元：奖励仅在原始片段的单一响应上计算，模型从未被要求在不同视角间保持一致行为。
AI.method: 提出行为包优化（BPO），用一组跨反事实视角（视角按问题类型选择）、联合评分的输出 "行为包" 替代单一响应。包奖励要求：干预无关时保持稳定、关键证据移除时保持敏感、无证据时进行弃答。为在小包尺寸下稳定该目标，BPO 采用锚点相对优势，以原始视角的响应作为每个提示的参考，而非混合视角的组均值。
AI.result: 在 TempCompass、MVBench、NExT-QA 上，相比同一 SFT 检查点、预算匹配的 vanilla GRPO 基线，BPO 将 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 的宏准确率提升 4.7 个百分点，时序困难子集提升 7.8 个百分点，弃答 F1 提升 20.0 个百分点。收益可迁移至 Video-MME、LongVideoBench 以及 LLaVA-Video-7B；消融实验证实收益来自视角集而非 rollout 数量。
AI.conclusion: BPO 通过包级后训练视角，使视频多模态大模型的行为由时序证据驱动而非外观与语言先验，为视频多模态与多模态后训练社区迈向证据接地的视频推理提供了有益起点。

title: CalCErt: Bin-wise Certification of Confidence Calibration in Medical Image Classification
summary: Deep neural networks remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, which can distort not only predictions but also confidence scores, undermining uncertainty calibration. While existing certification methods focus on preserving the predicted category, providing guarantees on how calibration behaves under adversarial attacks remains overlooked. In this work, we introduce CalCErt, a simple and efficient post-hoc strategy that certifies bin-wise confidence calibration for any pretrained differentiable classifier. Our approach combines empirical calibration estimates, statistical concentration bounds, and local Lipschitz estimates of the confidence function to derive data-dependent upper bounds on worst-case miscalibration within an $ell_2$-ball of radius R. We evaluate CalCErt across 11 medical image classification tasks and multiple adversarial perturbations, demonstrating substantially higher certified coverage than baseline strategies while maintaining competitive tightness. Our code is available at https://github.com/leofillioux/calcert.

AI.tldr: 提出CalCErt，一种针对任意预训练可微分类器的后处理方法，用于认证置信度的分箱校准在ℓ2扰动下的最坏情况误校准上界。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络对对抗扰动脆弱，扰动不仅会扭曲预测，还会扭曲置信度分数，破坏不确定性校准。现有认证方法只关注保持预测类别，而对抗攻击下校准行为的保证尚未被研究。
AI.method: CalCErt结合经验校准估计、统计集中不等式以及置信度函数的局部Lipschitz估计，推导出在半径R的ℓ2球内最坏情况误校准的数据依赖上界。该方法简单高效，作为后处理策略适用于任意预训练可微分类器。
AI.result: 在11个医学图像分类任务和多种对抗扰动上进行评估，CalCErt相比基线策略实现了显著更高的认证覆盖率，同时保持有竞争力的紧致度。
AI.conclusion: CalCErt首次为对抗扰动下的置信度校 providing认证保证，在医学图像分类任务中验证了其有效性与效率，代码已开源。

title: Does Physics Live in the Activations? Localizing Physical Quantities in Video Diffusion Models
summary: Video generation models produce strikingly realistic sequences and are increasingly proposed as world models, yet recent benchmarks reveal pronounced deficits in their physical reasoning. This raises the question of whether these models internalize physical principles or merely reproduce familiar motion patterns. We address this by probing internal representations of video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for simulator-derived ground-truth physical quantities spanning kinematic motion and rigid-body dynamics under gravity and contact. We find that these quantities are linearly decodable with high accuracy early in the denoising process, substantially outperforming a baseline decoded directly from the model's own noised latents, indicating that the relevant physical information is actively constructed during denoising rather than already present in the input. Additionally, we show that activations at on-object tokens carry the relevant physical information and that quantities defined over multiple frames are readable from single latent frames. Hence, information is sharply localized within the token sequence and is computed globally but stored locally. The probes further show partial extrapolation, transferring to scene variations and object configurations outside their training regime, so what they read is not simply a correlate of the scenes they were fit on. When fitted directly in the full-resolution activation space, the probing directions can serve as steering vectors to change the model's output.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过线性探针研究视频扩散Transformer( DiT )的内部表征，发现仿真器导出的物理量在去噪早期即可被高精度线性解码，且物理信息在去噪过程中被主动构建、于物体token处局部存储，并可作为控制向量改变模型输出。
AI.motivation: 近期基准测试显示视频生成模型在物理推理上存在明显缺陷，引发了一个核心问题：这些模型是真正内化了物理原理，还是仅复现了熟悉的运动模式？作者希望从内部表征层面回答这一问题。
AI.method: 作者用仿真器导出的、涵盖运动学与刚体动力学（重力与接触）的真值物理量，对视频DiT的内部表征进行线性探针( probing )分析，并与直接从模型自身含噪潜变量解码的基线对比；同时考察激活在token序列中的定位（物体token、单帧潜变量）及跨场景/跨物体配置的外推能力，并将在全分辨率激活空间拟合的探针方向用作steering vectors。
AI.result: 物理量在去噪过程早期即可被高精度线性解码，显著优于从模型自身含噪潜变量解码的基线；激活在物体token处携带相关物理信息，多帧定义的物理量可从单帧潜变量读出；探针表现出部分外推能力，可迁移到训练范围外的场景变化与物体配置；在全分辨率激活空间拟合的探针方向可作为steering vectors改变模型输出。
AI.conclusion: 视频DiT并非仅复现表面运动模式，其去噪过程中主动构建了物理信息；这些信息在token序列中高度局部化——全局计算但局部存储；所探测的物理读数不是对拟合场景的简单相关性，且可用于引导生成输出。

title: OncoNoteBERT: A Foundation Representation Model for Natural Language Processing of Real-World Outpatient Oncology Notes
comment: Accepted at the AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Real-world outpatient oncology notes contain specialised terminology, tumour staging expressions, treatment names, toxicity descriptions, and institution-specific de-identification markers that may not be represented efficiently by general biomedical or adjacent clinical language models. We developed and evaluated oncology-specific BERT-style encoders using a governed UK outpatient oncology corpus comprising 290,026 notes from 21,564 patients treated for lung and head-and-neck cancer. We compared RadBERT and PathologyBERT with two local strategies: OncoNote-RadBERT, produced by continued masked language model pretraining, and OncoNoteBERT, trained from scratch with an oncology WordPiece tokenizer. Models were evaluated using masked language modelling loss and perplexity on the validation set, tokenizer fragmentation metrics, clinical term tokenisation, masked-token probes, and exploratory representation analysis. Both external encoders fit the oncology corpus poorly in zero-shot evaluation (perplexity 113.04 for RadBERT; 2035.03 for PathologyBERT), while continued pretraining produced the strongest fit (2.10 for OncoNote-RadBERT). OncoNoteBERT achieved perplexity 2.83 but produced the most efficient tokenisation, with lower subword fertility and shorter normalised sequence length. It also returned a clinically acceptable prediction for 12 of 13 masked-token probes, compared with 7 of 13 for OncoNote-RadBERT. This divergence between corpus-level fit and masked-token performance was partly attributable to tokenizer fragmentation rather than learned semantics alone. Both locally developed models represented the institutional placeholder as a single learnable token. These findings show that continued adaptation and bespoke tokenisation provide complementary benefits, and that representation-layer design matters before adjacent-domain encoders are applied to oncology NLP.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于英国门诊肿瘤语料开发并评估肿瘤学专用BERT编码器，发现继续预训练与定制分词器各具优势：OncoNote-RadBERT语料拟合最优（困惑度2.10），而从头训练的OncoNoteBERT分词效率最高且掩码预测表现更好。
AI.motivation: 真实世界肿瘤门诊记录包含专业术语、肿瘤分期、治疗方案、毒性描述及机构特定的去标识标记，通用生物医学或邻近临床语言模型难以高效表征。作者希望探究邻近领域编码器直接迁移到肿瘤学NLP前的表征层设计问题，并明确继续适配与定制分词化的相对贡献。
AI.method: 基于受治理的英国门诊肿瘤语料（21,564名患者的290,026份记录，覆盖肺癌与头颈癌），开发并比较肿瘤学专用BERT式编码器。对比RadBERT与PathologyBERT两种外部编码器，以及两种本地策略：OncoNote-RadBERT（继续掩码语言模型预训练）和OncoNoteBERT（使用肿瘤学WordPiece分词器从头训练）。评估手段包括验证集上的MLM损失与困惑度、分词器碎片化指标、临床术语分词、掩码token探针及探索性表征分析。
AI.result: 零样本评估下两种外部编码器对肿瘤语料拟合较差（RadBERT困惑度113.04，PathologyBERT为2035.03），继续预训练拟合最佳（OncoNote-RadBERT为2.10）。OncoNoteBERT困惑度为2.83，但分词效率最高，子词繁殖率更低、归一化序列长度更短；13项掩码token探针中12项达到临床可接受预测，优于OncoNote-RadBERT的7/13。语料级拟合与掩码token表现的分歧部分源于分词器碎片化而非单纯学习语义。两种本地模型均将机构占位符表示为单一可学习token。
AI.conclusion: 继续适配与定制分词化提供互补收益；在将邻近领域编码器应用于肿瘤学NLP之前，表征层设计至关重要。

title: Budgeted-GS: Real-Time Large-Scale Gaussian Splatting via Factoring LOD
comment: 28 pages, 21 figures. Preprint of the EG 2027 submission (paper1075)
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting achieves excellent visual quality with real-time rendering, but at the scale of entire cities it does not fit: a trained model carries millions of primitives and gigabytes of memory, and real-time rendering at high quality on a consumer GPU remains out of reach. We introduce Budgeted-GS, a post-hoc method that turns any trained 3DGS model into a factoring tree, a multi-resolution hierarchy of moment-matched aggregates. After a construction pass of a few seconds, a single quality parameter selects, for each view, the level of detail that fits the memory of the target device, so the same city-scale model serves GPUs with widely different memory capacities. When a new scene is to be trained, the same theory applies: instead of growing a full-sized model and compressing it afterwards, budget-centered training first measures how many primitives the scene needs and then trains the model directly at that size, avoiding the wasted effort of optimizing primitives that are later discarded. Both methods are grounded in a measurable capacity floor, a budget-error law derived from optimal transport in phase space; selection rules certified by recent covering theorems decide which primitives are redundant. The floor answers how many primitives a scene actually needs and how many can safely be given up. We validate the floor on 13 public scenes under a preregistered protocol, and exercise both methods from object scenes to an official city capture, rendering it at native 1920x1080, full SH, in real time on one consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: Budgeted-GS 将任意训练好的 3DGS 模型转化为因子树多分辨率层次，用单一质量参数按视角选择细节层级以适配不同显存设备；训练端则先测容量下限再直接按该规模训练，并给出基于相空间最优传输的预算-误差定律与覆盖定理认证的冗余判定。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 视觉质量好、可实时渲染，但城市级场景不适用：模型含数百万图元、占用 GB 级内存，消费级 GPU 上高画质实时渲染难以实现。核心动机是让同一城市模型适配不同显存容量的 GPU，并避免训练全尺寸模型后压缩或丢弃图元的算力浪费。
AI.method: 后处理方法：将任意训练好的 3DGS 模型转为 factoring tree——矩匹配聚合的多分辨率层次，构造仅需数秒；再由单一质量参数为每个视角选择适配目标设备内存的细节层级。训练方法：budget-centered training 先测量场景所需图元数量，再直接按该规模训练。理论依据为可测量的容量下限（phase space 中由最优传输导出的 budget-error law），选择规则由近期覆盖定理认证以判定冗余图元。
AI.result: 在 13 个公开场景上按预注册协议验证容量下限；两种方法从物体级场景到官方城市采集数据均有效，在单块消费级 GPU 上以原生 1920x1080、完整 SH 实现实时渲染。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把 3DGS 的规模控制从经验压缩转为有理论下限指导的预算化设计：同一城市模型可跨显存设备服务，训练也无需先生成全尺寸再裁剪，并给出图元数量该取多少、可安全舍弃多少的可度量答案。

title: Predicting Steering Vectors and Adapter Weights for Few-Shot Author-Style Transfer
summary: Adapting large language models to an individual author's style from a few examples is challenging, and scientific writing sharpens the difficulty: formal conventions leave little surface variation, and authors write about their own topics, so extracted ``style'' easily entangles with content. We study style-conditioned abstract generation from a few example abstracts per author and propose three methods: (1) contrastive activation steering, (2) a network that predicts steering vectors, and (3) a hypernetwork that predicts LoRA adapters. We find a consistent trade-off between style imitation and output quality: fine-tuning buys most of the available style signal but forfeits fluency, while the hypernetwork achieves the best trade-off on both seen and unseen authors. Our steering operates at author level, contrasting an author's abstracts against style-neutral generations for the same content. This holds topic fixed, removes the need for a predefined style inventory, and outperforms inventory-based steering. % [EDIT 1a] softened "no single optimal axis" claim Moreover, our analyses demonstrate that manually extracted and predicted steering vectors are near-orthogonal yet score comparably, indicating that style conditioning here can admit at least two unrelated directions rather than requiring one particular axis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从每位作者的少量摘要样例进行风格条件化摘要生成，提出对比激活引导、引导向量预测网络和超网络预测LoRA适配器三种方法，发现风格模仿与输出质量存在权衡，超网络在可见与未见作者上取得最佳折中，且风格条件可兼容至少两个不相关方向。
AI.motivation: 将大语言模型适配到个体作者风格本身困难，科学写作进一步加剧难度：正式规范限制表层变化，且作者书写自身主题，导致抽取的“风格”易与内容纠缠。因此需要在不预设风格清单、固定主题的前提下研究少样本风格条件化生成。
AI.method: 基于每位作者的少量摘要样例，提出三种风格条件化方法：(1) 对比激活引导；(2) 预测引导向量的网络；(3) 预测LoRA适配器的超网络。引导在作者层面进行，将作者摘要与同一内容的风格中性生成相对比，以固定主题、免除预定义风格清单。
AI.result: 实验显示风格模仿与输出质量之间存在一致的权衡：微调获得最多风格信号但牺牲流畅性，超网络在可见与未见作者上均取得最佳权衡。作者级引导优于基于清单的引导。分析表明，人工提取与预测的引导向量近乎正交却评分相当。
AI.conclusion: 风格条件化在此场景下可至少存在两个互不相关的方向，而非必须依赖某一特定轴；作者级对比引导为少样本科学写作风格适配提供了有效且无需风格清单的路径。

title: Geometry-Aligned Semantic Matching for Cross-Modal Planar Image Registration
summary: Cross-modal image matching establishes stable and accurate geometric correspondences across modalities for planar registration. Existing semantic representations provide cross-modal consistency, but semantic similarity does not necessarily imply geometric correspondence. Meanwhile, fine-grained CNN features provide accurate local details but lack global cross-modal semantic guidance for stable refinement. To address these issues, we propose CDPM, which first establishes geometrically consistent semantic representations and then preserves their dominant role in correspondence estimation during fine-grained localization. Specifically, we progressively adapt DINOv3 using geometrically consistent cross-modal patch pairs, enabling feature similarity to better reflect true cross-modal spatial correspondences. We then construct a DINO-Centric Feature Pyramid, where multi-scale DINO representations maintain stable cross-modal correspondences, while a lightweight CNN branch provides auxiliary structural details for precise local refinement. Extensive experiments on three cross-modal datasets demonstrate the superior performance of CDPM. On VIS-IR, compared with the dense matcher RoMa, CDPM improves AUC@3/5/10/20 by 7.36, 13.40, 13.75, and 10.42 percentage points, respectively, and reduces mACE from 5.83 to 2.78 pixels. It also outperforms RoMa v2 across all metrics while requiring 45.6% fewer FLOPs. The online demo and dataset are available, and the code will be released on our project page at https://warren-wzw.github.io/CDPM/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨模态图像匹配方法 CDPM，通过几何一致的语义表征建立跨模态对应，并在细粒度定位中保持其主导地位，在三个跨模态数据集上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有语义表征虽具跨模态一致性，但语义相似不等于几何对应；而细粒度 CNN 特征虽细节精确，却缺乏全局跨模态语义引导，难以稳定精化。需要兼顾几何一致性与细粒度定位。
AI.method: 1) 使用几何一致的跨模态 patch 对逐步适配 DINOv3，使特征相似度更好反映真实空间对应；2) 构建以 DINO 为中心的 Feature Pyramid，多尺度 DINO 表征维持稳定跨模态对应，轻量 CNN 分支提供辅助结构细节用于局部精化。
AI.result: 在三个跨模态数据集上验证。VIS-IR 上相比稠密匹配器 RoMa，AUC@3/5/10/20 分别提升 7.36、13.40、13.75、10.42 个百分点，mACE 从 5.83 降至 2.78 像素；并在所有指标上超越 RoMa v2，同时 FLOPs 减少 45.6%。
AI.conclusion: CDPM 通过几何一致的语义表征与 DINO 中心的特征金字塔设计，有效解决语义一致性与几何对应不一致、细粒度精化缺乏语义引导的问题，在跨模态匹配上表现出色且计算更高效。

title: Hindsight-Guided Rationale Distillation for Rare Disease Diagnosis
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, Github: https://github.com/joetheguide2/hindsight, Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP SRW 2026
summary: We study hindsight-guided distillation for rare disease diagnosis on ZebraMap: a 1.5B student is fine-tuned on chain-of-thought traces from a 8B teacher that observes the ground-truth diagnosis during generation. Absolute accuracy remains low for all models - the task is hard at this scale - but within this ceiling a filtered variant (StudentF) achieves a small, statistically significant accuracy advantage over the teacher (p < 0.001), concentrated in better-represented diseases. The unfiltered student does not significantly outperform the teacher (p = 0.129), establishing that contamination filtering - not hindsight distillation alone - drives the gain. The gap traces to an artifact we term GT hallucination. Label-visible generation causes the teacher to embed "ground truth is X" phrases in its reasoning chain; SFT copies the pattern. At inference, the unfiltered student reproduces the phrase in 33.9% of cases, with severe accuracy degradation when the hallucinated label is wrong. A regex filter removing these slots reduces contamination to near-zero, producing the observed gain - though the effect remains small. We precisely quantify this gain-cost tradeoff, document frequency-dependent knowledge transfer absent from the RL-trained teacher, and characterize a calibration gap that SFT does not close - identifying both as directions for future work.

AI.tldr: 在ZebraMap罕见病诊断任务上，将8B教师（生成时可看到金标准诊断）的思维链蒸馏到1.5B学生，绝对准确率整体偏低；经正则过滤去除“金标准为X”类GT幻觉短语后的学生（StudentF）以微小但显著的幅度超过教师（p<0.001），而未过滤学生不显著（p=0.129），说明增益来自污染过滤而非事后蒸馏本身。
AI.motivation: 罕见病诊断任务本身困难，在小规模模型上探索事后引导式蒸馏（hindsight-guided distillation）是否有效；同时需要辨析蒸馏带来的准确率变化究竟源于知识迁移，还是源于教师可见标签导致的推理链污染。
AI.method: 以ZebraMap为基准，8B教师在生成思维链时可观察金标准诊断，1.5B学生通过SFT学习这些思维链；设置未过滤与过滤（正则移除“ground truth is X”等标签泄露短语）两种变体，并进行显著性检验与污染率统计。
AI.result: 所有模型绝对准确率均偏低；StudentF相对教师具有小幅但统计显著的准确率优势（p<0.001），且集中在代表性较好的疾病上；未过滤学生相对教师不显著（p=0.129）。未过滤学生在推理中复现该短语的比例达33.9%，当幻觉标签错误时准确率严重下降；正则过滤将污染降至接近零。
AI.conclusion: 驱动增益的是污染过滤而非事后蒸馏本身；论文精确量化了增益—代价权衡，记录了RL训练教师所不具备的频率依赖式知识迁移，并刻画了SFT无法闭合的校准差距，二者被列为未来工作方向。

title: Gains and Collapse in On-Policy Distillation:A Reinforcement Learning Perspective
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become an important approach to language model post-training. However, despite its performance gains, OPD can also collapse into excessively long and repetitive generation, and the mechanism underlying these divergent outcomes remains poorly understood. We explain these outcomes through a reinforcement learning perspective: the teacher implicitly rewards student behaviors, even those it rarely exhibits itself. From this perspective, our experiments show that OPD improves performance without expanding the student's capabilities. When the implicit reward model is reliable, OPD makes correct responses easier to sample. In contrast, when the preference misaligns with quality, reward hacking happens: the implicit reward model amplifies overlong, repetitive student rollouts, even though it rarely generates such text itself. Guided by this diagnosis, we find that masking unhealthy responses during training and using SFT initialization can each effectively mitigate the collapse. Together, these findings show that OPD amplifies student behaviors favored by the teacher's implicit feedback, shifting the focus from how well the teacher generates to how reliably it evaluates student rollouts. Our code is available at https://github.com/HancCui/opd_hacking.

AI.tldr: 本文将同策略蒸馏(OPD)的成败从强化学习视角解释为"教师隐式奖励模型"的作用：奖励可靠则提升性能，奖励与质量错位则出现奖励黑客（过长、重复生成），并给出掩码不良响应与SFT初始化两种缓解手段。
AI.motivation: OPD在语言模型后训练中效果显著，但会偶发坍缩为过长且重复的生成，其内在机制尚不清楚，作者希望解释这种"好/坏两种结局"的成因。
AI.method: 将OPD形式化为强化学习视角：把教师对学生行为的偏好视为隐式奖励模型，并通过实验分别考察奖励可靠与奖励错位两种情形下的学生行为变化，再验证掩码不良响应与SFT初始化两种干预。
AI.result: OPD提升性能但并未扩展学生能力；隐式奖励可靠时使正确响应更易被采样；偏好与质量错位时发生奖励黑客，隐式奖励放大过长、重复的学生rollout（尽管教师自身很少生成此类文本）；掩码不良响应与SFT初始化均能有效缓解坍缩。
AI.conclusion: OPD本质上是放大学生被教师隐式反馈所偏好的行为，因此关注点应从"教师生成得多好"转向"教师评估学生rollout有多可靠"。

title: Lightweight and Resource-Efficient Perception for Robotic Guide Dogs
summary: Robotic guide dogs should understand their surroundings, objects, and potential risks. Prior research has focused on raw sensor data from cameras and 2D or 3D LiDAR, which precisely measure distance points rather than provide a semantic understanding of the scene. While these physical measurements are effective for robot-centric collision avoidance and robot safety, they are not suitable for human-centric guidance. The system should recognize the type and relevance of obstacles and explain them, clearly and actionably, in terms of their spatial relation to the user. We present complete on-device perception modules that fuse a 360 camera and a 2D LiDAR for reliable collision avoidance, with moving-object detection and tracking for human-centric guidance. Finally, in walking-impossible situations, a vision--language model delivers pathway explanations as a safety mechanism to reduce user anxiety. In experiments, verification of fused 360 camera--LiDAR depth shows reliable near-range perception but inherent mid-range bias, while the system as a whole sustained real-time performance under 55 W. On the real-world egocentric GuideDogQA benchmark, our system achieved 83.8\% accuracy, compared with 67.1\% for GPT-4o. These results demonstrate that practical human-centric guidance with real-time on-device inference is feasible even on quadrupeds.

AI.tldr: 提出面向机器人导盲犬的端上感知系统，融合360相机与2D LiDAR，实现以人为中心的避障、动目标检测跟踪及视觉语言模型路径解释。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多依赖相机与2D/3D LiDAR的原始传感器数据，虽能精确测距，适合以机器人为中心的碰撞避免，但缺乏场景语义理解，不适合以人为中心的导盲。系统需识别障碍物类型与相关性，并以用户为中心、清晰可执行地解释其空间关系。
AI.method: 提出完整的端上感知模块：融合360相机与2D LiDAR实现可靠避障，并进行动目标检测与跟踪以支持以人为中心的引导；在无法行走的情况下，由视觉语言模型提供路径解释作为安全机制，缓解用户焦虑。
AI.result: 实验验证融合的360相机-LiDAR深度感知在近距可靠，但存在固有中距偏差；系统整体在55 W以下保持实时性能。在真实自我中心GuideDogQA基准上达83.8%准确率，高于GPT-4o的67.1%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，即使在四足机器人上，实现实时端上推理的实用型以人为中心导盲也具备可行性。

title: Not Until the Evidence Says So: Teaching LLM Investigators When to Close a Case
comment: 23 pages. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/etigerstudio/Nautil ; Models: https://huggingface.co/etigerstudio/Nautil-SFT , https://huggingface.co/etigerstudio/Nautil-RLVR ; Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/etigerstudio/Nautil-Demo ; Code: https://github.com/etigerstudio/Nautil
summary: Accident, defect and outage investigations end with a decision that ordinary question answering never faces: whether the evidence gathered so far is enough to close the case. We study this decision for LLM investigators, which request evidence from a case file, revise their hypotheses, and either close the case with a conclusion grounded in what they read or leave it open and name what is missing. This judgment does not come with capability: an untrained 9B model overstates its evidence in 97% of its answers, and a frontier model that identifies the right cause in 84% of cases still overstates in 91% and closes 17 of the 41 cases whose official finding is "cause undetermined". Measuring it is also non-trivial: the source of a case largely predicts its label, and a rule that reads only the source reaches 83.0 balanced accuracy on our test cases. We therefore evaluate closure with three tests: closure accuracy, reported against this rule and within each source; evidence dependence, which removes the grounds of a conclusion and checks whether the model stops closing; and conclusion and gap quality, a judged checklist of what the model asserts and what it says is missing. We build Nautil, 731 audited cases from aviation, rail, maritime, chemical-safety and vehicle-defect reports and production server incidents, with teacher trajectories, an out-of-distribution test set and counterfactual evidence versions. Fine-tuning a 9B model on these trajectories makes its closures follow the evidence: removing the grounds lowers its closure rate by 26 points relative to a matched control, overstatement falls from 97% to 35%, and correct, non-overstated conclusions rise from 3% to 43%. Reinforcement learning that rewards only the closure decision then raises balanced accuracy from 69.2 to 83.3, on par with the teacher, and within-source accuracy from 60.4 to 74.1, at some cost in evidence dependence.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM调查员在事故/缺陷/宕机调查中"证据是否足以结案"的决策问题，构建了Nautil数据集（731个审计案例），并提出三项评估测试；实验表明仅凭能力无法保证合理结案，微调与强化学习可显著降低过度断言并提升结案准确率。
AI.motivation: 事故、缺陷与宕机调查最终要做出普通问答系统从未面对的决策：现有证据是否足以结案。这一判断与模型能力并不等同——未经训练的9B模型在97%的回答中夸大证据，即便前沿模型能在84%案例中识别正确原因，仍有91%夸大证据，并在官方结论为"原因未确定"的41个案例中错误结案17个。同时该决策的测量本身也很困难：案例来源在很大程度上可预测标签，仅读取来源的规则就能达到83.0的平衡准确率，因此需要更严谨的评估设计。
AI.method: 作者构建Nautil数据集，包含来自航空、铁路、海事、化学品安全、车辆缺陷报告及生产服务器事故的731个经审计案例，并配有教师轨迹、分布外测试集与反事实证据版本。评估采用三项测试：结案准确率（对照仅用来源的规则及来源内比较）、证据依赖性（移除结论依据后检查模型是否停止结案）、结论与缺口质量（模型所述断言与缺失项的评判清单）。训练方法包括在轨迹上微调9B模型，以及仅奖励结案决策的强化学习。
AI.result: 微调9B模型后，其结案行为开始跟随证据：相对匹配对照，移除依据使结案率下降26个百分点，夸大率从97%降至35%，正确且未夸大的结论从3%升至43%。仅以结案决策为奖励的强化学习将平衡准确率从69.2提升至83.3，与教师模型相当；来源内准确率从60.4提升至74.1，但在证据依赖性上有所损失。
AI.conclusion: LLM调查员的"结案与否"判断不等同于模型能力，需专门评估与训练。Nautil数据集及三项测试提供了可衡量的评估框架，微调与强化学习能有效改进结案的证据依赖性与准确率，但准确率与证据依赖性之间存在权衡。

title: PocketSplat: Mobile Gaussian Reconstruction via World-Space Latent Allocatio
summary: Mobile Gaussian reconstruction must satisfy two requirements: the reconstruction model must execute within a device resource envelope, and the resulting Gaussian asset must expose a representation size suited to downstream mobile use. Existing feed-forward Gaussian reconstructors commonly decode dense, image-aligned candidates whose final cardinality is implicitly determined by the input resolution and number of views. We present PocketSplat, a feed-forward framework for budgeted mobile Gaussian asset construction. Given a prescribed output budget, PocketSplat organizes dense geometry-aware latent candidates in predicted world space, allocates exact integer capacity across local latent cells, and decodes complete Gaussian attributes only for retained candidates. Cell-conditioned latent fusion aggregates repeated multi-view evidence before decoding, while spatial responsibility decoding adapts Gaussian support after local sparsification. Experiments on DL3DV and out-of-distribution benchmarks establish a strong quality--budget trade-off against feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction baselines. On Mip-NeRF 360, PocketSplat executes directly on a target iPhone and constructs compact, higher-quality Gaussian assets substantially faster than a deployable streamed MVSplat variant; native MVSplat and DepthSplat exceed the device memory budget.

AI.tldr: PocketSplat 是一个前馈式高斯重建框架，通过预算约束与世界空间候选组织，实现移动端可执行的紧凑高斯资产构建。
AI.motivation: 移动端高斯重建需同时满足设备资源受限下的可执行性和下游使用所需的表示尺寸适配；现有前馈式重建器解码稠密、图像对齐候选，其最终高斯数量由输入分辨率和视角数隐式决定，难以控制规模。
AI.method: 给定输出预算后，PocketSplat 在预测世界空间中组织稠密几何感知隐候选，对局部隐单元分配精确整数容量，仅对保留候选解码完整高斯属性；采用单元条件隐融合聚合多视角重复证据，并通过空间责任解码在局部稀疏化后调整高斯支持范围。
AI.result: 在 DL3DV 与分布外基准上取得优于前馈高斯重建基线的质量—预算权衡；在 Mip-NeRF 360 上可直接在目标 iPhone 运行，生成更紧凑且更高质量的高斯资产，并显著快于可部署的流式 MVSplat 变体；原生 MVSplat 与 DepthSplat 超出设备内存预算。
AI.conclusion: PocketSplat 通过预算化前馈构建与局部容量分配，实现移动端高效、高质量、尺寸可控的高斯资产重建，具备实际部署可行性。

title: Bridging Research and Practice: A Systematic Evaluation of Generalist and Dermatology-Specific Models in Clinical Skin Lesion Classification
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, approved at MICCAI 2026
summary: The application of machine learning to dermatology has grown substantially in recent years, moving beyond proof-of-concept studies toward potential applications. However, clinical dermatology remains a challenging and still open problem. Diagnostic assessment is often ambiguous, and skin lesions exhibit high variability, compounded by differences in acquisition modality, device quality, and patient demographics. These factors hinder the development of robust models suitable for safe and equitable clinical use. To support translation into practice, it is essential to systematically evaluate how contemporary models generalize across heterogeneous data sources. In this work, we benchmark a diverse set of architectures on recent dermatology datasets, spanning dermoscopic images and smartphone-based clinical photographs. We assess the robustness of recent general-purpose and medical vision-language models, as well as foundation models, and compare them against task-specific dermatology classifiers, including embedding-based approaches and convolutional neural networks. Our study provides an evaluation of model performance under distribution shifts, modality changes, and demographic variability. By quantifying the gap between current state-of-the-art models and the requirements of clinical deployment, we aim to contribute to the development of reliable, accessible, and clinically applicable AI systems for dermatology.

AI.tldr: 该论文对多种架构（通用与医学视觉语言模型、基础模型、皮肤科专用分类器）在近期皮肤科数据集上进行基准评测，涵盖皮肤镜图像与手机临床照片，考察分布偏移、模态变化和人口统计学差异下的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 皮肤科机器学习研究已从概念验证走向潜在应用，但临床落地仍面临挑战：诊断评估常具模糊性，皮损变异度高，且受采集模态、设备质量和患者人口统计学差异影响。这些因素阻碍了安全、公平的临床模型的开发，因此需系统评估当代模型在异构数据源上的泛化能力。
AI.method: 在近期皮肤科数据集（皮肤镜图像与手机临床照片）上对多种架构进行基准测试，评估通用与医学视觉语言模型、基础模型的鲁棒性，并与任务专用皮肤科分类器（基于嵌入的方法和卷积神经网络）进行对比。
AI.result: 在分布偏移、模态变化和人口统计学变异性条件下给出了模型性能评估，量化了当前最先进模型与临床部署要求之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 通过量化现有模型与临床部署需求之间的差距，旨在推动可靠、可及且具临床适用性的皮肤科AI系统发展。

title: Source Preference in the Wild: How LLM Agents Favor Items by Source, and How to Reduce It
summary: As LLM agents decide on users' behalf which product to buy, which hotel to book, or which paper to cite, a preference for items from certain sources (the sites or services they come from) shapes what users receive and which sources are selected. We study source preference in end-to-end search with 12 agent models across three domains. Comparing items from different sources that satisfy the same requirements at the same position, we find that each model prefers some sources and avoids others in every domain, largely agreeing on which. This preference can outweigh how well items satisfy the request: an item satisfying one requirement fewer is selected about two-thirds of the time when it comes from a preferred source and the better one from a dispreferred source, but almost never in the reverse case. The information identifying an item's source affects selection by itself: hiding it weakens the preference, and relabeling an item with a preferred source raises its selection rate. We test two routes to this preference: training that rewards better items can make a source a shortcut for requirement satisfaction, and missing information can trigger preconceptions about the source. Supplying missing information or a prompt countering these preconceptions reduces source preference.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM智能体在端到端搜索中的“来源偏好”：12个模型、3个领域均表现出对特定来源的一致偏好，且该偏好可压过需求满足度。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体替用户决定购买商品、预订酒店或引用论文，其对某些来源（网站或服务）的偏好会塑造用户所见内容与所选来源，需系统研究该偏好。
AI.method: 在3个领域对12个智能体模型开展端到端搜索实验；控制同一需求、同一位置，仅比较不同来源条目；通过隐藏来源信息、将条目重贴标签为偏好来源进行干预；并检验两条成因路径（训练使来源成为需求满足的捷径、信息缺失触发对来源的预设）。
AI.result: 每个模型在各领域均偏好部分来源、回避另一些，且模型间判断大体一致；少满足一项需求的条目若来自偏好来源，约三分之二情况下仍被选中，反之几乎不会被选；隐藏来源削弱偏好，重贴标签提升选择率；补充缺失信息或提示反驳预设可降低来源偏好。
AI.conclusion: 来源偏好是LLM智能体端到端搜索中的稳健、可干预现象，其强度足以凌驾于需求满足度之上；既源于训练形成的捷径，也源于信息缺失下的预设，可通过补全信息或反预设提示缓解。

title: KV$^2$: A Self-Refining KV Cache
summary: The memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache constrains the practical use of long-context models, and it dominates cost when one prefilled context must later serve many different queries. In this reusable setting, query-agnostic compression trades cost against quality: lightweight estimators are cheap but less accurate, whereas full-context reconstruction scoring is more accurate yet reprocesses the entire prompt. We introduce KV$^2$, a query-agnostic KV-cache compression method based on selective reconstruction. KV$^2$ first uses a lightweight proxy scorer to identify informative in-context tokens, then reprocesses only this subset to compute final eviction scores. On RULER, Needle-in-a-Haystack, and LongBench, KV$^2$'s margin over baselines widens as the budget tightens: on RULER 16K at a 2% KV-cache budget it improves the average score over the next-best baseline by more than 40 percentage points, and on LongBench it attains the highest average across 2%-10% budgets at lower compression-stage runtime and peak memory than full-context reconstruction. Reusable KV-cache compression thus does not require reprocessing the full context. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/KVsquared-0B97.

AI.tldr: 提出 KV²，一种基于选择性重建的查询无关 KV 缓存压缩方法，仅对轻量代理筛选出的子集重新计算淘汰分数，从而在紧预算下显著优于基线且降低开销。
AI.motivation: KV 缓存的内存占用限制了长上下文模型的实际应用，尤其在“一次预填充、多次查询”的可复用场景下成本突出。查询无关压缩面临质量与成本的两难：轻量估计器便宜但不准确，全上下文重建评分准确但需重新处理整个提示。
AI.method: KV² 采用选择性重建：(1) 用轻量代理评分器（proxy scorer）识别上下文中信息量高的 token；(2) 仅对该子集重新处理，计算最终的淘汰（eviction）分数。
AI.result: 在 RULER、Needle-in-a-Haystack 和 LongBench 上，KV² 相对基线的优势随预算收紧而扩大：RULER 16K、2% KV 缓存预算下，平均分比次优基线提升超过 40 个百分点；LongBench 上在 2%–10% 各预算下取得最高平均分，且压缩阶段运行时间与峰值内存均低于全上下文重建。
AI.conclusion: 可复用的 KV 缓存压缩无需重新处理完整上下文，选择性重建即可兼顾精度与效率。

title: Predicting and Repairing Merge Collapse in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models fine-tuned from a shared base can be merged by averaging their task vectors, but some merges collapse far below the base model, and common merge operators give no warning before evaluation. We show that one statistic of the specialists' task vectors both predicts this collapse and calibrates its repair. The power that averaging removes equals the variance of the task vectors across specialists, our measure of interference. Under a working noise model, the disturbance that a merge injects grows with the merge coefficient and with interference, yielding a pre-merge score. In our experiments on twenty-two merge configurations from four model families, only destructive merges exceed a threshold on this score. We find that statistics of sign conflict between specialists, a common target of existing merge operators, are anti-predictive. We then predicted the outcomes of fourteen merges before evaluating them, and twelve predictions were correct, including the destructive outcome of a specialist pair pushed past the threshold by continued pretraining. To address this collapse, we introduce PRISM, an operator that averages the task vectors first and then soft-thresholds each layer at a level set by the layer's interference. Without data or tuning, PRISM keeps all five destructive merges above the threshold within evaluation noise of the base model, where plain averaging falls at least 14.4 points below it or collapses entirely. We apply PRISM only above the threshold and keep the plain average for merges below it, which include all fifteen harmless ones. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PRISM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用专家任务向量间的方差（干扰度）这一统计量，在评估前预测并修复模型合并崩溃，并给出算子 PRISM。
AI.motivation: 从共享基座微调的大模型可通过平均任务向量合并，但部分合并会严重崩溃，且常见合并算子事先无预警。
AI.method: 利用任务向量在专家间的方差度量干扰；基于噪声模型推导随合并系数与干扰增长的预合并分数；提出 PRISM：先平均任务向量，再按各层干扰水平做软阈值处理，仅在超阈值时启用。
AI.result: 在四个模型族、22 个合并配置中，仅破坏性合并超过该分数阈值；符号冲突统计反而具反预测性。事前预测 14 个合并，12 个正确。PRISM 使 5 个破坏性合并保持基座模型水平（纯平均则低至少 14.4 分或崩溃），15 个无害合并仍用纯平均。
AI.conclusion: 任务向量方差既是崩溃预测指标又可校准修复，PRISM 无需数据与调参即可避免合并崩溃。

title: Contextual Flow Matching: Adaptive Step Selection in Flow Models for Efficient Visual Generation
summary: Flow Matching enables high-quality visual generation via continuous-time dynamics, but inference remains costly due to multiple sequential function evaluations. Existing acceleration methods reduce the number of function evaluations but often introduce additional training overhead, degrade quality, or fail to account for input-dependent variability. We propose COFLOW, an inference-time method that adaptively selects the step counts each generation based on the prompt features. Our context-aware COFLOW is trained online with an unsupervised reward that balances inference efficiency and generation fidelity. Our method is plug-and-play, requiring no retraining of the underlying generative model. It generalizes to image and video generation, achieving over 2.5x speedup while preserving perceptual and semantic quality. We further provide a theoretical analysis establishing an O(1/K) forward-Euler discretization error bound under standard regularity conditions.

AI.tldr: COFLOW是一种无需重训练扩散/流匹配模型的推理时加速方法，通过基于提示特征自适应选择步数，以无监督奖励在线训练，实现超2.5倍加速且保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 流匹配（Flow Matching）虽能通过连续时间动力学实现高质量视觉生成，但推理需多次串行函数评估，成本高昂。现有加速方法虽能减少函数评估次数，却往往带来额外训练开销、质量下降，或未考虑输入相关的变异性。
AI.method: 提出COFLOW，一种推理时方法：根据提示（prompt）特征为每次生成自适应地选择步数；该上下文感知策略在线训练，采用平衡推理效率与生成保真度的无监督奖励；方法即插即用，无需重新训练底层生成模型。
AI.result: 可泛化至图像与视频生成，实现超过2.5倍的加速，同时保持感知与语义质量；并给出理论分析，在标准正则性条件下建立O(1/K)的前向欧拉离散化误差界。
AI.conclusion: COFLOW以即插即用、无监督、自适应的方式有效缓解流匹配推理成本问题，兼顾效率与质量，兼具理论支撑。

title: StanceEval 2026: The Second Stance Detection Shared Task
comment: 14 pages total (8 pages main paper + 6 pages appendix), 5 tables in the main paper, excluding the appendix
summary: StanceEval 2026 is the second edition of the StanceEval shared task series on stance detection in Arabic social media text. Stance detection aims to identify a writer's stance toward a given topic. Given a tweet and a target, participating systems must determine whether the writer's stance is Favor, Against, or None. This edition focuses on cross-target generalization across two distinct evaluation tracks: Track 1 evaluates thematically related cross-target transfer (testing on Women Driving, related to Women Empowerment from training data), while Track 2 evaluates cross-domain transfer to completely unseen targets (E-Cars and Trimester System). The shared task attracted 80 registered teams from 12 countries. During the evaluation phase, 30 unique teams submitted entries, with 21 teams officially ranked in Track 1 and 13 in Track 2 following validation filtering, and 20 teams submitting system-description papers. Participating teams employed diverse methodologies, including fine-tuned pretrained language models, prompt-based and retrieval-augmented large language models (LLMs), fine-tuned LLMs, and hybrid cascades. Top systems achieved impressive $F_{avg2}$ scores of 0.8994 on Track 1 and 0.9400 on Track 2, substantially outperforming the strongest baselines (0.7366 and 0.7475, respectively), where $F_{avg2}$ denotes the macro-averaged F1 score over the Favor and Against classes. Counterintuitively, performance on the unseen targets was higher than on the related target, a disparity could be driven by extreme target polarization, class imbalance, and dialectal or sarcastic nuance across topics.

AI.tldr: StanceEval 2026 是阿拉伯语社交媒体立场检测共享任务的第二届，聚焦跨目标泛化，设两条评测赛道，30支队伍提交，最佳系统F_avg2分别达0.8994（Track 1）和0.9400（Track 2），显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 立场检测旨在识别作者对特定主题的立场（Favor/Against/None）。本届任务的核心动机是检验系统在训练目标之外、即跨目标（cross-target）场景下的泛化能力，包括主题相关的跨目标迁移与完全未见目标的跨领域迁移，以评估模型对目标变化的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 设置两条评测赛道：Track 1 为主题相关跨目标迁移（训练含 Women Empowerment，测试 Women Driving）；Track 2 为跨领域迁移至完全未见目标（E-Cars、Trimester System）。参赛系统采用多种方法，包括微调预训练语言模型、基于提示与检索增强的大语言模型（LLM）、微调LLM，以及混合级联方法。评价指标为 F_avg2，即 Favor 与 Against 两类上的宏平均 F1。
AI.result: 共80支队伍注册（来自12个国家），评测阶段30支队伍提交结果，经校验后Track 1有21支、Track 2有13支正式排名，20支队伍提交系统描述论文。最佳系统 F_avg2 在 Track 1 为0.8994、Track 2 为0.9400，大幅超过最强基线（0.7366 与 0.7475）。反直觉的是，未见目标上的性能高于相关目标。
AI.conclusion: 本届任务表明当前方法在跨目标立场检测上已取得显著进展，但相关目标表现低于未见目标这一反差，可能由极端目标极化、类别不平衡以及方言或讽刺语义差异所致，提示未来需进一步研究目标极化与数据分布因素对跨目标泛化的影响。

title: VisionMX: Unlocking Microscaling Post-Training Quantization for Vision Models
summary: Microscaling (MX) formats are emerging as a hardware-supported approach to efficient training and inference. They combine low-precision elements with shared block scales, but their impact on vision models remains underexplored. We systematically investigate post-training MX quantization across vision models and tasks. An analysis of direct conversion identifies three sources of error: block-scale representation, the poor alignment of some small convolutional weight tensors with nonuniform element grids, and the underuse of signed codes by nonnegative activations. These findings motivate VisionMX, a post-training MX quantization method that optimizes bounded weight rounding and applies a foldable affine correction to activations. We evaluate VisionMX across image classification, object detection, semantic segmentation, and low-light image enhancement using several MX-style formats. It improves on direct conversion and the evaluated post-training quantization baselines, with the largest performance recoveries in architectures most sensitive to MX conversion

AI.tldr: VisionMX：一种针对视觉模型的训练后MX量化方法，通过优化有界权重舍入和对激活的可折叠仿射校正，在分类、检测、分割和低光增强任务上优于直接转换和现有PTQ基线。
AI.motivation: Microscaling (MX)格式结合低精度元素与共享块缩放，已获硬件支持，但其对视觉模型的影响尚缺系统研究。直接转换存在三类误差来源，阻碍MX在视觉模型中的有效应用。
AI.method: 系统研究视觉模型与任务上的训练后MX量化，分析直接转换的三类误差：块缩放表示误差、部分小卷积权重张量与不均匀元素网格对齐差、非负激活对带符号码利用不足。据此提出VisionMX，优化有界权重舍入，并对激活施加可折叠仿射校正。
AI.result: 在图像分类、目标检测、语义分割和低光图像增强任务上，采用多种MX风格格式评估，VisionMX优于直接转换及所评估的训练后量化基线，在对MX转换最敏感的架构上性能恢复最大。
AI.conclusion: VisionMX有效缓解了MX直接转换的三类误差，为视觉模型的训练后MX量化提供了可行方案，尤其适用于对MX转换敏感的架构。

title: Evolving Hybrid Quantum-Classical Architectures for Image Classification
comment: Under Review at The Fifteenth International Conference on Learning Representations 2027
summary: Hybrid quantum classical neural networks integrate parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) with established deep learning architectures, but their performance depends strongly on the choice of quantum circuit architecture, a choice that remains largely manual. Most existing approaches rely on hand-designed or fixed circuit ansätze, requiring circuit structure, gate composition, and qubit connectivity to be specified in advance with no guarantee that they suit the task. This limitation is especially acute in image classification, where quantum circuits must transform features extracted by classical networks while remaining compact enough for practical training, requirements that generic, task-agnostic ansätze are unlikely to satisfy simultaneously. We extend EXAQC, an evolutionary framework for automated quantum circuit discovery, to image classification. EXAQC evolves PQCs as intermediate processing modules while retaining classical feature-extraction and prediction layers. On MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10, EXAQC achieves 98.42%, 90.62%, and 85.47% accuracy, respectively, while using comparable gate counts to other quantum architecture-search methods. Against classical networks, evolved hybrid models maintain comparable accuracy with substantially fewer trainable parameters, reaching 85.68% on CIFAR-10 with over 25$\times$ fewer parameters than a 10-layer CNN. Encoding choice also matters: rotation-based encodings (RX, RY, U3) outperform amplitude encoding by 22-25 points on CIFAR-10. These results demonstrate that automated circuit discovery yields compact quantum modules that can replace larger classical components in vision architectures while retaining competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文将自动化量子电路发现框架EXAQC扩展到图像分类任务，通过进化算法自动搜索参数化量子电路作为混合量子-经典网络的中间处理模块。在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上分别达到98.42%、90.62%和85.47%的准确率，且参数量显著少于经典网络。
AI.motivation: 混合量子-经典神经网络虽然将参数化量子电路（PQC）与深度学习架构结合，但其性能高度依赖量子电路架构的选择，而这一选择目前主要靠手工设计。现有方法依赖手工设计或固定电路ansatz，需预先指定电路结构、门组成和量子比特连接方式，且无法保证适合任务。该问题在图像分类中尤为突出，因为量子电路需转换经典网络提取的特征，同时要保持足够紧凑以便实际训练，这对通用、任务无关的ansatz难以同时满足。
AI.method: 将EXAQC（一种用于自动化量子电路发现的进化框架）扩展到图像分类任务。EXAQC将PQC作为中间处理模块进行进化，同时保留经典的特征提取层和预测层。即由经典网络提取特征，进化的量子电路进行中间变换，最后由经典层完成预测。
AI.result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上分别达到98.42%、90.62%和85.47%的准确率，与其他量子架构搜索方法使用相当的量子门数量。与经典网络相比，进化的混合模型在准确率相当的情况下可训练参数量大幅减少，在CIFAR-10上以超过25倍少于10层CNN的参数量达到85.68%。编码方式也有影响：基于旋转的编码（RX、RY、U3）在CIFAR-10上比振幅编码高出22-25个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 自动化电路发现能够产生紧凑的量子模块，可在视觉架构中替代更大的经典组件，同时保持有竞争力的准确率，证明了进化式量子电路自动搜索在图像分类中的有效性。

title: VDOT++: Unified Few-Step Video Generation via Unbalanced Optimal Transport Distillation
summary: Video creation spans text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and condition-based generation, yet video diffusion models remain costly because they repeatedly evaluate large backbones during sampling. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) reduces this cost, but its reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) objective can provide unstable or incomplete guidance when the student and teacher distributions have limited overlap. VDOT addressed this issue by adding optimal transport distillation (OTD), whose explicit coupling supplies geometric directions for condition-based generation. Balanced OTD, however, performs full-mass matching between the spatial tokens of each corresponding student--teacher frame pair. This assumption weakens for T2V and I2V, where one condition admits many valid outputs and spatial content need not align across different realizations. We present VDOT++, a unified distillation framework that applies the same training recipe separately to generators for the three task families. It makes OTD robust to output diversity through an asymmetric unbalanced formulation that allows unreliable student tokens to carry less mass while maintaining coverage of the teacher tokens. An $\ell_1$ ground cost further replaces mean-based aggregation with a more mode-preserving weighted median that limits the influence of distant transport targets. The two changes respectively determine whom to match and how the selected targets should be aggregated. We additionally combine distribution matching and adversarial refinement through sequential backward passes, and exploit the decoupled score networks for cross-scale distillation, where larger score networks improve a compact generator. Experiments on UVCBench, VBench, VBench-I2V, and the VACE benchmark show that the resulting four-step generators are competitive with many-step teachers and strong few-step baselines across all three task families.

AI.tldr: VDOT++ 提出统一蒸馏框架，通过非对称非平衡最优传输与 ℓ1 加权中值聚合，提升 T2V、I2V 及条件生成三类任务的少步视频生成质量。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型因采样时反复评估大骨干网络而成本高昂；DMD 的逆 KL 目标在师生分布重叠有限时指导不稳定，VDOT 引入 OTD 但平衡式全质量匹配假设在 T2V/I2V 中不成立（一个条件对应多种合理输出，空间内容无需对齐）。
AI.method: 1）对三类任务的生成器分别使用同一训练配方；2）采用非对称非平衡 OTD，让不可靠学生 token 携带较少质量，同时保持对教师 token 的覆盖；3）用 ℓ1 地面代价替代均值聚合，以加权中值限制远距离传输目标影响；4）通过顺序反向传播结合分布匹配与对抗精炼；5）利用解耦分数网络进行跨尺度蒸馏，以大分数网络提升紧凑生成器。
AI.result: 在 UVCBench、VBench、VBench-I2V 和 VACE 基准上，所得四步生成器在三类任务族中均与多步教师及强少步基线具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 两项改动分别决定“与谁匹配”与“如何聚合选中目标”，使 OTD 对输出多样性更鲁棒；统一配方加跨尺度蒸馏有效实现高效高质量少步视频生成。

title: AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents are typically trained with sparse outcome rewards, making trajectory-level objectives too coarse to distinguish the contribution of individual decisions. Step-level credit assignment provides finer-grained supervision, but its estimates can be unreliable because observed returns also depend on subsequent actions, environment transitions, and trajectory length. We propose AdaStep, an Adaptive Step-credit weighting method that controls how strongly each group-derived local advantage modifies the trajectory-level signal. We formulate this weighting as a mean-squared-error estimation problem for the latent step advantage and, under an explicit conditional sampling assumption, derive an optimal per-state shrinkage coefficient. The coefficient admits a signal-to-total-variance interpretation: it preserves local credit when return variation is attributable to the selected action and suppresses it when variation is dominated by downstream randomness. AdaStep requires only lightweight scalar computation, with no critic, additional rollouts, or extra model inference. Experiments with three model backbones on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld show consistent improvements over baselines at low computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaStep，一种自适应步级信用加权方法，通过最优收缩系数控制组内局部优势对轨迹级信号的修正强度，在无需额外critic或rollout的前提下提升长程LLM智能体训练效果。
AI.motivation: 长程LLM智能体通常采用稀疏的结果奖励，轨迹级目标过于粗糙，难以区分单个决策的贡献；而步级信用分配虽提供更细粒度监督，但其估计不可靠，因为观测回报同时受后续动作、环境转移和轨迹长度影响。
AI.method: 将步级优势的加权建模为潜变量步优势的均方误差估计问题，在显式条件采样假设下推导出最优的逐状态收缩系数。该系数具有"信号-总方差"比值解释：当回报变化可归因于所选动作时保留局部信用，当变化被下游随机性主导时抑制局部信用。方法仅需轻量标量计算，无需critic、额外rollout或额外模型推理。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld上，使用三种模型骨干进行实验，均以较低计算成本持续优于基线。
AI.conclusion: AdaStep通过可解释的最优收缩系数实现可靠的步级信用分配，兼顾细粒度监督与估计稳定性，且计算开销极小，是长程LLM智能体训练的有效改进方案。

title: Uncertainty as a Proxy for Semantic Correctness in Diffusion-Based Medical Image Synthesis
summary: Diffusion models can synthesise contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) from non-contrast CT (NCCT), avoiding contrast administration and its environmental and patient-access costs. However, visually realistic images are not necessarily anatomically correct, and the pixel-intensity and feature-space similarity metrics used to assess generation quality do not directly measure anatomical correctness. In this work, we investigate whether uncertainty can serve as a proxy for semantic correctness in diffusion-based medical image synthesis. We study NCCT-to-CECT synthesis using AortaDiff, a multitask diffusion framework that jointly generates CECT images and lumen segmentations. The segmentation output provides an explicit representation of the generated vascular anatomy, enabling segmentation-derived errors to be used as a quantitative measure of generation correctness. Six methods spanning weight (Ensemble, HyperDiff, BayesDiff), architecture-perturbation (MCDropout), generative-stochasticity (RDS) and input-perturbation (TTA) uncertainty are compared at the pixel, region and image levels, and for detection of clinically relevant out-of-distribution (OOD) cases. Uncertainty proves informative at all three spatial scales, remains informative on an external multi-centre dataset under distribution shift, and supports OOD detection. MCDropout stands out among the six: it ranks among the leading methods at every scale, generalizes well on the external dataset, and can be enabled at inference on any model already trained with dropout, so reliable uncertainty comes at no extra training cost. Uncertainty reliably flags severe failures but discriminates poorly among already high-quality images. These findings support uncertainty as a practical and computationally economical signal for quality filtering, reliability assessment and OOD detection in NCCT-to CECT synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨不确定性是否可作为扩散式医学图像合成中语义正确性的代理指标。基于AortaDiff多任务扩散框架的NCCT到CECT合成，通过分割输出量化生成正确性，比较六种不确定性方法。结果显示不确定性在像素、区域、图像三个尺度均有信息量，在外部数据集上仍有效，并支持OOD检测；MCDropout表现最佳且无需额外训练成本。不确定性可靠标记严重失败，但对高质量图像区分能力有限。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型可从平扫CT（NCCT）合成增强CT（CECT），避免造影剂使用及其环境与患者可及性成本。然而视觉逼真的图像未必解剖正确，而像素强度与特征空间的相似度指标并不直接衡量解剖正确性。因此需要研究不确定性是否能作为语义正确性的代理指标。
AI.method: 采用AortaDiff多任务扩散框架进行NCCT到CECT合成，联合生成CECT图像与管腔分割；分割输出提供生成血管解剖的显式表示，使分割衍生的误差可作为生成正确性的定量度量。比较六种不确定性方法，涵盖权重（Ensemble、HyperDiff、BayesDiff）、架构扰动（MCDropout）、生成随机性（RDS）与输入扰动（TTA），在像素、区域、图像三个尺度上评估，并用于检测临床相关的分布外（OOD）病例。
AI.result: 不确定性在三个空间尺度上均具信息量，在分布偏移下的外部多中心数据集上仍保持信息量，并支持OOD检测。MCDropout在六种方法中表现突出：在所有尺度上均居领先，在外部数据集上泛化良好，且可在任何已用dropout训练的模型上于推理时启用，无需额外训练成本。不确定性可可靠标记严重失败，但在已属高质量的图像之间区分能力较差。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持将不确定性作为NCCT到CECT合成中进行质量过滤、可靠性评估与OOD检测的实用且计算经济的信号。

title: Collective Bias Mitigation via Model Routing and Collaboration
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in public health, finance, and governance, requiring both accuracy and societal value alignment. Despite recent advances, LLMs often perpetuate or amplify bias embedded in their training data, posing challenges to fairness. While self-debiasing encourages an LLM to identify and correct its own biases, relying on a single model's intrinsic knowledge may be insufficient to address deeply ingrained stereotypes. To address this limitation, we introduce Collective Bias Mitigation (CBM), a framework that alleviates bias by learning fine-grained model behavior and fostering knowledge sharing among diverse LLMs. This work is the first to systematically explore the effective selection and organization of distinct LLMs to cultivate fairer LLM responses. Experiments show CBM substantially outperforms standalone baselines (e.g., in the top-7 setting, Committee lowers the age bias score from 0.25 to 0.10). Our Debating and Committee topologies achieve substantial bias reduction, with the latter balancing mitigation effectiveness and inference cost, highlighting the potential of CBM for fairer LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出Collective Bias Mitigation框架，通过学习细粒度模型行为并在多个LLM间共享知识来缓解偏见，实验表明其显著优于单体基线。
AI.motivation: LLM广泛部署于公共卫生、金融和治理等领域，需兼顾准确性与社会价值对齐；但LLM常延续或放大训练数据中的偏见，威胁公平性。而self-debiasing依赖单一模型的内在知识，难以应对根深蒂固的刻板印象。
AI.method: CBM框架：学习细粒度的模型行为，促进多个异构LLM之间的知识共享；首次系统探究不同LLM的有效选择与组织方式；提出Debating与Committee等拓扑结构。
AI.result: CBM显著超越单体基线，如在top-7设置下Committee将年龄偏见分数从0.25降至0.10；Debating与Committee拓扑均实现明显偏见降低，其中Committee在缓解效果与推理成本间取得平衡。
AI.conclusion: CBM通过多模型协作与知识共享提升LLM公平性，展示了构建更公平LLM的潜力。

title: EmbPASS: Towards Cross-Embodiment Open Panoramic Segmentation
summary: Panoramic images provide a complete 360-degree field of view, enabling comprehensive scene understanding for embodied perception. However, heterogeneous embodied platforms exhibit substantial differences in observation viewpoints and spatial layouts, giving rise to cross-embodiment observation shifts that pose additional challenges to consistent and reliable panoramic perception, while systematic studies of this problem remain limited. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new task, termed Cross-Embodiment Open Panoramic Segmentation. Meanwhile, we establish EmbPASS, a multi-platform panoramic semantic segmentation benchmark spanning Vehicle, Drone, Wearable, and Quadruped platforms under a unified semantic taxonomy, providing a testbed for systematically studying cross-embodiment panoramic perception. We further propose EPONet, an open-vocabulary panoramic semantic segmentation network that integrates Relation-Aware Metric Adapter (RAMA) and Content-Adaptive Semantic Transfer (CAST) to enhance spatial modeling and semantic transfer under heterogeneous embodied observations. Extensive experiments show that EPONet achieves the best platform-balanced performance on EmbPASS with 35.82% mIoU, outperforming the strongest baseline by 1.10%, while remaining competitive on existing panoramic segmentation benchmarks. The source code and EmbPASS benchmark will be made publicly available at https://github.com/guopj1/EmbPASS.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出跨具身开放全景分割新任务，构建了涵盖车辆、无人机、可穿戴与四足平台的多平台全景语义分割基准 EmbPASS，并提出集成 RAMA 与 CAST 的开放词汇网络 EPONet，以应对跨具身观测偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 全景图像提供完整 360° 视场，有助于具身感知的整体场景理解。然而不同具身平台在观测视角与空间布局上差异显著，产生跨具身观测偏移，给一致可靠的全景感知带来额外挑战，而针对该问题的系统性研究仍较有限。
AI.method: 论文定义新任务 Cross-Embodiment Open Panoramic Segmentation，并构建 EmbPASS 基准：在统一语义分类体系下覆盖车辆、无人机、可穿戴设备与四足平台的多平台全景语义分割数据集。同时提出 EPONet 开放词汇全景语义分割网络，集成 Relation-Aware Metric Adapter（RAMA）与 Content-Adaptive Semantic Transfer（CAST），以增强异构具身观测下的空间建模与语义迁移能力。
AI.result: 在 EmbPASS 上，EPONet 取得最佳的平台均衡性能，mIoU 达 35.82%，较最强基线提升 1.10%；同时在现有全景分割基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过新任务、新基准与网络方法，为跨具身全景感知提供了系统研究平台，验证了 RAMA 与 CAST 的有效性，并计划公开源代码与 EmbPASS 基准。

title: COSMI: COmpositional Synthesis of Multi-object Interactions
summary: Generative models of human-object interaction are bounded by the data that exists: everyday activities involve several objects, but most captured datasets record one at a time, as multi-object capture is combinatorially expensive. Our observation is that interactions are local, so single-object captures already contain the parts of multi-object activities. We compose them: contact-consistent clips of single interactions, mirrored to balance the hands, transfer between bodies, and a language model and geometric checks admit only the pairings that are plausible, semantically and physically. Therefore, the dataset grows combinatorially with the clips rather than recording time. The COSMI dataset holds 222k sequences and 275 hours with up to five objects, nearly thirty times the largest multi-object capture, and can be extended by adding datasets or even hand-object recordings. On this data we train the COSMI method, a text-to-interaction diffusion transformer that follows how the data is built: weight-shared object slots generate a variable number of objects, predicted relative to the body parts that move them. On a benchmark with an unseen object and unseen interaction combinations, models trained on the dataset generalize to the unseen combinations. COSMI outperforms baselines in text alignment and contact accuracy, where its margin is largest on the unseen object. Code, models, and the dataset pipeline will be released on the project page: https://ptrvilya.github.io/cosmi.

AI.tldr: 提出COSMI数据集与文本到交互扩散Transformer方法，通过组合单物体交互片段构建大规模多物体人-物交互数据，实现组合式泛化。
AI.motivation: 多物体人-物交互数据采集成本组合爆炸，现有数据集通常一次只记录单个物体，导致生成模型受限于数据规模，难以覆盖多物体日常活动。
AI.method: 基于"交互具有局部性"的观察，将单物体交互片段组合：接触一致的片段、镜像平衡双手、跨身体迁移，并用语言模型与几何检查筛选语义和物理上合理的配对，使数据随片段组合式增长。据此训练COSMI方法——文本到交互扩散Transformer，采用权重共享的物体槽生成可变数量物体，并相对驱动身体部位预测物体。
AI.result: COSMI数据集含222k序列、275小时、最多5个物体，约为最大多物体采集数据的近30倍；在含未见物体与未见交互组合的基准上，模型可泛化到未见组合，在文本对齐和接触准确率上优于基线，尤以未见物体上优势最大。
AI.conclusion: 组合式数据构建可突破多物体交互数据的采集瓶颈，支撑组合泛化的文本到交互生成；代码、模型与数据管线将开源。

title: Consecutive Posterior Fusion for Diffusive Recovery of Unobservable Image Structures
summary: Solving severely ill-posed imaging inverse problems requires recovering image structures that are unobservable or weakly constrained by the measurements. Diffusion models provide expressive learned priors for inferring such missing information, while posterior sampling incorporates measurement consistency along the reverse process. Standard diffusion posterior samplers, however, rely on instantaneous measurement-aware estimates, without explicitly exploiting information carried by previous posterior corrections. We introduce Consecutive Posterior Fusion Denoising Diffusion Null-Space Models (CPF-DDNM), an inference-time strategy that fuses consecutive measurement-aware estimates to improve the diffusive recovery of unobservable image structures, without requiring retraining or additional denoiser evaluations. We instantiate this principle within DDNM, whose range/null-space decomposition reveals that consecutive fusion preserves the measurement-determined component while acting exclusively on the prior-driven null-space estimate. We thus provide a geometric interpretation of CPF-DDNM and a local error analysis that characterizes the optimal time-dependent fusion coefficient, including the extrapolative regime. Experiments on sparse-view and simulated low-dose computed tomography, as well as medical image super-resolution, show consistent improvements over DDNM and competitive performance against diffusion-based inverse solvers.

AI.tldr: 提出CPF-DDNM，一种推理时策略，通过融合相邻的测量感知估计改进扩散模型对不可观测图像结构的恢复，无需重训练或额外去噪评估。
AI.motivation: 严重病态的成像逆问题需要恢复测量无法观测或约束较弱的图像结构。扩散模型提供表达力强的学习先验，后验采样在反向过程中融入测量一致性。但标准扩散后验采样器仅依赖瞬时测量感知估计，未显式利用此前后验校正所携带的信息。
AI.method: 提出连续后验融合去噪扩散零空间模型（CPF-DDNM）：在推理时融合连续的测量感知估计以改善不可观测结构的扩散恢复，无需重训练或额外去噪器评估。将该原理实例化于DDNM中，利用其值域/零空间分解证明连续融合保留测量决定分量，仅作用于先验驱动的零空间估计；并给出几何解释及局部误差分析，刻画最优时间相关融合系数，包括外推情形。
AI.result: 在稀疏视角CT、模拟低剂量CT以及医学图像超分辨率实验中，CPF-DDNM较DDNM取得一致性提升，并与基于扩散的逆问题求解器相比具有竞争性表现。
AI.conclusion: 连续后验融合是一种无需额外开销的通用推理策略，可在保持测量一致性的同时增强扩散先验对不可观测结构的恢复能力。

title: Shrome at Touché: Soft-Vote Ensembling and Counter-Causal Augmentation for Causality Extraction
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Both authors contributed equally. Working notes of Touché at CLEF 2026 (Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum), 21-24 September 2026, Jena, Germany
summary: Touché 2026 extends causality extraction to counter-causal claims: news sentences whose surface form appears causal but whose meaning denies the causation, as in "It is falsely believed that X caused Y." A system that relies on surface cues such as "caused" or "led to" will accept such a sentence as causal and give it the wrong polarity. On the Countercausal News Corpus (CCNC), the task has three subtasks: deciding whether a sentence is causal (detection), locating its cause and effect spans (extraction), and labeling its polarity as procausal, counter-causal, or uncausal. We build one model per subtask. Detection is a fine-tuned classifier with a single cross-task rule that uses the extracted spans to remove false positives. For extraction, we ensemble three RoBERTa-large BILOU+CRF taggers by averaging their token-level scores before decoding, rather than voting on the spans each tagger produces. For polarity, where labeled counter-causal examples are scarcest, we add training sentences generated by a large language model prompted with nine patterns of counter-causal expression adapted from Hagen et al., keeping only those that pass automatic structural checks. On the held-out CCNC test set, the system reaches F1 0.869 on detection and macro-F1 0.817 on polarity, and in the organizers' final causal-only evaluation of extraction it scores granularity-adjusted F1 0.728, the highest extraction score among all submissions including the organizers' baseline. The development split is used only for component selection and the ablations reported in the paper.

AI.tldr: 论文将因果关系抽取扩展到反因果主张（counter-causal claims），在CCNC语料上构建检测、抽取、极性三子任务模型，检测F1 0.869、极性macro-F1 0.817、抽取granularity-adjusted F1 0.728。
AI.motivation: 新闻句子表面形式看似因果（如"caused""led to"），但语义上否定该因果关系（如"It is falsely believed that X caused Y"）。依赖表面线索的系统会将其误判为因果并给出错误极性，因此需要将因果抽取扩展到反因果主张的识别与极性判定，以纠正这类假阳性。
AI.method: 针对CCNC的三个子任务各建一个模型：检测采用微调分类器，并用一条跨任务规则根据抽取的跨度剔除假阳性；抽取对三个RoBERTa-large BILOU+CRF标注器在解码前平均token级得分的集成方式（而非对跨度投票）；极性任务因标注的反因果样本最稀缺，利用大语言模型以Hagen等改编的九种反因果表达模式为提示生成训练句，仅保留通过自动结构检查的样本。开发集仅用于组件选择与消融实验。
AI.result: 在留出的CCNC测试集上，检测F1达0.869，极性macro-F1达0.817；在组织方最终仅因果的抽取评测中，granularity-adjusted F1为0.728，是所有提交（含组织方基线）中最高的抽取得分。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨任务规则抑制假阳性、解码前分数级集成以及LLM生成的反因果数据增强，系统在反因果主张的检测、抽取与极性判定上均取得领先性能，尤其抽取任务超越所有提交基线。

title: Moving Forward with Video Saliency: A New Dataset and Benchmark where Motion Matters
summary: Video saliency prediction is inherently harder to model than static image saliency due to the additional temporal dimension. Video saliency benchmarks rest on the premise that predicting gaze on video requires utilizing temporal activity distributed across frames. Prior work has challenged this, showing that static baselines recover a significant fraction of the explainable gaze information on LEDOV, a popular video saliency dataset, and that video saliency models fail in the same places as this static baseline. We verify that this diagnosis still stands: under a more capable gold standard than the original analysis, and an updated panel of recent architectures, the strongest temporal architecture in the panel still does not substantially improve over a fine-tuned static baseline. However, it remains unclear whether the marginal gain reflects limitations of current temporal architectures or a lack of temporal patterns in the benchmark itself. We introduce SalTempto, a video saliency benchmark with greater dynamism: 224 clips of highly dynamic content, sourced from the HACS-Segments dataset so that each clip contains an event together with its lead-up and aftermath, with gaze recordings from up to 16 subjects and a training split for adapting pretrained models. On SalTempto, the static baseline recovers only about 13\% of the headroom above the centerbias, against more than half on LEDOV. A fine-tuned temporal architecture shows a substantial gain in performance over the static baseline, indicating that it does capture meaningfully more temporal information, which LEDOV fails to measure. Yet, even this SoTA model still leaves nearly half of SalTempto's headroom unexplained, indicating room for improvement in video saliency modelling. Examination of SalTempto also lets us describe human tendencies that models miss. SalTempto link: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bethgelab/video_saliency.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了LEDOV数据集中"静态基线可恢复大部分可解释注视信息"的结论在更强金标准与更新模型面板下依然成立，并提出更具动态性的视频显著性基准SalTempto。在该基准上，静态基线仅恢复约13%的headroom（LEDOV上超过一半），而微调后的时序架构显著超越静态基线，但仍遗留近一半headroom未被解释。
AI.motivation: 视频显著性预测因引入时间维度而比静态图像显著性更难建模，其基准的前提是预测视频注视需要利用跨帧的时间活动。已有工作对此提出质疑：在LEDOV上静态基线即可恢复相当比例的可解释注视信息，且视频显著性模型与静态基线在相同位置失败。本文旨在验证这一诊断在更强评估设置下是否仍成立，并探究边际增益究竟源于当前时序架构的局限，还是基准本身缺乏时序模式。
AI.method: 1) 在比原始分析更强的金标准（gold standard，即更优的注视聚合/评估目标）与更新的近期架构面板下，复现并检验"静态基线可解释大部分注视信息"的诊断；2) 构建新基准SalTempto：从HACS-Segments数据集采集224个高动态视频片段，每段包含一个事件及其前因与后续，注视记录来自最多16名被试，并提供训练划分以适配预训练模型；3) 在SalTempto上对比静态基线与微调时序架构相对于centerbias的headroom恢复情况。
AI.result: 在更新架构面板中，最强的时序架构相较微调静态基线仍未取得实质性提升，说明原诊断依旧成立。在SalTempto上，静态基线仅恢复约13%的headroom（相对centerbias），而LEDOV上超过一半；微调时序架构相较静态基线取得显著性能提升，表明其确实捕获了更多时序信息，而LEDOV未能测量到这一点。即便如此，该SoTA模型仍留下近一半的SalTempto headroom未被解释。
AI.conclusion: LEDOV的边际增益更多反映基准自身缺乏时序模式，而非时序架构的局限；SalTempto通过更高动态性内容揭示了时序架构的真实优势，同时显示视频显著性建模仍有较大改进空间。此外，对SalTempto的分析还揭示了人类注视倾向中被模型忽略的部分。数据链接：https://huggingface.co/datasets/bethgelab/video_saliency。

title: HexVIO: Towards All-Day Stereo-Inertial Tracking Through Commodity DSPs
summary: The ability of a device to localize itself within its surroundings is a fundamental prerequisite for spatial computing. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) has proven to be a cost-effective and accurate solution for this task. Robots, wearables, XR devices, and drones can benefit significantly from efficient implementations of VIO since they allow for cooler, lighter, and cheaper devices with longer battery life and a better user experience. In this work, we propose to enhance the efficiency of a VIO system by leveraging the Hexagon DSP, a commodity co-processor present in many modern smartphones and XR devices. Our approach offloads the visual frontend of a stereo-inertial odometry system to the DSP while keeping the backend on the main CPU. By optimizing the implementation for the DSP architecture, we achieve significant reductions in power consumption and latency compared to CPU-only execution. Our system, HexVIO, demonstrates a 67% reduction in power consumption or an 86% increase in throughput on a commodity smartphone, with the ability to sustain long-term real-time 30 fps tracking for 0.83 W, corresponding to ~18 hours of tracking on the testing device. These results highlight the potential of commodity DSPs for enabling all-day visual-inertial tracking in robotics and mobile devices.

AI.tldr: 将VIO视觉前端卸载到Hexagon DSP并保留后端于CPU，显著降低功耗与时延。
AI.motivation: 空间计算需要设备自定位，VIO是低成本高精度方案，机器人、可穿戴、XR、无人机等受益于高效VIO实现，可获得更轻更便宜、续航更长的设备。因此需要提升VIO效率。
AI.method: 利用现代智能手机和XR设备中常见的商用协处理器Hexagon DSP，将立体惯性里程计系统的视觉前端卸载到DSP，后端保留在主CPU，并针对DSP架构优化实现。
AI.result: 相比纯CPU执行，HexVIO在商用智能手机上功耗降低67%或吞吐提升86%，可持续实时30 fps跟踪且功耗0.83 W，对应测试设备约18小时跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明商用DSP有潜力在机器人和移动设备中实现全天候视觉惯性跟踪。

title: Wrong Organ, Right Physics: Transferring Echocardiography Pretraining to Lung Ultrasound for Tuberculosis Screening
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at SATNAC 2026, Drakensberg, South Africa, 11-14 October 2026
summary: Lung ultrasound (LUS) is attractive for tuberculosis (TB) screening at primary-care level, but labelled cohorts are small. Echocardiography carries no such constraint, while sharing the same underlying ultrasound imaging physics, signal processing and B-mode appearance as LUS. We ask whether an encoder pretrained on that high-resource ultrasound domain carries representations that remain usable in the low-resource one. Only the encoder varies, across seventeen encoders spanning three architecture families. Among them, a latent-predictive video encoder pretrained on generic video (V-JEPA2-L) and its echocardiography counterpart (EchoJEPA-L) differ in pretraining corpus alone. The choice among these encoders does not resolve the classification, the whole family spanning 2.50 percentage points against a measurement resolution of 2.71. What moves the task instead is feature conditioning. Standardising the features between the encoder and the classifier improves all seventeen encoders by a mean of +1.23 percentage points at $p=1.5\times10^{-5}$. On the held-out test set every encoder selected on the development folds stands above the baseline system by up to +2.57 percentage points of area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), and specificity at 90% sensitivity reaches 79.3% against 60.3%. The contrast specified in advance, EchoJEPA-L against V-JEPA2-L, measures -0.16 percentage points at $p=0.926$. We therefore find no evidence that shared ultrasonic physics alone makes echocardiography a more productive pretraining corpus than generic video, and any advantage, if present, is smaller than this cohort can resolve. The video encoders receive replicated still images, however, so whether this absence of an effect reflects the pretraining domain or a video encoder applied to static frames cannot be separated. The limiting factor is the labelled cohort rather than the encoder.

AI.tldr: 在低资源肺超声（LUS）结核病筛查任务上，编码器选择对分类性能影响极小；真正带来提升的是编码器与分类器之间的特征标准化，瓶颈在于标注队列规模而非预训练域。
AI.motivation: LUS 适合基层结核病筛查，但带标注队列规模小，限制模型开发。超声心动图数据资源丰富，且与 LUS 共享超声成像物理、信号处理和 B 模式外观。作者希望验证：在高资源超声域（超声心动图）上预训练的编码器，其表征能否迁移到低资源域（肺超声），即共享超声物理是否使超声心动图成为更有效的预训练语料。
AI.method: 固定除编码器外的其他环节，比较三种架构族、共十七个编码器。其中 V-JEPA2-L（通用视频预训练）与 EchoJEPA-L（超声心动图预训练）仅预训练语料不同，构成预先设定的对照。此外引入特征条件化（在编码器与分类器之间对特征进行标准化），评估其对全部十七个编码器的影响。评估采用开发折选择模型，并在留出测试集上报告 AUROC 及 90% 敏感度下的特异度。
AI.result: 编码器选择无法决定分类结果，整个架构族内差异为 2.50 个百分点，而测量分辨率为 2.71。特征标准化使全部十七个编码器平均提升 +1.23 个百分点（p=1.5×10^-5）。测试集上，所有在开发折选出的编码器均优于基线系统，AUROC 最高提升 +2.57 个百分点，90% 敏感度下特异度达 79.3%（基线 60.3%）。预设对照 EchoJEPA-L 对 V-JEPA2-L 为 -0.16 个百分点（p=0.926）。
AI.conclusion: 没有证据表明仅凭共享超声物理就能使超声心动图成为比通用视频更有效的预训练语料；即便存在优势，也小于该队列可分辨的限度。由于视频编码器接收的是复制的静态图像，无法区分这种效应缺失是源于预训练域还是视频编码器用于静态帧所致。限制因素是标注队列而非编码器。

title: T3lescope: Arbitrary-Resolution High-Fidelity Generative Surface Reconstruction from Images
summary: We reconstruct high-fidelity 3D scene meshes from posed multi-view images without per-scene optimization, across scales ranging from single objects to large outdoor scenes. Per-scene optimization methods lack the learned 3D prior needed when observations are sparse or surfaces are glossy or transparent. Existing generative methods leverage such priors to complete geometry in sparsely observed regions, but typically operate at a fixed resolution over a limited spatial extent, trading spatial coverage against detail. Reconstructing a large scene therefore often requires partitioning it into independently processed overlapping local regions, making it difficult to maintain global geometric consistency. To address these issues, we propose T3lescope, which applies a single fixed-resolution generator across scene scales in an inference-time coarse-to-fine cascade. A coarse level establishes the scene layout, and finer levels perturb and denoise geometry inherited from the coarser level within progressively finer spatial cells to recover surface detail. The model is trained on individual cells at multiple scales and shares its weights across all levels, so no hierarchy is fixed during training, and the number of levels, cell scales, and cell locations are determined at inference time. On indoor, outdoor, and city-scale scenes, T3lescope outperforms feed-forward and generative baselines, matches or surpasses per-scene optimization, and recovers fine structures as well as glossy and transparent surfaces. These results show that our method generalizes across diverse scenes, view counts, and image resolutions. Project page: https://pfnet-research.github.io/t3lescope/

AI.tldr: T3lescope 提出一种无需逐场景优化、以单一固定分辨率生成器在推理时进行由粗到细级联的 3D 场景网格重建方法，可在单物体到大型户外场景的广泛尺度上保持全局几何一致性并恢复细节。
AI.motivation: 逐场景优化方法在观测稀疏或表面为镜面、透明时缺乏学习到的 3D 先验；现有生成式方法虽有先验可补全稀疏区域几何，但通常在有限空间范围内以固定分辨率运行，在空间覆盖与细节之间取舍，重建大场景时需切分为重叠局部区域独立处理，难以保持全局几何一致性。
AI.method: 提出 T3lescope：使用单一固定分辨率生成器，在推理时以由粗到细级联方式跨场景尺度应用。粗层级建立场景布局，细层级在逐渐变细的空间单元内对继承自粗层级的几何进行扰动与去噪以恢复表面细节。模型在多个尺度的单个空间单元上训练并跨所有层级共享权重，因此训练时不固定层级结构，层数、单元尺度与单元位置均在推理时确定。
AI.result: 在室内、户外与城市尺度场景上，T3lescope 优于前馈与生成式基线，匹配或超过逐场景优化方法，并能恢复精细结构以及镜面和透明表面。结果表明该方法可泛化到多样场景、视角数量与图像分辨率。
AI.conclusion: 通过推理时的由粗到细级联与跨层级权重共享，T3lescope 在不依赖逐场景优化的情况下实现了跨尺度、高保真且全局一致的三维场景网格重建。

title: To Jev or Not? Evaluating the Accuracy and Efficiency of Structured Decision Models for Hate-Speech Moderation
summary: The scale of online content makes hate-speech moderation challenging, while Large Language Models (LLMs) enable harmful material to be produced and adapted more easily. Moderation therefore requires efficient classifiers that can accommodate different definitions of hate speech. Recent structured decision models accept natural-language criteria and select among specified answers, raising the question of whether they can meet these requirements without task-specific training. We present HATEDECIDE, an evaluation of six decision-model configurations on four hate-speech datasets against specialized moderation, zero-shot, commercial, and supervised baselines. We examine whether supplying a dataset's definition, or decomposing it into multiple questions, improves classification, and we measure their latency and cost. We find that commercial LLMs significantly outperform all decision models on only one dataset. Supplying definitions changes up to 28\% of predictions without consistently improving classification, and decomposition significantly improves performance in only 20\% of the comparisons. On a diagnostic set of test cases, the best hosted decision model comes within 1.6 macro-F1 points of the best commercial LLM at approximately 97\% lower inference cost. These results identify opportunities for inexpensive moderation, while showing that explicit criteria and additional questions do not reliably improve classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HATEDECIDE评估框架，在4个仇恨言论数据集上测试6种结构化决策模型配置，与专用审核、零样本、商用及监督基线对比，考察提供定义与问题分解的作用，并测量延迟与成本。
AI.motivation: 在线内容规模庞大，仇恨言论审核困难；大语言模型使有害内容更易生成与变体化。审核需要高效且能适应不同仇恨言论定义（即自然语言标准）的分类器。近期结构化决策模型可接受自然语言标准并在给定答案中选择，因此本文追问：这类模型能否无需任务特定训练即满足上述需求。
AI.method: 构建HATEDECIDE评测：在4个仇恨言论数据集上评估6种决策模型配置，与专用审核模型、零样本、商用LLM、监督基线对比。实验考察两类干预——向模型提供数据集的仇恨言论定义、以及将判定分解为多个子问题——是否提升分类效果；同时测量推理延迟与成本。并设计诊断性测试集用于细粒度对比。
AI.result: 商用LLM仅在1个数据集上显著优于所有决策模型。提供定义最多改变28%的预测，但分类效果并未持续提升；问题分解仅在20%的对比中显著改善性能。在诊断测试集上，最佳托管决策模型与最佳商用LLM的macro-F1差距仅1.6个百分点，而推理成本降低约97%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化决策模型在无需任务特定训练的前提下，能以极低成本接近商用LLM的审核性能，为低成本审核提供了可能；但显式提供标准与增加额外问题并不能可靠地提升分类效果。

title: SyntaxBench: A Statistical Diagnostic Framework for Character-Level Reasoning in Large Language Models
comment: 32 pages, 17 figures. The first two authors contributed equally. The code will be released soon
summary: Large language models are increasingly used where small syntactic errors matter, yet character-level reasoning is still evaluated mostly through isolated probes and aggregate accuracy. We introduce SyntaxBench, a diagnostic benchmark and statistical evaluation framework for character-level reasoning. It contains five core tasks, character counting, letter containment, palindrome detection, edit distance, and longest-string selection, plus index_to_span, a harder substring-extraction stress test. The five core tasks use paired English and character-length-matched random-string inputs. index_to_span documents share a 200-500 word band and are not character-length matched. All six tasks use zero-, one-, and four-shot prompts. We evaluate eight open-weight models from 2B to 32B parameters across 11 reasoning-mode configurations. The framework reports exact-match and relaxed accuracy, Cohen's kappa, paired McNemar tests with odds ratios, bootstrap confidence intervals, Kendall's tau, class-conditional metrics, tokenization analysis, and multiple-comparison-corrected tests. Three findings stand out. First, tokenization shapes accuracy: random strings are more character-visible than English strings (1.892 vs. 3.169 characters per token), and character-counting accuracy falls as English words occupy more tokens. Second, reasoning mode is not uniformly helpful: Gemma4-31B is nearly unchanged across modes on the near-saturated tasks, while Qwen3.6-27B is worse with thinking on palindrome detection (0.952 non-thinking vs. 0.886 thinking at four-shot). Third, index_to_span remains largely unsolved; the best four-shot exact-match accuracy is 6.75%. Character-level evaluation needs controlled inputs, paired tests, and analyses of tokenization and reasoning mode rather than aggregate accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SyntaxBench，一个面向字符级推理的诊断基准与统计评估框架，包含五个核心任务和一项更难的子串抽取压力测试，并系统评估了 8 个开源模型在 11 种推理模式配置下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有字符级推理评估多依赖孤立探针与聚合准确率，难以揭示模型在小语法错误敏感场景中的真实能力，也掩盖了分词与推理模式等因素的影响，因此需要受控输入与配对统计检验相结合的诊断评估方法。
AI.method: 构建 SyntaxBench，包含字符计数、字母包含、回文检测、编辑距离、最长字符串选择五个核心任务，以及更难的 index_to_span 子串抽取压力测试。核心任务使用英文与字符长度匹配的随机字符串配对输入，index_to_span 文档为 200–500 词且不做字符长度匹配；六项任务均采用 zero-shot、one-shot、four-shot 提示。评估 8 个 2B–32B 参数的开源权重模型、共 11 种推理模式配置。统计框架报告精确匹配与宽松准确率、Cohen's kappa、配对 McNemar 检验及优势比、bootstrap 置信区间、Kendall's tau、类条件指标、分词分析和多重比较校正检验。
AI.result: 三项主要发现：其一，分词影响准确率，随机字符串的字符可见性高于英文（1.892 对 3.169 字符/词元），英文单词占用词元越多，字符计数准确率越低；其二，推理模式并非普遍有益，Gemma4-31B 在接近饱和任务上各模式几乎不变，而 Qwen3.6-27B 在回文检测上启用思考反而更差（four-shot 下 0.952 对 0.886）；其三，index_to_span 仍基本未被解决，最佳 four-shot 精确匹配准确率仅 6.75%。
AI.conclusion: 字符级评估需要受控输入、配对检验以及对分词和推理模式的分析，而不能仅依赖聚合准确率。

title: A Fully Automatic Pipeline for 3D Dendrite Instance Segmentation in SBF-SEM
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE-EMBS Conference on Biomedical Engineering and Sciences (IECBES)
summary: Accurate three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction of individual dendrites in serial block-face scanning electron microscopy (SBF-SEM) is essential for quantifying structural plasticity in the brain, yet manual annotation at scale is infeasible. We present a fully automatic pipeline for 3D dendrite instance segmentation that unifies YOLOv6-guided Segment Anything Model (SAM) prompting on downsampled slices, iterative two-dimensional mask refinement, random forest 3D instance linking, and instance-aware high-resolution refinement using nnU-Net at native resolution into a single system requiring no manual prompting at inference. Applied to hippocampal CA1 SBF-SEM datasets from a control rat and a pilocarpine- induced epileptic rat, our pipeline reconstructs coherent, well- separated dendrites with high semantic accuracy (Dice 0.93 and 0.91) and strong instance-level performance on control tissue, while analysis of the more challenging epileptic tissue identifies instance recognition in dense regions as the principal remaining limitation. The high-resolution refinement stage recovers thin dendritic protrusions, providing a basis for downstream spine- level analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/ ZE-WEN/dendrite-3d-instance-seg.

AI.tldr: 提出全自动3D树突实例分割流水线，结合YOLOv6引导SAM、2D掩膜迭代精修、随机森林3D实例连接及nnU-Net高分辨实例精修，在CA1 SBF-SEM数据上取得高语义精度。
AI.motivation: SBF-SEM中单个树突的精确3D重建对量化脑结构可塑性至关重要，但大规模人工标注不可行，因此需要全自动的3D树突实例分割方法。
AI.method: 统一流水线：在降采样切片上用YOLOv6引导SAM提示；迭代式二维掩膜精修；随机森林进行3D实例连接；在原始分辨率下用nnU-Net进行实例感知高分辨精修；推理阶段无需人工提示。
AI.result: 在对照大鼠与匹罗卡品诱导癫痫大鼠的海马CA1 SBF-SEM数据上，重建出连贯且分离良好的树突，语义精度高（Dice 0.93与0.91），对照组织实例级性能强；致痫组织中密集区域的实例识别为主要局限；高分辨精修阶段可恢复细薄树突突起。
AI.conclusion: 该全自动流水线可实现高精度3D树突实例分割，并为下游棘突级分析提供基础，密集区域实例识别仍是待改进之处。

title: Multilingual GSM-Symbolic: What determines capability transfer across languages?
summary: We understand little about how capabilities acquired in one language carry over to another, or what governs this transfer: evaluations rely on incomparable, saturation-prone datasets and rarely examine its determinants jointly. Identifying what predicts transfer would let us avoid exhaustive evaluation across all language pairs and let developers target the factors that limit performance in low-resource languages. To evaluate cross-lingual capability transfer, we introduce Multilingual GSM-Symbolic, an extensible multilingual mathematical dataset covering 30,000 item-matched question-answer pairs and spanning 15 languages. It utilises symbolic templates to prevent overfitting and ensure generalisation by allowing generation of millions of high-quality variations from a single sample. Using Multilingual GSM-Symbolic, we quantify the largest determinants of capability as model size ($β= 1.77$), language resource level ($β= 0.77$), reasoning ($β= 0.67$) and typological distance ($β= -0.25$). This joint estimation allows these determinants to be expressed in terms of one another: a 32B model evaluated in Marathi performs like a 10B model in English. Our findings have important implications for model developers, showing that model size and reasoning narrow the performance gap between low- and high-resource languages ($β= -0.27$ and $β= -0.20$, respectively), while similar levers have little or no effect on typologically distant languages. Overall, our analysis framework explains 92% of between-language variation, but only 23% of the model-by-language variation, and predicts a model's performance on an unseen language within 6.0pp (r=.96). Incorporating measurements from just 10 templates in the target language reduces this to 4.19pp, enabling reasonable estimates of performance with little or no downstream dataset.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出可扩展的多语言数学数据集Multilingual GSM-Symbolic（30,000对条目匹配问答对，覆盖15种语言），联合量化跨语言能力迁移的决定因素，并提供可用少量目标语言模板预测未见语言性能的框架。
AI.motivation: 目前对"一种语言中获得的能力如何迁移到另一种语言"及迁移机制理解不足：现有评测依赖不可比、易饱和的数据集，且很少联合考察迁移的决定因素。识别迁移的预测因子可避免对所有语言对进行穷举评测，并帮助开发者针对限制低资源语言性能的因素进行优化。
AI.method: 构建Multilingual GSM-Symbolic：基于符号模板生成条目匹配的问答对，共30,000对、覆盖15种语言，可由单一样本生成数百万高质量变体，防止过拟合并保证泛化。利用该数据集对模型规模、语言资源水平、推理能力、类型学距离等决定因素进行联合回归估计，并分析模型规模与推理对低/高资源语言差距及类型学远距离语言的作用，以及用目标语言少量模板进行性能预测。
AI.result: 能力的主要决定因素为：模型规模（β=1.77）、语言资源水平（β=0.77）、推理（β=0.67）、类型学距离（β=-0.25）。据此可跨因素换算：32B模型在马拉地语的表现相当于10B模型在英语的表现。模型规模与推理缩小低资源与高资源语言间的差距（β分别为-0.27与-0.20），但对类型学远距离语言作用很小或无作用。分析框架解释92%的语言间变异，但仅解释23%的"模型×语言"变异；预测模型在未见语言上的性能误差在6.0pp以内（r=.96），加入目标语言仅10个模板的测量后可降至4.19pp。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言能力迁移可由少数关键因素联合刻画，模型规模与推理主要缓解资源水平差距而非类型学距离带来的差距；该框架能以极低评测成本（甚至无需下游数据集）较准确预测未见语言性能，对模型开发者的资源分配与低资源语言优化具有实践意义。

title: LAS-CLIP: A Lightweight Adapter Steering Approach for CLIP's Visual Encoder
