summary: CLIP's visual encoder produces only global image representations, limiting its use in region-level tasks. Existing adaptations rely on visual prompting, input masking, or encoder fine-tuning, each compromising pre-trained representations. We propose LAS-CLIP, a Lightweight Adapter Steering approach that keeps every CLIP parameter frozen. A compact MaskAdapter generates per-head, per-layer attention biases from an input mask and injects them into the frozen self-attention layers, steering attention toward the target region. Crucially, because the backbone remains strictly untouched, LAS-CLIP seamlessly reverts to vanilla CLIP when no mask is provided, preserving its foundational zero-shot capabilities. With approximately 116K to 145K trainable parameters and 100K training samples on two T4 GPUs, LAS-CLIP achieves competitive or superior results compared to Alpha-CLIP on ImageNet-S zero-shot classification and RefCOCO referring expression comprehension, despite the latter fine-tuning its entire encoder on millions of samples. Qualitative analysis further confirms stronger representational fidelity under incorrect masks and in downstream generation.

AI.tldr: LAS-CLIP 是一种轻量级适配器引导方法，在完全冻结 CLIP 参数的前提下，通过 MaskAdapter 生成逐头逐层注意力偏置并注入自注意力层，实现区域级视觉任务，且可无缝退回原生 CLIP。
AI.motivation: CLIP 的视觉编码器仅输出全局图像表示，难以用于区域级任务；现有适配方案依赖视觉提示、输入掩码或编码器微调，均会损害预训练表示。
AI.method: 提出 LAS-CLIP，保持所有 CLIP 参数冻结；用紧凑的 MaskAdapter 从输入掩码生成逐头、逐层的注意力偏置，注入冻结的自注意力层，将注意力引导至目标区域。
AI.result: 可训练参数约 116K–145K，在两张 T4 GPU 上使用 100K 训练样本，在 ImageNet-S 零样本分类和 RefCOCO 指代表达理解上取得与 Alpha-CLIP 相当或更优的结果，后者需在数百万样本上微调整个编码器；定性分析还表明在错误掩码和下游生成中具有更强的表示保真度。
AI.conclusion: 由于骨干网络严格未被改动，LAS-CLIP 在无掩码输入时可无缝恢复为原生 CLIP，保留其基础零样本能力，是一种高效且不破坏预训练表示的 CLIP 区域级适配方案。

title: EVEWorld: Physical Evolution Supervision for Embodied World Models
summary: Embodied world models enable scalable simulation of embodied interactions for robot learning. However, existing models are prone to Model Laziness, as they focus on visual fidelity at the expense of physical reasoning and lack process-level supervision over the temporal dynamics of manipulated objects. In this work, we propose EVEWorld, a physical evolution-supervision framework for physically consistent target evolution. EVEWorld consists of two components: Instance-Guided Restoration (IGR) and Temporal Instance Alignment (TIA). First, IGR promotes instance consistency through restoration supervision. Second, TIA promotes cross-frame consistency by aligning target instances across adjacent frames. We further introduce the Model Laziness Rate (MLR), a metric that measures persistent violations of instance consistency in generated trajectories. Extensive experiments on DreamGenBench, EWMBench, and PBench demonstrate the effectiveness of EVEWorld, notably achieving an 87.5% reduction in MLR compared with GigaWorld-0. On the WorldArena 2.0 Track 1 leaderboard, our model ranks 6th in JEPA Similarity and 17th overall, which further validates the performance of our evolution supervision strategy.

AI.tldr: 提出EVEWorld物理演化监督框架，通过实例引导修复与时序实例对齐抑制具身世界模型的"模型懒惰"，并引入MLR指标，在多个基准上显著降低违规率。
AI.motivation: 现有具身世界模型偏向视觉保真度而忽视物理推理，且缺乏对操作对象时序动态的过程级监督，导致"模型懒惰"问题，即生成轨迹中持续出现实例一致性的违背。
AI.method: EVEWorld包含两个组件：实例引导修复（IGR）通过修复监督提升实例一致性；时序实例对齐（TIA）通过对齐相邻帧的目标实例提升跨帧一致性。同时提出模型懒惰率（MLR）度量生成轨迹中持久的实例一致性违规。
AI.result: 在DreamGenBench、EWMBench和PBench上的大量实验验证了EVEWorld的有效性，相比GigaWorld-0实现MLR降低87.5%。在WorldArena 2.0 Track 1排行榜中，JEPA相似度排名第6，总体排名第17。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明物理演化监督策略能有效提升具身世界模型的物理一致性与时序一致性，验证了框架性能。

title: Interpretable Deepfake Detection in Videos via Explicit Forensic Features and Temporal Modeling
summary: Deepfake detection in videos remains challenging, as manipulated content may appear visually consistent at the frame level while exhibiting subtle temporal inconsistencies. This paper introduces an interpretable deepfake detection framework that models spatially and temporally coherent facial features in video sequences. Unlike end-to-end deep models relying on implicit representations, the proposed approach explicitly encodes physically grounded forensic cues, enabling transparent analysis and improved multi-dataset generalization. The pipeline transforms videos into identity-consistent facial trajectories, segments them into fixed-length temporal windows, and represents each frame using 68 structured descriptors spanning four complementary domains: photometric, textural, geometric, and compression-based features. These descriptors provide a compact multi-domain representation of manipulation artifacts and are processed by a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to capture temporal dependencies and subtle irregularities. Evaluation on four benchmark datasets, FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF v2, a curated subset of the DeepFake Detection Challenge (DFDC), and DeeperForensics, yields strong and consistent F1-scores of 98.0%, 91.0%, 97.6%, and 96.2%, respectively. The approach also demonstrated a good cross-dataset generalization, providing a robust and interpretable solution for video deepfake detection.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可解释的视频深伪检测框架，通过显式编码物理依据的多域取证特征（光度、纹理、几何、压缩）并用LSTM建模时序依赖，在四个基准数据集上取得高F1并具备良好跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 视频深伪检测仍具挑战：篡改内容在帧级可能视觉一致，但在时序上存在细微不一致。端到端深度模型依赖隐式表征，缺乏透明性且跨数据集泛化有限，因此需要显式、物理可解释的取证线索建模。
AI.method: 将视频转换为身份一致的人脸轨迹，切分为固定长度时间窗；每帧用68维结构化描述符表示，覆盖光度、纹理、几何、压缩四个互补域；再由LSTM处理序列以捕获时序依赖与细微异常。
AI.result: 在FaceForensics++、Celeb-DF v2、DFDC精选子集、DeeperForensics四个基准上F1分别为98.0%、91.0%、97.6%、96.2%，并展现良好的跨数据集泛化。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以紧凑的多域可解释表征结合时序建模，为视频深伪检测提供稳健且可解释的解决方案，并验证了物理依据特征的泛化优势。

title: Benchmarking candidate coverage and rejection policy transfer in typed decision models
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures. v2: expanded evaluation with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and CLINC150; added fixed-budget rejection policy transfer, three missing-answer sources, and controlled robustness analyses. Code and benchmark artifacts: https://github.com/luckykevvv/Decision_Model_Benchmark
summary: Rejection policies must remain useful as candidate sets and tasks change. We compare Laya, Jev and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct using public reference labels, testing Laya/Jev policy transfer at equal calibration budgets and all three models on artificial omission, natural retrieval misses and public out-of-scope queries. Source calibration often fails to preserve the target operating point. A Jev policy calibrated on DBpedia rejects 69.3% of covered Emotion test inputs, while an Emotion policy loses detection entirely. Retrieval exposes a different tradeoff: with ten intent candidates, Laya detects 99.0% of out-of-scope queries but rejects 48.8% of covered queries. Separating missing-answer sources reveals these costs alongside retrieval coverage. The benchmark provides shared inputs, explicit decision and failure categories, and reproducible scoring to assess rejection policies under the conditions in which they are reused. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/luckykevvv/Decision_Model_Benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个拒绝策略评测基准，比较Laya、Jev与Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在策略迁移、检索遗漏和域外查询等条件下的表现，并公开可复现的评分方案与代码。
AI.motivation: 候选集合与任务会变化，拒绝策略需在新条件下仍然有效，但源域校准得到的策略往往无法保持目标域的工作点，因此需要统一的评测条件来检验拒绝策略复用时的表现。
AI.method: 使用公开参考标签，在相同校准预算下测试Laya/Jev的策略迁移，并在人工遗漏、自然检索遗漏与公开域外查询三类条件下评测三个模型；通过区分缺失答案来源，将检索覆盖率与拒绝代价分开度量，并提供共享输入、明确决策与失败类别及可复现评分。
AI.result: 源域校准常无法保留目标工作点：DBpedia上校准的Jev策略拒绝了69.3%的Emotion覆盖测试输入，而Emotion策略则完全丧失检测能力；检索带来不同权衡，在十个意图候选下，Laya检出99.0%域外查询但拒绝48.8%覆盖查询。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝策略的性能高度依赖校准域与检索配置，需在复用条件下评估；该基准通过明确失败类别和可复现评分揭示此类代价，为拒绝策略的可迁移性评估提供统一平台。

title: From Patching to Pruning Visual Computation in Vision Language Models
summary: Vision language models (VLMs) incur substantial inference cost because every visual token is processed by the attention and MLP projections of every decoder layer, even when token-specific visual computation is unnecessary at many depths. We introduce Patch-to-Prune (P2P), inspired by Mechanistic Interpretability, a training-free framework that converts activation patching from a diagnostic tool into an inference-time computation bypass. P2P performs validation-guided forward and backward layer sweeps to identify decoder regions whose visual-token projection outputs can be replaced by fixed neutral proxy activation vectors within a user-specified accuracy tolerance. Unlike conventional token-pruning methods, P2P preserves the sequence length, token order, positional information, attention mask, and residual pathways, thereby pruning computation without removing tokens or modifying the pretrained model weights. We evaluate P2P on four VLMs from the Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA families across seven multi-modal benchmarks using mutually disjoint calibration, validation, and test partitions. P2P at a 3% tolerance retains around 94% of dense accuracy while reducing FLOPs by 55%. Beyond these efficiency gains, our layer-wise analysis suggests that visual processing in VLMs is non-uniformly distributed across decoder depth: early and late layers often require little token-specific visual computation, whereas intermediate layers appear to perform most task-relevant visual integration, enabling later reasoning to rely largely on visual information already embedded in shared residual and textual representations. This makes P2P both an efficient inference framework and a causal lens into visual information processing in VLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 Patch-to-Prune (P2P)，通过将视觉 token 的投影输出替换为固定"中性代理激活向量"，在保持序列长度、token 顺序、位置信息、注意力掩码和残差通路不变的前提下跳过部分解码层计算，实现免剪枝 token 的推理加速，并揭示 VLM 视觉计算在解码深度上的非均匀分布。
AI.motivation: VLM 推理成本高：每个视觉 token 都要经过每个解码层的注意力与 MLP 投影，但在许多深度上 token 特定的视觉计算并非必要，导致大量冗余计算。现有 token 剪枝方法会改变序列长度、token 顺序或位置信息，可能破坏模型结构完整性。作者希望利用机制可解释性工具，把"激活补丁"从诊断手段转化为推理时的计算旁路，在不动模型权重、不删 token 的条件下省算力。]]
AI.method: 1) 受机制可解释性启发，将 activation patching 从诊断工具改造为推理期计算旁路（training-free）。2) 通过验证集引导的前向/反向层扫描（validation-guided forward and backward layer sweeps），定位那些视觉 token 投影输出可被固定中性代理激活向量（neutral proxy activation vectors）替代的解码区域，替代需满足用户指定的精度容忍度（accuracy tolerance）。3) 与常规 token pruning 不同，P2P 保留序列长度、token 顺序、位置信息、注意力掩码与残差通路，即只"修剪计算"而不删 token、不修改预训练权重。4) 在 Qwen2.5-VL 与 LLaVA 两大家族共四个 VLM、七个多模态基准上评估，并使用互不重叠的 calibration / validation / test 划分。]]
AI.result: 在 3% 容忍度下，P2P 保留约 94% 的稠密（dense）精度，同时将 FLOPs 降低 55%。此外，逐层分析显示 VLM 的视觉处理在解码深度上分布不均匀：早期与晚期层通常几乎不需要 token 特定的视觉计算，而中间层承担了大部分与任务相关的视觉整合，使后续推理可主要依赖已嵌入共享残差表示与文本表示中的视觉信息。]]
AI.conclusion: P2P 既是高效的免训练推理加速框架（3% 容忍度下省 55% FLOPs、保 94% 精度），也是一种审视 VLM 视觉信息处理的因果视角（causal lens），为理解解码器深度上视觉计算的非均匀分布提供了证据。

title: Native Action-Prior Learning from Videos for World Action Models
summary: World action models integrate future visual dynamics with robot action prediction, but their scalability remains limited by the need for action-annotated robot trajectories. Observation-only videos contain rich evidence about interaction dynamics, but existing approaches typically use them either to pretrain visual representations that must later be adapted for control, or to infer latent actions that are subsequently grounded to robot commands. We present NAVA-WAM, which introduces native action-prior learning by directly pretraining the action policy from observation-only videos, avoiding indirect representation-to-control transfer or a separate latent-action model. Our training consists of two stages. First, we pretrain on observation-only videos, where future-video flow-matching supervision over visual transitions is propagated through transition-structured joint attention to optimize the Action-DiT and learn action-relevant priors. Second, we use action-labeled demonstrations to post-train the Action-DiT for robot control through joint video--action flow matching, while asymmetric attention decouples the visual branch from iterative action denoising and enables efficient action-only inference. Extensive experiments show that NAVA-WAM consistently outperforms prior approaches under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, while demonstrating strong action-label efficiency and effective real-robot generalization. These results establish native action-prior learning as an effective approach to directly pretrain action policies from observation-only videos, providing a scalable path beyond action-labeled robot data.

AI.tldr: 提出 NAVA-WAM，通过"原生动作先验学习"直接用纯观测视频预训练动作策略，两阶段训练后显著优于既有方法，并具备强动作标签效率与真实机器人泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）虽能融合未来视觉动态与机器人动作预测，但其可扩展性受限于对带动作标注的机器人轨迹数据的依赖。纯观测视频蕴含丰富的交互动态信息，但现有方法要么仅用于预训练视觉表征再适配到控制，要么仅用于推断潜动作再接地到机器人指令，均需间接的中间环节。
AI.method: 提出 NAVA-WAM，进行原生动作先验学习，即直接从纯观测视频预训练动作策略，避免表征到控制的间接迁移与独立潜动作模型。训练分两阶段：第一阶段在纯观测视频上预训练，将未来视频的流匹配监督信号通过"转移结构化的联合注意力"传播，以优化 Action-DiT、学习与动作相关的先验；第二阶段用带动作标注的示教数据，通过视频—动作联合流匹配对 Action-DiT 进行后训练以用于机器人控制，同时采用非对称注意力将视觉分支与迭代式动作去噪解耦，实现高效的动作单模态推理。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，NAVA-WAM 在分布内与分布外设置下均持续优于先前方法，并展现出较强的动作标签效率与有效的真实机器人泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了"原生动作先验学习"作为直接从纯观测视频预训练动作策略的有效途径，为超越依赖动作标注机器人数据提供了一条可扩展路径。

title: Beyond Entropy: Self-Diagnostic Multi-Role Token Optimization for Video Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially advanced multimodal reasoning, yet it remains fundamentally limited by ambiguous token-level credit assignment. While high-entropy token heuristics encourage possibility exploration, naively extending them to video reasoning tends to induce lengthy reasoning, as the model becomes overly reliant on high-entropy visual activations. Alternative approaches that rely on counterfactual-based visual token localization for credit assignment also tend to over-prioritize visual exploration at the expense of decisive reasoning cues for answer derivation, thereby exacerbating the interference from spurious visual nuances. Moreover, these methods employ static counterfactual strategies that fail to co-evolve with the policy during training. In this paper, we introduce DyCPO, a co-evolutionary framework that jointly optimizes reliable token selection and adaptive counterfactual intervention. It constructs a multi-role dependence metric to balance visual exploration and answer-relevance mining in token-wise contrastive learning, while suppressing exploration-only filler tokens and spurious visual noise. Rather than relying on static counterfactual priors, DyCPO dynamically derives counterfactual signals from the model's own successful and failed rollouts, enabling self-diagnostic analysis and co-evolution of the optimization objective with the policy. Extensive experiments on complex video reasoning and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance improvements, establishing DyCPO as a robust token-level credit assignment paradigm for multimodal reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DyCPO，一个协同进化框架，联合优化可靠token选择与自适应反事实干预，用于多模态强化学习中的token级信用分配。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习视频推理存在token级信用分配模糊问题：高熵token启发式易导致冗长推理并过度依赖高熵视觉激活；基于反事实的视觉token定位方法则过度侧重视觉探索，忽视关键推理线索，且采用静态反事实策略，无法随策略训练协同进化。
AI.method: DyCPO构建多角色依赖度量，在token级对比学习中平衡视觉探索与答案相关性挖掘，同时抑制纯探索填充token和虚假视觉噪声；不依赖静态反事实先验，而是从模型自身成功与失败的rollout中动态导出反事实信号，实现自我诊断分析和优化目标与策略的协同进化。
AI.result: 在复杂视频推理和通用视频理解基准上的大量实验表明性能持续提升，验证DyCPO是一种稳健的多模态强化学习token级信用分配范式。
AI.conclusion: DyCPO通过协同进化的可靠token选择与自适应反事实干预，有效解决了多模态强化学习中token级信用分配的核心挑战，为视频推理提供了更优的信用分配方案。

title: ForestQuery: Boundary-Aware and Spatially Anchored Query Learning for Unified Forest Point Cloud Segmentation
summary: Forest point cloud segmentation is fundamental for fine-grained 3D forest scene understanding, yet remains challenging due to irregular tree structures, severe occlusions, density variations, and ambiguous instance boundaries. Recent query-based forest segmentation methods have shown promise for unified semantic and instance prediction, but they still insufficiently exploit forest-specific spatial structure and account for boundary uncertainty. In this paper, we propose ForestQuery, a boundary-aware and spatially anchored query learning framework for unified forest point cloud segmentation. ForestQuery enhances instance and semantic query learning through two complementary designs. Specifically, boundary uncertainty is explicitly modeled to guide reliable instance query construction and modulate query optimization through adaptive loss reweighting. Meanwhile, spatially anchored semantic query enhancement (SA-SQE) introduces learnable 3D anchors encoding forest vertical stratification priors to enrich semantic queries with explicit spatial references. We evaluate ForestQuery on multiple public forest point cloud benchmarks and a self-collected annotated real-world dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in both individual-tree segmentation and semantic segmentation across diverse forest scenes. Code and data are publicly available at https://zhan994.github.io/ForestQuery

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ForestQuery，一个边界感知且空间锚定的查询学习框架，用于统一的森林点云语义与实例分割。
AI.motivation: 森林点云分割面临树结构不规则、遮挡严重、密度变化大及实例边界模糊等挑战，而现有基于查询的森林分割方法未充分利用森林特有的空间结构，也未考虑边界不确定性。
AI.method: ForestQuery 通过两个互补设计增强实例与语义查询学习：一是显式建模边界不确定性，引导可靠的实例查询构建，并通过自适应损失重加权调制查询优化；二是空间锚定语义查询增强（SA-SQE），引入编码森林垂直分层先验的可学习 3D 锚点，为语义查询提供显式空间参考。
AI.result: 在多个公开森林点云基准和一个自采集标注的真实数据集上，ForestQuery 在单木分割与语义分割任务中均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: ForestQuery 有效利用了边界不确定性与森林空间结构先验，在多样森林场景下实现了统一的点云分割性能改进，代码与数据已公开。

title: Iterating Consistency Models: Stability, Error Bounds and Noise Schedules
summary: Consistency models (CMs) have become a leading approach for generating high-quality samples in few steps. However, adding steps can improve or degrade sample quality in ways that are highly sensitive to the schedule and that existing theory does not fully explain. To provide accuracy guarantees and guide CM sampler design, we analyze multistep CM sampling as a composition of noising and approximate denoising operators. Under explicit, verifiable stability assumptions, we derive a non-asymptotic error bound that separates contraction of the initialization error from accumulation of approximation error. The bound assigns distinct roles to the schedule: large early noise levels drive contraction, while small late noise levels control the residual bias. As a corollary, we obtain explicit constants for strongly log-concave and semi-log-concave targets. We further establish a complementary guarantee whose assumptions, one-step accuracy and stability, can be estimated for a given trained model. Experiments show that the contraction and approximation profiles entering our bounds can be reliably measured and closely match the predicted functional forms. Together, these results provide a meaningful convergence theory for multi-step CMs and a practical route to sampler design.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多步一致性模型（CM）采样分析为加噪与近似去噪算子的复合，在显式稳定性假设下推导了非渐近误差界，将初始化误差的收缩与近似误差的累积分离，并揭示调度表的双重作用，为CM采样器设计提供理论与实用指导。
AI.motivation: 一致性模型是少步高质量生成的主流方法，但增加步数对样本质量的影响高度依赖噪声调度，且现有理论无法充分解释这一现象，也缺乏准确的误差保证来指导采样器设计。
AI.method: 将多步CM采样建模为加噪与近似去噪算子的复合；在显式、可验证的稳定性假设下推导非渐近误差界，分离初始化误差的收缩项与近似误差的累积项；对强对数凹和半对数凹目标给出显式常数；并建立以单步精度和稳定性为假设的互补保证，其假设可在训练模型上估计。
AI.result: 实验表明误差界中涉及的收缩轮廓与近似轮廓可被可靠测量，并与理论预测的函数形式高度吻合；误差界明确了噪声调度的作用——早期大噪声水平驱动收缩，后期小噪声水平控制残余偏差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多步一致性模型提供了有意义的收敛理论，并给出了一条实用的采样器设计路径。

title: CLIMB: Confidence-Guided Complementary Evidence for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong visual reasoning abilities, but knowledge-intensive visual question answering often requires external textual evidence beyond the image and the model's parametric knowledge. Existing multimodal RAG systems commonly rely on Top-$K$ retrieval or reranking, which may return redundant passages and provide limited control over whether an answer update is sufficiently supported by the retrieved evidence. We propose \textit{CLIMB}, a training-free inference-time framework for multimodal RAG. CLIMB first constructs a compact complementary evidence pool using an MMR-style objective that balances query relevance and passage-level redundancy. It then performs confidence-controlled refinement within this fixed pool: an R/E/C critic scores passages by relevance, evidence specificity, and cross-modal alignment, while an evidence-grounded confidence estimator accepts an updated answer only when the estimated confidence increases. This design provides a simple stopping criterion and reduces unnecessary refinement without modifying the underlying retriever or MLLM. Experiments on Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek show that CLIMB consistently improves over retrieval-augmented multimodal baselines. Ablations further indicate that complementary pooling, critic-based scoring, and iterative confidence-controlled refinement each contribute to the final performance.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的多模态RAG推理框架CLIMB，通过互补证据池构建与置信度控制的迭代精炼提升知识密集型视觉问答性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在知识密集型视觉问答中常需图像与参数知识之外的文本证据。现有多模态RAG多依赖Top-K检索或重排序，易返回冗余段落，且对"答案更新是否被证据充分支持"缺乏控制。
AI.method: CLIMB为免训练推理时框架：先用MMR式目标构建紧凑互补证据池，平衡查询相关性与段落级冗余；再在固定池内做置信度控制的精炼，由R/E/C critic从相关性、证据特异性、跨模态对齐打分，证据锚定的置信度估计器仅在估计置信度提升时接受更新答案，从而提供简单停止准则，且不修改检索器与MLLM。
AI.result: 在Encyclopedic-VQA与InfoSeek上，CLIMB稳定优于检索增强的多模态基线；消融实验表明互补池化、critic打分与迭代置信度控制精炼均对最终性能有贡献。
AI.conclusion: CLIMB以免训练、即插即用的方式改善了多模态RAG的证据选择与答案更新机制，验证了互补证据池与置信度控制精炼的有效性。

title: OuroReward: Sequential Reward Scheduling for Reinforcement Learning in Text-to-3D Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for Text-to-3D (T23D) generation requires optimization across multiple quality dimensions such as semantic alignment and texture clarity. Existing methods typically optimize these dimensions simultaneously through multiple reward aggregation, without explicitly modeling inter-dimension dependencies. This can cause imbalanced optimization and persistent interference among conflicting dimensions. To address this limitation, we propose OuroReward, an interference-aware sequential reward scheduling strategy for T23D RL. OuroReward first estimates pairwise dependencies among dimensions and constructs a cyclic optimization path that minimizes cumulative interference. By incorporating the tail-to-head dependency, the cycle captures global compatibility across the entire schedule. Then, OuroReward converts the cycle into a one-pass sequence, and starts optimization from the dimension with the lowest aggregate interference. Rather than assigning a fixed optimization budget to each dimension-wise reward, training adaptively determines when to advance to the next reward according to the remaining optimization headroom of the current one. We further introduce AdaSelect, an adaptive prompt selection strategy that identifies reliable and informative prompts aligned with the model's current capability. By focusing policy updates on these prompts, AdaSelect effectively improves training stability. Extensive experiments across different T23D models and RL algorithms demonstrate that our framework consistently improves generation quality across multiple dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OuroReward，一种干扰感知的序列化奖励调度策略，用于 Text-to-3D 强化学习。它通过估计维度间成对依赖构建干扰最小的循环优化路径，并转化为单程优化序列，配合 AdaSelect 自适应提示选择，提升生成质量与训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有 T23D 强化学习方法通常将语义对齐、纹理清晰度等多个质量维度通过多奖励聚合同时优化，未显式建模维度间依赖关系，导致优化不均衡以及冲突维度间的持续干扰。
AI.method: 1) OuroReward：估计各维度成对依赖，构建累积干扰最小的循环优化路径，并引入尾到头依赖以捕捉全局兼容性；2) 将循环转换为单程序列，从聚合干扰最低的维度开始优化；3) 不设定固定优化预算，而是根据当前奖励的剩余优化空间自适应决定何时切换到下一奖励；4) AdaSelect：自适应提示选择策略，识别与模型当前能力相符的可靠且信息量大的提示，聚焦策略更新以提升训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在不同 T23D 模型和 RL 算法上的大量实验表明，该框架在多个维度上持续提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模并调度维度间依赖关系，取代同时对多奖励的聚合优化，可有效缓解维度间干扰与优化失衡；结合自适应提示选择，该框架在多种模型与算法上具备一致的有效性。

title: The Shape of Speech: A Geometric Measure of Coarticulation for Speech-Driven 3D Facial Animation
summary: Speech-driven 3D facial animation can reproduce recognizable mouth poses. However, it can simplify the motion between them, and that motion carries coarticulation, the way the sounds around each sound shape its articulation. We introduce a geometric measure of this trajectory shaping: lip-path length compared with the shortest route through the vowel, consonant and vowel positions of a speech segment. In contrast to the endpoint chord, this consonant-aware route accounts for obligatory transit and avoids degeneracy, while preserving invariance to uniform motion gain. The measure needs only a forced alignment, so it applies where no ground truth exists. We demonstrate it on four state-of-the-art methods, one per architectural family, real-time and offline. All four trace flatter lip trajectories than captured speech. Against frame-rate-matched ground truth, DiffPoseTalk, ARTalk and FaceFormer show clear deficits, equivalent on this measure to removing 15-60% of real speech's fast articulatory component. CodeTalker is marginal on the primary measure and clear on a companion measure. A pre-registered study with 97 viewers and 3,523 judgments underpins the measured direction: controlled damping of real motion lowers the score and is penalized, whereas exaggeration shows no detected penalty over the tested range. Viewers also prefer real speech in 73.4% of sentence comparisons and, in the aggregate, on single words. Together, the measure, its calibration and the study identify a perceptually relevant loss of trajectory shaping and a concrete target for improving synthesized articulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅依赖强制对齐的几何度量（唇部路径长度对比经过V-C-V位置的几何最短路径），用于衡量语音驱动3D面部动画中协同发音导致的轨迹弯曲程度。在四种SOTA方法上验证发现，生成动画的唇部轨迹普遍比真实语音更"平直"，并通过预注册感知实验证明该度量与人类偏好相关。
AI.motivation: 语音驱动3D面部动画虽能生成可识别的口型，但往往简化了口型之间的过渡运动，而这种过渡恰恰承载了协同发音（coarticulation）——相邻音素如何塑造当前音素的发音。现有评估缺乏对"轨迹形状"的几何刻画，且许多场景下没有真值可供参考，因此需要一个无需真值、对运动速率不变、且能避免退化（如仅用端点弦）的度量来捕捉这一损失。
AI.method: 提出一种几何度量：将某语音段的唇部运动路径长度，与穿过该段中元音、辅音、元音（V-C-V）位置的几何最短路径（即考虑辅音的"必经路线"）进行比较。该度量基于该辅音感知路径而非仅端点弦，从而纳入必要的过渡、避免退化，并保持对整体运动增益（uniform motion gain）的不变性。度量仅需强制对齐（forced alignment），因此适用于无真值场景。作者在四种代表性架构（含实时与离线）的SOTA方法上进行评估，并与帧率匹配的真值对比；同时开展预注册的感知研究（97名被试、3523条判断），通过对真实运动的受控阻尼与夸张化来检验度量的感知相关性。
AI.result: 四种方法的唇部轨迹均比真实语音更"平直"。以帧率匹配的真值为参照，DiffPoseTalk、ARTalk和FaceFormer在该度量上表现出明显不足，相当于去除了真实语音快速发音成分的15–60%；CodeTalker在主度量上处于边缘水平，但在配套度量上表现明显。感知研究支持度量所指方向：对真实运动的受控阻尼会降低得分并受到惩罚，而夸张化在测试范围内未检测到惩罚。观众在73.4%的句子对比中更偏好真实语音，在词级别总体上亦然。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一个几何度量及其标定方法，并结合感知研究，识别出合成动画中一种与感知相关的轨迹形状损失，为改进合成发音提供了一个具体、可量化的优化目标。

title: Depth Hypothesis Guided Iterative Refinement for Event-Image Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Event cameras hold excellent dynamic properties, showing great potential for monocular depth estimation (MDE). However, existing methods mainly improve performance by optimizing contextual features, but still struggle with the ill-posed and nonlinear nature of direct full-depth regression. In this paper, we propose HypoDepth, the first event-image monocular depth iterative refinement framework. By introducing a discrete Depth Hypothesis Volume (DHV), we transform the depth regression problem into a constrained depth search task. Specifically, we construct a 3D cost volume between the DHV features and contextual features and perform a multi-scale correlation search to guide stable residual optimization. This lightweight cost volume enables efficient global-to-local refinement across multi-resolution. Our method outperforms existing approaches on DSEC and MVSEC with state-of-the-art results and strong zero-shot generalization. Meanwhile, our tiny model achieves an excellent balance between accuracy and efficiency, enabling real-time performance on resource-limited devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HypoDepth，首个事件图像单目深度迭代细化框架，通过离散深度假设体（DHV）将深度回归转化为受约束的深度搜索，在 DSEC 和 MVSEC 上取得 SOTA 并具备强零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有事件相机单目深度估计方法主要通过优化上下文特征提升性能，但仍难以应对直接全深度回归的病态性与非线性问题。
AI.method: 引入离散深度假设体（DHV），将深度回归问题转化为受约束的深度搜索任务；构建 DHV 特征与上下文特征之间的三维代价体，并进行多尺度相关性搜索以引导稳定的残差优化；该轻量代价体支持多分辨率下的高效全局到局部细化。
AI.result: 在 DSEC 和 MVSEC 数据集上优于现有方法，取得 SOTA 结果并具有强零样本泛化能力；tiny 模型在精度与效率间取得良好平衡，可在资源受限设备上实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 通过将深度回归重构为基于深度假设体的迭代搜索与细化，HypoDepth 有效缓解了全深度回归的病态性问题，同时兼顾精度、泛化性与实时效率。

title: ChromaGS: Text-Driven Semantic Editing of 4D Gaussian Avatars
summary: We present ChromaGS, a method for real-time, language-guided color editing of animatable 3D Gaussian head avatars. Given a trained animatable avatar, users can instantly modify the color of semantic regions through natural language, with edits applied at render time and no retraining required. Our key insight is to augment each Gaussian primitive with learned soft assignments to semantic regions and decompose colors into region-level base colors and Gaussian-level residuals. This decomposition enables coherent color transfer: modifying a region's base color propagates naturally through all associated Gaussians while preserving fine appearance details encoded in residuals. A two-stage language pipeline translates text instructions into target colors, supporting both absolute specifications and relative adjustments. Unlike generative editing methods that may introduce unintended modifications, our approach provides deterministic, precisely localized semantic control. Experiments demonstrate faithful appearance preservation and intuitive interaction across diverse subjects. Project page and code are available at: https://a-canela.github.io/chromags/

AI.tldr: ChromaGS实现实时语言引导的可动画3D高斯头部头像颜色编辑，无需重训练，通过语义区域软分配与颜色分解实现精确局部编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有可动画3D高斯头像编辑多依赖生成式方法，可能引入非预期的外观改动，缺乏精确、可控的语义局部编辑能力；同时实时性与免训练需求未被很好满足。
AI.method: 为每个高斯图元学习对语义区域的软分配，并将颜色分解为区域级基色与高斯级残差；编辑区域基色即可在相关高斯间一致传播，同时由残差保留细节。采用两阶段语言管线将文本指令解析为目标颜色，支持绝对指定与相对调整，编辑在渲染时完成。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能在多种主体上忠实保持原始外观，交互直观，并实现确定性的、精确定位的语义颜色编辑，优于可能产生非预期修改的生成式编辑方法。
AI.conclusion: ChromaGS实现了免训练、实时、语言引导的语义颜色编辑，兼顾外观保真与语义可控性，适用于多样化可动画3D高斯头部头像。项目页面与代码已公开。

title: Corrupted but Correct: Why Vision-Language Models Lie to Themselves Internally
comment: Accepted at the VLM4RWD Workshop (Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment), NeurIPS 2026. 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: A targeted adversarial perturbation can drive a vision-language model's (VLM's) teacher-forced training loss for a fixed target caption to near zero, yet the same model, allowed to generate freely, produces the original, correct description with no trace of the target. We call this dissociation the train/inference gap, and give it a precise mechanistic account on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct using a controlled two-stage PGD attack on 200 held-out COCO images. First, we show that image-level pixel statistics, including a correctly re-implemented, texture-based attackability measure from the CNN robustness literature, have essentially no predictive power over which images are corrupted (best predictor r=-0.050, p=0.484; ridge regression R^2=0.069). Second, using the logit lens, we localise the gap to a single autoregressive step: the rank of the target token, conditioned on the correct first token already being generated, is fixed at exactly 3,488 out of 152,064 vocabulary entries for every image and every condition, with zero variance. Third, tracking target-token rank across all 28 LLM decoder layers reveals that the visual encoder corrupts every image's representation by a comparable margin regardless of eventual outcome, but the language model decoder then differentially arbitrates: amplifying the corrupted signal for susceptible images and actively suppressing it, past its clean-image baseline, for resistant ones (p<0.001, rank-biserial r=0.579). A linear probe on the merger hidden state separates these two outcomes with AUC=0.858, though we flag a circularity concern in this estimate. Together these results argue that adversarial robustness in autoregressive VLMs is substantially a property of the language decoder's prior, not the visual encoder, with direct implications for where faithfulness evaluations and defenses for deployed VLM systems should be targeted.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VLM存在"训练/推理鸿沟"：在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上通过受控两阶段PGD攻击发现，即使teacher-forcing损失被压至近零，自由生成仍输出正确描述；机制上该鸿沟定位于单步自回归位置，且鲁棒性主要由语言解码器先验而非视觉编码器决定。
AI.motivation: 针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）中对抗扰动可使teacher-forced训练损失趋近于零、但自由生成仍输出原始正确描述这一反常现象，作者试图精确刻画该"训练/推理鸿沟"的机制，并厘清鲁棒性究竟源自视觉编码器还是语言解码器，从而指导忠实性评估与防御的定位。
AI.method: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上，对200张留出COCO图像实施受控两阶段PGD攻击；检验图像级像素统计（含重新实现的CNN鲁棒性文献中基于纹理的可攻击性度量）的预测力；使用logit lens定位鸿沟所在的自回归步；跨全部28个LLM解码器层追踪目标token排名；并对merger隐状态做线性探针分类。
AI.result: （1）图像级像素统计预测力几乎为零（最佳预测因子r=-0.050, p=0.484；岭回归R^2=0.069）；（2）logit lens将鸿沟定位到单一步骤：在正确首token已生成条件下，目标token排名恒为152,064词表中的第3,488位，零方差；（3）跨28层追踪显示视觉编码器对各图像的污染幅度相当，而语言解码器差异调节：对易感图像放大污染信号，对抵抗图像主动抑制至低于干净基线（p<0.001, rank-biserial r=0.579）；（4）merger隐状态线性探针以AUC=0.858区分两种结果，但作者指出存在循环性隐忧。
AI.conclusion: 自回归VLM的对抗鲁棒性在很大程度上是语言解码器先验的属性，而非视觉编码器的属性，这直接指明了部署VLM系统的忠实性评估与防御应聚焦的目标位置。

title: Passing the Test You Trained On: Re-evaluating Prompt-Injection Detectors for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly screen tool outputs with small prompt-injection detectors, and teams choose among detectors by their scores on public benchmarks. We ask whether those scores predict how a detector behaves inside an agent. We replay the ground-truth tool calls of two agent benchmarks, AgentDojo and tau-bench, without an LLM to obtain tool outputs that are benign by construction, label injected outputs by differential replay, and evaluate fifteen detectors, including Meta's Prompt Guard 2, and two task-aware LLM judges on these outputs and on the BIPIA benchmark. Detection rankings transfer poorly between benchmarks: the best detector on BIPIA catches 2% of AgentDojo injections at a 1% false-positive rate, and a detector that catches 72% of AgentDojo injections catches 15% on tau-bench. False-positive rates on tool outputs, which range from none to over 90%, do transfer between the two agent benchmarks. Where training data is public, the form of the training inputs explains the results. The BIPIA leader was trained on full BIPIA inputs, but having seen InjecAgent's attack strings as short prompts does not help it find them inside tool outputs; the best detector on both agent benchmarks shares no data with any benchmark and was trained on agent-style inputs. Evaluations meant to inform deployment should use the agent's own tool outputs, report detection at a low false-positive rate, and audit what the detector was trained on.

AI.tldr: 公开基准分数难以预测提示注入检测器在真实智能体中的表现：跨基准检测排名迁移性差，但工具输出上的误报率可迁移；训练输入形式是主因；评估应使用智能体自身工具输出、低误报率并审计训练数据。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体日益使用小型提示注入检测器筛查工具输出，团队通常依据公开基准分数来选择检测器。本文质疑这些分数能否预测检测器在智能体内部的实际行为，即基准排名是否具备部署指导意义。
AI.method: 无 LLM 重放 AgentDojo 与 tau-bench 的真实工具调用，得到天然良性工具输出；通过差分重放标注注入输出；在工具输出与 BIPIA 上评估 15 个检测器（含 Meta Prompt Guard 2）及 2 个任务感知 LLM 裁判；并针对训练数据公开的检测器分析训练输入形式的影响。
AI.result: 检测排名跨基准迁移性差：BIPIA 最佳检测器在 1% 误报率下仅捕获 2% 的 AgentDojo 注入；能捕获 72% AgentDojo 注入的检测器在 tau-bench 上仅 15%。工具输出误报率（从 0 到超 90%）在两者间可迁移。BIPIA 冠军因训练于完整 BIPIA 输入，未见过 InjecAgent 攻击串作为短提示的情形；在两个智能体基准上均最佳的检测器与任何基准无数据交集，训练于智能体风格输入。
AI.conclusion: 面向部署的评估应使用智能体自身工具输出、在低误报率下报告检测性能，并审计检测器的训练数据，而非依赖公开基准分数。

title: I2CD: Direct Image-to-Convex Decomposition for Simulation-Ready Collision Geometry
summary: Physics simulators and motion planners require convex collision geometry, yet image-to-3D generative models output dense, frequently non-manifold visual meshes. Bridging the two today takes a slow, brittle reconstruct-then-decompose pipeline of repair, decimation, and approximate convex decomposition. We present I2CD, which predicts a convex decomposition directly from a single RGB image. Rather than train a new image-to-3D model, I2CD freezes the pretrained Hunyuan3D-2 image-conditioned diffusion transformer and shape decoder and trains only a lightweight cross-attention head (38M parameters, under ten GPU-hours) whose learned "convex-slot" tokens emit the halfplane parameters of $K$ convex polytopes. The output is compact, convex by construction, and loads into physics engines without any post-processing, in ${\sim}0.5$s per image. On $227$ held-out OmniObject3D and Google Scanned Objects instances, I2CD attains the highest volumetric IoU among eight reconstruct-then-decompose pipelines while running $6$-$37\times$ faster end-to-end. In a cross-simulator study in MuJoCo, PyBullet, Genesis, and Isaac Sim, every engine uses I2CD geometry as delivered, whereas raw generated meshes "load" everywhere but are silently replaced by a different collision shape in most cases or need seconds to minutes of per-object preprocessing. On a physical xArm7, I2CD produces planner-ready geometry for a $20$-object cluttered scene in $11$s versus $328$s for the strongest baseline, at comparable pick-and-place execution success ($85$ vs. $90$ of $100$ trials).

AI.tldr: I2CD 通过冻结预训练的 Hunyuan3D-2 并仅训练一个 38M 参数的跨注意力头部，直接从单张 RGB 图像预测凸分解，输出可直接用于物理引擎的凸多面体，速度与体积 IoU 均优于现有"重建-再分解"流水线。
AI.motivation: 物理仿真器与运动规划器需要凸碰撞几何，而图像到 3D 的生成模型输出的是稠密、常非流形的视觉网格。现有弥合方式依赖"先重建、再分解"的流水线，包含修复、简化与近似凸分解，速度慢且脆弱。
AI.method: I2CD 不训练新的图像到 3D 模型，而是冻结预训练的 Hunyuan3D-2 图像条件扩散 Transformer 与形状解码器，仅训练一个轻量跨注意力头部（38M 参数，少于十个 GPU 小时）。其学习到的"凸槽"（convex-slot）token 输出 K 个凸多面体的半平面参数，使输出天然紧凑且构造上即为凸。
AI.result: 在 227 个留出的 OmniObject3D 与 Google Scanned Objects 实例上，I2CD 在八条"重建-再分解"流水线中取得最高体积 IoU，同时端到端快 6–37 倍，每张图约 0.5 秒。在 MuJoCo、PyBullet、Genesis 和 Isaac Sim 的跨仿真器研究中，各引擎可直接使用 I2CD 几何，而原始生成网格虽能"加载"却多数被静默替换为其他碰撞形状，或需数秒至数分钟的逐对象预处理。在物理 xArm7 上，I2CD 为 20 个物体的杂乱场景在 11 秒内生成可规划几何（最强基线为 328 秒），抓放执行成功率相当（85/100 对 90/100）。
AI.conclusion: I2CD 表明，冻结大型图像到 3D 生成模型并仅学习一个轻量凸分解头部，即可直接从单图输出免后处理、可直接用于物理引擎的凸几何，在精度、速度与跨仿真器可用性上显著优于现有重建-再分解方案，并具备真实机器人规划的实用价值。

title: A Near-Zero Monitor Readout Is Not Evidence of Behavioral Control
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of LLM Post-Training in Changing Environments (FLLMPT)
summary: Post-training with verifiable rewards can induce reward hacking, motivating the use of monitors within the training objective rather than solely for offline auditing. We show that a low monitor readout does not identify whether such an intervention controls behavior. In a code-generation environment whose dominant exploit is available at the start of the reasoning trace, we train policies against three monitors that pass the same offline gate: an in-domain activation probe and two penalties conditioned on how early the policy commits to its own final answer. The probe score is at its numerical floor from the first recorded training step, and the trained-score median is zero for every prefix-trained run at the endpoint. These readouts estimate different quantities, and we do not compare their scales; within each monitor family, however, low values do not establish behavioral control. Within one fixed configuration, prefix-trained runs with the same zero-median trained score range, by seed alone, from a mixed regime with a low hacking share to near-pure reward hacking. All probe runs reach the hacking regime, but their floor-level readout reflects a mismatch between the position where the probe was validated and the position where it was read during training, not a second instance of this ambiguity. Text-level analysis identifies a prefix failure mode: generic planning and filler shells postpone the exploit past the cut without eliminating it from the final output. Low measured commitment therefore does not distinguish a low hacking share from delayed commitment to the exploit. Offline discrimination and low monitor-aligned readouts are insufficient evidence of behavioral control; an out-of-band behavioral check is required. We characterize the endpoint readout, not its evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/zhezhou1106/spoof-cost.

AI.tldr: 低监控读数不能证明行为受控：通过前缀训练的三种监控器实验表明，离线判别力与低读数不足以确认对奖励黑客的控制，需借助带外行为检查。
AI.motivation: 研究动机：可验证奖励的后训练可能诱发奖励黑客（reward hacking），因此人们倾向于把监控器纳入训练目标，而非仅用于离线审计。但监控读数低是否等于行为受控尚不清楚，本文对此提出检验。
AI.method: 方法：构建一个代码生成环境，其主要可利用漏洞在推理轨迹开始处即可获得。针对三种均通过相同离线门槛的监控器训练策略：一个域内激活探针，以及两个以策略多早承诺自身最终答案为条件的惩罚项。记录训练全程得分，并按前缀/种子划分训练运行，结合文本级分析定位失败模式。
AI.result: 结果：探针得分从首个记录训练步起即处于数值下限；所有前缀训练运行在终点处的训练得分中位数均为零，但固定配置下相同零中位的运行仅因随机种子不同，就从低黑客比例的混合状态跨到近乎纯奖励黑客。所有探针运行都进入黑客状态，其下限级读数源于探针验证位置与训练读取位置错配，而非第二种歧义。文本分析发现前缀失败模式：通用规划与填充外壳把漏洞利用推迟到截断之后，却未从最终输出中消除。
AI.conclusion: 结论：低测量承诺无法区分低黑客比例与对利用的延迟承诺；离线判别力与监控对齐的低读数不足以作为行为受控的证据，必须进行带外行为检查。本文刻画的是终点读数，而非其演化过程。

title: SYNLAT: Syntax-Aligned Text-Latent Compression for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) traces impose substantial output-token costs. Under constrained budgets, compression must preserve answer-critical information, making boundary placement central. Token-level and fixed-length boundaries can fragment coherent spans such as phrases, formulas, and local derivations, whereas step-level boundaries can bind content requiring different compression actions. We introduce SynLat, a text-latent CoT framework that aligns compression boundaries with syntactic structure through non-overlapping Syntax-Aligned Units (SAUs). An answer-conditioned Teacher constructs progressive KEEP/LATENT targets for a single compression-conditioned Student, which generates mixed reasoning from only the question and requested compression level at inference. Across two Qwen3 Student scales, Standard-CoT and Long-CoT groups, and three compression levels, SynLat matches or exceeds the strongest evaluated baseline in all 12 task-group aggregates and strictly leads in 11 under the reported achieved-CR selection protocol. Overall gains reach 3.6/2.6 points at MEDIUM and 7.0/5.5 points at HIGH for Qwen3-8B/14B, with larger advantages under stronger compression, particularly on Long-CoT groups.

AI.tldr: SynLat 通过语法对齐单元（SAU）将压缩边界与句法结构对齐，缓解长链思维（CoT）token 成本高的问题。它用答案条件化的 Teacher 生成渐进式 KEEP/LATENT 目标训练单一压缩条件 Student。在 Qwen3-8B/14B 上，12 个任务-组聚合中 11 个严格领先，压缩越强优势越明显。
AI.motivation: 长链 CoT 轨迹带来显著的输出 token 成本，在预算受限时压缩必须保留对答案关键的信息，因此压缩边界位置至关重要。现有 token 级与固定长度边界会割裂短语、公式、局部推导等连贯片段，而 step 级边界又会把需要不同压缩动作的内容绑在一起。
AI.method: 提出 SynLat，一种文本-潜变量 CoT 框架，用不重叠的语法对齐单元（Syntax-Aligned Units, SAUs）把压缩边界对齐到句法结构。由答案条件化的 Teacher 为单一压缩条件 Student 构建渐进式 KEEP/LATENT 目标；推理时 Student 仅根据问题和请求的压缩等级生成混合推理。
AI.result: 在两个 Qwen3 Student 规模、Standard-CoT 与 Long-CoT 两组以及三个压缩等级下，SynLat 在全部 12 个任务-组聚合中达到或超过最强基线，在报告的 achieved-CR 选择协议下 11 个严格领先。整体增益在 MEDIUM 下为 3.6/2.6 分，在 HIGH 下为 7.0/5.5 分（Qwen3-8B/14B），压缩更强时优势更大，Long-CoT 组尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 将压缩边界与句法结构对齐可有效实现 CoT 压缩，在保持答案关键信息的同时显著降低 token 成本，且在高压缩率下相对基线优势更突出。

title: Preserving Anatomical Continuity: Three-Stage Pipeline for Colon Segmentation in 3D Abdominal CT Scans
summary: Accurate colon segmentation from CT images is essential for colorectal disease analysis, yet deep learning based methods often produce disconnected predictions due to complex anatomy. This study introduces a three-stage, topology-preserving segmentation pipeline to address this issue. The first stage performs initial deep learning-based segmentation, followed by centreline bridging to reconnect disjoint regions and a reconstruction stage to refine continuity. Evaluations on TotalSegmentator and RAOS datasets using overlap, distance and topology-based metrics demonstrate improved structural consistency while maintaining segmentation accuracy. The proposed method enhances topological integrity, enabling more reliable colon segmentation for clinical and research applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种三阶段、保持拓扑的结肠分割流程，通过中心线桥接与重建修复深度学习分割产生的断裂预测，在TotalSegmentator和RAOS数据集上提升了结构连续性并保持精度。
AI.motivation: 基于深度学习的结肠CT分割常因解剖结构复杂而产生不连通的预测结果，破坏拓扑完整性，影响结直肠疾病的临床分析与研究可靠性。
AI.method: 三阶段流程：第一阶段用深度学习进行初始分割；第二阶段通过中心线桥接重新连接不连通区域；第三阶段进行重建以细化连续性，实现拓扑保持的分割。
AI.result: 在TotalSegmentator和RAOS数据集上，采用重叠度、距离和拓扑类指标评估，结果显示结构一致性提升，同时分割精度得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 该方法增强了拓扑完整性，可实现更可靠的结肠分割，适用于临床与研究应用。

title: A Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based Pipeline for End-to-End Procedural Modeling of Field-Grown Maize from Point Clouds
summary: Editable 3D models of field-grown crops support high-throughput phenotyping and in silico breeding trials, but building them from scanned point clouds requires organ-level segmentation and fitting. Procedural generators can turn an organ-level parameter set into an analysis-suitable 3D model, but obtaining that set requires hours of manual tuning per plant or segmentation models trained on species-specific labels. We present an automated pipeline that reconstructs procedural maize models from raw 3D point clouds without manual tuning or species-specific training data. A multimodal vision-language model (VLM) annotates leaf midlines in rendered orthographic views. Deterministic geometric algorithms back-project the annotations onto the point cloud, merge them into 3D leaves by cross-view consensus, and grow the midlines to full blades on an orientation-weighted surface graph. Measured organ parameters populate a plant descriptor for a Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS)-based procedural model generator. Each leaf surface is then refined against its scan points by differentiable NURBS fitting. The pipeline reached a median whole-plant Chamfer distance of 5.4 mm on 100 genotypically diverse field-grown maize plants from the MaizeField3D dataset. The reconstructions were closer to the scans than those of an earlier semi-automated pipeline based on manual annotations. The pipeline recovered 1,017 of 1,023 (99.4%) curated reference leaves at an intersection-over-union of at least 0.5 without using those labels as input. These results show that VLM annotations become usable organ-level measurements when downstream geometric stages can correct them. This makes automated generation of editable 3D plant assets feasible at the scale of modern phenotyping experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出一条自动化流水线，可从原始3D点云重建程序化玉米模型，无需人工调参或物种专用训练标签：用多模态视觉语言模型标注正交视图中的叶中线，再以确定性几何算法反投影、跨视图共识合并为3D叶片并生长为完整叶面，提取器官参数驱动NURBS程序化生成器，最后用可微NURBS拟合精化。在MaizeField3D的100株田间玉米上全株Chamfer距离中位数5.4 mm，优于此前基于人工标注的半自动流水线，并在不使用标签的前提下以IoU≥0.5恢复1017/1023（99.4%）参考叶。
AI.motivation: 田间作物的可编辑3D模型对高通量表型与计算机育种试验很有价值，但从扫描点云构建需进行器官级分割与拟合。程序化生成器能把器官级参数集转为可分析模型，然而获得该参数集需每株数小时人工调参，或依赖物种专用标签训练的分割模型，规模化代价高。
AI.method: 1) 多模态视觉语言模型（VLM）在渲染的正交视图中标注叶中线；2) 确定性几何算法将标注反投影到点云，通过跨视图共识合并为3D叶片，并在方向加权表面图上将叶中线生长为完整叶面；3) 由实测器官参数填充植株描述符，驱动基于NURBS的程序化模型生成器；4) 用可微NURBS拟合将每片叶面相对其扫描点精化。
AI.result: 在MaizeField3D数据集100株基因型多样的田间玉米上，全株Chamfer距离中位数为5.4 mm，重建结果比基于人工标注的早期半自动流水线更贴近扫描点；在不将标签作为输入的情况下，以IoU≥0.5恢复1017/1023（99.4%）的精选参考叶。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当下游几何阶段能够纠正VLM标注时，VLM标注可转化为可用的器官级测量值，使可编辑3D植株资产的自动化生成在现代表型实验规模上变得可行。

title: UniDynamics: Event-RGB Fusion for Unified Future 4D Dynamic Scene Generation
summary: We propose UniDynamics, a diffusion-based framework for future 4D dynamic scenes (RGB, depth, and optical flow) generation from a single event-RGB pair, without requiring long histories or control priors as in existing methods, while explicitly modeling future motion fields. The core idea is to leverage event streams to offer an alternative motion prior for single-RGB extrapolation, and to enforce geometric and motion constraints throughout generation via multimodal modeling. Specifically, we design an Event Latent Enhancement (ELE) module to align and enhance event latents into diffusion-injectable conditioning features, providing robust initial motion priors and reliable texture/structure cues. We further introduce a Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS) embedded in the multi-scale U-Net, which decouples and adaptively interacts depth and flow while continuously feeding back constraints to appearance features, improving geometric-motion consistency for physically plausible and spatiotemporally coherent prediction. Experiments on VKitti2 and DSEC demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, producing high-quality, temporally coherent, and 4D-consistent future predictions, especially under challenging high-speed motion blur.

AI.tldr: UniDynamics提出一个基于扩散的框架，仅用单对事件-RGB输入即可生成未来4D动态场景（RGB、深度、光流），无需长历史或控制先验，并显式建模未来运动场。
AI.motivation: 现有方法生成未来4D动态场景通常依赖长历史序列或控制先验，且未显式建模未来运动场，在高速运动模糊等挑战场景下表现受限。
AI.method: 核心思路是利用事件流为单RGB外推提供运动先验，并通过多模态建模在生成过程中施加几何与运动约束。具体设计两个模块：事件潜变量增强（ELE）模块，将事件潜变量对齐并增强为可注入扩散模型的条件特征，提供稳定的初始运动先验与纹理/结构线索；感知动态空间（PDS），嵌入多尺度U-Net，解耦并自适应交互深度与光流，同时持续向外观特征反馈约束。
AI.result: 在VKitti2和DSEC数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能，生成高质量、时间一致且4D一致的未来预测，尤其在高速度运动模糊条件下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: UniDynamics验证了以事件流作为运动先验并结合多模态约束的扩散框架，可有效实现从单事件-RGB对出发的未来4D动态场景生成。

title: Fed-ADApt: Federated Anytime Depth Adaptation for Resource-Aware Medical Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted to The 4th International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2026)
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training of medical image segmentation models without sharing raw patient data, yet existing approaches assume a homogeneous compute budget across institutions, limiting participation of low-resource sites. We propose Fed-ADApt, a depth-adaptive federated framework for UNet-based segmentation that jointly addresses low-compute training and inference. Fed-ADApt integrates multi-depth supervision with hierarchical depth-wise aggregation, allowing each site to train according to its local compute budget while contributing to a global model that supports dynamic depth selection at deployment. We evaluated Fed-ADApt on multi-site 2D retinal fundus disc segmentation and 3D brain tumor segmentation. Across both tasks, federated collaboration substantially improves robustness under domain shift. Fed-ADApt matched the full-resource FedAvg performance in 3D and achieved competitive 2D performance with a 4.7% average Dice reduction, while reducing average inference cost by 19.5% in 3D and 34.5% in 2D and substantially reducing training cost by 98% at the most constrained sites. Importantly, Fed-ADApt enables low-resource institutions that cannot train full-capacity models to participate in federations while maintaining competitive global performance under a favorable accuracy to efficiency trade-off. By considering training and inference compute budgets, Fed-ADApt provides a practical and equitable solution for federated medical image segmentation across heterogeneous clinical and edge-enabled imaging environments.

AI.tldr: 提出深度自适应联邦框架Fed-ADApt，使低算力机构可参与医学图像分割联邦训练并支持动态深度推理。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦学习方法假设各机构算力预算同构，限制了低资源站点的参与，需同时解决训练与推理的低算力问题。
AI.method: 基于UNet分割模型，将多深度监督与分层深度聚合相结合，各站点按本地算力预算训练，汇聚为支持部署时动态深度选择的全局模型。
AI.result: 在2D视网膜眼底视盘分割与3D脑肿瘤分割上评测：联邦协作显著提升域偏移下的鲁棒性；3D任务达到与全资源FedAvg相当的性能，2D任务Dice平均下降4.7%；平均推理开销3D降低19.5%、2D降低34.5%，最受限站点训练开销降低约98%。
AI.conclusion: Fed-ADApt兼顾训练与推理算力预算，使低资源机构以competitive的全局性能和良好的精度-效率权衡参与联邦，为异构临床与边缘影像环境提供实用且公平的联邦医学图像分割方案。

title: Single-Pass Uncertainty Heads for Claim-Level Hallucination Detection in Persian Medical Language Models
summary: Hallucination detection is particularly important for medical language models, but repeated-sampling approaches are computationally expensive. A faster alternative is a single-pass uncertainty head that predicts hallucination risk from a frozen generator's internal signals. Existing uncertainty heads consume backbone-specific features and tokenization, motivating adaptation when the backbone or language changes. We study two Persian medical models, Gaokerena-V and Gaokerena-R, on a 168-question Iranian medical entrance examination. Across five generations per question, Gaokerena-V produces the same option on only 14 questions and Gaokerena-R on 37, compared with 168 for Med-Gemma, indicating substantial response variability in the Gaokerena models. We therefore adapt the LLM Uncertainty Head (LUH) framework to these models and construct two paired claim-level hallucination datasets directly in Persian, with 1,600 responses per backbone. Lightweight heads are trained on frozen-backbone attention maps and token probabilities. On held-out test splits, the heads achieve PR-AUCs of 0.4820 and 0.4652, corresponding to 2.30 and 2.66 times their respective random baselines, and ROC-AUCs of 0.7852 and 0.7810. The resulting detectors require neither retrieval nor repeated sampling at inference.

AI.tldr: 该研究将单次前向的LLM Uncertainty Head框架适配到两个波斯语医学模型(Gaokerena-V与Gaokerena-R),在波斯语构建配对claim级幻觉数据集,用冻结主干注意力图与token概率训练轻量检测头,取得PR-AUC约0.47–0.48、ROC-AUC约0.78的表现。
AI.motivation: 医学语言模型的幻觉检测至关重要,但重复采样方法计算代价高。单次前向的不确定性头是更快的替代方案,然而现有头部依赖特定主干的特征与分词方式,当主干或语言改变时需要适配,因此作者针对波斯语医学模型开展适配研究。
AI.method: 在一套168题的波斯语医学入学考试上评测Gaokerena-V与Gaokerena-R两个模型,每题生成五次。将LLM Uncertainty Head框架适配到这两个模型,直接用波斯语构建两个成对的claim级幻觉数据集,每个主干1,600条响应;在冻结主干的注意力图与token概率上训练轻量检测头。
AI.result: Gaokerena-V仅在14题、Gaokerena-R仅在37题上五次生成给出相同选项,而Med-Gemma为168题,说明Gaokerena模型响应变异性较大。在留出测试集上,检测头的PR-AUC为0.4820与0.4652,分别是随机基线的2.30倍与2.66倍,ROC-AUC为0.7852与0.7810。
AI.conclusion: 轻量不确定性头可适配波斯语医学模型,在推理时既不需要检索也不需要重复采样,即可实现有效的claim级幻觉检测。

title: Weave Forcing: Compositional Memory Routing for Interactive Long Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in autoregressive video generation have improved temporal consistency over extended durations, yet interactive storytelling requires more than continuous scene extension: a new shot may combine characters and backgrounds from different historical shots. Whole prompt retrieval can overlook the distinct reference needs of individual components, while directly combining all historical memories may introduce unrelated visual content. To address these problems, we present Weave Forcing, a training-free framework for compositional memory reuse in interactive long video generation. First, we use an LLM for semantic slot routing to decompose user prompts into character and background descriptions and explicitly select suitable historical references for each component. To isolate the required content, masked memory weaving uses contrasting attention maps conditioned on semantic slots to construct refined semantic masks, selectively exposing relevant tokens from compressed historical KV memories to guide the generation of the current shot. We further introduce coverage adaptive RoPE to adjust temporal offsets and memory retention according to no, partial, or full reference coverage, addressing visual artifacts observed when incomplete historical references are positioned close to the current generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Weave Forcing improves cross-shot subject and background consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality and text alignment.

AI.tldr: Weave Forcing 是一个免训练框架，通过语义槽路由、掩码记忆编织和覆盖率自适应 RoPE，实现交互式长视频生成中的组合式记忆复用。
AI.motivation: 交互式叙事需要新镜头组合来自不同历史镜头的角色与背景，而整体提示检索忽略各组件差异化的参考需求，直接拼接全部历史记忆又会引入无关视觉内容。
AI.method: 1) 用 LLM 进行语义槽路由，将用户提示分解为角色与背景描述并分别选择合适的历史参考；2) 掩码记忆编织，基于语义槽条件化对比注意力图构建精细语义掩码，从压缩的历史 KV 记忆中选取相关 token 引导当前镜头生成；3) 覆盖率自适应 RoPE，根据无/部分/全覆盖调整时间偏移与记忆保留。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Weave Forcing 提升了跨镜头主体与背景一致性，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量和文本对齐。
AI.conclusion: 通过组件级记忆检索与复用，可在免训练条件下实现更一致的交互式长视频生成。

title: ProgressNet: Sketching and Prompting with a Frozen Text-to-Image Model
summary: Humans draw progressively: a few strokes, a look at the result, a stroke erased, a prompt revised. Image generators do not work this way. They typically take a finished sketch and produce the image in a single pass, so every edit starts the picture again, and the models that do keep state across turns are driven by text, cannot take a stroke, and are too slow to draw with. We present ProgressNet, a training-free framework that lets a frozen text-to-image model follow a drawing session as it unfolds: strokes are added and erased, the prompt is revised, and the image keeps up at about a second per turn. It needs no new parameters because the frozen model already has what a progressive generator needs, a pathway through which the previous turn can be remembered, layers that can carry appearance forward without freezing structure, and an internal signal of how far to trust an unfinished sketch; three inference-time mechanisms (Previous-Concept Memory, Layer-Selective K/V Injection and Banded Adaptive Control) use each in turn. As a sketch fills in, every existing method degrades, the FID of the FLUX+ControlNet baseline doubling between 10% and 100% completion on FS-COCO, while ProgressNet's barely moves; it maintains strong fidelity and progressive coherence across three sketch domains and is preferred by users over five competitors, most widely on erasure.

AI.tldr: ProgressNet：一个免训练框架，使冻结的文本到图像模型能够跟随绘画过程（增删笔画、修改提示词），以约每秒一轮的速度持续更新图像，无需新增参数。
AI.motivation: 人类绘画是渐进的（加笔画、擦除、修改提示词），而现有图像生成器通常一次性由完整草图生成图像；有状态的多轮模型又由文本驱动、无法接受笔画且速度过慢，难以支持实时绘画会话。
AI.method: 利用冻结模型已有的三种能力——记忆上一轮的路径、在不冻结结构下传递外观的层、以及对未完成草图的信任度内部信号——对应设计三种推理期机制：Previous-Concept Memory（上一概念记忆）、Layer-Selective K/V Injection（层选择性K/V注入）与Banded Adaptive Control（分带自适应控制）。
AI.result: 在FS-COCO上，现有方法随草图完成度提升而退化，FLUX+ControlNet基线的FID在10%到100%完成度间翻倍，而ProgressNet几乎不变；在三个草图域上保持强保真度与渐进一致性，并在与五个竞争方法的用户偏好比较中胜出，在擦除场景优势最明显。
AI.conclusion: 免训练、无需新参数的ProgressNet能够实现渐进式、可交互的草图到图像生成，在保真度、渐进一致性和用户体验上优于现有方法。

title: Learning from Repaired Reasoning: Root-Cause-Guided On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses reference solutions as privileged hindsight to supervise student-generated reasoning trajectories. However, reference-based guidance may explain a correct solution without addressing why the student's own reasoning fails. This reasoning mismatch between the guidance provided and the correction needed can encourage the student to borrow correct conclusions while leaving its reasoning errors unresolved. Moreover, applying the same hindsight throughout the trajectory risks a distillation trap, where unnecessary constraints on valid reasoning compete with correction of substantive errors. To address these issues, we propose Root-Cause-Guided On-Policy Distillation (RC-OPD), which uses repairs of the student's own reasoning to provide guidance that addresses its specific errors while building on valid progress. For each failed attempt, RC-OPD locates the earliest substantive error, develops a local correction, and uses the corrected intermediate result as an anchor for the valid prefix. An iterative diagnosis--repair--continuation process tests the repairs through student continuation, identifying further errors within a fixed repair budget. For repair chains that reach a correct answer, root--cause--guided distillation uses failure diagnoses and corrective goals to supervise the erroneous segments, while anchor-guided distillation supports the corresponding valid prefixes with reasoning chains leading to the repaired intermediate results. We evaluate RC-OPD across multiple datasets and model scales. Extensive experiments and analyses show that it mitigates reasoning mismatch and the distillation trap, yielding substantial performance gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出根因引导的在线策略自蒸馏方法 RC-OPD，利用对学生自身推理的修复而非参考答案作为指导，通过定位最早实质性错误、局部修复并迭代诊断，缓解推理错配与蒸馏陷阱，在多个数据集和模型规模上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）使用参考解答作为特权 hindsight 监督学生的推理轨迹，但参考解答可能只解释了正确解法，而未针对学生自身推理为何失败。这种"指导内容"与"所需纠正"之间的推理错配（reasoning mismatch），会诱导学生借用正确结论却未解决其推理错误。此外，将同一 hindsight 施加于整条轨迹会带来蒸馏陷阱（distillation trap），即对有效推理的多余约束与对实质性错误的纠正相互竞争。
AI.method: 提出 RC-OPD：针对每次失败尝试，定位最早的实质性错误，做局部修正，并将修正后的中间结果作为有效前缀的锚点。采用迭代的"诊断—修复—续写"过程，通过学生续写检验修复效果，在固定修复预算下识别后续错误。对于能够到达正确答案的修复链，根因引导蒸馏利用失败诊断与纠正目标监督错误片段，锚点引导蒸馏则用通向修复中间结果的推理链支持对应的有效前缀。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种模型规模上进行评估，大量实验与分析表明 RC-OPD 能缓解推理错配与蒸馏陷阱，带来显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 以学生自身推理的根因修复替代参考答案作为指导信号，是提升在线策略自蒸馏效果的有效途径，RC-OPD 在抑制无效约束、聚焦实质性错误纠正方面表现优越。

title: XGenAct: Geometry-Enhanced World Action Models through Cross-Task Generation
summary: World action models (WAMs) have advanced robot control by predicting how observations and actions evolve over time. Despite this progress, RGB and action based future prediction does not explicitly address the spatial understanding needed for robot manipulation. Existing efforts often add a limited set of spatial prediction tasks through specialized heads or branches, leaving both the range of spatial supervision and the model architecture fragmented. We introduce XGenAct, a world action model that represents RGB observations, robot actions, metric depth, surface normals, and functional role segmentation as RGB videos through deterministic codecs. By sampling perception and action tasks during training, XGenAct uses one video diffusion transformer and one objective to learn temporal prediction across these spaces without modality specific learned heads. On held out RLBench tasks, structured perception training improves average closed loop success over RGB only training, and XGenAct achieves 52% success in the five task external comparison, versus 26% for the strongest evaluated baselines. It also predicts future depth and segmentation more accurately than the evaluated pipelines that generate RGB first and then apply a frozen perception expert.

AI.tldr: 提出XGenAct世界动作模型，将RGB观测、机器人动作、度量深度、表面法线与功能角色分割通过确定性编解码器统一表示为RGB视频，用单一视频扩散transformer和单一目标学习多空间时序预测。
AI.motivation: 现有基于RGB与动作的未来预测未显式建模机器人操作所需的空间理解；已有方法仅通过专用头或分支添加少量空间预测任务，导致空间监督范围有限、模型架构碎片化。
AI.method: 通过确定性编解码器将RGB观测、机器人动作、度量深度、表面法线及功能角色分割统一编码为RGB视频；训练时对感知与动作任务进行采样，使用单一视频扩散transformer与单一目标函数，在不引入模态专用可学习头的情况下学习跨空间时序预测。
AI.result: 在留出的RLBench任务上，结构化感知训练相比仅RGB训练提升了平均闭环成功率；在五任务外部对比中XGenAct达到52%成功率，最强基线为26%；其预测未来深度与分割的精度也优于"先生成RGB再应用冻结感知专家"的对比流程。
AI.conclusion: 统一的多空间感知-动作联合预测可有效提升机器人操作闭环成功率与未来空间感知预测精度，且无需模态专用头。

title: Feedforward Novel View Synthesis for Heterogeneous Cameras
summary: Feed-forward novel view synthesis has recently shown promising results from sparse posed images, but most existing methods assume that context and target views share a fixed camera family. This homogeneous-camera assumption breaks in practical multi-sensor systems, where perspective, fisheye, and panoramic cameras may coexist and where the target projection may be unseen during training. We study feed-forward NVS across heterogeneous central cameras and identify a key ambiguity introduced by tokenization: a visual token aggregates a projection-dependent bundle of pixel rays, while existing camera encodings mainly expose absolute rays or token-center relations. To address this, we combine token-center relative Camera Positional Encodings and proposed local raymaps, a token-level representation that explicitly describes the intra-patch ray distribution summarized by each token. We further propose projection-aware 2D RoPE, which replaces raw image-grid coordinates with ray-induced angular coordinates so that relative positional reasoning is aligned across camera projections. Together, these components treat diverse cameras as calibrated samplings of a shared ray space rather than separate visual domains. On ScanNet++ with heterogeneous-camera system, our method improves over camera-conditioned baselines under mixed-camera evaluation and demonstrates zero-shot generalization to panoramic views.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究异构中心相机下的前馈新视角合成（NVS），指出tokenization引入的"token聚合投影相关像素光线束"歧义，提出token中心相对相机位置编码、局部raymaps和投影感知2D RoPE，将多种相机视为共享光线空间的校准采样。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈NVS方法多假设上下文与目标视图属于同一相机族（同质相机假设），但在透视、鱼眼、全景相机共存且目标投影在训练中未出现的多传感器系统中该假设失效。同时，tokenization使每个视觉token聚合了投影相关的像素光线束，而现有相机编码仅提供绝对光线或token中心关系，产生表征歧义。
AI.method: 1）结合token中心相对相机位置编码（Camera Positional Encodings）；2）提出局部raymaps（local raymaps），即token级表示，显式描述每个token所汇总的patch内光线分布；3）提出投影感知2D RoPE，用光线诱导的角坐标替代原始图像网格坐标，使相对位置推理在不同相机投影间对齐。
AI.result: 在具有异构相机系统的ScanNet++数据集上，方法在混合相机评测中优于相机条件化基线，并展示出对全景视图的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将多样相机统一建模为共享光线空间的校准采样，而非彼此独立的视觉域，所提组件有效解决了异构中心相机前馈NVS中的tokenization歧义问题，并在混合相机评测与全景视图零样本泛化上取得提升。

title: Structured Composition of Verifiable Atomic Insights for Table-to-Report Generation
summary: Table-to-report generation refers to the task of automatically generating article-level analyt- ical reports from relational tables and is an essential capability for automated data science and decision support. Its central challenge lies in systematically discovering verifiable com- posite insights across tables, attributes, and analytical perspectives, and organizing them into coherent, complete, and traceable evidence chains. Existing methods primarily rely on sequential, reactive data agents or direct Large Language Model(LLM) generation. They suffer from exploration bias: early local observations constrain subsequent actions, causing models to focus prematurely on local analyzes and miss cross-table or cross-dimensional evidence. We propose ComInsight, which reformulates insight discovery as the composition of atomic evidences. We first define an atomic insight as the smallest executable analytical unit conforming to a predefined analysis pattern and enumerate all valid atomic insights from database schema and content. These atoms are then organized into a multi-relational insight graph, where nodes represent verified data facts and edges encode logical, temporal, or hierarchical relations. Finally, a set of composition operators systematically fuses atomic nodes into higher-order composite conclusions. Every composite output is accompanied by executable SQL and fine-grained provenance, ensuring full verifiability. Across three benchmarks InsightBench, DDR-Bench, and T2R-Bench, ComInsight consistently outperforms strong baselines in factual correctness, novelty, and structural completeness. We believe ComInsight offers a reliable, efficient, and explainable path toward table-to-report generation.

AI.tldr: ComInsight将表到报告生成中的洞察发现重构为原子证据的组合：先枚举原子洞察，再构建多关系洞察图，最后通过组合算子融合为可验证的复合结论。
AI.motivation: 表到报告生成的核心挑战是系统性地发现跨表、跨属性、跨分析视角的可验证复合洞察，并组织成连贯、完整、可追溯的证据链。现有方法依赖顺序式、反应式数据智能体或LLM直接生成，存在探索偏差：早期局部观察会约束后续动作，导致模型过早聚焦局部分析，遗漏跨表或跨维度证据。
AI.method: 提出ComInsight框架，将洞察发现重构为原子证据的组合。首先定义原子洞察为符合预定义分析模式的最小可执行分析单元，并从数据库模式与内容中枚举所有有效原子洞察；随后将这些原子组织为多关系洞察图，节点表示已验证的数据事实，边编码逻辑、时间或层次关系；最后通过一组组合算子将原子节点系统融合为高阶复合结论，每个复合输出均附带可执行SQL与细粒度溯源，确保完全可验证。
AI.result: 在InsightBench、DDR-Bench和T2R-Bench三个基准上，ComInsight在事实正确性、新颖性和结构完整性方面持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ComInsight为表到报告生成提供了一条可靠、高效且可解释的路径。

title: Divergence controls entropy in distillation
summary: Distillation has become a core primitive of large language model training, but its properties are not yet well understood. We take an entropic perspective, studying how the entropy of the student depends on the data and the divergence that define the distillation objective. We prove that forward KL inflates the entropy of the student above that of the teacher. Since cross-entropy training is a special case, this yields an identity that we verify quantitatively in pretraining and supervised finetuning. Other divergences come with no such guarantee: reverse KL deflates entropy until the gap between student and teacher gets too large, and interpolating between the two changes entropy smoothly early in training but abruptly at convergence. The lower entropy of on-policy distillation comes from token-level reverse KL, not from on-policy sampling. The divergence therefore acts as an implicit entropy regularizer, whose role is clearest in self-distillation: as conditioning on privileged information deflates entropy, the divergence hyperparameters that work best are those that compensate for it.

AI.tldr: 本文从熵的角度研究知识蒸馏，证明不同散度对师生熵差的影响不同：前向KL使学生熵高于教师（交叉熵为特例），反向KL则压缩学生熵；散度相当于隐式熵正则化器。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏已成为大语言模型训练的核心手段，但其性质尚未被充分理解，尤其是散度选择和数据如何影响学生模型熵这一关键问题缺乏系统分析。
AI.method: 采用熵的视角进行理论与实证分析：(1) 证明前向KL会使学生熵膨胀至高于教师；(2) 将交叉熵视为特例并导出恒等式，在预训练和监督微调中定量验证；(3) 分析反向KL及两种散度插值下的熵行为；(4) 通过对比实验区分on-policy蒸馏中低熵的来源；(5) 以自蒸馏验证散度作为隐式熵正则化器的作用。
AI.result: 前向KL使学生熵高于教师熵，交叉熵特例的恒等式在预训练和监督微调中得到定量验证；反向KL会持续压缩熵，直到师生差距过大；两者插值在训练早期熵平滑变化，但收敛时突变。on-policy蒸馏的低熵来源于token级反向KL而非on-policy采样。在自蒸馏中，条件于特权信息会压低熵，最佳散度超参数正是补偿该效应的取值。
AI.conclusion: 散度在蒸馏中充当隐式熵正则化器，其作用在自蒸馏中最为明显；这一熵视角为理解与设计蒸馏目标（包括散度选择及超参数调节）提供了统一的理论解释。

title: Author Representation Strategies for Zero-Shot Authorship Attribution: A Comparative Study of LLM-Based and Embedding-Based Approaches
summary: Authorship Attribution (AA) requires capturing fine-grained stylistic characteristics, making it particularly challenging in zero-shot (ZS) settings where no task-specific supervision is available. In this work, we investigate the effect of author representations on ZS AA by evaluating a label-only prompting baseline together with three author representation strategies: representative writing samples, LLM-generated descriptions, and style embeddings (LISA). The first three approaches perform attribution using LLM prompting, while the embedding-based approach uses style embeddings with cosine similarity. We investigate the influence of prompt design and propose a two-stage embedding-based attribution framework that combines candidate space reduction with embedding-dimension selection. The results show that label-only ZS AA is ineffective, while incorporating author-specific representations consistently improves attribution performance. Among the evaluated approaches, the proposed two-stage LISA framework achieves the strongest overall performance, whereas LLM-generated style descriptions provide a substantially more compact representation of author style at the cost of some attribution performance. These findings demonstrate the importance of author representation in ZS AA, while indicating that current open-source LLMs remain insufficient for robust attribution without more effective representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究作者表示对零样本作者归属(AA)的影响，比较了标签提示、代表性写作样本、LLM生成描述与风格嵌入(LISA)四种策略，并提出两阶段嵌入归属框架，发现标签提示无效、作者表示可提升性能、两阶段LISA最优。
AI.motivation: 作者归属需要捕捉细粒度文体特征，在无任务监督的零样本设定下尤为困难。本文旨在探究不同类型作者表示对零样本作者归属效果的影响。
AI.method: 评估一个仅标签提示基线及三种作者表示策略：代表性写作样本、LLM生成描述、风格嵌入(LISA)。前三种基于LLM提示进行归属，嵌入方法用风格嵌入加余弦相似度。同时研究提示设计的影响，并提出两阶段嵌入归属框架，结合候选空间缩减与嵌入维度选择。
AI.result: 标签-only零样本AA无效；引入作者特定表示能稳定提升归属性能。所提两阶段LISA框架整体性能最强；LLM生成风格描述表示更紧凑，但归属性能有所下降。
AI.conclusion: 作者表示在零样本AA中至关重要；当前开源LLM在缺乏更有效表示学习时仍不足以实现鲁棒归属。

title: Abdominal Ultrasound Simulation from Semantic Labels using Paired Label-to-Physics-Based Image Translation
summary: Purpose: Current abdominal ultrasound (US) simulation methods often require CT-based anatomical references for ray-casting, limiting deformation and pathology variability. We propose a learning-based pipeline trained to predict physics-based images derived from CT scans from semantic labels, enabling controlled simulations without patient-specific CT volumes at inference time. Methods: We introduce a two-stage pipeline that maps anatomical segmentations to realistic US images through a simplified US image. Stage~I synthesizes this image from semantic labels using models trained on CT-based ray-casting outputs. Stage~II refines it into a realistic US scan using anatomically guided unpaired translation. Deformations and pathologies are generated by editing anatomical maps. Results: We evaluated Pix2Pix and the Semantic Diffusion Model (SDM) in Stage~I, followed by segmentation-guided CycleGAN (SG-CycleGAN) refinement in Stage~II. SDM significantly outperformed Pix2Pix in morphological metrics, including MAE (19.85 vs. 21.65), SSIM (0.28 vs. 0.24), and mIoU (0.43 vs. 0.29), whereas Pix2Pix yielded better perceptual point estimates (LPIPS: 0.17 vs. 0.19; FID: 0.32 vs. 0.37; KID: 0.25 vs. 0.48). Conclusion: Training paired generative models with physics-based supervision enables approximation of CT-derived ray-casting outputs at inference time directly from semantic labels. Although the pipeline does not require patient-specific CT volumes at inference time, CT-derived segmentations and ray-casting simulations remain necessary to train Stage~I. Once trained, the framework enables controllable healthy and pathological simulations through semantic-map modification.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段学习式流水线，从语义标签直接生成逼真腹部超声图像，推理时无需患者CT，可通过编辑解剖图实现可控形变与病理仿真。
AI.motivation: 现有腹部超声仿真多依赖基于CT的解剖参考进行光线投射，导致形变与病理多样性受限，且推理阶段需患者特异性CT体数据。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：Stage I 用基于CT光线投射输出训练的模型，将解剖分割标签合成为简化超声图像，比较Pix2Pix与语义扩散模型(SDM)；Stage II 使用解剖引导的配对/非配对翻译(分割引导CycleGAN, SG-CycleGAN)精修为真实超声。形变与病理通过编辑解剖图生成。
AI.result: SDM在形态学指标上显著优于Pix2Pix：MAE 19.85 vs. 21.65，SSIM 0.28 vs. 0.24，mIoU 0.43 vs. 0.29；Pix2Pix在感知点估计上更优：LPIPS 0.17 vs. 0.19，FID 0.32 vs. 0.37，KID 0.25 vs. 0.48。
AI.conclusion: 以物理仿真为监督训练配对生成模型，可在推理时仅凭语义标签近似CT光线投射输出；虽推理不需患者CT，但训练Stage I仍需CT分割与光线投射仿真。框架训练后可通过修改语义图实现可控的健康与病理仿真。

title: DuoMatching: Joint-Marginal Distribution Matching for Few-Step Video Generation
summary: Streaming video generation has benefited from distribution matching distillation (DMD), which matches the joint distribution of video frames to a video teacher's approximation of the real video distribution. Although this joint matching mitigates drift during autoregressive rollouts, limitations remain in visual quality and semantic alignment. To address these limitations, we propose DuoMatching, a distribution matching framework that approximates the real video distribution through a unified joint-marginal formulation. On top of existing joint matching formulations, the additional marginal matching objective provides dedicated frame-level supervision from an image generator, transferring complementary visual and semantic priors from it. To apply this frame-level supervision in video generation, we introduce LatentBridge to resolve the latent representation mismatch between the video student and the image teacher. Latent Variation Sampling further distributes such frame-level supervision across distinct temporal segments, reducing redundancy. Experiments demonstrate that DuoMatching improves visual quality, composition, and semantic alignment while largely preserving motion dynamics. Human evaluations show overall preference rates above 80% against all evaluated baselines. The project page is available at https://johnzhan2023.github.io/DuoMatching/.

AI.tldr: 提出DuoMatching分布匹配框架，通过联合-边缘统一建模视频分布，结合LatentBridge与Latent Variation Sampling，提升流式视频生成的视觉质量与语义对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有基于DMD的流式视频生成虽通过联合分布匹配缓解自回归漂移，但在视觉质量与语义对齐上仍存在不足，缺乏帧级监督并无法充分利用图像生成器的先验。
AI.method: DuoMatching在联合匹配基础上引入额外的边缘匹配目标，从图像生成器提供帧级监督以迁移互补的视觉与语义先验；为此提出LatentBridge解决视频学生模型与图像教师模型间的潜表示不匹配；并提出Latent Variation Sampling将帧级监督分配到不同时间片段以减少冗余。
AI.result: 实验表明DuoMatching在基本保持运动动态的同时提升了视觉质量、构图与语义对齐，人工评测中相对所有基线整体偏好率均超过80%。
AI.conclusion: 联合-边缘统一分布匹配为流式视频生成提供有效改进路径，帧级图像先验可弥补联合匹配的局限。

title: Writerslogic at PAN 2026: Process over Content for Robust Detection under Domain Shift
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Notebook for the PAN Lab at CLEF 2026. Code https://github.com/dcondrey/voight-kampff-clef2026 and https://github.com/dcondrey/trajectory-detection-clef2026
summary: We describe the Writerslogic systems for three PAN at CLEF 2026 shared tasks (Reasoning Trajectory Detection, Voight-Kampff Generative AI Detection, and Multi-Author Writing Style Analysis), unified by a shared analytical framework: feature robustness under distribution shift is governed by support overlap between training and test distributions, not by training-set effect size. This yields a taxonomy (domain-anchored, domain-portable, domain-invariant) that explains why generator-specific features die under domain shift while vocabulary fingerprints (hapax ratio, Yule's K, Heaps' exponent), compression measures, and character n-grams survive. On Reasoning Trajectory Detection, where training was entirely mathematics and 84 percent of test was unseen domains, the framework guided system design to 1st place in source detection (0.85 macro F1 via Opus-Sonnet agreement) and 3rd place in safety classification (0.66 macro F1 via query-refusal decomposition). For Voight-Kampff, we built a calibrated ensemble of DeBERTa-v2 (ONNX), multi-seed LightGBM with 44 domain-portable stylometric features, and SVM on n-gram TF-IDF, combined via learned stacking with isotonic calibration; the best configuration achieved 0.891 on the PAN 2026 test set with balanced sub-metrics (0.853 to 0.902 across all evaluation dimensions). For Multi-Author Writing Style Analysis, we describe a system fusing spectral clustering over character n-gram similarity graphs, normalized compression distance for local boundary detection, and SmolLM-135M perplexity for neural change-point detection; a platform mix-up meant our run never reached the official evaluation, so we report the design and its a priori predictions. Across all three tasks, features measuring generation process properties are designed to outperform features measuring generated content properties under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 该论文描述 Writerslogic 参与 PAN at CLEF 2026 三项共享任务的系统，统一框架为：特征在分布偏移下的稳健性由训练-测试支持重叠决定，而非训练集效应量，并据此提出三类特征分类法。
AI.motivation: 解释生成器特定特征在域偏移下失效、而词汇指纹与压缩类特征得以存活的现象，并为跨域任务提供统一的系统设计依据。
AI.method: 提出领域锚定、领域可迁移、领域不变的特征分类法；在推理轨迹检测中依据该框架设计系统；在 Voight-Kampff 任务中构建 DeBERTa-v2 (ONNX)、多随机种子 LightGBM（44个领域可迁移文体特征）与 n-gram TF-IDF SVM 的校准集成，采用学习式堆叠与等渗校准；多作者风格分析融合字符 n-gram 相似图的谱聚类、归一化压缩距离边界检测与 SmolLM-135M 困惑度变点检测。
AI.result: 推理轨迹检测中源检测获第1名（宏F1 0.85，基于 Opus-Sonnet 一致性），安全分类第3名（宏F1 0.66，基于查询拒答分解）；Voight-Kampff 最优配置在 PAN 2026 测试集取得 0.891，各评估维度子指标均衡（0.853–0.902）；多作者风格分析因平台混淆未进入官方评测，仅报告设计与先验预测。
AI.conclusion: 在分布偏移下，度量生成过程属性的特征优于度量生成内容属性的特征；特征稳健性取决于训练与测试分布的支持重叠。

title: Writerslogic at the CLEF 2026 SimpleText Track: Multi-Candidate LLM Simplification and Stacked Complexity Spotting
comment: 11 pages, 3 tables. Notebook for the SimpleText Lab at CLEF 2026. Code: https://github.com/dcondrey/simpletext-clef2026
summary: We describe the Writerslogic team's participation in the CLEF 2026 SimpleText shared task, addressing Task 1 (text simplification) and Task 2 (complexity spotting). For Task 1, we develop a multi-candidate generation pipeline using GPT-4o-mini that produces five simplification candidates per sentence at varying temperatures, then selects the best candidate using a reference-free scoring heuristic that rewards compression, source word retention, Cochrane Plain Language Summary vocabulary usage, and lexical simplicity. On Task 1.1 (sentence-level simplification), our Claude Sonnet 4 submission achieves SARI 47.43 and BLEU 14.21, the top-ranked sentence-level system (3rd on the combined Task 1 leaderboard, behind two document-level submissions). For Task 2, we fine-tune a DeBERTa-v3-large NLI model on 350K labeled (source, sentence) pairs, framing hallucination detection as natural language inference. The model reads the most relevant source sentence as premise and the candidate as hypothesis, directly learning to distinguish grounded from hallucinated content. On Task 2.1 (binary overgeneration identification), our fine-tuned DeBERTa system achieves 0.8081 document-level macro F1 (0.8085 in our best ensemble), the top-ranked entry within the identification track and 2nd among teams overall, behind AIIR Lab (0.8197). On Task 2.2 (multi-class error classification), our best submission reaches 0.804 multiclass accuracy, ranking 2nd among unique teams behind AIIR Lab (0.827). We evaluate both tasks on English and multilingual biomedical text from Cochrane systematic reviews.

AI.tldr: Writerslogic团队参加CLEF 2026 SimpleText共享任务，Task 1采用GPT-4o-mini多候选生成＋无参考启发式打分，句子级简化取得SARI 47.43、BLEU 14.21；Task 2将幻觉检测建模为NLI任务并微调DeBERTa-v3-large，二分类过生成识别获0.8081文档级宏F1，多分类错误分类获0.804准确率。
AI.motivation: 面向Cochrane系统综述的英文及多语种生物医学文本，推进文本简化与复杂度/幻觉识别的实用系统建设，并参与CLEF 2026 SimpleText共享任务的Task 1与Task 2评测。
AI.method: Task 1：基于GPT-4o-mini的多候选生成流水线，每句在不同温度下生成5个简化候选，再用无参考打分启发式进行选择，奖励压缩程度、源词保留、Cochrane通俗语言摘要（PLS）词汇使用及词汇简洁性。Task 2：在35万条标注（源句, 候选句）对上微调DeBERTa-v3-large NLI模型，以最相关源句为前提、候选句为假设，将幻觉检测形式化为自然语言推理，直接学习区分有据内容与幻觉内容。
AI.result: Task 1.1（句子级简化）：Claude Sonnet 4提交取得SARI 47.43、BLEU 14.21，排名句子级系统第一，综合Task 1榜单第三（前两名均为文档级提交）。Task 2.1（二分类过生成识别）：微调DeBERTa取得0.8081文档级宏F1（最佳集成0.8085），为识别赛道第一、团队总排名第二，仅次于AIIR Lab（0.8197）。Task 2.2（多分类错误分类）：最佳提交达0.804多分类准确率，在独立团队中排名第二，仅次于AIIR Lab（0.827）。
AI.conclusion: 多候选生成＋无参考启发式打分在句子级简化上具竞争力；将幻觉检测重构为NLI可有效支撑过生成识别与错误分类，两类任务均取得赛道领先或前列成绩，验证了方法在生物医学文本上的有效性。

title: Rethinking What to Cache in Few-Step Diffusion Transformers: Solver-Aware Target Selection
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) can generate high-quality images and videos, but generating each sample requires multiple costly DiT forward passes. Two common ways to accelerate DiT sampling are step distillation, which reduces the number of sampling steps, and caching, which skips some DiT evaluations by reusing a tensor computed at an earlier step. Most caching methods decide in advance which tensor to reuse. After distillation, adjacent sampling steps are farther apart. Reusing a tensor across this larger gap introduces more error, so choosing what to cache becomes especially important. We therefore introduce AutoTarget, a method that chooses the cached tensor for a given model, solver, and reuse schedule. AutoTarget uses a small set of runs without cache reuse to measure the error caused by reusing each candidate tensor, then selects the candidate with the lowest error.
