We also analyze how an error at one reuse step affects the final sample. For Euler sampling, we identify cache targets that produce the same trajectory and show why a stored solver update may not. Experiments on distilled image and video DiTs show that the best cache target changes with the model, image resolution, and solver. AutoTarget reduces DiT evaluations and retained cache storage. Generation quality remains close to the corresponding uncached run. On the tested PixArt-LCM and FLUX.1-schnell settings, its calibration ranking matches the ranking from held-out cached runs. To help others reproduce the method, we provide its core implementation on GitHub at https://github.com/wali1024-offical/AutoTarget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AutoTarget，一种为给定模型、求解器和复用调度自动选择缓存张量的方法，以减少扩散 Transformer（DiT）采样中的评估次数与缓存存储，同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: DiT 生成图像和视频质量高，但每个样本需要多次昂贵的 DiT 前向传播。加速采样常用步数蒸馏（减少采样步数）与缓存（跳过部分评估、复用早期步骤张量）两种方式。多数缓存方法预先固定复用哪个张量，而经过蒸馏后相邻采样步间隔变大，跨更大间隔复用张量会引入更多误差，因此“缓存什么”变得尤为关键。
AI.method: AutoTarget 针对特定模型、求解器与复用调度选择缓存张量：先用少量不使用缓存复用的运行来度量复用每个候选张量所造成的误差，再选择误差最低的候选。作者还分析了某一步复用误差如何影响最终样本；对 Euler 采样，识别出能产生相同轨迹的缓存目标，并说明为何存储的求解器更新量可能不行。
AI.result: 在蒸馏的图像与视频 DiT 上，最佳缓存目标随模型、图像分辨率和求解器而变化。AutoTarget 减少了 DiT 评估次数与保留的缓存存储，生成质量与相应未缓存运行接近。在测试的 PixArt-LCM 与 FLUX.1-schnell 设置上，其校准排名与留出缓存运行的排名一致。
AI.conclusion: AutoTarget 通过基于误差测量的自动选择缓存张量，有效加速蒸馏 DiT 采样并降低缓存开销，且保持生成质量；核心实现已在 GitHub 开源以便复现。

title: ManifoldSplat: Language-Guided Semantic Shape Editing of 3D Gaussian Head Avatars
summary: High-fidelity 3D head avatars have reached near-photorealistic quality. While recent methods enable text-driven manipulation, they struggle to provide fine-grained localized control, often entangling features or lacking geometric consistency. Modifying geometry through natural language currently requires slow per-prompt optimization or compromises identity and rigging. We present ManifoldSplat, the first end-toend framework for language-guided semantic shape editing of animatable 3D Gaussian Splatting avatars reconstructed from monocular videos. By performing edits within the structured FLAME manifold rather than directly optimizing an unstructured Gaussian cloud, we strictly preserve identity and animation. We introduce DeltaRegion, a per-region disentangled Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) delivering feedforward shape deltas, alongside a refining stage to recover view-consistent details. ManifoldSplat reconstructs and edits an avatar in ~90 seconds on a consumer GPU, rendering at ~800 FPS. Extensive evaluations demonstrate our approach sets a new state-of-the-art in localized prompt alignment, geometric coherence, and identity preservation. Project page and code: https://a-canela.github.io/manifoldsplat/

AI.tldr: ManifoldSplat是首个端到端框架，可在FLAME流形上对可动画3D高斯泼溅头像进行语言引导的语义形状编辑，实现细粒度局部控制并严格保持身份与动画一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动头像编辑方法难以提供细粒度局部控制，常导致特征纠缠或几何不一致；通过自然语言修改几何通常依赖缓慢的逐提示优化，或牺牲身份与绑定（rigging）质量。
AI.method: 在结构化FLAME流形内执行编辑，而非直接优化非结构化高斯点云，从而严格保持身份与动画；提出DeltaRegion——按区域解耦的条件变分自编码器（CVAE），以馈送前向方式输出形状增量，并配合精化阶段恢复视图一致的细节。
AI.result: 在消费级GPU上约90秒完成头像重建与编辑，渲染速度约800 FPS；大量评估表明该方法在局部提示对齐、几何连贯性和身份保持方面达到新的最优水平。
AI.conclusion: ManifoldSplat通过将编辑约束于FLAME流形并采用解耦的区域化CVAE，实现了高效、端到端且高保真的语言引导语义形状编辑。

title: DEPICT: Scoring Text-to-Image Alignment by Answer Agreement
summary: Image-text alignment is a core problem in computer vision with applications in caption evaluation, hallucination detection, data curation, and the benchmarking of text-to-image (T2I) generators. As T2I models improve, benchmarking has become demanding, requiring metrics capable of finding a series of issues like missing objects, swapped attributes, miscounts, and ignored negations. Recent work addresses this by fine-tuning evaluators on preference data or by prompting a vision-language model, either holistically with the caption or with decomposed verification questions. However, existing approaches fall short: fine-tuned metrics remain bound to one backbone and training distribution; holistic metrics miss fine-grained details; and decomposed metrics rely on a fixed-YES assumption that penalizes faithful images whenever that assumption fails. In contrast, we propose DEPICT, a training-free metric that replaces fixed reference answers with expected agreement between image-based and caption-only answers, weighting questions by how decisively the caption determines them. By replacing fixed references, our agreement rule increases negation accuracy from 19% to 88%. To recover the context lost during decomposition, DEPICT merges this agreement score with a holistic score. We evaluate DEPICT on five benchmarks and eleven backbones from three model families and find that it surpasses all training-free metrics and exceeds fine-tuned evaluators on two out of three human-correlation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DEPICT，一种无需训练的图像-文本对齐评价指标，用图像答案与纯文本答案之间的期望一致度替代固定参考答案，并结合整体分数，在五个基准、十一个骨干模型上超越所有免训练指标。
AI.motivation: 图像-文本对齐是计算机视觉的核心问题，用于描述评价、幻觉检测、数据筛选和T2I生成器基准测试。随着T2I模型进步，基准测试要求指标能发现缺失物体、属性互换、计数错误、忽略否定等问题。现有方法存在三类缺陷：微调指标受限于单一骨干与训练分布；整体式指标遗漏细粒度细节；分解式指标依赖"固定答案为是"的假设，该假设不成立时会惩罚忠实图像。
AI.method: DEPICT是一种免训练指标。它以图像答案与仅基于描述的答案之间的"期望一致度"替代固定参考答案，并按描述对问题的判定程度对问题加权，从而取代固定参考。为弥补分解过程中丢失的上下文，DEPICT将该一致度分数与整体式分数融合。
AI.result: 替换固定参考后，一致度规则将否定准确率从19%提升至88%。在五个基准和来自三个模型家族的十一个骨干上评估，DEPICT超越所有免训练指标，并在三个与人相关的相关性基准中的两个上超过微调评价器。
AI.conclusion: DEPICT通过期望一致度与整体分数的融合，兼顾细粒度与全局上下文，且不依赖特定骨干或训练数据，是有效的免训练图像-文本对齐评价指标。

title: Low-Cost Video--Time Priors as a Strong Baseline for EEG--fNIRS Emotion Regression on Familiar Videos
summary: Continuous emotion regression estimates moment-to-moment valence and arousal while a viewer watches a video. In familiar-video deployment, responses fron training participant-specific estimate, and prior-dominating fixed fusion tests whether physiology adds residual correction. In five-fold subject-held-out evaluation on 24was within 0.05 and 0.32 MAE of fusion in the internal and external evaluations, respectively. Source-explicit ablations showed that video identity and within-video tine accounted for most of the reduction, while EG-FNIRS gains were smaller and varied across participants and videos. These results identify the video-time prior as a strong, low-cost baseline and position EEG-fNIRS as an optional residual signal for familiar-video emotion regression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"视频-时间先验主导的固定融合"基线，用于熟悉视频场景下的连续情绪回归，并评估EEG-fNIRS生理信号能否提供残差修正。
AI.motivation: 熟悉视频部署中，训练被试特定响应即可较好估计情绪，需检验生理信号是否带来额外增益。作者试图厘清性能提升究竟来自视频身份与视频内时间，还是来自EEG-fNIRS。
AI.method: 在24名被试上进行五折留一被试交叉验证，采用视频-时间先验主导的固定融合框架；内部与外部评估各自给出MAE；并进行源显式消融，分别考察视频身份、视频内时间与EEG-fNIRS的贡献。
AI.result: 在内部与外部评估中，融合结果与被试特定估计的MAE差距分别为0.05与0.32以内。源显式消融显示，性能下降主要归因于视频身份与视频内时间，EEG-fNIRS增益较小且随被试和视频变化。
AI.conclusion: 视频-时间先验是一种强且低成本的基线，EEG-fNIRS应被视为熟悉视频情绪回归中的可选取残差信号。

title: FALCON: A Model and Dataset Agnostic Framework for Synthetic Data Generation for NL2SQL Pairs
summary: Relational databases are among the most widely deployed forms of structured knowledge, and natural language access to them requires grounding language onto schema entities and relations while handling the ambiguity inherent in how people phrase requests. Existing synthetic NL-to-SQL data generation methods largely ignore this ambiguity and produce oversimplified queries that fail to prepare models for the complexity of real-world structured knowledge access. We present FALCON, a framework that generates realistic, ambiguity-aware NL-to-SQL data matching the complexity of challenging real-world benchmarks, at low cost using compact open models. Our approach combines reserved-word SQL seeding and persona-based prompting to generate structurally complex queries, while alignment-based filtering preserves difficulty by distinguishing genuinely incorrect examples from complex but valid queries. Human evaluation confirms consistent high quality across model sizes, and our generated data exceeds existing benchmarks in both SQL complexity and natural language richness. Difficulty-stratified analysis shows models trained on FALCON data increasingly outperform baseline-trained models as query complexity increases, validating our pipeline's success in generating challenging training data. When combined with a small proportion of existing benchmark data, mixed training recovers performance on simpler queries while preserving these advantages on complex ones. The model- and database-agnostic design enables organizations to generate high-complexity NL-to-SQL training data locally without external APIs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FALCON框架，利用保留字SQL种子与基于人设的提示生成结构复杂的NL-to-SQL数据，并通过对齐式过滤区分真正错误与复杂但有效的查询，从而低成本地生成具有歧义感知特性、贴近真实复杂度的训练数据。
AI.motivation: 关系数据库是广泛部署的结构化知识形式，自然语言访问需将语言落地到模式实体与关系，并处理人们表述中固有的歧义。现有合成NL-to-SQL数据生成方法大多忽视这种歧义，产生过度简化的查询，无法让模型应对真实世界结构化知识访问的复杂性。
AI.method: FALCON框架：结合保留字SQL种子（reserved-word SQL seeding）与基于人设的提示（persona-based prompting）生成结构复杂的查询；采用基于对齐的过滤（alignment-based filtering）区分真正错误的样本与复杂但有效的查询，以保持数据难度；利用紧凑开源模型以低成本生成数据，且设计与模型、数据库无关。
AI.result: 人工评估确认各模型规模下数据质量稳定较高；生成数据在SQL复杂度和自然语言丰富度上均超过现有基准。难度分层分析表明，随着查询复杂度提升，在FALCON数据上训练的模型相较基线训练模型优势愈加明显。与少量现有基准数据混合训练，可在简单查询上恢复性能，同时保持复杂查询上的优势。
AI.conclusion: FALCON能有效生成具有挑战性的NL-to-SQL训练数据，验证了流水线在生成高难度数据方面的成功。其模型与数据库无关的设计使组织能够在本地生成高复杂度NL-to-SQL训练数据，无需依赖外部API。

title: World Embedding Benchmark
summary: Physical fidelity has received increasing attention in world models and video generation, yet how video representations encode physical information remains less understood. We introduce the World Embedding Benchmark, comprising 8,000 controlled simulation cases from 80 families spanning fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, dynamics, and optics & electromagnetism. Each case pairs a rendered video with simulation-derived physical annotations, supporting three complementary tasks: text-video retrieval, physical-property regression, and multiple-choice video-description pair classification. We use these tasks to distinguish cross-modal physical alignment from the recoverability of quantitative physical information. Evaluated pre-trained omnimodal embedding models show weak retrieval and near-chance within-family pair classification, while lightweight probes recover useful physical information from frozen video embeddings. Continual contrastive training with physics-specific video-text pairs improves retrieval and pair classification but degrades physical-property regression, revealing a trade-off between alignment and quantitative information recoverability. Finally, we use the embeddings to retrieve reference videos for retrieval-augmented generation with MiniMax-H3. Retrieved references improve the physical fidelity of generated videos, with stronger retrieval models yielding larger gains in our experiments. Together, these findings highlight the need to evaluate physical alignment and property recoverability jointly, and demonstrate the utility of physical representations for improving video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出World Embedding Benchmark（8,000个受控仿真样本，覆盖80个物理族、四大物理领域），通过三项任务区分跨模态物理对齐与定量物理信息可恢复性，发现二者存在权衡，并证明物理表征可用于检索增强的视频生成以提升物理保真度。
AI.motivation: 物理保真度在世界模型与视频生成中日益受到关注，但视频表征如何编码物理信息仍缺乏理解，且缺少系统性评测手段。
AI.method: 构建World Embedding Benchmark：8,000个受控仿真案例、80个族，涵盖流体力学、固体力学、动力学、光学与电磁学；每个案例由渲染视频与仿真导出的物理标注配对，支持文本-视频检索、物理属性回归、多选视频-描述对分类三项任务。评测预训练全模态嵌入模型，并采用轻量探针、物理专用视频-文本对的持续对比训练，最后用嵌入检索参考视频进行检索增强生成（MiniMax-H3）。
AI.result: 预训练全模态嵌入模型检索性能弱、族内配对分类接近随机；轻量探针可从冻结视频嵌入中恢复有用物理信息；持续对比训练提升检索与配对分类，却降低物理属性回归性能，体现对齐与定量信息可恢复性之间的权衡；检索到的参考视频提升生成视频的物理保真度，检索模型越强增益越大。
AI.conclusion: 需联合评估物理对齐与属性可恢复性，物理表征对改进视频生成具有实用价值。

title: LoGo: Local-Global Rewards for Consistent Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Camera-controlled video models are rapidly advancing toward long generation horizons and complex camera control. A key failure mode is 3D inconsistency: as the camera moves, objects lose permanence and scene structures shift. Existing post-training techniques, which assign a single scalar reward to the entire generation, are poorly suited to correcting these inconsistencies over long horizons. We introduce LoGo, which blends global and spatially localized rewards for camera-controlled video models. The local reward provides fine-grained credit assignment, which substantially improves 3D consistency, while the global reward preserves camera following and video quality. Across three base models, LoGo shows a clear advantage on DL3DV and TrajectoryBench, a new benchmark for long-horizon, complex-camera-control generation that current evaluations lack. LoGo effectively reduces local object shifts, artifacts, and global scene changes, illustrating the importance of credit assignment in post-training video models. Project website: https://ziqi-ma.github.io/logo-website/

AI.tldr: LoGo提出一种混合全局与空间局部奖励的后训练方法，用于相机控制视频模型，通过细粒度信用分配显著提升长时程3D一致性，同时保持相机跟随与画质。
AI.motivation: 相机控制视频模型正朝着长生成时程与复杂相机控制发展，但其关键失效模式是3D不一致性：相机移动时物体失去持久性、场景结构发生漂移。现有的后训练技术为整段生成分配单一标量奖励，难以在长时程上修正这类不一致，缺乏有效的信用分配机制。
AI.method: 提出LoGo方法，为相机控制视频模型混合全局奖励与空间局部奖励。局部奖励提供细粒度信用分配，用于修正局部物体漂移与伪影；全局奖励保持相机跟随能力与视频质量。同时在三个基座模型上进行验证，并提出TrajectoryBench基准，用于评估长时程、复杂相机控制的生成任务。
AI.result: 在DL3DV与TrajectoryBench上，LoGo相对现有方法均表现出一致且明显的优势。方法有效减少了局部物体漂移、伪影以及全局场景变化，验证了信用分配在后训练视频模型中的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度信用分配是提升相机控制视频模型长时程3D一致性的关键；全局与局部奖励的结合能在不牺牲相机跟随和画质的前提下显著改善生成稳定性。同时，TrajectoryBench填补了长时程复杂相机控制评测的空白。

title: On-Board Anomaly Detection for Efficient Marine Environmental Monitoring
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Presented at the 9th International Workshop on On-Board Payload Data Compression (OBPDC 2024), Gran Canaria, Spain, 2-4 October 2024
summary: Marine ecosystems are impacted by various threats such as oil spills, algal blooms, and sediment floods, which disrupt habitats, wildlife, and human activities. Advances in satellite imagery and Artificial Intelligence (AI) have enhanced our capabilities for early detection and mitigation of such hazards. In this paper, we propose a marine event detection pipeline for Earth observation satellites equipped with multi- or hyperspectral sensors. Our approach includes a self-supervised neural network encoder that compresses satellite images into a reduced latent space, enabling efficient onboard processing. A machine learning anomaly detection model identifies deviations from normal sea patterns to detect environmental anomalies. We compare its performance against traditional algorithms such as Isolation Forest, One-Class Support Vector Machine and Local Outlier Factors. Our lightweight, resource-efficient pipeline is optimized for deployment on satellites with limited computational resources, ranging from embedded CPUs to AI hardware accelerators. By prioritizing the transmission of critical information, our solution enhances system responsiveness and optimizes satellite communication bandwidth. Demonstrated through current integration across multiple missions, including European Space Agency's (ESA) Phisat-2 mission and Microsoft/Thales Alenia Space IMAGIN-e mission, our pipeline aims to improve marine environmental monitoring by providing timely alerts and efficient data reduction.

AI.tldr: 提出一套面向多/高光谱卫星的在轨海洋事件检测流水线，用自监督编码器压缩图像并配合异常检测模型识别海洋环境异常，轻量化设计适配星上算力，已在ESA Phisat-2与Microsoft/Thales Alenia Space IMAGIN-e任务中集成。
AI.motivation: 海洋生态系统受溢油、藻华、泥沙洪泛等威胁，破坏栖息地、野生动植物与人类活动；卫星遥感与AI的进步为早期探测与缓解此类灾害提供了能力，但星上计算资源有限、下行带宽受限，需要高效的在轨处理与关键信息优先传输方案。
AI.method: 构建面向搭载多光谱/高光谱传感器的对地观测卫星的海洋事件检测流水线：1）自监督神经网络编码器将卫星图像压缩至低维潜在空间，实现高效在轨处理；2）机器学习异常检测模型识别偏离正常海洋模式的信号，从而探测环境异常；3）将所提方法与Isolation Forest、One-Class SVM、Local Outlier Factor等传统算法进行性能对比；4）流水线轻量、资源高效，针对从嵌入式CPU到AI硬件加速器的星载平台优化，通过优先传输关键信息提升系统响应速度并优化通信带宽。
AI.result: 流水线已在多项任务中集成验证，包括ESA的Phisat-2任务以及Microsoft/Thales Alenia Space的IMAGIN-e任务；相较Isolation Forest、One-Class SVM、Local Outlier Factor等传统算法进行了性能比较（原文未给出具体数值指标）。整体实现轻量化与资源高效，可在受限算力平台上部署，并支持及时告警与数据缩减。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线通过自监督压缩与异常检测相结合，在星上实现海洋环境异常的高效检测与数据降减，可提供及时告警，改善海洋环境监测，并已在多个实际任务中落地验证。

title: ProAR: Learning Prospective Reasoning with Autoregressive Video Models
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video models excel at causal generation, but their reliance on next-chunk prediction confines them to a short-sighted, reactive paradigm. This limitation is particularly consequential for reasoning-oriented generation, where achieving a target outcome through valid intermediate states matters more than local visual plausibility. To address this challenge, we propose Learning Prospective Reasoning with Autoregressive Video Models (ProAR), a novel framework that transforms autoregressive video generation into a goal-oriented reasoning process. ProAR introduces two key components: (1) To anchor generation to the long-range outcome, we integrate goal-frame prediction into the autoregressive loop via an asymmetric attention mask, enabling the predicted goal frame to guide the generation of intermediate states without being disrupted by them. (2) To guide short-range transitions, we introduce future representation self-alignment to encourage current hidden states to anticipate upcoming temporal dynamics. By leveraging teacher-forcing in AR training, we extract clean future representations in a single forward pass and align current representations with them using a lightweight, training-only predictor. Together, these two mechanisms seamlessly combine explicit, sparse target supervision with implicit, dense step-wise guidance, promoting coherent, goal-directed reasoning progress with modest computational cost. Experiments show that ProAR's complementary components consistently improve performance across diverse visual reasoning benchmarks. The framework proves highly training-efficient, surpassing fully trained standard AR baselines using only 25% of the training steps. This paradigm also demonstrates promising applicability to embodied reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: ProAR 将自回归视频生成转化为目标导向的推理过程，通过目标帧预测与未来表征自对齐，在仅用 25% 训练步数下超越标准 AR 基线。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频模型擅长因果生成，但依赖"下一块预测"导致其短视、被动，难以胜任以推理为导向的生成任务——此类任务更看重通过有效中间状态达成目标结果，而非局部视觉合理性。
AI.method: 提出 ProAR 框架，包含两个组件：(1) 将目标帧预测通过非对称注意力掩码嵌入自回归循环，使预测目标帧引导中间状态生成且不被其干扰；(2) 引入未来表征自对齐，利用 AR 训练中的 teacher-forcing 单次前向提取干净的未来表征，并通过轻量级、仅训练期使用的预测器对齐当前表征。二者结合稀疏显式目标监督与稠密隐式逐步引导。
AI.result: 两个互补组件在多种视觉推理基准上持续提升性能；训练效率极高，仅用 25% 训练步数即超越完全训练的标准 AR 基线；在具身推理任务上亦展现良好适用性。
AI.conclusion: ProAR 以适中计算成本实现连贯、目标导向的推理进程，验证了将 AR 视频生成重构为目标导向推理范式的有效性。

title: Pivot-SD: Efficient Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLMs) offer a promising parallel alternative to autoregressive models for complex reasoning. However, they face a distinct credit-assignment challenge, since a few commitments during denoising sharply reduce the uncertainty over the remaining masked positions and shape much of the response. Most post-training recipes for dLMs do not use this signal to decide which tokens to train on: they typically train on the final text or assign rewards to whole denoising steps, rather than selecting the individual commitments that shape the response. We introduce Pivot-SD, an efficient offline self-distillation framework that supervises only these high-impact commitments (pivots). Pivot-SD selects pivots using an information-gain metric measuring uncertainty reduction over the remaining masked positions. Pivots from successful trajectories are trained with cross-entropy, and pivots from failed trajectories with targeted unlikelihood, leaving the rest of the failed trajectory untouched. Using only 200 questions and four rollouts each, Pivot-SD improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct over full-sequence SFT and budget-matched diffusion RL baselines across math and code benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Pivot-SD，一种离线自蒸馏框架，仅监督去噪过程中高影响的"关键承诺"（pivots），用 200 个问题即提升掩码扩散语言模型的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型在复杂推理上面临credit assignment难题：去噪过程中少数承诺会大幅降低剩余掩码位置的不确定性并决定响应走向，但现有后训练方法（基于最终文本或整步奖励）未利用该信号来选择训练token。
AI.method: Pivot-SD 用信息增益指标（对剩余掩码位置的不确定性降低量）选出 pivots；对成功轨迹的 pivots 用交叉熵训练，对失败轨迹的 pivots 用定向unlikelihood训练，失败轨迹其余部分不动。
AI.result: 仅用 200 个问题、每题 4 次 rollout，Pivot-SD 在数学与代码基准上超过全序列 SFT 和算力匹配的扩散 RL 基线，模型为 LLaDA-8B-Instruct。
AI.conclusion: 选择性监督高信息增益的关键承诺是掩码扩散语言模型后训练的高效信号，能在极少数据下优于 SFT 与 RL 基线。

title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
summary: LLM-guided evolutionary methods, such as AlphaEvolve, have emerged as powerful approaches for challenging computational optimization problems, such as circle packing. However, prior work typically optimizes performance gain over a fixed number of iterations. We argue that practical optimization should maximize gain per unit cost. To this end, we propose FrugalEvo, a cost-aware evolutionary framework where a stronger, higher-cost LLM explores solution strategies, and a cheaper LLM implements them and iteratively refines the resulting code. We also design a cache-efficient evolution process, where our harness and prompts maximize the sharing of prefixes across different evolution steps, to improve cache reuse. To measure solution quality throughout a fixed cost budget, we introduce Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve (BA-AUC), defined as the area under the best-so-far evaluation score curve over cumulative LLM cost, up to the budget. Across 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks, FrugalEvo matches or surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, including OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve, AdaEvolve, and EvoX, in final solution quality and achieves higher BA-AUC on 9 tasks. It also achieves higher average performance than these baselines on 10 algorithmic optimization tasks from ALE-Bench-Lite. Notably, on circle packing, FrugalEvo achieves new state-of-the-art performance with GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna for only 1.68 USD and with GLM-5.3 and its Flash variant for only 0.55 USD, matching or surpassing all baselines, including multi-agent methods such as CORAL and SwarmResearch, which cost approximately 50 USD on average.

AI.tldr: 提出成本感知的进化框架FrugalEvo，用强LLM探索策略、廉价LLM实现与迭代精炼，并配以缓存高效的进化流程；通过新指标BA-AUC衡量固定预算下的解质量，在多类优化任务上以极低成本达到或超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM引导的进化方法（如AlphaEvolve）通常在固定迭代次数下优化性能，但实际优化应最大化单位成本收益，即需要成本感知的优化范式。
AI.method: FrugalEvo：强而贵的LLM负责探索解策略，便宜的LLM负责实现并迭代精炼代码；设计缓存高效的进化过程，通过harness与prompt最大化跨进化步骤的前缀共享以提升缓存复用；提出BA-AUC（预算感知曲线下面积）指标，定义为在累计LLM成本上直到预算为止的最优评估分数曲线的面积。
AI.result: 在10个数学与系统优化任务上，最终解质量匹配或超越OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve、AdaEvolve、EvoX等SOTA基线，并在9个任务上取得更高BA-AUC；在ALE-Bench-Lite的10个算法优化任务上平均性能更优。圆填充任务上，用GPT-5.6 Terra与Luna仅1.68美元、GLM-5.3及其Flash变体仅0.55美元即达到新SOTA，匹配或超越平均花费约50美元的多智能体方法（如CORAL、SwarmResearch）。
AI.conclusion: 成本感知的进化优化能显著提升单位成本收益，FrugalEvo以极低预算在多种优化任务上达到或超越高成本基线，验证了以BA-AUC为目标的实用价值。

title: SigLIP2 for aerial fire risk classification
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code available at https://github.com/yunusserhat/firerisk
summary: We examine the transfer of a pretrained SigLIP2 image encoder to seven class fire risk classification from aerial imagery. We introduce a reproducible partition of the public FireRisk training mirror and an implementation that records data provenance, preprocessing and model selection. Two initial runs compare a frozen encoder probe with full model adaptation. On the validation partition, full adaptation reaches 63.05% accuracy and 58.94% macro F1, compared with 55.95% and 50.19% for the probe. Both runs use one training seed and select their checkpoint on the same validation partition. These development results support further evaluation of SigLIP2 but do not establish performance on an independent test set or unseen regions. The accompanying code provides a common framework for repeated experiments and comparisons with additional visual encoders.

AI.tldr: 将预训练SigLIP2图像编码器迁移至航拍影像的七类火灾风险分类任务，比较冻结编码器探针与全模型微调两种方案，提供可复现的数据划分与实验框架。
AI.motivation: 探究预训练视觉编码器（SigLIP2）在航拍火灾风险分类这一特定遥感任务上的可迁移性，并建立可复现、可扩展的实验基础，以便后续与更多视觉编码器进行对比。
AI.method: 对公开FireRisk训练镜像进行可复现的数据划分，实现记录数据来源、预处理与模型选择流程；开展两组初步实验，分别采用冻结编码器探针（linear probe）与全模型适配（full fine-tuning），使用单一训练随机种子，并在同一验证集上选择检查点。
AI.result: 在验证集上，全模型适配达到63.05%准确率与58.94%宏F1，优于探针方案的55.95%与50.19%。
AI.conclusion: 初步开发结果支持对SigLIP2的进一步评估，但尚不能确立其在独立测试集或未见区域上的性能；配套代码为重复实验及与其他视觉编码器的比较提供了统一框架。

title: FlowHMR: Physically Plausible Motion Capture from Video
summary: We present FlowHMR, a framework for recovering physically plausible global 3D human motion from monocular video. Previous learning-based methods typically regress human motion directly from video and train the network with geometric supervision. However, recovering human motion from monocular video is inherently ambiguous in depth, and direct regression tends to collapse toward an averaged solution. Moreover, the recovered motions are not guaranteed to be physically plausible, so physics-based tracking of them often fails. To address these challenges, we formulate video motion capture as a video-conditioned motion generation problem and first pretrain a flow matching model for this task. Given an input video, the pretrained model generates diverse motion candidates, but not all of them are faithful to the video or physically trackable. We therefore post-train the model using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with two rewards. A fidelity reward encourages consistency with the input video. A tracking reward favors motions that a physics-based controller can track successfully. Together, these rewards shift the model's output preference, so the post-trained model stays faithful to the input video while producing more physically plausible motion. We further introduce Wild-4K, a large and diverse dataset of about 4K internet videos, for evaluating human motion recovery in the wild. Qualitative and quantitative experiments on Wild-4K show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods in overall motion fidelity and achieves a physical tracking success rate of 82.47%, compared with 62.82% for the strongest baseline, GVHMR.

AI.tldr: FlowHMR：将单目视频人体运动捕捉形式化为视频条件运动生成问题，用流匹配预训练生成多样化候选，再以GRPO和保真度/可跟踪性双奖励后训练，在Wild-4K上超越SOTA并获得82.47%物理跟踪成功率。
AI.motivation: 单目视频恢复全局3D人体运动存在深度歧义，直接回归易塌缩为平均解；且恢复的运动不保证物理可行，导致基于物理的跟踪常常失败。需要同时解决运动多样性、视频保真度与物理可跟踪性问题。
AI.method: 1) 把视频运动捕捉建模为视频条件运动生成任务，先预训练一个flow matching模型；2) 给定输入视频，预训练模型生成多样化运动候选；3) 用GRPO后训练，设计两个奖励：保真度奖励鼓励与输入视频一致，跟踪奖励倾向于物理控制器能成功跟踪的运动；两个奖励共同调整模型输出偏好；4) 构建Wild-4K数据集（约4K互联网视频）用于野外评估。
AI.result: 在Wild-4K上，定性定量实验显示该方法在整体运动保真度上优于SOTA，物理跟踪成功率达82.47%，而最强基线GVHMR为62.82%。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成式建模+强化学习后训练的双奖励机制，可有效缓解单目视频运动恢复的深度歧义与物理不可行问题，同时保持视频保真度，实现更鲁棒、物理可跟踪的全局3D人体运动恢复。

title: Language Models that Play Chess and Explain Their Moves
summary: Modern chess engines are silent experts: they play at a superhuman level, but do not offer explanations for their play. On the other hand, language models (LMs) can generate plausible-sounding explanations, but their weak playing strength limits the utility of their explanations. We introduce Queen, a 4B-parameter chess-language model that can explain its moves and plans while playing at the level of a typical Grandmaster. Our novel framework enables domain-specific reasoning through complementary components: an encoder-decoder architecture and an iterative distillation algorithm. This architecture integrates a silent expert chess encoder with an instruction-tuned LM through cross-attention, which we train via a question-answering curriculum to extract chess concepts from the encoder's representations. Building on this domain-adapted model, we iteratively improve its explanations with a natural-language analog of the Bellman update: the model analyzes the positions after its top candidate moves and consolidates them into an explanation of the current position, which is then distilled back into the model. Over seven iterations, our model gains over 900 Elo points (1782 to 2697), substantially surpassing all frontier models on both playing strength and puzzle accuracy, despite containing three orders of magnitude fewer parameters. Furthermore, LM-based evaluations show that our explanations are fluent and approach GPT-5.6-Sol (high) in coherence. The generality of our architecture and training procedure suggests a recipe for applying language models to domains where silent expert encoders are available, like games, robotics, and computer use.

AI.tldr: 提出Queen，一个40亿参数的棋类语言模型，兼具大师级棋力（2697 Elo）与流畅走法解释能力，架构为"静默专家编码器+指令微调LM"经交叉注意力耦合，并用类Bellman迭代蒸馏提升解释质量。
AI.motivation: 现有棋类引擎棋力超人类但不提供解释；语言模型能生成看似合理的解释，但棋力薄弱，导致解释缺乏实用价值。作者希望同时获得强棋力与可信解释，并给出可迁移到其他"静默专家"领域（游戏、机器人、计算机操作）的通用方案。
AI.method: 1) 架构：将静默的国际象棋专家编码器与指令微调LM通过交叉注意力结合，构成编码器-解码器结构；2) 训练：以问答课程学习让模型从编码器表征中抽取棋类概念；3) 迭代蒸馏：采用自然语言版的Bellman更新——模型先分析其最优候选走法之后局面的结果，再整合为对当前局面的解释，并蒸馏回模型，共迭代7次。
AI.result: 迭代7次后模型提升逾900 Elo（1782→2697），在棋力与题目（puzzle）准确率上显著超越所有前沿模型，而参数量少三个数量级；基于LM的评测显示其解释流畅，连贯性接近GPT-5.6-Sol (high)。
AI.conclusion: 互补组件（专家编码器+LM+迭代自蒸馏）可有效赋予语言模型领域专长与可解释性，为存在静默专家编码器的领域提供通用配方。

title: Decoding the Functional Roles of Register and High-Norm Patch Tokens in Vision Transformers
summary: Self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs), such as DINOv2, learn rich visual representations, but the functions of their internal tokens remain poorly understood. Recent architectures introduce dedicated register tokens to reduce high-norm out- lier patch tokens that emerge in background re- gions, yet the semantic and functional roles of both token types have not been fully established. In this paper, we analyze these roles by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on register-token and outlier-token activations in DINOv2. Using an automated interpretability pipeline, UMAP clus- tering, and CLIP-space cross-checks, we find that register-token features are more strongly associ- ated with high-level semantic concepts. Outlier- token features, by contrast, are more often associ- ated with lower-level structural, background, and texture-dominant patterns. Causal ablations fur- ther reveal a substantial functional asymmetry: disrupting top-activating register-derived features produces a 48.17% drop in representation cosine similarity, whereas disrupting outlier-derived fea- tures produces only a 0.31% drop. Together, our results provide evidence for token specialization in self-supervised ViTs.

AI.tldr: 通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）分析DINOv2中寄存器token与离群patch token的激活，发现两类token在语义与功能上存在显著分工。
AI.motivation: 自监督ViT（如DINOv2）内部token的功能尚不清晰；寄存器token被引入以抑制背景区域的高范数离群patch token，但两类token的语义与功能角色未被系统确立。
AI.method: 在DINOv2的寄存器token与离群token激活上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE），并结合自动化可解释性流水线、UMAP聚类与CLIP空间交叉验证进行特征分析；进一步通过因果消融检验功能不对称性。
AI.result: 寄存器token特征更强关联高层语义概念，离群token特征更多关联低层结构、背景与纹理主导模式。消融最高激活的寄存器派生特征使表示余弦相似度下降48.17%，而消融离群派生特征仅下降0.31%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明自监督ViT中存在token特化现象：寄存器token承担高层语义功能，离群token则偏向低层结构/纹理信息，二者功能不对称明显。

title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Continual World Models Workshop
summary: Continual learning treats degradation on previously seen data as evidence of failure, a convention inherited from settings with a stationary prediction target, where a correct label remains correct indefinitely. World models do not satisfy this condition. Their prediction target is the environment, which changes, so knowledge that was accurate when acquired may later become false, and discarding it is required behavior rather than a defect. Non-stationary ground truth is well studied in the concept drift literature and in the temporal factuality of language models, but has not been formulated for world models, which are distinctive in that they also encode knowledge that must never be revised. We argue that continual world models require retention stratified by invariance timescale, separating invariants such as physics and object permanence, which must never be revised, from instance-level facts that should be revised as soon as the environment changes. Standard forgetting metrics cannot distinguish a world model that has correctly revised outdated knowledge from one that has suffered catastrophic forgetting, and consequently rank a frozen model highest, while existing physical-reasoning benchmarks evaluate only frozen checkpoints. We propose differential retention, which reports invariant regression testing across the adaptation stream jointly with revision latency, without aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文argue认为持续世界模型不应把对旧数据的遗忘一律视为失败，因为世界模型的预测目标（环境）本身是非平稳的；应按不变性时间尺度分层保留，并提出“差分保留”评测范式，分别报告不变量的回归测试与知识修订延迟。
AI.motivation: 持续学习沿用平稳预测目标的假设，把对已见数据的性能退化等同于失败，但世界模型的预测目标是不断变化的环境，过时知识被修改是应有行为而非缺陷。现有概念漂移与语言模型时间事实性研究未针对世界模型，而世界模型的独特之处在于同时包含必须永不修改的知识。此外，标准遗忘指标无法区分“正确修订过时知识”与“灾难性遗忘”，甚至会错误地把冻结模型排为最优，而现有物理推理基准又只评测冻结检查点。
AI.method: 提出持续世界模型需按不变性时间尺度进行分层保留：将物理规律、客体永久性等不变量与应随环境变化立即修订的实例级事实区分开。为此提出“差分保留”（differential retention）评测方法，在适应流上联合报告不变量回归测试与修订延迟，且不做聚合。
AI.result: 标准遗忘指标无法区分已正确修订过时知识的世界模型与发生灾难性遗忘的模型，导致其将冻结模型排为最高；现有物理推理基准仅评估冻结检查点，无法反映分层保留行为。差分保留通过不聚合的双维度报告揭示上述差异。
AI.conclusion: 持续世界模型应以按不变性时间尺度分层的保留替代统一遗忘惩罚，并采用差分保留（不变量回归测试＋修订延迟、不聚合）作为评测标准。

title: GOTT: Object-centric Dexterous Manipulation with a Reusable Cross-Embodiment Primitive
summary: Foundation models and large-scale human data provide rich sources of manipulation intent, but translating this intent into multi-fingered robot behavior remains difficult. Dexterous hands still lack a reusable low-level primitive that reliably establishes contact across tasks and embodiments. We propose GOTT, a reach-acquire-move framework built around a single cross-embodiment contact-acquisition primitive. Given a robot-agnostic object trajectory and a reach specification, GOTT first brings the hand near a task-relevant contact region. The shared closed-loop primitive then establishes stable contact from this approximate initialization, and a pose-conditioned controller tracks the desired object motion. Reach specifications may come from future-aware planning, external models, or human demonstrations, while the primitive and tracking backend remain unchanged. Simulation and real-world experiments show that GOTT is able to establish robust contact across diverse objects, arm-hand platforms, and seen and unseen hand morphologies. It also consistently improves end-to-end task success over open-loop grasp execution.

AI.tldr: 提出GOTT框架，以单一跨具身接触获取原语实现多指灵巧手操作，将机器人无关的物体轨迹与到达规范转化为稳健的接触与运动跟踪。
AI.motivation: 基础模型和大规模人类数据蕴含丰富的操作意图，但缺乏可复用的底层原语来在多任务、多具身条件下可靠建立接触，导致意图难以转化为多指机器人行为。
AI.method: GOTT采用"到达-获取-移动"框架：给定机器人无关的物体轨迹与到达规范，先将手部移近任务相关接触区域；再由共享的闭环接触获取原语从近似初始化建立稳定接触；最后由位姿条件控制器跟踪目标物体运动。到达规范可来自未来感知规划、外部模型或人类示范，而原语与跟踪后端保持不变。
AI.result: 仿真与真实实验表明，GOTT能在多样物体、臂-手平台以及已知和未知手部形态上建立稳健接触，并相较开环抓取执行持续提升端到端任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 单一跨具身接触获取原语可有效解耦高层操作意图与底层执行，为多指灵巧操作提供可复用、跨具身且稳健的底层能力。

title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
summary: We introduce 4DCodeBench, a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, in which agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs. To accomplish this, agents must translate visual observations into compact representations of scene structure and dynamics, by implementing abstractions such as physical simulations to reproduce complex behavior. To evaluate this capability, we curate a set of real-world videos and construct synthetic scenes spanning diverse physical phenomena, including deformation, fluid flow, and fracture. We perform extensive benchmarking of frontier models, finding that strong static reconstruction capabilities do not yet translate into reliable reconstruction of complex dynamics. 4DCodeBench provides a testbed for tracking progress toward agents that can interpret the dynamics of the world through code. Our benchmark is available at https://github.com/4DCodeBench/4DCodeBench

AI.tldr: 提出4DCodeBench基准，通过代码生成进行4D逆图形学，考察智能体从视频重建动态场景为可执行图形程序的能力。
AI.motivation: 评估智能体能否将视觉观测转化为场景结构与动力学的紧凑表示，并通过物理模拟等抽象复现复杂动态行为，填补动态场景重建评测的空白。
AI.method: 构建包含真实世界视频与涵盖形变、流体流动、断裂等物理现象的合成场景数据集，并对前沿模型进行广泛基准测试。
AI.result: 强静态重建能力尚不能转化为对复杂动态的可靠重建。
AI.conclusion: 4DCodeBench为追踪能够通过代码理解世界动态的智能体进展提供了测试平台，已开源。

title: MoSE3: Learning World-Space SE(3) at Every Pixel
summary: Dense 3D point tracking has been a prominent paradigm for modeling motion in dynamic scenes, but a point track is just a 3-DoF translation curve per pixel: it captures where pixels go, not the rotation of the underlying part, nor which pixels move together as one body. We propose MoSE3, the first feed-forward model that predicts dense SE(3) motion from monocular RGB video, producing full 6-DoF rigid transforms at every pixel in world space. Per-pixel SE(3) motion offers a richer view of how a scene moves: rotation, translation, and grouping all at once. Directly predicting SE(3) is challenging: rotations lie on a curved manifold that is ill-suited to Euclidean regression, and annotations for SE(3) are particularly difficult to acquire. To address these challenges, MoSE3 predicts per-pixel SE(3) through two jointly learned intermediates, 3D point tracks and rigidity embeddings, and recovers SE(3) by differentiably fitting transforms within each soft rigid cluster, enabling end-to-end prediction and supervision. To close the data gap, we introduce Art-Kubric, a large-scale synthetic dataset with dense SE(3) and rigidity labels for articulated objects with rich physical interactions. MoSE3 achieves state-of-the-art SE(3) estimation at pixel, part, and object levels on both rigid and articulated benchmarks, and state-of-the-art average 3D point tracking accuracy across three datasets, while showing strong generalization to real-world videos despite being trained solely on synthetic motion data.

AI.tldr: MoSE3是首个从单目RGB视频前馈预测逐像素稠密SE(3)运动（全6-DoF刚体变换）的模型，通过3D点轨迹与刚性嵌入两个中间量实现端到端预测与监督，并附带合成数据集Art-Kubric。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密3D点跟踪仅以每个像素的3自由度平移曲线表示运动，只能捕捉像素去向，无法反映部件旋转及哪些像素作为同一刚体共同运动，即缺少旋转与运动分组信息。
AI.method: 直接回归SE(3)存在旋转位于弯曲流形不适合欧氏回归、以及SE(3)标注获取困难两大挑战。MoSE3联合学习两个中间量——3D点轨迹与刚性嵌入，在软刚性簇内通过可微拟合变换恢复SE(3)，实现端到端预测与监督。同时构建大规模合成数据集Art-Kubric，为关节物体提供稠密SE(3)与刚性标签。
AI.result: MoSE3在刚性与关节基准上，于像素级、部件级和物体级均取得最优SE(3)估计；在三个数据集上取得最优平均3D点跟踪精度；仅用合成运动数据训练，却对真实视频展现强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 逐像素SE(3)运动同时提供旋转、平移与分组信息，比点跟踪更具表达力；借助中间表示与合成数据，MoSE3验证了单目视频稠密6-DoF运动估计的可行性，并具备良好的真实场景泛化性。

title: Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis
summary: This paper examines the role of Novel View Synthesis (NVS) in geometric representation learning. In principle, NVS should reason about 3D scene structure, thereby enabling transferable multi-view geometric representations. Yet, existing encoder-based NVS methods yield poor representations. This is not because of a lack of supervisory signal, but rather due to inconspicuous architectural choices: \textit{spatially expressive decoders} that dilute representational capabilities of the scene encoder, and \textit{low-level pixel-space targets} that hinder feature learning. We present SNAP, a self-supervised encoder-decoder transformer that addresses both through a pose-conditioned local decoder and a latent-space reconstruction objective. SNAP is task agnostic, and we show that it is competitive with special-purpose geometry-supervised methods. SNAP also performs competitively against self-supervised representations across five tasks: visual localization, pose estimation, point correspondence, depth estimation, and robot manipulation. Remarkably, SNAP's patch features exhibit emergent viewpoint invariance that approaches heavily supervised models despite lower compute and data budgets. Under camera shifts where standard 2D representations collapse, SNAP degrades more gracefully, revealing that restricting decoder expressivity actively prevents the suppression of transferable geometric structure. https://snap-nvs.github.io

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SNAP，一种自监督编码器-解码器 Transformer，通过姿态条件局部解码器与隐空间重建目标，缓解现有编码式 NVS 方法表征质量差的问题，并在多项几何与机器人任务上取得竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 理论上 NVS 应能促使模型推理三维场景结构，从而学到可迁移的多视角几何表征；但现有基于编码器的 NVS 方法所产出的表征质量很差。作者指出这并非监督信号不足，而是架构选择上的隐性缺陷：空间表达能力过强的解码器会稀释场景编码器的表征能力，而低层次像素空间目标会妨碍特征学习。
AI.method: 提出 SNAP，一个自监督的编码器-解码器 Transformer。针对上述两个问题分别设计：1）姿态条件（pose-conditioned）的局部解码器，以限制解码器空间表达能力；2）隐空间（latent-space）重建目标，替代低层次像素空间目标。方法为任务无关（task agnostic）设计。
AI.result: SNAP 与专用几何监督方法具有竞争力；在五项任务上——视觉定位、姿态估计、点对应、深度估计、机器人操作——与自监督表征方法相比表现有竞争力。其 patch 特征表现出涌现的视角不变性，在计算量与数据预算更低的情况下接近重监督模型。在相机位移导致标准 2D 表征崩溃的情形下，SNAP 退化更为平缓。
AI.conclusion: 限制解码器的表达能力能够主动防止可迁移几何结构被抑制，说明解码器架构与重建目标层次的选择是 NVS 学到可迁移几何表征的关键；SNAP 以任务无关的自监督方式实现了接近监督模型的几何表征能力。

title: Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery
summary: AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. ADSD follows a diagnosis-first paradigm that first explains why a solver performs poorly, then uses this diagnosis to guide the discovery of appropriate numerical methods. The resulting knowledge is packaged into reusable solver skills, turning solver improvement from trial-and-error editing into a structured process of diagnosis, discovery, and implementation. Across four challenging numerical domains--power flow equation, AC optimal power flow control, stiff ordinary differential equations, and heterogeneous diffusion PDEs--ADSD consistently improves solver accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. On GOC-500 power flow, for example, ADSD reduces mean solver error by nearly $71\times$, with improvements further transferring to unseen grid topologies and operating regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出ADSD框架，将数值求解器的诊断与可复用技能发现相连接，实现从试错编辑到"诊断-发现-实现"的结构化求解器自我改进，在四类数值问题上显著提升精度、鲁棒性与效率。
AI.motivation: AI智能体虽能生成科学代码，但生成代码不等于改进其背后的算法。对数值求解器而言，执行反馈只能暴露性能不佳，却很少揭示其根本原因及改进方法，导致求解器改进停留在低效的试错编辑层面。
AI.method: ADSD采用"诊断优先"范式：先解释求解器为何表现不佳（数值诊断），再据此引导发现合适的数值方法（技能发现），最后将所得知识封装为可复用的solver skills，把求解器改进流程化为诊断、发现、实现三阶段。
AI.result: 在四类挑战性数值领域——潮流方程、交流最优潮流控制、刚性常微分方程、异质扩散偏微分方程——ADSD持续提升求解器精度、鲁棒性与效率。例如在GOC-500潮流问题上，平均求解误差降低近71倍，且改进可迁移到未见过的电网拓扑与运行工况。
AI.conclusion: ADSD通过将数值诊断与可复用技能发现相连接，把求解器自我改进从试错编辑转变为结构化流程，在多个数值领域验证了其有效性并具备良好的泛化迁移能力。

title: Streaming Multi-Track Timeline Control for 3D Human Motion Generation
summary: Text-driven human motion generation has advanced substantially, yet most methods assume instructions are available before synthesis. Interactive applications require responding to new instructions while continuing ongoing actions, such as answering a phone while walking. Existing approaches address streaming generation or simultaneous composition without explicitly combining streaming instruction arrival with independently timed, overlapping actions. We introduce streaming multi-track timeline control and propose TimelineControl to incorporate new instructions alongside ongoing actions. Interval-aware conditioning preserves instruction timing, while causal part-structured representations and part-aware denoising coordinate concurrent actions across body regions. We also construct TimelineMotion, a dataset with overlapping instruction intervals and body-part annotations. Experiments on TimelineMotion and MTT demonstrate improved semantic alignment and temporal adherence over evaluated streaming baselines, including models retrained on the same data. Ablations and human evaluations validate our design, complemented by spatial conditioning and humanoid execution demonstrations. Our code, data and models will become publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出流式多轨时间线控制任务及 TimelineControl 方法，实现"边执行边响应新指令"的重叠动作生成，并构建 TimelineMotion 数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动动作生成大多假设指令在合成前已全部给定；而交互式应用（如边走边接电话）需要在动作持续进行中响应新到的指令。已有工作分别处理流式生成或同步组合，但未将"流式指令到达"与"独立定时的重叠动作"显式结合。
AI.method: 提出 TimelineControl：采用区间感知条件（interval-aware conditioning）保留指令时序；使用因果部件结构化表示（causal part-structured representation）与部件感知去噪（part-aware denoising）协调身体不同区域上的并发动作。同时构建数据集 TimelineMotion，包含重叠指令区间与身体部件标注。
AI.result: 在 TimelineMotion 与 MTT 上，语义对齐与时间遵循性均优于对比的流式基线（包括在同一数据上重训练的模型）；消融实验与人工评估验证了设计有效性，并附带空间条件与类人执行演示。
AI.conclusion: 该方法验证了流式多轨时间线控制在重叠并发动作生成上的有效性，代码、数据与模型将公开。

title: Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities
summary: A deployed LLM agent emits tool calls, queries, and code that can be silently wrong -- by the time the error surfaces, the action has run. Frontier chat APIs hide the model's token probabilities; the agent's stated confidence barely beats chance on the mistakes that matter; and resampling does not help, since frontier models are highly repetitive, reproducing the same call across samples. We recover the missing signal from a low-cost open-weight surrogate run in parallel. It reads the same context, schema, and proposed action as the agent, then scores the call from its own log-probabilities through a family of complementary readouts: teacher forcing and request-PMI weigh the likelihood of each argument value, a discriminative verdict judges the call as a whole, and tool-choice competition tests the function against its siblings. One principle says which to trust: a generative likelihood localizes wrong argument values, while the verdict catches holistically wrong calls. When the error type is unknown, an ensemble is the low-regret default. The readout is training-free, needs no access to the agent's internals, and costs one prefill pass alongside the tool call. On difficult coding tasks it reaches AUROC 0.825 where the actor's stated confidence is near chance (0.598), and the generative readouts beat it by +0.07 to +0.28 across three further actors. Against self-consistency it gains +0.14 to +0.19 on near-deterministic actors, at 1/K the cost. The signal drives two deployment modes: a real-time gate escalating the least-trustworthy calls for review (+0.05 to +0.30 accepted-action accuracy at 50% coverage), and confidence feedback, returning the tool result with the score so the agent adapts its next step -- lifting task success on live-execution benchmarks (+0.119 and +0.137, p <= 1e-4) and beating a random-value control where step errors are silent (+0.078, p = 0.003).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种免训练、低开销的方法，用并行运行的开源轻量代理模型（surrogate）从其自身log-probabilities中提取互补读取信号，为LLM代理的工具调用提供可信度评分，用于实时把关和置信度反馈。
AI.motivation: 已部署的LLM代理会发出静默错误的工具调用、查询和代码，错误往往在动作执行后才暴露。前沿聊天API隐藏token概率，代理自报置信度对关键错误几乎等同随机猜测，且重采样因前沿模型高度重复性而无效。因此需要从外部恢复缺失的错误信号。
AI.method: 使用低成本开源轻量代理模型并行读取相同上下文、模式和候选动作，通过一族互补读取方式打分：teacher forcing与request-PMI评估各参数值的似然，判别式裁决整体判断调用，工具选择竞争测试函数相对同级函数的表现。核心原则是：生成式似然定位错误参数值，裁决捕获整体性错误调用；错误类型未知时用集成作为低遗憾默认。该方法免训练、无需访问代理内部、仅需一次prefill。
AI.result: 在困难编码任务上AUROC达0.825，而actor自报置信度接近随机（0.598）；生成式读取在另外三个actor上领先+0.07至+0.28。相比self-consistency在近确定性actor上增益+0.14至+0.19，成本仅1/K。两种部署模式：实时把关提升可接受动作准确率+0.05至+0.30（50%覆盖率）；置信度反馈在实机执行基准上提升任务成功率（+0.119和+0.137，p≤1e-4），并在静默步骤错误场景中优于随机值对照（+0.078，p=0.003）。
AI.conclusion: 轻量开源代理模型的生成式与判别式读取信号可有效替代缺失的模型不确定性，实现对LLM代理工具调用的可靠错误检测与纠正，支持实时把关和置信度反馈两种落地模式。

title: When Evidence Changes: Evaluating Memory Repair and Re-reading in Language-Model Agents
summary: When documents supporting an agent's derived facts are revoked or replaced, should it repair memory or re-read current evidence? We introduce an evidence-revision evaluation on medication- and problem-list tasks from public ICU records. Under revocation, replacement and control events, we compare full and source-filtered re-reading with caching, rebuilding and graph-local repair across two 7B models. Memory is supplied in full without retrieval, and costs include ingest, revision and every use. On short records, local repair uses 5-10$\times$ fewer revision tokens than rebuilding, yet every memory pipeline costs at least twice full re-reading in held-out conditions. In a small pre-specified development sweep, adding task-ineligible documents extended records to about 10,000 tokens; at that length, memory's mean cumulative cost fell below full re-reading's after 2-14 uses, partly through truncated extraction, while source-filtered re-reading remained cheapest. In the replacement study, none of the four primary confirmatory tests reached statistical significance. These results show why the cost of agent memory after evidence revision must be assessed against source-filtered re-reading over the full pipeline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出\"证据修订\"评测，比较在证据被撤销/替换时，智能体记忆修复与重新阅读证据的成本与效果。结论：记忆修复在修订阶段省token，但全流程成本常高于源过滤重读。
AI.motivation: 当支持智能体推导事实的文档被撤销或替换时，是修复记忆还是重新读取当前证据，缺乏系统性评测。需要量化不同策略在全流程成本下的优劣。
AI.method: 在公开ICU记录的用药与问题列表任务上构建证据修订评测，覆盖撤销、替换与控制事件。对比完整重读、源过滤重读，以及缓存、重建、图局部修复三种记忆管线，使用两个7B模型；记忆全量提供、不做检索，成本计入摄入、修订与每次使用。
AI.result: 短记录下，局部修复的修订token比重建少5-10倍，但所有记忆管线在留出条件下成本至少是完整重读的两倍。在预设开发扫描中，加入任务不合格文档使记录扩展到约1万token，此时记忆的平均累积成本在2-14次使用后低于完整重读，部分源于截断抽取；源过滤重读仍最便宜。替换研究中四项主要验证测试均未达统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 证据修订后智能体记忆的成本评估，必须在完整流程上以源过滤重读为基准，而不能只看修订阶段的局部节省。

title: DABACO: A Multi-Camera Dataset and Benchmark for Screen Localization and Pointing Estimation
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22797835. Code and toolkit: https://domondo.github.io/dabaco-dataset-toolkit/
summary: Screen localization and pointing estimation are key to low-cost interactive devices. Yet developing and evaluating these algorithms requires realistic data: synthetic captures cannot fully reproduce the optical distortion, rolling shutter, motion blur, and display processing of a physical acquisition, and most existing datasets provide static images rather than the video needed to assess continuous pointing. In this paper, we introduce the DABACO Dataset. Developed within the DABACO (Dispositivo Apuntador de BAjo COste, or Low-Cost Pointing Device) project, this dataset supports the development and evaluation of screen detection and camera-based pointing algorithms for embedded systems. It comprises video sequences captured with multiple low-cost camera sensors, including monochrome global-shutter and color rolling-shutter modules, on embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4B and ESP32-S3. We present a systematic annotation pipeline combining temporary visual watermarking, optical-flow tracking, manual verification, and marker removal. Both the original marked captures and the marker-free images, together with explicit corner annotations and modification masks, are released to support auditing and the study of potential reconstruction bias. In addition, we release an open-source evaluation toolkit with two reference baselines: a classical screen-detection pipeline based on edge and contour geometry, and a closed-vocabulary, off-the-shelf YOLOv8 segmentation model evaluated without dataset-specific training. Both are evaluated on a general-purpose computer using Intersection over Union, corner error, and pointing error, establishing initial reference results for future embedded implementations. Overall, DABACO addresses a gap in existing resources and is intended to support the development and evaluation of new low-cost screen-localization and pointing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 DABACO 数据集，用于低成本屏幕定位与指向估计算法的开发与评测，包含多款低成本相机传感器采集的视频序列、系统化标注流程、原始与去标记图像、角点标注、修改掩码以及开源评测工具包和两个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 屏幕定位与指向估计是低成本交互设备的关键技术，但开发与评估此类算法需要真实数据：合成采集无法完全复现物理采集中的光学畸变、卷帘快门、运动模糊和显示处理，且现有数据集多为静态图像，缺少评估连续指向所需的视频。因此，本文旨在填补现有资源空白。
AI.method: 构建 DABACO 数据集：使用多种低成本相机传感器（黑白全局快门与彩色卷帘快门模块）在 Raspberry Pi 4B、ESP32-S3 等嵌入式平台采集视频序列；采用结合临时视觉水印、光流追踪、人工校验和标记移除的系统化标注流程；发布原始标记采集与无标记图像、显式角点标注和修改掩码；并提供开源评测工具包与两个参考基线：基于边缘与轮廓几何的经典屏幕检测流程，以及未经数据集特定训练的闭词表现成 YOLOv8 分割模型。
AI.result: 在通用计算机上使用交并比（IoU）、角点误差和指向误差对两个基线进行评估，建立了面向未来嵌入式实现的初始参考结果。
AI.conclusion: DABACO 填补了现有资源的空白，旨在支持新型低成本屏幕定位与指向系统的开发与评估。

title: General Decision Models: Benchmarking and Insights Beyond Jev
summary: General decision models, such as Jev, have recently emerged as efficient alternatives to LLMs for structured judgment and selection. But what kinds of decisions can these models reliably make, and how does their behavior change when individual decisions are composed into larger systems? To study this, we introduce JEVal, a bilingual benchmark comprising 11,257 instances from 36 datasets across 10 application domains, and evaluate 25 model configurations spanning general decision models and generative LLMs. Our results show that (1) general decision models are most competitive when decisions can be resolved from available evidence, but weaken when they require specialist knowledge or faithful uncertainty estimation: they can often identify the most likely outcome while substantially overstating its probability. (2) In more dynamic and realistic systems involving long-horizon, multi-step interactions, the advantages of fast local decision making are offset by reliability failures at the system level. on $τ$-bench, faster local decisions reduce median episode time but lower task success as decision errors accumulate over long trajectories. (3) In large-scale social simulation, decision models approach strong generative LLMs on individual response prediction at substantially lower inference cost, yet remain weaker in user profiling and exhibit larger aggregate estimation errors and systematic bias. Finally, we propose SII-Decision-4B and SII-Decision-27B, which internalize an open-weight LLM's own reasoning into a single-pass first-token decision through Reasoning-to-Readout Self-Distillation, with SII-Decision-27B performing on par with Jev on JEVal while answering a typical query in about 0.1 s.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双语基准 JEVal（11,257 实例、36 个数据集、10 个应用域），系统评估 25 个通用决策模型与生成式 LLM 配置，揭示通用决策模型的能力边界与系统级失效模式，并提出 SII-Decision-4B/27B 模型。
AI.motivation: 通用决策模型（如 Jev）被视为 LLM 在结构化判断与选择任务上的高效替代方案，但其可靠决策范围、以及个体决策组合为更大系统后行为如何变化尚不清晰，缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 JEVal 双语基准，涵盖 11,257 个实例、36 个数据集、10 个应用域；评测 25 个模型配置（通用决策模型与生成式 LLM）。并在长程多步交互系统（τ-bench）与大规模社会模拟两类场景考察组合效应。同时提出 Reasoning-to-Readout Self-Distillation，将开放权重 LLM 的推理内化为单次前向首 token 决策，得到 SII-Decision-4B 与 SII-Decision-27B。
AI.result: （1）证据充分可解时通用决策模型最具竞争力，但涉及专业知识或不确定性估计时能力下降，常能识别最可能结果却显著高估其概率；（2）在长程多步系统中，快速局部决策可缩短 τ-bench 中位 episode 时长，但决策误差沿轨迹累积导致任务成功率下降；（3）大规模社会模拟中，决策模型以显著更低推理成本接近强生成式 LLM 的个体响应预测，但用户画像建模更弱，聚合估计误差与系统性偏差更大。SII-Decision-27B 在 JEVal 上性能与 Jev 相当，典型查询约 0.1 s。
AI.conclusion: 通用决策模型的优势集中于证据可解的局部快速判断，其不确定性校准与专业领域能力仍是短板，且在组合成动态系统时会因误差累积产生系统级可靠性问题；通过自蒸馏将 LLM 推理压缩为单步决策，可在保持性能的同时大幅降低推理时延。

title: A Step Towards Forgetting: Optimiser History and the Loss of Answer Mass
summary: During fine-tuning, a language model can assign less probability to previously learned answers even when the current gradient acts to preserve that probability. With momentum, each update also carries gradients computed at earlier model states, and these stored contributions can push the model in the opposite direction. We investigate how this optimiser memory contributes to forgetting by separating old-task loss into confusion among its answers and leakage of probability outside the answer set. Across three language-model families, answer mass consistently declines while discrimination among old answers usually improves: the model becomes less likely to produce answers that it can still distinguish correctly. Decomposing Adam updates reveals opposing contributions to this loss of answer mass. Over training, accumulated history favours leakage, while the current gradient opposes it. Resolving history by age shows that the harmful contributions come mainly from older gradients of the new task, whereas recent gradients tend to protect the old answers. Changes in history's effect are dominated by its orientation relative to the old-task gradient. Interventions that reset momentum while matching the initial update norm establish that stored history affects retention, with state-dependent immediate effects and lower final old-task loss over longer Adam continuations, mainly through recovered answer mass. Finally, integration along finite updates shows that most sampled large loss increases are captured by local projections, while curvature along history amplifies some events. Together, these findings reveal how an optimiser's memory can erode learned behaviour even as its current gradient acts to preserve it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究优化器动量记忆如何导致语言模型微调中的遗忘，发现Adam累积历史促进旧任务答案概率泄漏，而当前梯度倾向于保护，且有害贡献主要来自较旧的梯度。
AI.motivation: 在微调中，语言模型可能降低对已学答案的概率，即使当前梯度试图保持该概率。动量使每次更新携带早期模型状态计算出的梯度，这些存储贡献可能将模型推向相反方向。作者旨在探究优化器记忆对遗忘的贡献机制。
AI.method: 将旧任务损失分解为答案间的混淆与答案集外的概率泄漏；在三个语言模型家族上分析答案质量与区分度；分解Adam更新为累积历史与当前梯度两部分，并按梯度年龄解析历史贡献；通过重置动量并匹配初始更新范数进行干预实验；沿有限更新做积分分析，评估局部投影与曲率的作用。
AI.result: 跨三个模型家族，答案质量持续下降而旧答案间区分度通常提升，即模型更不容易产生仍能正确区分的答案。Adam分解显示累积历史倾向于促进泄漏，当前梯度则反对泄漏；有害贡献主要来自新任务的较旧梯度，近期梯度倾向保护旧答案。历史效应变化主要由其相对旧任务梯度的方向决定。重置动量实验表明存储历史影响保留性，即时效应依赖状态，更长Adam延续下最终旧任务损失更低，主要通过恢复答案质量实现。积分分析显示多数采样的较大损失增加可由局部投影捕获，沿历史的曲率放大某些事件。
AI.conclusion: 优化器的记忆（动量累积历史）会侵蚀已学行为，即使当前梯度试图保持它。遗忘的关键来源是较旧梯度对答案质量的泄漏效应，其作用主要由历史相对旧任务梯度的方向决定。

title: Dynamic Time Step Prediction in Inverse Heat Dissipation for Blur-Like Image Restoration Tasks
summary: When using diffusion models to target image restoration problems, diffusion inversion is typically employed to retain relevant image information from the degraded images. Instead of inverting back to the initial time step (i.e., T), many methods invert to a pre-determined intermediate time step, in order to better preserve information from degraded source images. However, a pre-determined time step for inversion is not ideal for reconstruction, as a severely degraded image requires an earlier starting time step than a mildly degraded one. In addition, DDIM-based models corrupt the original signal by adding Gaussian noise, which can be mismatched to the nature of blur-like degradations, such as blur, haze, and low-light. To address these problems, we propose two solutions: (1) we adopt an alternative diffusion process, called the Inverse Heat Dissipation Model, that diffuses the input image by gradually blurring a data point (2) we propose to implement a time predictor to estimate the starting time step for the inversion, with the model learning to adapt to the degradation severity. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations, with excellent generalization to many restoration tasks.

AI.tldr: 针对扩散模型图像复原中反演时间步固定和DDIM加噪与模糊类退化不匹配的问题，提出逆热耗散模型与时间预测器，实现自适应反演的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 在扩散模型用于图像复原时，常通过扩散反演保留退化图像信息。但现有方法反演到预先设定的中间时间步，不够理想：严重退化图像需要更早的起始时间步，而轻微退化则需要较晚的起始步。此外，DDIM类模型通过添加高斯噪声破坏原始信号，这与模糊、雾霾、低光等"模糊型"退化的本质不匹配。
AI.method: 提出两项解决方案：（1）采用一种替代的扩散过程——逆热耗散模型（Inverse Heat Dissipation Model），通过逐步模糊数据点来进行扩散，而非添加高斯噪声；（2）引入时间预测器，估计反演的起始时间步，使模型能够自适应退化严重程度。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在定量与定性评估中均达到最先进（SOTA）性能，并对多种复原任务具有优异的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过逆热耗散扩散过程替代高斯加噪、并结合时间预测器自适应选择反演起始时间步，可有效解决固定时间步与退化性质不匹配的问题，在多种图像复原任务上取得领先效果。

title: BAIBAICHUCHU at the NTCIR-19 FinArg-3 Task: When Is Maximum Possible Profit Predictable from Investor Text?
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Both authors contributed equally. Selected for oral presentation at NTCIR-19 (FinArg-3 Social Media Subtask)
summary: The BAIBAICHUCHU team participated in the Social Media Subtask of NTCIR-19 FinArg-3, ranking Chinese investor posts by Maximum Possible Profit (MPP). A three-track ensemble of lexical features, a FinArg-2-pre-finetuned MacBERT ranker, and an LLM judge reaches 0.734 in post-grouped development evaluation, but our best official run scores 0.517. All twelve submitted runs lie between 0.4598 and 0.5402, and our 26 unanimous three-track pairs score 0.500. A post-hoc audit finds that the submitted judge applied a long-only rule to bearish posts although MPP is stance-aware. Correcting it changes 28 of 87 official predictions without changing accuracy, yet lowers development accuracy from 0.680 to 0.622: a regime-specific semantic shortcut improved validation fit. We decompose ranking into directional text, volatility and horizon, and pairwise margin. A running-extremum model predicts $σ\sqrt{T}$ scaling, observed ex post in 502 price-aligned posts from a separate July 2026 collection. Pre-posting volatility scaled by the post-specific observation horizon, $σ_{\mathrm{pre},20}\sqrt{N_i}$, is associated with a later truncated-horizon MPP proxy (Spearman $ρ=0.320$; ticker-cluster 95% CI [0.133,0.466]) and correctly orders 61.4% of unequal-outcome pairs. Transferred text is nearly uncorrelated with the July outcome ($ρ=0.055$) and adds little conditional on this score and stance. Development reliability rises from about 0.60 to 0.93 as the labeled MPP gap widens. An earlier ERAI result of 0.6207 rules out universal unpredictability as a simple explanation. Evaluation should jointly consider text, market regime, historical volatility, horizon, and pair composition.

AI.tldr: 该文报告BAIBAICHUCHU团队在NTCIR-19 FinArg-3社交媒体子任务中的表现与复盘：三路集成在开发集达0.734，但官方提交仅0.517，所有12个提交run落在0.4598–0.5402。事后审计发现LLM评委对看跌帖错误施加了long-only规则；修正后预测变化但准确率不变，开发集准确率反降。作者将排序分解为方向性文本、波动率与持有期、成对margin，并提出用盘前波动率按观测期缩放（σ_pre,20√N_i）的代理指标。
AI.motivation: 该研究动机在于：按最大可能收益（MPP）对投资者帖子排序时，文本信息、市场状态与持有期相互作用，导致开发集表现与官方评测表现严重不一致（0.734 vs 0.517）。作者希望厘清这种泛化落差来源，并检验"方向性文本+波动率/持有期缩放"能否作为可迁移的排序信号。
AI.method: 方法上，构建三路集成：词法特征、FinArg-2预微调的MacBERT排序器、LLM评委；共提交12个run。事后审计LLM评委的long-only规则偏差。将排序任务分解为方向性文本、波动率与持有期、成对margin三部分。提出running-extremum模型预测σ√T缩放关系，并在2026年7月独立收集的502条价格对齐帖子上检验；用帖特定观测期缩放的盘前波动率σ_pre,20√N_i关联截断持有期MPP代理（Spearman ρ=0.320，ticker聚类95% CI [0.133,0.466]）。
AI.result: 结果：开发集后分组评测0.734，最佳官方run为0.517，12个提交run区间0.4598–0.5402，26个三路一致对为0.500。修正long-only规则改变87条官方预测中的28条但准确率不变，开发集准确率由0.680降至0.622，说明存在regime-specific语义捷径。σ_pre,20√N_i与截断持有期MPP代理相关（ρ=0.320），正确排序61.4%的不等结果对；迁移文本与7月结果近乎不相关（ρ=0.055）。开发集可靠性随标注MPP差距拉大从约0.60升至0.93。早前ERAI结果0.6207排除了"普遍不可预测"的简单解释。
AI.conclusion: 结论：评测应联合考虑文本、市场状态、历史波动率、持有期与成对组成；单靠方向性文本的跨期迁移能力有限，波动率-持有期缩放是更稳定的排序信号，而开发集的语义捷径会高估验证表现。

title: FADE: Frame-Aware Diffusion-Transformer-based Multi-Concept Erasure for Video Unlearning
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can reproduce copyrighted, violent, or explicit content, which motivates concept erasure: removing designated concepts from a pretrained model while preserving its behavior on everything else. Existing T2V erasure methods leave two problems open. Their frame-agnostic suppression can leave isolated frames in which an erased concept resurfaces, a frame-reactivation gap that clip-level averages obscure; and they are usually evaluated with one target concept or category at a time. We propose Frame-Aware Diffusion Erasure (FADE), a multi-concept video unlearning framework. FADE first applies a joint closed-form key/value edit that suppresses all target concepts, then trains per-concept frame-aware low-rank adapters whose strength is gated by the frame index and the denoising timestep to remove residual per-frame leakage. Each adapter is trained with the other targets' prompts as hard negatives, which keeps the concept-specific components of different adapters well separated, and a similarity-based soft router combines the adapters according to the prompt. With 16 concepts (objects, artistic styles, and nudity) erased from a single Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, FADE reduces the residual accuracy on the object benchmark to 4.9%, against 15.5% for the strongest of eight baselines, while keeping the VBench average within 0.9% of the unedited model. The ranking is unchanged under a VLM judge and a blinded human study, and the advantage over the strongest baseline carries over to prompts that combine several erased concepts, to 30 simultaneously erased celebrity identities, and to Wan2.1-T2V-14B, CogVideoX-2B, and HunyuanVideo-1.5.

AI.tldr: FADE是一种多概念视频扩散模型擦除框架，通过联合闭式KV编辑与帧感知LoRA适配器，在擦除16个概念的同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: T2V扩散模型可能生成受版权保护、暴力或露骨内容，需要概念擦除。现有方法存在两个问题：一是帧无关的抑制会留下被擦除概念复现的孤立帧（帧重激活间隙），被片段级平均指标掩盖；二是通常只针对单一概念或类别进行评估。
AI.method: FADE先应用联合闭式key/value编辑抑制所有目标概念，然后训练逐概念的帧感知低秩适配器，其强度由帧索引和去噪时间步门控以消除残余的逐帧泄漏。每个适配器以其他目标提示作为硬负样本训练以保持概念特异性组件分离，并用基于相似度的软路由器根据提示组合适配器。
AI.result: 在单个Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B骨架上擦除16个概念（物体、艺术风格、裸露）时，FADE将物体基准上的残余准确率降至4.9%，而八个基线中最强的为15.5%，同时VBench平均值与未编辑模型相差在0.9%以内。在VLM评判和盲测人类研究中排名不变，且对组合多个擦除概念的提示、30个同时擦除的名人身份，以及Wan2.1-T2V-14B、CogVideoX-2B和HunyuanVideo-1.5模型上优势依然保持。
AI.conclusion: FADE有效解决了T2V概念擦除中的帧重激活间隙和多概念评估不足问题，在多概念擦除、生成质量保持和跨模型泛化方面均优于现有基线。

title: Masked Privileged-Information Distillation for Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification Under Missing Clinical Metadata
summary: Multimodal skin lesion classification combines clinical images with patient metadata to improve diagnostic accuracy. However, complete metadata available during training may be only partially accessible at deployment, and resource-constrained settings additionally require computational efficiency. We address these challenges with a privileged-information distillation framework in which a multimodal teacher trained on complete metadata supervises a 9.2x smaller student trained with randomly masked clinical fields. Clinical fields are masked as whole groups at a per-sample rate drawn from U(0,1), so one training run covers the full metadata availability range. Fusion is residual, with metadata added as a gated correction to an unconditional image base. On the PAD-UFES-20 dataset, distillation under masked training improves balanced accuracy over cross-entropy training at every availability level, by an average of +4.7 points versus +1.8 points without masking. The masked student loses only 7.8 balanced-accuracy points as metadata decreases from complete to absent, compared with 36.6 points for the same student trained on complete metadata, highlighting the role of masked training in graceful degradation beyond distillation alone. Grad-CAM visualizations further show that the masked student's attention generally remains lesion-centered as metadata is withdrawn. The resulting compact model targets point-of-care settings, where clinical metadata is often incomplete.

AI.tldr: 提出特权信息蒸馏框架：用完整元数据训练的多模态教师模型，指导一个体积小9.2倍、训练时随机掩码临床字段的学生模型，在PAD-UFES-20上实现全元数据可用度范围内的稳健皮肤病变分类。
AI.motivation: 多模态皮肤病变分类虽能结合临床图像与患者元数据提升诊断准确率，但训练时完整的元数据在部署阶段往往只能部分获取，且资源受限场景还需计算高效。因此需要一种在元数据不完整、且模型紧凑的条件下仍能保持性能的方法。
AI.method: 采用特权信息蒸馏框架：教师模型基于完整元数据训练，学生模型小9.2倍并接受随机掩码的临床字段。掩码以整组字段为单位、按样本级U(0,1)速率进行，使一次训练即覆盖元数据可用度的完整区间。融合方式为残差式，元数据以门控修正形式叠加到无条件图像基线上。
AI.result: 在PAD-UFES-20数据集上，掩码训练下的蒸馏在每个元数据可用度水平上都优于交叉熵训练，平均提升+4.7个百分点，而无掩码时仅+1.8个百分点。当元数据由完整降至缺失时，掩码学生仅损失7.8个平衡准确率点，而同一学生用完整元数据训练时损失达36.6点。Grad-CAM显示随元数据撤除，掩码学生的注意力总体仍集中于病变区域。
AI.conclusion: 掩码训练在蒸馏之外还带来平滑退化能力，使紧凑学生模型在元数据可用度波动下保持稳健性能，适用于临床元数据常不完整的即时诊疗（point-of-care）场景。

title: Behavioral History Outperforms Descriptions of the Person for LLM Synthetic Personas
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic personas representing survey respondents. Their validity as substitutes for particular respondents depends on whether they reproduce individuals' decisions. We examine what information helps synthetic respondents predict each individual's later choices, using five conditions that add progressively richer information: no personal information, demographics, personality traits, cognitive scores, and finally the respondent's earlier survey choices as behavioral history. We use a two-wave panel of 845 US adults who completed measures of 14 behavioral biases (spanning risk, time preferences, overconfidence, and reasoning), so each respondent's earlier answers provide a human test-retest benchmark; in the behavioral-history condition, all items that score the target bias are withheld. At the population level, the average number of biases per respondent in every condition is close to the human average (7.1-8.1 biases, against 7.1 for humans). This aggregate similarity masks differences in variance: persona descriptions recover only 53-67% of human between-person variation, whereas adding behavioral history restores it to approximately the human level. At the individual level, description-based personas achieve only 7-12% of the informedness observed in human test-retest responses, while adding behavioral history raises this to 28%. The condition including behavioral history has the highest estimated informedness in all 17 demographic groups, whereas description-based conditions provide little or no information for some groups. Synthetic responses also exhibit stronger education- and income-related differences than human responses. For LLM synthetic personas, a respondent's past answers add more to individual-level prediction than a description of who they are.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察了不同信息条件下LLM合成受访者预测个体后续选择的能力：仅靠人口统计学、人格特质与认知得分等描述信息只能恢复部分人际差异，而加入受访者过往问卷作答作为行为历史后，个体层面的预测有效性显著提升。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作代表调查受访者的合成人格，但其作为特定个体替代者的有效性取决于能否复现个体的真实决策。作者希望弄清哪些信息能帮助合成受访者预测每个个体的后续选择。
AI.method: 使用845名美国成年人的两波面板数据，测量14种行为偏差（涵盖风险、时间偏好、过度自信与推理）。构建五种逐级增加信息量的条件：无个人信息、人口统计学、人格特质、认知得分、以及受访者此前的调查作答（行为历史）。在行为历史条件下，所有用于评分目标偏差的题目均被隐藏。以人类重测信度作为基准进行比较。
AI.result: 在群体层面，各条件下人均偏差数量接近人类平均（7.1–8.1 vs 7.1），但这一总体相似掩盖了方差差异：描述性人格仅恢复53–67%的人际变异，加入行为历史后恢复至接近人类水平。个体层面，基于描述的人格仅达到人类重测所观测 informedness 的7–12%，加入行为历史后提升至28%。包含行为历史的条件在全部17个人口统计学分组中估计 informedness 最高，而基于描述的条件对部分群体几乎不提供信息。合成回答还表现出比人类更强的教育与收入相关差异。
AI.conclusion: 对LLM合成人格而言，受访者过去的答案比对其身份的描述更能提升个体层面的预测能力。

title: Do Language Models Need a Trainable Input Embedding Table? Fixed Minimal Token Codes at 1.7B-Class Scale
summary: A trainable input embedding table assigns each vocabulary item an independently adjustable vector. We investigate whether this token-specific parameterization is required for substantial language-modeling capability, or whether a shared Transformer can learn from fixed token identities. We compare three decoder-only language models trained from scratch with the same tokenizer, contextual backbone, untied output-head architecture, and training recipe, with a target budget of 100 billion prediction tokens per model. Their input interfaces are a learned table, canonical 16-bit token-ID codes, and one fixed invertible recoding over GF(2). The fixed codes are repeated to model width without an additional trainable input projection. Both fixed-code models acquire substantial capabilities: canonical codes achieve 52.40\% HellaSwag normalized accuracy, 70.51\% PIQA accuracy, and 42.75\% LAMBADA accuracy. The learned-input control performs better on several evaluations, including HellaSwag and LAMBADA, so these results establish viability rather than performance parity. The fixed interfaces remove 100.7 million trainable parameters, yielding 1.711B-parameter models, but parameter reduction is not the central result. These single-run experiments distinguish architectural necessity from empirical utility: independently trainable token-specific input vectors are not required for the observed capabilities. A fixed identity interface also provides a controlled setting for studying representation learning downstream of an immutable input, without establishing where particular capabilities are localized.

AI.tldr: 该研究验证了可训练的token嵌入表是否为语言建模能力的必要条件。实验表明，固定token身份接口（16位ID码及GF(2)可逆重编码）训练的模型仍能获得实质性能力，但性能未达到学习型嵌入的水平。
AI.motivation: 主流语言模型为每个词表项分配独立可训练的嵌入向量，作者质疑这种token特定参数化是否为获得实质语言建模能力的必要条件，或共享Transformer能否仅从固定token身份中学习。
AI.method: 对比三个从头训练的decoder-only语言模型，共享同一分词器、上下文骨干、非绑定输出头结构和训练配方，每个模型预算约1000亿预测token。三种输入接口分别为：可学习嵌入表、规范的16位token-ID编码、以及GF(2)上的一个固定可逆重编码。固定编码直接重复至模型宽度，不添加额外可训练输入投影。
AI.result: 两种固定编码模型均获得实质性能力：规范编码在HellaSwag归一化准确率52.40%、PIQA准确率70.51%、LAMBADA准确率42.75%。可学习输入对照组在HellaSwag和LAMBADA等多项评测上表现更优。固定接口移除了1.007亿可训练参数，模型规模为17.11亿参数，但参数削减并非核心结论。
AI.conclusion: 独立可训练的token特定输入向量并非观察到的语言建模能力所必需，这些单次运行实验区分了架构必要性与经验有效性。固定身份接口为研究不可变输入下游的表示学习提供了受控环境，但未确定特定能力在何处产生。

title: Selective Backpropagation for Efficient Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) requires models to continuously learn new classes from limited samples while retaining prior knowledge, under strict constraints on compute and memory. Existing approaches lie along a difficult trade-off: simple fine-tuning is computationally efficient but suffers from catastrophic forgetting, replay-based methods mitigate forgetting at the cost of substantial compute and memory, and exemplar-free methods often reduce forgetting by freezing most of the backbone, improving efficiency at the expense of adaptability. We propose Selective Backpropagation (SBP), a deterministic parameter budgeting framework that bridges this gap. SBP restricts gradient updates to a pre-allocated subset of network parameters, freezing past knowledge and preserving unbiased capacity for future learning, enabling rapid adaptation without costly mask optimization. We show that SBP achieves strong performance across standard FSCIL benchmarks while requiring training time close to that of naive fine-tuning and substantially lower training time than prior SOTA methods. Crucially, our experiments expose a limitation of standard FSCIL evaluation: performance on short, distribution-consistent benchmarks does not necessarily predict behavior under distribution shift or over substantially longer learning horizons. We therefore evaluate FSCIL methods in cross-domain settings and over an 80-session ImageNet-1K stream. SBP remains strong across these regimes while maintaining low training cost, providing a favorable stability-plasticity-efficiency trade-off. Our code is available at https://github.com/PaInt-Lab/sbp-main-public.

AI.tldr: 本文提出选择性反向传播（SBP），一种确定性的参数预算框架，通过将梯度更新限制在预分配的参数子集上，在小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中同时兼顾稳定性、可塑性与训练效率。
AI.motivation: 现有FSCIL方法存在难以调和的权衡：简单微调计算高效但易发生灾难性遗忘；基于回放的方法缓解遗忘却带来高昂的计算与内存开销；无样本方法往往通过冻结大部分主干来减少遗忘，虽提升效率却牺牲了可塑性。作者希望找到一种能弥合该间隙的方法，并指出标准FSCIL评估的局限——短程、同分布基准上的表现未必能预测分布偏移或更长学习周期下的行为。
AI.method: SBP将梯度更新限制在预先分配的、确定的网络参数子集上，冻结其余参数以保留历史知识，同时为未来学习保留无偏容量，从而实现快速适应而无需昂贵的掩码优化。
AI.result: 在标准FSCIL基准上，SBP取得强劲性能，训练时间接近朴素微调，并显著低于先前SOTA方法。在跨域设置与80个会话的ImageNet-1K长流上，SBP仍保持较强表现且训练成本低。
AI.conclusion: SBP在稳定性、可塑性与效率之间提供了良好的权衡，同时揭示了标准短程同分布评估的不足，强调需在分布偏移和长学习周期下评估FSCIL方法。代码已开源。

title: Verifier-Guided Synthetic Augmentation for 3D Human Shape Generation
summary: Limited training data diversity constrains generative modeling of 3D human bodies: conservative models remain close to observed examples, whereas exploratory models often violate basic body proportions. We introduce a verifier-guided augmentation framework that uses global and mode-local PCA to generate inexpensive candidates, screens them using correspondence-derived skeletal proportions and body-part geometry, and retrains a diffusion model on accepted candidates. Elastic registration provides both the modal structure used by distributed PCA and the dense anatomical correspondence needed for scalable screening without per-candidate body-model fitting. A blinded human study supports the verifier as a conservative gatekeeper, favoring verifier-accepted over rejected outputs. We evaluate full-pool verifier acceptance separately from the coverage and departure of accepted samples and combine them through EAUC. On 4,498 registered DFAUST surfaces, distributed-PCA augmentation achieves 86.32% acceptance, the highest CP-AUC (0.871), and the highest EAUC (0.752), improving EAUC by 32% over real-only and self-augmented diffusion. These results show that mode-local, verifier-guided proposals broaden diffusion generation while maintaining high agreement with calibrated body measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出验证器引导的分布式PCA数据增强框架，用骨骼比例与身体部位几何筛选候选样本，再训练扩散模型，在DFAUST上实现86.32%接受率与EAUC提升32%。
AI.motivation: 3D人体生成建模受限于训练数据多样性不足：保守模型贴近已见样本，探索性模型易违反基本身体比例。需在扩展生成多样性与维持解剖合理性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 采用全局与局部（mode-local）PCA生成低成本候选；利用弹性配准提供的模态结构和密集解剖对应关系，通过对应关系推导的骨骼比例与身体部位几何进行可扩展筛选（无需逐候选拟合身体模型）；用被接受的候选重训练扩散模型。评估上分离全体候选的验证器接受率与被接受样本的覆盖率/偏离度，并用EAUC综合。
AI.result: 盲法人类研究支持验证器作为保守把关者，偏好被接受而非被拒绝的输出。在4,498个配准DFAUST表面上，分布式PCA增强取得86.32%接受率、最高CP-AUC(0.871)和最高EAUC(0.752)，较仅真实数据与自增强扩散基线EAUC提升32%。
AI.conclusion: 模式局部、验证器引导的候选生成能拓宽扩散生成范围，同时保持与校准身体测量的高度一致性，为数据稀缺下的人体生成提供有效增强方案。

title: VolS-GS: Relightable Gaussian Splatting with Volumetric Subsurface Scattering
summary: We present VolS-GS, a relightable Gaussian splatting framework that reconstructs objects from one-light-at-a-time (OLAT) captures and renders them under novel lighting and viewpoints. Relightable Gaussian Splatting methods typically model appearance independently at each primitive, which makes non-local effects difficult to represent. This limitation is particularly apparent for subsurface scattering, where light entering the object at one location can emerge at another. Rather than modeling this effect solely with a neural network or a local kernel at each primitive, we use the spatial support of the Gaussian scene as the domain of a differentiable finite-volume transport solver, so that light can propagate through the object's interior. A small network predicts scattering and absorption coefficients for each Gaussian, and the solve redistributes incident light through the resulting field. The coefficients are fit to images rather than measured, so the solve supplies a transport-shaped path for aggregating per-primitive appearance, not a measurement of the material. To keep the learned shadow and specular terms from taking over the other components, our shadow term is predicted from visibility together with the transmittances and the scattering the solve produces, and a regularizer suppresses specular highlights in regions the shadow term predicts to be unlit. Experiments on three OLAT benchmarks show that VolS-GS consistently improves relighting quality on held-out lights and views.

AI.tldr: VolS-GS 将高斯泼溅空间作为可微有限体积光传输求解域，让光在物体内部传播以建模次表面散射，从而在 OLAT 数据上实现更好的重光照与视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有可重光照 Gaussian Splatting 方法通常在每个图元上独立建模外观，难以表达非局部效应，尤其是光从一处进入、从另一处射出的次表面散射。仅靠神经网络或局部核无法有效刻画这种空间传播。
AI.method: 提出 VolS-GS 框架：以高斯场景的空间支撑作为可微有限体积传输求解器的域，使光可在物体内部传播；小型网络为每个高斯预测散射与吸收系数，求解器据此将入射光重新分布。系数由图像拟合而非实测，求解提供的是聚合各图元外观的传输式路径，而非材质测量。阴影项由可见性、透射率及求解产生的散射共同预测，并加入正则项抑制阴影预测为无光照区域的镜面高光。实验在三个 OLAT 基准上进行。
AI.result: 在三个 OLAT 基准数据集上，VolS-GS 在未见过的光照与视角下均持续提升重光照质量。
AI.conclusion: 将高斯泼溅与可微有限体积光传输结合，可有效建模次表面散射等非局部效应，显著改善重光照与视角合成的表现。

title: SUAVE: Unified Video-Action Models via Masked Diffusion
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit strong semantic grounding from pretrained vision-language backbones but are typically optimized for predicting actions rather than future observations. They can see and act, but they do not imagine the future before acting. World action models (WAMs) built on video diffusion backbones can imagine but treat language as frozen conditioning on a continuous latent space. Unified models bring these modalities into one architecture, but they either decode autoregressively, one token at a time, or keep video continuous with an auxiliary action head. In this work, we present SUAVE, a Single vocabulary Unified Action-Video modEl in which a masked diffusion transformer generates video and actions conditioned on language, with all three modalities represented as discrete tokens in a shared sequence. Choosing which tokens to mask at inference turns the same network into a world model, a robot policy, or a video-action model. For action-free co-training, the action positions of unlabeled video are filled with mask tokens and excluded from the loss. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate two findings. First, a single SUAVE model predicts long-horizon video and acts as a policy, competitive with dedicated world models and specialized action policies on static and dynamic manipulation tasks. On a real robot, our model generates subgoal images and an action chunk spanning one second of motion in 1,030 ms on an RTX 5090 GPU, sustaining closed-loop control at 2.5 actions per second. Second, pretraining on robot video and co-training on human video substantially improves policy performance and zero-shot robustness to distribution shift. Together, these results show that masked diffusion is a practical and versatile foundation for unified video-action modeling.

AI.tldr: SUAVE 提出统一动作-视频模型，用单一离散词表与掩码扩散Transformer同时生成视频与动作，可在推理时切换为世界模型、策略或视频-动作模型。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型仅预测动作而无法预见未来观测，WAM以视频扩散为核心但语言仅作冻结条件，统一模型或采用逐token自回归解码或保持视频连续另接动作头，缺乏共享离散序列下的统一建模。
AI.method: 将视频、动作、语言三者表示为共享序列中的离散token，由掩码扩散Transformer在语言条件下联合生成；通过选择推理时被掩码的token位置，使同一网络充当世界模型、机器人策略或视频-动作模型；无动作视频的动作位置填掩码token并排除出损失，实现无动作共训练。
AI.result: 单一SUAVE模型可预测长时程视频并作为策略，在静态与动态操作任务上媲美专用世界模型与专门动作策略；真机上在RTX 5090 GPU上1030ms内生成子目标图像与1秒动作块，维持2.5次/秒闭环控制；机器人视频预训练与人类视频共训练显著提升策略性能及对分布偏移的零样本鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 掩码扩散是统一视频-动作建模的实用且通用的基础范式。

title: PhysMamba: Selective State Space Models as Learned Articulated Body Simulators
comment: CVPR 2026 Workshop on Physically Grounded Human Perception and Modeling -- 1st PhysHuman
